Gen: Ekuqaleni uNkulunkulu wadala izulu nomhlaba.
Umhlaba wawungenasimo futhi ungenalutho. Ubumnyama babumboze amanzi ajulile, futhi uMoya kaNkulunkulu wawunyakaza phezu kwamanzi.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Makube khona ukukhanya." Kwase kuba khona ukukhanya.
UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi ukukhanya kuhle. Wehlukanisa ukukhanya nobumnyama.
UNkulunkulu wabiza ukukhanya ngokuthi "imini", nobumnyama wabubiza ngokuthi "ubusuku". Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lokuqala.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Makube khona isikhala esibanzi phakathi kwamanzi, sehlukanise amanzi abe yizingxenye ezimbili."
Ngakho uNkulunkulu wenza isikhala esibanzi. Wehlukanisa amanzi angaphansi kwaso namanzi angaphezu kwaso. Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wabiza isikhala esibanzi ngokuthi "isibhakabhaka". Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesibili.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Amanzi angaphansi kwesibhakabhaka mawabuthane endaweni eyodwa, ukuze kubonakale umhlabathi owomile." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wabiza umhlabathi owomile ngokuthi "izwe", namanzi ayebuthene wawabiza ngokuthi "izilwandle". UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Izwe malimilise izitshalo: izitshalo eziluhlaza ezenza imbewu, nemithi ethela izithelo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, ngamunye ngohlobo lwawo." Kwaba njengoba esho.
Izwe lamilisa izitshalo ezenza imbewu, ngasinye ngohlobo lwaso, nemithi ethela izithelo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, ngamunye ngohlobo lwawo. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesithathu.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Makube khona izinto ezikhanyayo esibhakabhakeni zehlukanise imini nobusuku. Mazibe yizimpawu eziphawula izinkathi zonyaka, izinsuku neminyaka.
Mazikhanye esibhakabhakeni zinike umhlaba ukukhanya." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wenza izinto ezimbili ezinkulu ezikhanyayo: esikhulu ukuba sibuse imini, nesincane ukuba sibuse ubusuku. Wenza nezinkanyezi.
UNkulunkulu wazibeka esibhakabhakeni ukuze zinike umhlaba ukukhanya,
zibuse imini nobusuku, futhi zehlukanise ukukhanya nobumnyama. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesine.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Amanzi magcwale izidalwa eziphilayo, nezinyoni mazindize phezu komhlaba esibhakabhakeni esivulekile."
Ngakho uNkulunkulu wadala izilwane ezinkulu zasolwandle nazo zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezinyakazayo emanzini. Wadala nazo zonke izinhlobo zezinyoni. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
UNkulunkulu wazibusisa wathi: "Zalanini nande. Gcwalisani amanzi ezilwandle, nezinyoni mazande emhlabeni."
Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesihlanu.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Izwe malikhiphe izidalwa eziphilayo, ngasinye ngohlobo lwaso: imfuyo, izilwanyana ezincane ezihamba phansi, nezilwane zasendle." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wenza izilwane zasendle, imfuyo nazo zonke izilwanyana ezincane ezihamba phansi, ngasinye ngohlobo lwaso. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Masenze abantu ngomfanekiso wethu, bafane nathi. Mababuse izinhlanzi zasolwandle, izinyoni zezulu, imfuyo, umhlaba wonke, nazo zonke izilwanyana ezincane ezihamba phansi."
Ngakho uNkulunkulu wadala abantu ngomfanekiso wakhe. Wabadala ngomfanekiso kaNkulunkulu. Wabadala owesilisa nowesifazane.

UNkulunkulu wababusisa wathi kubo: "Zalanini nande. Gcwalisani umhlaba, niwunakekele futhi niwuphathe. Busani izinhlanzi zasolwandle, izinyoni zezulu nazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo ezinyakazayo emhlabeni."
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Bhekani! Nginiphe zonke izitshalo emhlabeni wonke ezenza imbewu, nayo yonke imithi ethela izithelo ezinembewu. Kuzoba ukudla kwenu.
Futhi kuzo zonke izilwane zomhlaba, zonke izinyoni zezulu nazo zonke izidalwa ezihamba phansi, konke okunomoya wokuphila, nginika zonke izitshalo eziluhlaza zibe ukudla." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wabheka konke ayekwenzile, futhi kwakukuhle kakhulu. Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesithupha.
Ngakho izulu nomhlaba kwaqedwa, kanye nakho konke okukukho.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa uNkulunkulu wayesewuqedile umsebenzi ayewenza. Ngakho ngosuku lwesikhombisa waphumula kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe.
UNkulunkulu wabusisa usuku lwesikhombisa walwenza lwaba ngcwele, ngoba ngalolo suku waphumula kuwo wonke umsebenzi wokudala ayewenzile.
Le yindaba yezulu nomhlaba lapho kudalwa, ngesikhathi iNkosi uNkulunkulu yenza umhlaba nezulu.
Kwakungakabikho sihlahla emhlabeni, futhi kwakungakamili sitshalo emasimini. INkosi uNkulunkulu yayingakayinisi imvula emhlabeni, futhi kwakungekho muntu wokulima umhlabathi.
Kodwa inkungu yenyuka emhlabeni yamanzisa yonke indawo yomhlabathi.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yabumba indoda ngothuli lomhlabathi. Yaphefumulela umoya wokuphila emakhaleni endoda, indoda yaba yisidalwa esiphilayo.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yatshala insimu empumalanga, e-Edeni. Yabeka khona indoda eyayiyibumbile.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yamilisa emhlabathini zonke izinhlobo zemithi. Yayimihle ukuyibuka futhi ilungele ukudliwa. Phakathi nensimu kwakumi umuthi wokuphila nomuthi wokwazi okuhle nokubi.
Umfula wawugeleza uphuma e-Edeni ukuze unisele insimu. Ukusuka lapho wahlukana waba yimifula emine.
Umfula wokuqala ubizwa ngokuthi yiPishoni. Ugeleza uzungeza lonke izwe laseHavila, lapho kukhona igolide.
Igolide lalelo zwe limsulwa. Kutholakala khona nenhlaka enephunga elimnandi netshe eliyigugu elibizwa ngokuthi i-onikisi.
Umfula wesibili ubizwa ngokuthi yiGihoni. Ugeleza uzungeza lonke izwe laseKushi.
Umfula wesithathu ubizwa ngokuthi yiTigrisi. Ugeleza ngasempumalanga ye-Asiriya. Umfula wesine yi-Ewufrathe.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yathatha indoda yayibeka ensimini yase-Edeni ukuba ilime umhlabathi futhi iwunakekele.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yanika indoda lo myalo: "Ukhululekile ukudla kunoma yimuphi umuthi osensimini,
kodwa akumele udle emthini wokwazi okuhle nokubi. Ngosuku ozodla kuwo, uzofa nakanjani."
INkosi uNkulunkulu yathi: "Akukuhle ukuba indoda ibe yodwa. Ngizoyenzela umsizi oyifanele ngempela."

INkosi uNkulunkulu yabumba ngomhlabathi zonke izilwane zasendle nazo zonke izinyoni zezulu. Yaziletha endodeni ukuze ibone ukuthi izoziqamba ngamaphi amagama. Noma yiliphi igama indoda eyaliqamba isidalwa ngasinye esiphilayo, laba yigama laso.
Ngakho indoda yaqamba amagama azo zonke izifuyo, izinyoni zezulu nazo zonke izilwane zasendle. Kodwa u-Adamu wayengenaye umsizi omfanele ngempela.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yenza indoda yalala ubuthongo obukhulu. Isalele, uNkulunkulu wathatha olunye lwezimbambo zayo, wavala indawo leyo ngenyama.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yenza owesifazane ngembambo eyayiyikhiphe endodeni, yamletha endodeni.
Indoda yathi: "Ekugcineni! Nangu umuntu oyithambo lamathambo ami nenyama yenyama yami. Uzobizwa ngokuthi 'owesifazane', ngoba wathathwa endodeni."
Yingakho indoda ishiya uyise nonina ihlanganiswe nomkayo, futhi bobabili baba munye.
Indoda nomkayo babenqunu bobabili, kodwa babengenamahloni.
Inyoka yayinobuqili ukwedlula zonke izilwane zasendle iNkosi uNkulunkulu eyayizenzile. Yathi kowesifazane: "Ingabe uNkulunkulu wathi ngempela, 'Ningadli kunoma yimuphi umuthi osensimini'?"
Owesifazane wayiphendula inyoka wathi: "Singadla izithelo zemithi esensimini.
Kodwa ngomuthi ophakathi nensimu, uNkulunkulu wathi: 'Ningadli izithelo zawo. Ningawuthinti nokuwuthinta, funa nife.'"
Inyoka yathi kowesifazane: "Ngeke nife!
UNkulunkulu uyazi ukuthi uma nidla kuwo, amehlo enu azovuleka. Nizofana noNkulunkulu, nazi okuhle nokubi."

Owesifazane wabona ukuthi isithelo somuthi silungele ukudliwa futhi sihle ukusibuka, nokuthi siyafiseka ngoba singenza umuntu ahlakaniphe. Ngakho wathatha esinye isithelo wasidla. Wanika nendoda yakhe eyayinaye, nayo yadla.
Amehlo abo bobabili avuleka, babona ukuthi banqunu. Ngakho bathunga amaqabunga omkhiwane benza izembatho zabo.
Ngesikhathi esipholile semini, bezwa umsindo weNkosi uNkulunkulu ihamba ensimini. Indoda nomkayo bacasha eNkosini uNkulunkulu phakathi kwemithi yensimu.
Kodwa iNkosi uNkulunkulu yabiza indoda yathi: "Uphi?"
Yaphendula yathi: "Ngikuzwile ensimini, ngesaba ngoba nginqunu. Ngakho ngacasha."
UNkulunkulu wabuza: "Ubani okutshele ukuthi unqunu? Ingabe udlile emthini engakuyala ukuba ungadli kuwo?"
Indoda yathi: "Owesifazane owamnika ukuba abe nami unginike isithelo somuthi, ngase ngiyadla."
INkosi uNkulunkulu yathi kowesifazane: "Yini le oyenzile?" Owesifazane wathi: "Inyoka ingikhohlisile, ngase ngiyadla."

INkosi uNkulunkulu yathi kunyoka: "Ngenxa yokuthi wenze lokhu, uqalekisiwe ukwedlula zonke izifuyo nazo zonke izilwane zasendle. Uzohamba ngesisu sakho, futhi uzodla uthuli zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakho.
Ngizokwenza wena nowesifazane nibe yizitha, nenzalo yakho nenzalo yakhe kube yizitha futhi. Yena uzochoboza ikhanda lakho, wena uzoluma isithende sakhe."
Kowesifazane yathi: "Ngizokwandisa kakhulu ubuhlungu bakho lapho ukhulelwe. Uzobeletha ngobuhlungu. Uzolangazelela indoda yakho, futhi yona izokubusa."

Ku-Adamu yathi: "Ulalele umkakho wadla isithelo somuthi engakuyala ukuba ungadli kuwo. Ngakho umhlabathi uqalekisiwe ngenxa yakho. Zonke izinsuku zokuphila kwakho kuzodingeka usebenze kanzima ukuze uthole ukudla kuwo.
Uzokumilisela ameva nokhula, futhi uzodla izitshalo zasendle.
Uzojuluka ukuze uthole isinkwa sakho uze ubuyele emhlabathini, ngoba wathathwa kuwo. Uluthuli, futhi uzobuyela othulini."
U-Adamu waqamba umkakhe ngokuthi u-Eva, ngoba wayezoba ngunina wabo bonke abaphilayo.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yenzela u-Adamu nomkakhe izingubo ngezikhumba zezilwane, yabagqokisa.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yathi: "Bhekani, umuntu usefana nomunye wethu, ngokwazi okuhle nokubi. Akumele avunyelwe ukwelula isandla sakhe, athathe nesithelo somuthi wokuphila, asidle aphile phakade."
Ngakho iNkosi uNkulunkulu yamxosha ensimini yase-Edeni ukuba alime umhlabathi ayethathwe kuwo.

Isimxoshile umuntu, yabeka amakherubi, izidalwa zezulu ezinamandla, ngasempumalanga yensimu yase-Edeni. Yabeka nenkemba evuthayo eyayibenyezela iya le nale, ukuze iqaphe indlela eya emthini wokuphila.

Wadlula uYosefu usuku lwakhe lokugxeka, wakhuluma epastheni likaFaro, wathi, Uma ngithole inhlonipho enhliziyweni yenu, ngicela nikhulume ngami kuFaro:
Ubaba wami ungisibekele isibopho, esithi:‍‍, Ngizofa; ngizibulale esiqandisini ngaseKanana. Manje ke, ngiyakucela, ngi preponde, ngizidalele ubaba wami, bese ngibuya.'
Wathi uFaro: Yiya uxhumane nobaba wakho, njengokuba wathi kuwe.

Nabo bonke abantu besango likaYosefu, nabangane bakhe, nalabo abasemndenini wakwababa wakhe; bashiye kuphela izingane zabo, ne giganti zabo, nezimvu zabo, ezweni laseGoshen.

yilapho uYosefu ehlala khona ekuseni, futhi lapho afika khona esikoleni, uJosefu wahalalisela ubaba wakhe, wathi: "Kulungile, ngikujabulela ukukubona.

Babona amaKanana ahlala khona ubuhlungu e-Athadi, bathi: "Isikhathi esinzima kakhulu abaMijipi," ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngaseYorodani ngokuthi i-Abeli-Mizraim, okusho ukuthi, "ubuhlungu bamaMijipi."
Bakwenza ke uYakobi nabantwana bakhe, njengokuba wabawiselayo.

Bathi, "Uzohlala ezweni laseKanana," washo uAbrahamu. Bemthwala emazweni aseKhanani, bamwikisa emgodini wendawo yaseMakpela, obhekene neMambreli; uAbrahami wayeyithengele leyo ndawo kanye nomhlaba ka-Efron umHeti, ibe yindawo yokuzibulala.
UYosefu, emva kokufa kobaba wakhe, wabuyela eYiputa, yena nobazalwane bakhe, nabo bonke abaye baphuma naye ukufa ubaba wakhe.
Bathe babona abazalwane ukuthi ubaba wabo sewufile, bathi: "Ngabe uYusufu akafuni ukusikhohlisa?"
Bathuthela kuYusufu, bethi kuye, Ubaba wakho wabeka umthetho phambi kokuba aphele, esithi,

Uthi, "Uzothi kuYosefu, 'Njengoba, ngikucela ukhulule abazalwane bakho ngenxa yephutha labo, kanye nesono sabo, njengoba bekwenzela wena ngokubi; ngakho manje, ngikucela ukhulule isono labakhonzi bakaThixo kababa wakho.' "
Bafike abazalwane bakhe, babhujiswa phambi kwakhe, bathi: "Njengoba siyimikhonzi yakho,"
UYosefu wathi kubo, Musani ukukhathazeka. Ingabe ngimi endaweni kaThixo?

Ngakho-ke, ungakhathazeki; ngizokulethela wena kanye nezingane zakho. "Uthe ke wabasabisa, futhiranjela ngenhliziyo yabo.

Wathi uYosefu kubazalwane bakhe, Ngizofa; kodwa uNkulunkulu uzokubonani ngokuqinisekile, futhi uzozikhuphula nisuka kule lizwe liya ezweni ebelibhekwa nguAbrahama noIsake noYakobi.
UYusufu wathatha isibopho esiqinile, wathi kubo: "Uma uNkulunkulu efika ukukusizani, khona-ke kufanele nizikhuphule izicubu zami ponad pleva.

Exod: Lawona amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, abafika eYiputa noYakobi, wonke umuntu nomndeni wakhe:
uRubhene, noSimeoni, noLevi, noYuda;
uIssakha, noZebuloni, noBhenjamini,
uDani noNaphtali, uGadi noAsheri.
Wonke umndeni kaYakobi, owaphuma emilenzeni yakhe, waba ngumuntu oyisixhenxe. UYosefu wayesele eYiputa.
Wafa uYosefu, nabazalwane bakhe bonke, nabo bonke abantu baleso sikhathi.
Bakhulela ke amadodana aseSirayeli, bakhula bekhula, babe namandla amakhulu kakhulu; izwe lagcwele ngawo.
Kwaphuma ukumkani omusha phezu kweYiputa, ongakaze ayazi uYosefu.
Wathi kubo abantu bakhe, Thola, abantu bakaSirayeli baningi kunathi, futhi banamandla kunathi.
Hamba, sibhekene nabo ngokuzimela, noma bangakhula kakhulu; uma kwenzeka umkhosi, bangakwazi ukujoyina abasolwa bethu, bazinqobe nathi, bashiye izwe.
Bathi ama-Egyptians abeke phezu kwabo abaphathi, ukuba basebenzele ngemisebenzi enzima; futhi bakwakha iPithom, neRaamses, imiphakathi yokugcina izinto, uFaro.
Kodwa uma bebacindezela kakhulu, bakhulela kakhulu, bakhulule kakhulu; futhi abaMishi bakhathazekile ngenxa yamadodana aseSirayeli.
I-Egyptians yacindezela abantu baseSirayeli ukuba basebenze ngaphandle kothando.
Bakwenza impilo yabo ibe buhlungu ngomsebenzi onzima, ngokwenza ingilazi, nokwenza amatshe, nokwenza yonke imisebenzi yasendaweni; emisebenzini yabo yonke, abaMishi abengabazi.
Wathi ukumkani waseMisri ezibhedlela zesiHebhere, izibhedlela zokubelethisa; igama lomunye lalinguShifra, negama lomunye linguPua.
Wathi, "Uma nisiza iziHebhere ukuthi zikhulelwe, futhi nibona ezibhedlela ukuthi zikhulelwe, uma kuzalwa umntwana owesifazane, bulala yena; kodwa uma kuzalwa indodakazi, ahlale ephila.
Kodwa labo ababelethisi bagwema uNkulunkulu, bangakwenzanga njengokuthi ukumkani waseYiputa kubo; bagcine izingane zamadoda ziphila.
Wathi ukumkani waseMisri, wabiza labo ababelethisi, wathi kubo, Kungani na ukuthi nikwenze lokhu? Kungani na ukuthi nigcine izingane zamadoda ziphila?
Wathi uFaro, ngoba amakhosikazi aseHebhere awafana namadodakazi aseMisri; ngenxa yokuthi anamandla kakhulu; ngaphambi kokuba afike khona owesifazane, bakhulela.
UNkulunkulu wakwenza kahle labo abakhulelwa; abantu bakhula, babe namandla kakhulu.
Nokho, ngenxa yokuthi labo ababelethisi bakhathazekile ngoNkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu wabanika izingane.
Wathi uFarawo kubo bonke abantu bakhe, uthi: Wonke umfana ozalwa eSirayeli niwuthule emfuleni iNil, kodwa onke amantombazane ahlale eduze.
Kwaba khona umuntu wesizwe sakwaLevi, washada nomkakhe owesifazane wasesizwe sakwaLevi.
Wayekhulelwa, wazala indodana. Yabona ukuthi ubukeka kahle, yafihla ingane iminyaka emithathu, yazibuza ukuthi: "Ubani lo mntwana?

Lapho engakaze ikwazi ukumfihla ngaphezu kwalokho, yathola inkomishi eyenziwe ngezinkuni futhi yayigqoka nge-tar ukuze amanzi angeke afike ngaphakathi. Yabeka ingane kuyo futhi yamisa phakathi kwezihlahla eziphakeme ngaphesheya komfula
Udadewabo wahlala eduze ukuze abone ukuthi kuzokwenzekani kuye.
Kwathi uma inkosikazi kaFaro ikhuphuka elwandle ukuze ihlanzwe, futhi izisebenzi zayo zihamba ngaphesheya komfula, yabona ibhokisi phakathi kwezinkomo, yathumela umkhonzi wayo ukuthi ayithole.
Yavula, yabona ingane. Wayenyamalala, wazama ukumsindisa, wathi: "Lena enye yezingane zesiHebhere."
Wathi indodakazi kaFaro, Ingabe ngizoya ngifuna umfazi waseHebroni, ukuze akulelise lo mntwana?
Wathi indodakazi kaFaro, Yeka, uye; wahamba udadewabo, wamthatha umngane wakhe.
Wathi kuye indodana kaFaro, Thola lo mntwana, uyidlele; futhi ngizokulethela imali yakho. Wathatha uwesifazane lo mntwana, wayidlalela.
Wakhula lo mntwana, wathathwa yinkosikazi kaFaro, waba ngunyana wayo; yabiza igama lakhe ngokuthi uMoses; ngoba, kusho yena, ngawukhipha emanzini.
UMoses, lapho eneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala, waphuma waya ezweni lakwaHebhere. Wabona umsebenzi wabo onzima; wabona umuntu waseMisri eshaya umuntu waseHebhere, owayengumuntu wakhe.
UMoses wabheka ngapha nangapha, ebona ukuthi akukho okubonayo, wabulala umYiputa, wamfihla emhlabathini.
Kwathi ngesikhathi esilandelayo, lapho ephuma khona, wabona abantu ababili baseHebhere bedlalana. Wathi kulowo owenza iphutha lakhe, Kungani na ushaya umngane wakho waseHebhere?

Wathi yena kuye, Ubani owakwenza wena ube nguMengameli noMthethosivivinywa kuthina? Ingabe ufuna ukungibulala, njengokuthi wabulala umYiputa? UMoses wakhathazeka, wathi, Bazokwazi abantu lokho engikwenze.
UFaro wathola lokhu, wafuna ukumbulala uMoses; kodwa uMosis wehla phambi kukaFaro, waya ezweni laseMidiyani, wahlala khona enhliziyweni yempuphu.
Umbingeleli waseMidiyani wayenezingane ezisixhenxe. Zafika ziphuze amanzi, zagcwalisa amabhodwe okudlidliza izinkomo zikababa wabo.
Bafika ababheki, baphoqa ukuba bahambe; uMoses wavuka, wabasiza, waza wageza inkomo yabo.
Kwathi ziye kuyise uRehuweli, wathi kubo, Kungani na ukuthi nifike namuhla ekuseni kakhulu?
Bathi kubo, Umuntu waseMisri usindise izandla zethu emgodini wamabhishobhi; wageza futhi amanzi ethu, wamisa izimvu.
Wathi kubo izingane zakhe, Uphi yena? Kungani na nimushiya khona? Nimwisele ukuthi afike aphuze nathi.
UMoses wavuma ukuba ahlale nalowo muntu; yena ke wamnika intombi yakhe, uSepora, abe ngumfazi wakhe.
Wazala unyana, wathi uMoses igama lakhe nguGershon; ngoba wathi, Ngiye ngangihlala ezweni elisha.
Ngosuku olude, ukumkani waseYiputa wafa; futhi abantu bakaSirayeli baphuca ngenxa yobugebengu babo, baphoqa umlilo. Umlilo wabo ngenxa yobugebengu babo wawufinyelela kukaNkulunkulu.
Wasikia uNkulunkulu ukudubula kwabo, wakhumbula isivumelwano sakhe noAbrahamu, noIsake noYakobi.
UNkulunkulu wabheka abantu baseSirayeli, waqonda ukuthi bahamba kanjani.
UMoses ke wayebhema izinkomo zikaJethro, ubaba wakhe wesifazane, umpristi waseMidiyani; waqhuba inkomo enyakatho-ntshonalanga yesiqhingi, waya eHorebhi, entaba kaThixo.
Wabonakala kuye umbingeleli kaYehova, emlilweni womlilo osuka phakathi kweqhwa; wabheka, wabona ukuthi iqhwa ligcwele umlilo, kodwa alingena mlilo.
Wathi uMoses, Ngizohamba ngibheka le mboni enkulu, ukuthi kungani lo mnqumo ungenamlilo.
Wabona iNkosi ukuthi uMoses ufike ukubheka, wamwisela uNkulunkulu phakathi kweqhwa, wathi, UMosese, uMosese. Wathi uMosese, Ngikhona.
Wathi, Musa ukufinyelela lapha; khulula izinyawo zakho; ngoba indawo lapho uhlala khona yindawo engcwele.
Wathi, Ngiye uNkulunkulu kababa wakho, uNkulunkulu ka-Abrahamu, noNkulunkulu ka-Isakha, noThixo kaYakobi. UMoses wafihla ikhanda lakhe; ngoba wayekhathazekile ukubheka uNkulunkulu.
Wathi iNkosi, Ngabona ngokucacile ukuhlupheka kwabantu bam abaseYiputa; ngikuvile ukungcola kwabo ngenxa yabaphathi babo, ngoba ngizi izidumbu zabo.

Ngiye ngaphuma ngiwasindise emazweni aseMisiya, futhi ngiwakhuphule ezweni labo, ngiwaveze ezweni elilungile, elibanzi, elinokufulathela ubisi nengulube, endaweni yamaKanana, namaHeti, nama-Amoreti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
Ngiyabona ukuthi inkohlakalo yabantu bakaSirayeli ifike kimi, futhi ngibonile ubuhlungu abaMishithi bebawenza kubo.
Ngiyakuthumela kuFaro, ukuze ukhiphe abantu bam, oonyana bakaSirayeli, emazweni aseYiputa.
Wathi uMoses kuThixo, Ngibani na, ukuthi ngiye kuFaro, futhi ngisuse abantu bakaSirayeli emazweni aseYiputa?
Wathi, Ngizobe ngikhona nawe; futhi lokhu kuzoba uphawu lwakho ukuthi ngiyakuthumela: lapho ukhiphe khona abantu eYiputa, nizokhonza uNkulunkulu kulo mfula.
Wathi uMoses kuThixo, Khangela, uma ngiya kubo amadodana aseSirayeli, ngithi kubo, UNkulunkulu wabababa benu ungithumelele kuni; futhi bengibuza ukuthi, Liyini igama lakhe? Ngizobatshelani yini?
Wathi uNkulunkulu kuMoses, Ngiye nginguye lowo ngiye ngaye. Lokho wukuthi uzothi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Unginjalo-ke, ngimi, ungisithumeleleni.

Wathi uNkulunkulu kuMoses, Uzokhuluma ngale ndlela kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, uthi: UYehova, uNkulunkulu kababa benu, uNkulunkulu ka-Abrahamu, uNkulunkulu ka-Isake, noThixo ka-Yakobi, ungithumelele kuni; leli yigama lami kuze kube sekupheleni; leli yigama labo elizongikhumbula ngalo kuze kube sekupheleni.

Chofoza lapha, uyeke ukuqoqa izikhulu zakwaSirayeli, uthi kubo: UYehova, uNkulunkulu wababa bakho, uNkulunkulu ka-Abrahama, no-Isake, no-Yakobi, ubonakala kimi, wathi, Ngikuboneni, futhi ngikubona konke okube sekwenzekile kuwe eYiputa.
Ngikutshele ukuthi ngizokulethela ezweni laseMisri, ezweni lamaKanana, namaHethi, namaAmoreti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebhusi, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nengulube.

futhi izikhulu zakwaSirayeli kuzokulalela; futhi wena, kanye nezikhulu zakho, kufanele ufike ukumkani waseYiputa, nithi kuye: UYehova, uNkulunkulu wamaHebhere, wahlangana nathi; ngakho-ke, sicela, usivumele sihambe indlela yezinsuku ezintathu esiqhingini, ukuze sinikeze insindiso kukaNkulunkulu wethu.
Ngiyazi ukuthi ukumkani waseMisri ngeke akuvumeleni ukuba nihambe, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesandla esinamandla.
Ngizomisa isandla sami, ngibize iMisri ngazo zonke izinto ezimangazayo engizenzayo phakathi kwazo; futhi ngemuva kwalokho uzokushiya uhambe.
Ngizobeka abantu bami ebusweni bama-Egipta; futhi uma niphuma, ngeke nihambe ngezandla ezingasebenzi.
Umama ngamunye uzocela umngane wakhe, nowesifazane ohlala ekhaya lakhe, izinto zesiliva, negolide, nezigqoko; nizigqoke izingane zenu namadodakazi akho; futhi nizothatha isibopho sabantu baseYiputa.
Waphendula uMoses, wathi, Kungenzeka ukuthi bangangikholwanga, futhi bangangisizi izwi lami. Ingabe bazothi, UNkulunkulu akakubonakalisile?
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Yintoni leyo esandla sakho? Wathi uMoses, Intambo.
Wathi iNkosi, Yithule phansi. UMoses wayithulela phansi, yashintsha ibe yinyosi; uMosis wabaleka phambi kwayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Nciphisa isandla sakho, uyiqambe ngomlenze wayo. UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe, wayiqamba; yabuya ibe yintambo esandlani sakhe.
Wathi iNkosi, Yenza lokhu; ukuze bakholwa ukuthi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wababa babo, ubonakala kuwe, uNkulunkulu ka-Abrahama, uNkulunkulu ka-Isake, noNkulunkulu kaYakobi.
Wathi iNkosi, Thola isandla sakho emgodini wakho. UMoses wabeka isandla sakhe emgodini wakhe; futhi lapho ekhipha khona izandla zakhe, yabona ukuthi imilenze yakhe ibimhlophe njengethebhulethi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Thola futhi isandla sakho esiqhingini sakho. UMoses wehlise isandla sakhe esiqhingini sakhe; wakhipha, yabuya ibe ngcono kunawo wonke umzimba wakhe.
Wathi iNkosi, Uma bekungakukholwa wena, noma bekungakuqapheli uphawu lokuqala, bazokukholelwa uphawu lwesibili.
Uma bengazikholwa lezi zimpawu ezimbili, futhi bangakulalela, khona-ke uthathe amanzi emfuleni iNil, uwaphuze phezu kweqhwa; futhi amanzi owathatha emfuleni azoshintsha abe yigazi phezu kweqhwa.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Ngicela, Nkosi yami; ngoba angizange ngibe nolimi oluhle, namanje nalapho ukhuluma ngami njengomkhonzi wakho; ngoba nginomsindo, futhi ulimi lwami lunzima.

Wathi iNkosi kuye, Nguwubani owenza abantu babe nemilomo? Ngabe nguwubani owenza ukuthi bangakhuluma, noma ukuthi bangalalela? Ngabe nguwubani owenza ukuthi babone, noma ukuthi bagweme? Angeke ngibe ngimi yini, Nkosi?
Ngizokusiza ukuthi ukhulume, futhi ngizokufundisa ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze.
Wathi uMoses, Ngicela, Nkosi, thumela omunye.
UNkulunkulu wagwema uMoses, wathi, "Ubekho yini uAron, umngane wakho, uLevi? Ngiyazi ukuthi ukhuluma kahle; bheka, ufika ukukujabulela, futhi uzojabula uma ekubona.
Uzokhuluma naye bese utshela ukuthi yini ongayisho. Ngizokusiza nikhulume, futhi ngizokufundisa ukuthi yini okufanele niyenze.
Uzokhuluma nabantu endaweni yakho; uzobe efana nomlomo wakho, nawe uzobe ufana noThixo kuye.
Uzothatha le nkomishi esandla sakho, ukuze uyenze ngale imiqondiso.
UMoses wabuyela kuYethro, udadewabo, wathi kuye, Ngizobuya ngiye ezweni lami, eYiputa, ukuze ngibone ukuthi ngabe kukhona ophilayo phakathi kwabo. Wathi Yethro kuMoses, Yiya, ube nokuthula.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses eMidiyani, Yiya ubuyela eYiputa; ngoba bonke abantu abafuna ukukwenza ufile bafa.
Wabeka uMoses indodana yakhe nowesifazane wakhe phezu kwebhodlela, wabuyela ezweni laseYiputa; wathatha isandla sakhe isibhamu sikaThixo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Uma usuya ezweni laseYiputa, bheka ukuthi ukwenze phambi kukaFaro zonke izimanga eniyimise esandleni sakho; kodwa ngizomisa inhliziyo yakhe, aze avumele abantu bahambe.
Uzothi kuFaro, Usho lokhu iNkosi: Isirayeli ngunyana wami, umzali wam wokuqala.
Ngithe kuwe, Landela unyana wami, ukuze angikhonze; kodwa awuzange uwulandele; ngakho-ke ngizowubulala unyana wakho omdala.
Endlela, lapho behlala khona ekuseni, iNkosi wabhekana noMoses, wafuna ukumbulala.
Wathi uSepora, ethatha itshe elinobukhali, wamisa isisu somntwana wakhe, wehlisa izinyawo zakhe ngaso, wathi, "Uyindodana yegazi kimi!"
Wathi iNkosi kuye: "Uwowesifazane wegazi," ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe.
Wathi iNkosi ku-Aron, Yiya esiqhingini ukuhlangabezana noMoses. Wahamba ke uAron, wahlangana noMoses emfuleni kaThixo, wamxola.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron zonke izindaba zokuthi iNkosi wamthumela, nazo zonke izibonakaliso akazange azivumele.
Wahamba ke uMoses no-Aron, bahlanganisa bonke abakhulu bomndeni kaSirayeli.
Wathi u-Aron kubo konke okuthi iNkosi abewisela kuye uMoses, wakwenza izibonakaliso phambi kwamehlo abantu.
Abantu bakholwa. Bathe beva ukuthi iNkosi wafika ukusindisa oonyana bakaSirayeli, futhi wabona ukuhlupheka kwabo, baphakamisa ikhanda labo, bakhonza.
Kusukela lapho, uMoses no-Aron bafika kuFaro, bathi kuye, Uthi lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli: Landisa abantu bam, ukuze bagcine isikhumbuzo kimi ezweni elimnyama.
Wathi uFarawo, Ubani iNkosi, ukuthi ngiwuthobele, ngivumele amaSirayeli ahambe? Angiyazi iNkosi, futhi ngeke ngivumela amaSirayeli ahambe.

Bathi ke, UNkulunkulu wamaHebhere uhlangana nathi; sizohamba, sicela, uhambo lwezinsuku ezintathu esiqhingini, ukuze sisindise iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu; uma kungenjalo, angasibulala ngobhubhu noma ngeqhwa.
Wathi ukumkani waseMisri, UMosesi no-Aron, kungani nisusa abantu emisebenzini yabo? Yendeni nisebenzele umsebenzi wenu.
Wathi uFiraun: "Njengoba abantu bakho baningi ezweni, yini oyenzayo ukuthi nizivumele ukuba zingasebenzi?
Wathi uFaro, ngalolusuku olulodwa, wamisa abaphathi bezisebenzi, nabaqondisi bomphakathi.
Wathi, Musani ukunikeza abantu inkomo ukuze benze amatshe, njengokuba bekwenza ngaphambilini; bangaya baqoqe inkomo yabo.
Kodwa ukwenze ukuthi bakhiqize amatshe alinganayo nenani elingaphambilini; ungawanciphisi inani labo, ngoba bangasekho. Ngenxa yalokho bekhala, bethi, Siye sinikeze insindiso kuThixo wethu.
Yenza umsebenzi kube nzima kakhulu kubo, ukuze bahlale besebenza futhi babeke amehlo abo ekukhohliseni.
Baphuma ke abaphathi bezindlu, nabaqondisi babo, bakhuluma abantu, bethi, Lokho kusho uFaro, Ngizoyeka ukuninika isihlabathi.
Chofoza lapha ukuze uthole imbewu yakho, lapho ungathola khona; kodwa umsebenzi wakho ngeke ugwenywe ngalutho.
Basuka abantu ezweni lonke laseYiputa, baqoqe imbewu, ukuze bayisebenzise njengenkomo.
futhi abanikazi babo baqhubeka ukucindezela kubo, esithi, "Ukuphela umsebenzi wakho ngosuku ngalunye, njengoba wakwenza lapho imbewu!
Bathi abaphathi bakaSirayeli, abaholi bakaFaro, babulala labo abaphathi babo, besithi kubo: Kungani na ukuthi ningasebenzisi nsuku zonke inani lethu lamagquma, njengoba nisebenza ngaphambili?
Baye ke abaphathi bakaSirayeli, befika kuFaro, besithi, Kungani na ukwenze lokhu kubakhonzi bakho?
Asikho isitsha esithunyelwa nathi, futhi sithe kuthiwe, Ukwenza amatshe; futhi abakhonzi bakho bahlaselwa, kodwa abantu bakho banecala.
Wathi uFaro, Niyinyamakazi, niyinyamakazi; ngakho nithi, Thina sizohamba sinikela ngomnikelo kuYehova.
Manje buyela emsebenzini! Awuzothola noma yiluphi udoti, kodwa kufanele wenze inani eliphelele lamatshe."
Babona abaphathi bakwaSirayeli ukuthi sebesengozini, ngoba kwathiwa kubo: Akufanele ninciphise inani lamatshe owenzayo ngosuku ngalunye.
Uma bephuma kuFiraun, bathola uMoses no-Aharon belinde ukuhlangabezana nabo.
Bathi kubo, UNkulunkulu abhekane nalokho nikwenzayo, futhi akuhlonipheni; ngoba ninze uFaro nomakhelwane bakhe bafuna ukusikhohlisa, nibeka ikhebula esandla sabo ukuba basibulala.
Wabuyela uMoses kuYehova, wathi, Nkosi yami, yini na ekwenzeni izimo ezibi kubo bonke labo abantu? Kungani na ungisithumela?
Kusuka lapho ngiye kuFaro, ngakhuluma ngegama lakho, wakwenza kabi abantu labo; wena ke awuzange usindise abantu bakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Manje uzobona ukuthi ngizokwenzani noFarao; ngenxa yesandla sami esinamandla, uzowashiya bahambe; futhi ngenxa yesandla sami esinamandla, uzowasusa ezweni lakhe.
Wathi uNkulunkulu kuMoses, Ngiye iNkosi.
Ngiye ngabonakala ku-Abrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, ngokuba nguThixo Onamandla onke; kodwa ngegama lami, iNkosi, angikaze ngiphawulwe kubo.
Ngakwenza futhi umhlangano wami nabo, ukuthi ngibanike izwe likaKanana, lapho behlala khona njengezivakashi.
Nami ngikuvile ubuhlungu bomndeni wakwaSirayeli, abaYiputa bewaphatha njengabakhonzi; futhi ngakhumbula isivumelwano sami.

Uzothi kubo: Ngiye iNkosi, futhi ngizokususa ngaphansi kwemisebenzi enzima yama-Egipta, futhi ngizokukhulula ekusebenzeleni kwabo; futhi ngizokusindisa ngesandla sami esinamandla, nangenqubekelaphambili enkulu.
Ngizokuthathela ukuthi ube ngumuntu wami, futhi ngizoba uNkulunkulu wenu; niyazi ukuthi ngimi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, owenza ukuba niphume ngezansi kwemisebenzi enzima yama-Egypt.
Ngizokulethela izwe engithembise ngalo uAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi; ngizokulinika wena libe yikhaya lakho. Ngiye iNkosi.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli; kodwa abawutholile umsindo wakhe, ngenxa yokuthi inhliziyo yabo yaba buhlungu, futhi umsebenzi wabo wawunzima.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Chofoza lapha, bese ukhuluma kuFaro, ukumkani waseMisri, ukuthi avumele abantu bakaSirayeli baphume ezweni lakhe.
Wathi uMosis kuYehova, Abantu bakaSirayeli bangangilalelanga; kungani khona-ke ukuthi uFaro angamilalela, uma ngikhuluma ngamazwi anzima?
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noAron, mayelana nabantu bakaSirayeli naphezu kukaFaro ukumkani waseYiputa, wathi kubo, Nizikhuphule izingane zikaSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa.
Lawa amakhosikazi emindeni yabo. Oonyana bakaRubhen, umzali kaSirayeli: uHanoki, noPalu, noHezron, noKarmi; lalawa amabandla kaRubhen.
Oonyana bakaSimeoni: uJemuyeli, noYamini, noOhadi, noYakhini, noZohari, noShawuli, owesifazane waseKanana; lezi zimindeni kaSimeoni.
Lawa amagama oonyana bakaLawi, ngokusho kohlelo lokuzalwa kwabo: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari. Izinsuku zokuphila kukaLawi zaba yiminyaka engumakhulu amathathu anamashumi ayisithupha.
Oonyana bakaGershoni, ngokwemindeni yabo: uLibni noShimeyi.
Oonyana bakaKohati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli. Waphila uKohati iminyaka engumakhulu amathathu anamashumi amathathu anesihlanu.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi; lezi ziyimindeni yamaLevi, ngokusho kohlelo lokuzalwa kwabo.
U-Amram washada noJokhebedi, indodakazi yodadewabo; yena wazala uAron noMoses. Waphila u-Amram iminyaka engumakhulu amathathu anamashumi ayisithupha.
Oonyana baka-Ishar: uKora, noNefegi, noZikhri.
Oonyana bakaUziyeli: uMishayeli, noElzaphane, noSithri.
U-Aron washada noElisheba, intombi ka-Aminadabhi, inkosikazi ka-Nahshon; yena wazala uNadab, no-Abihu, no-Eleazare, no-Ithamari.
Oonyana bakaKora: u-Asiri, no-Elkana, no-Abiyasaphe; lezi zimindeni yama-Korahi.
U-Eleazare, unyana ka-Aron, washada nenye yezingane zika-Puthiyeli, wazalelwa nguPhinehasi; labo babe ngabaphathi bezindlu zakwaLevi ngokwezindlu zabo.
Lokho ngu-Aron noMoses, ababethi kubo iNkosi, Nciphisa izingane zakwaSirayeli zisuka eYiputa, ngohlobo lwazo ngalunye, njengeqhwa.
Baye labo abakhuluma noFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, ukuthi bakhuphule abantwana bakaSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa; lo Mosesi noAron.
Kwathi lapho iNkosi ekhuluma noMosesi eYiputa,
Wathi kuye, Ngimi iNkosi; khuluma kuFaro ukumkani waseYiputa konke engikushoyo kuwe.
Wathi uMosis kuYehova, Nginezwi elibi kakhulu; kungani uFaro engangilalela?
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Bona, ngikwenza ube nguThixo kuFaro; no-Aron umngane wakho uzobe ngumprofeti wakho.
Uzokhuluma konke okungiwiselayo; uAron umngane wakho uzokhuluma kuFaro, ukuthi avumele abantu bakaSirayeli ukuba baphume ezweni lakhe.
Ngizomisa inhliziyo kaFaro, futhi ngizahlule izibonakaliso zami nezimanga ezweni laseYiputa.
UFaro ngeke akuxhumaneni, kodwa ngizobeka isandla sami ezweni laseYiputa, futhi ngizokhipha abantu bami, izingane zakwaSirayeli, zisuka ezweni laseYiputa, ngomthetho omkhulu.
Bazokwazi ama-Egyptians ukuthi ngiyiNkosi, uma ngiphakamisa isandla sami e-Egypt, futhi ngikhuphe izingane zakwaSirayeli phakathi kwabo.
Wakwenza ke uMoses noAron, njengokuthi iNkosi wabawisela umthetho.
UMoses ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, no-Aron abeminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye namashumi mathathu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Uma uFiraun ekhuluma nani, ethi: 'Ningibonise uphawu', khona-ke utshele uHaruni: 'Thiba inkomishi yakho, uyithule phambi kukaFiraun, izobe yinkomo.
Waphuma uMoses noAron, wafika kuFaro, bakwenza njengokuthi iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; uArono wehlisa inkomishi yakhe phambi kukaFaro, nangaphambili kwabaphathi bakhe, yashintsha ibe yinyoka.
Wathi uFaro, wabiza abantu bakhe abadumile, nabamangali bakhe; bakwenza njalo nabamangali baseYiputa ngobuciko babo.
Bakhipha wonke umuntu inkomishi yakhe, futhi inkomishi ngayinye yashintsha ibe yinyoka; kodwa inkomishi ka-Aron yazidla inkomishi zabo.
Nokho intliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, akazange abonise, njengoba iNkosi abeshoyo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Intliziyo kaFaro iqinile; akafuni ukuwashiya abantu bahambe.
Yiya kuFaro ekuseni, lapho ephuma emlanjeni, ulinde kuye enhliziyweni yeNil. Thola isandla sakho isibhamu esishintshile ibe yinyamakazi.
Uthi kuye, UYehova, uNkulunkulu wamaHebhere, ungithumela kuwe, ngikutshele ukuthi, Vumela abantu bam bahambe, bamikhonze ezweni lezulu elimnyama; kodwa wena awuzange ulalele kuze kube manje.
Uthi iNkosi ukuthi: Ngalokhu uzokwazi ukuthi nginguYehova; bheka, ngizoshaya amanzi aseNilweni ngesandla sami, futhi azoshintsha abe yigazi.
Inhlanzi emfuleni iNayile izofa, futhi umfula uzoba nephunga elibuhlungu; abantu baseMijiphu bangadlanga amanzi akhe.

Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Uthi uHaron, Thola isandla sakho phezu kwamanzi aseYiputa, eduze kwezintaba zawo, eduze kwemifula yawo, eduze kwemifula yakhe, eduze kwezintaba zakhe, eduze kwezintaba zayo zonke, ukuze zishintshe zibe yigazi; futhi kuzoba khona igazi ezweni lonke laseYiputa, nasezindaweni zokhuni, nasezindaweni zetshe.

Wakwenza uMoses noAron, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; waphakamisa uAron inkomishi yakhe phambi kukaFaro, nangaphambili kwabaphathi bakhe, washaya amanzi aseNil, futhi amanzi onke eNil aguqulwa ibe yigazi.
Izinhlanzi eNil zafa, futhi umfula waba nephunga elibi kakhulu, ngakho-ke aBamishiyanga babengeke baphuze amanzi awo. Kwabekho igazi kuwo wonke amaMisiya.
Bakwenza njalo futhi abamangali baseYiputa ngobuhlakani babo; inhliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, awavami uMoses noHaarnau, njengokuthi iNkosi abesho.
UFiraun wehla, wabuyela endlu yakhe, futhi akazange athathe lokhu enhliziyweni.
Bathi bonke abaMijipida, baxhuma phezu kweNil, befuna amanzi okudlidliza; ngoba abengawadla amanzi emfuleni.
Kwadlula izinsuku ezisixhenxe, ngemuva kokuba iNkosi ahlasele iNil.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya kuFaro, uthi kuye, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Landisa abantu bam, bamikhonze mina.
Uma ungenasifiso ukuwashiya bahambe, ngizothumela ubhubhane lwezinhlanzi ezweni lakho lonke.

INtaba-mlilo izogcwele izimvu, zifike endlwini yakho, nasegumbini lakho lokuphumula, nasesibhedlela sakho. Ziya kungena ezindlini zabasebenzi bakho, nakwabanye abantu bakho, namabhodwe akho, nezitsha zakho zokupheka.
Izinhlanzi zizohamba phezu kwakho, kanye nabantu bakho, futhi zonke iziphathimandla zakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uthi uAron, Nciphisa isandla sakho ngentambo yakho phezu kwezintaba-mlilo, neziqukathi zendabuko, nezingqimba zolwandle, ukuze zikhuphule izingulube phezu kwezwe lakwaMisra.
Wamisa u-Aron isandla sakhe phezu kwamanzi aseYiputa, zaphuma izingulube, zagubuzela umhlaba wonke.
Nabo abamangali bakwenza njalo ngobuhlakani babo, futhi baphakamisa izingulube phezu kwezwe laseYiputa.
UFaro wabiza uMosis noAron, wathi, "Nxusa iNkosi ukuthi asuse lezi zinyoni kum nakubo bonke abantu bami; ngizovumela abantu ukuba bahambe, ukuze banikela ngenhlanhla kuNkosi.
Wathi uMoses kuFaro, Uzokwazi wena; kuphi lapho ngizothandaza khona kuwe, namakhosana akho, nabantu bakho, ukuze izinyoni zihambe kude nawe, nezindlu zakho, zihlale emfuleni kuphela?
Wathi uFaro, NgoMsombuluko. Wathi uMoses, Ngokuya ngamazwi akho, ukuze wazi ukuthi akukho muntu ofana noYehova uNkulunkulu wethu.
Izinkomo ziyakushiya wena, nezindlu zakho, nabaphathi bakho, nabantu bakho; kuzohlala eNtshonalanga kuphela.
UMoses noAron baphuma kuFaro; uMosis wathandaza kuYehova ngenxa yezinhlanzi, azenzayo kuFaro.
Wakwenza iNkosi njengokuthi uMosis; zafa izinyoni ezindlini, nasezikhungweni, nasezindaweni.
Bathi abantu, "Siyibeke phezu kwamanzi," futhi izwe lonke lalimaza.
UFaro, lapho ebona ukuthi izinkinga ziphelile, wakwenza intliziyo yakhe ibe namandla, akawatholi amazwi abo, njengoba iNkosi abesho.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uthi uAron, Nciphisa isandla sakho, cindezela inkungu yezulu, ukuze ibe yizinhlanzi ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Bakwenza njalo. U-Aron wehlisa isandla sakhe ngentambo, washaya uthuli lwezulu; kwavela amakhowe abantu nasezilwaneni. Uthuli lonke ezweni liphela laseYiputa lashintsha libe ngamakhowe.
Baye bazama ukwenza ama-lice ngemisebenzi yabo efihlakeleyo, kodwa abakwazi, futhi ama-lice ahlala abantu nenyama.
Bathi abamangali kuFaro, Le yimikhono kaThixo; kodwa intliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, akayiqondi, njengokuthi iNkosi wayesho.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uvuka ekuseni, uhlale phambi kukaFaro; uma ephuma amanzi, uthi kuye, Lokho kusho iNkosi: Landisa abantu bam, ukuze bamikhonze.

Uma ungazivumela abantu bam bahambe, bona, ngizothumela phezu kwakho, nakwabezi bakho, nakwabantu bakho, nasezindaweni zenu, inqwaba yezinhlanzi; futhi izakhiwo zakwaMisiriya zizogcwele izinhlanzi, nayo yonke indawo abahlala kuyo.
Ngosuku olulodwa ngizomisa izwe laseGosheni, lapho abantu bami behlala khona; ngeke kube khona amabhubesi, ukuze wazi ukuthi ngiyiNkosi phakathi kwalolu lizwe.
Ngizomisa isinqumo phakathi kwabantu bam nomphakathi wakho. Lo mqondiso uzokwenzeka kusasa.'
Wakwenza iNkosi lokhu: kwafika amabhungane akhulu endlu kaFaro, namabhungane emindenini yabantu bakhe; izwe lonke laseYiputa lalahleka ngamabhungane.
UFaro wabiza uMoses no-Aron, wathi, Yiya, ninikeze insindiso kuThixo wenu ezweni elinjalo.

Wathi uMoses, Akulungile lokhu; ngoba uma sinikela kuYehova uNkulunkulu wethu ngezinto ezibi engqondweni yama-Egipta, uma sinikela ngezinto ezibi engqondweni yabo phambi kwamehlo abo, bangasithutha kanjani ngamathumbu?
Sizohamba uhambo lwezinsuku ezintathu, sifike ezweni lezulu elimnyama, sinikeze umnikelo kuYehova uNkulunkulu wethu, njengoba esesiwiselayo.
Wathi uFaro, Ngizowavumelani nihambe, ukuze ninikeze insindiso kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu esiqhingini; kodwa akufanele nihambe eduze kakhulu; ngicelani manje.

Wathi uMoses, "Ngizothandaza kuYehova uma ngiphuma kuwe, ukuze izinyoni zihambe kaFaro, nabakhonzi bakhe, nabantu bakhe, kusasa; kodwa akumele uFaro aphinde anikeze abantu ithuba lokuphuma, ukuba banikela kukaNkulunkulu.
Waphuma uMoses kuFaro, wathandaza kuYehova.
Wakwenza iNkosi ngokusho kwaMosesi; izinyoni zasuka kuFaro, nabaphathi bakhe, nabantu bakhe; akukho linye lazo elihlala.
Kodwa uFaro wehlise inhliziyweni yakhe futhi ngalolu hlobo, akawavumela abantu bahambe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Iya kuFaro, uthi kuye, Usho lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wamaHebhere: Vumela abantu bam bahambe, ukuze bamikhonze.
Uma ungenasifiso ukuwashiya bahambe futhi uqhubeka nokuzibopha kubo,
Isandla sikaYehova sizoletha umkhuhlane omkhulu ezilwaneni zakho ezisendaweni, ezibhakabhakeni zakho, ezimbotsheni zakho, ezigungwini zakho, ezinkomo zakho, nezimvu zakho, nezimbuzi zakho.
Kodwa iNkosi uzozenza izilwane zakwaSirayeli zihlukile ezilwaneni zakwaYiputa; ngeke kube khona isilwane ngasinye sabantu bakaSirayeli esizofa.
Wabeka iNkosi isikhathi, wathi, NgoMsombuluko iNkosi uzokwenza lokhu ezweni.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, iNkosi wakwenza njalo; zonke izilwane zakwaMisra zafa; kodwa kwabaSirayeli akukho lutho lwazo lwafile.
UFaro wathumela abantu, babheka, futhi bona, kubonakala sengathi angeke kube nenyama yomndeni kaSirayeli efile; kodwa intliziyo kaFaro yaqhubeka iqinile, awazami ukuwashiya labo bantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaronu, Nciphisani izinkomishi zenu ezigcwele isibhakabhaka somlilo, uMosesi ayisetshenzise emkhathini phambi kukaFaro.
Uzoba wuthuli oluncane phezu kwezwe lonke laseYiputa, luzobangela ukuba kube khona izinhlungu ezibulalayo kumuntu nokudla kwezilwane ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Bathi ke, bathathe inkungu yomlilo, behlala phambi kuka-Firaun; uMoses wehla ngayo emkhathini, yaphuma khona imihuzuko evulekile kubantu nakwinyama.
Abamangali abazange bahlale phambi kukaMoses, ngenxa yezinhlayiya; ngoba izinhlayiya zazikhona kubo bonke abamangali, nakwabenzi bomhlaba.
Wakwenza iNkosi intliziyo kaFaro ibe yindida, akawalalelanga uMoses noAron; njengokuthi iNkosi wayesho kuMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Khumbula ekuseni, uhlale phambi kukaFaro, uthi kuye, Usho lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wamaHebhere: Vumela abantu bam bahambe, ukuze bangikhonze.
Ngokuba ngaleso sikhathi ngizothumela zonke izifo zami phezu kwakho, naphezu kwabaphathi bakho, naphezu kwabantu bakho; ukuze wazi ukuthi akukho muntu ofana nami emhlabeni wonke.
Ngalokhu ngangikwazi ukudlulisa isandla sami, futhi ngikuhlasele wena nomndeni wakho ngegciwane, ukuze ngikususe ezweni.
Kodwa ngalesi sizathu ngikugcine uphila, ukuze ngikubonise amandla ami, futhi ukuthi igama lami likwaziswe emhlabeni wonke.
Sekuyisikhathi eside ubeke isandla sakho phezu kwabantu bam, futhi awukaze ubavumele bahambe.
Ngokuba ngaleso sikhathi, ngizothumela ngoMsombuluko isivunguvungu esibi kunazo zonke, esingase sidlule eYiputa, kusukela ngosuku lapho yaba yizwe, kuze kube manje.

Ngakho-ke, utshele ukuthi zithunyelwe izilwane zakho, nezinto zonke ezikhona ezindaweni zomhlaba; futhi uma umuntu noma isilwane sishiywa ezindaweni zomhlaba, futhi singathunyelwa ngaphakathi, khona-ke isikhukhula sizogwama.
Baze bakhathazeka abaphathi bakaFaro ngenxa yezwi likaYehova, behamba ngokushesha, bezikhipha izisebenzi zabo nezilwane zabo.
Kodwa labo ababengabazi ilizwi likaYehova, bashiya abakhonzi babo nezilwane zabo ezindaweni zazo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho esibhakabhakeni, ukuze kube khona isikhukhula ezweni lonke laseYiputa, kubantu, nezilwane, nakwezo zonke izitshalo ezikhula emhlabathini waseYiputa.
UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, iNkosi wakhipha intaba-mlilo nezingqimba zeqhwa, futhi amatshe emvula akhuphuka ezweni; iNkosi wasusa izingqimba zeqhwa phezu kwezwe laseMizi.
Imvula yeqhwa yaphuma, futhi umlilo wawuhamba phakathi kwemvula yeqhwa; kwakuyimvula enkulu kunazo zonke ezweni lonke laseYiputa, kusukela lapho yaba yizwe.
Umlilo wabulala zonke izinto ezikhona ezweni lonke laseYiputa, abantu nokudla kwazo zonke izilwane; wabulala yonke imifino yezulu, waphula wonke umthi.
Indawo eyodwa kuphela lapho kwakungekho khona imvula enkulu, yilizwe laseGosheni, lapho abantu bakaSirayeli behlala khona.
Wathi uFaro, ebiza uMosis noAron, wathi kubo, Ngaphezu kwalokhu ngihlulekile; iNkosi ulungile, futhi mina nemindeni yami siyingozi.
Ngicelani iNkosi, ngoba sekuyinto eyanele izulu lethu nemvula yeqhwa; ngizokushiya uhambe; ngeke nihlale isikhathi eside.
Wathi uMoses kuye, Uma ngiphuma kulo mzi, ngizokhuphula izandla zami kuYehova; izivunguvungu zizoyeka, futhi ngeke kube khona isikhukhula; ukuze wazi ukuthi le mhlaba nguwo iNkosi.
Kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi wena nabangani bakho angeke nigweme iNkosi uNkulunkulu.
I-flax ne-barley zalahleka, ngoba i-barley yadala izindlebe zayo futhi i-flax yayihlotshiswe.
Kodwa-ke, inkomo ne-spelt azikabi zilahlekile, ngoba zikhula ngokushesha.
Waphuma ke uMoses emzini, esuka kuFaro, waphakamisa izandla zakhe kuye iNkosi; futhi izivunguvungu nezingqimba zeqhwa zanyamalala, intwasahlobo namanzi abandayo awabikho emhlabeni.
UFarawo, lapho ebona ukuthi imvula nezingqimba zeqhwa nezivunguvungu ziphelile, waqhubeka nokwenza ubugebengu; waba nomsindo emlonyeni wakhe, yena nabangane bakhe.
Inhliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, akaze avumele abantu bakaSirayeli bahambe; njengokuba iNkosi wathi ngaye ngoMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Yiya kuFaro; ngoba ngiyiqinise inhliziyo yakhe, kanye nenhliziyo yabangani bakhe, ukuze ngikwenze lezi zibonakaliso zami phakathi kwabo.
futhi ukuze utshele izingane zakho, nezingane zabantwana bakho, ukuthi ngikwenze kanjani eMisiyani, nezibonakaliso zami engizenza phakathi kwabo; ukuze nikwazi ukuthi ngingiNkosi.
Baye ke uMoses noAron kuFaro, bathi kuye: Uthi lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu wamaHibhuri, uthi: Kuze kube nini uma ungathandanga ukuxolisa phambi kwami? Vumela abantu bam bahambe, bangangikhonza.
Uma ungenasifiso ukuwashiya bahambe, ngoMsombuluko ngizoletha izingulube ezweni lakho.
Zizovala izwe, ukuze lingabonakali; ziyodla konke okuncane okusele kuwe ngemuva kweqhwa, kanye nesihlahla sonke esikhula ezweni lakho.

Zizogcwalisa izakhiwo zakho, nezindlu zabasebenzi bakho bonke, nama-Egyptians onke; okunjalo abazali bakho, nabangani bakho abakhulu, abangabonanga lutho olufana nalo, kusukela ngosuku lapho behlala khona ezweni lenu, kuze kube manje. UMoses wabuyela, waya kuFaro.
Bathi abaphathi bakaFaro kuye, Ingabe kuze kube isikhathi esingakanani ukuthi lo muntu abe yingozi yethu? Vumela abantu bahambe, bakhonza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wabo; awubonanga yini ukuthi iMisri iyafa?
Babuyiselwa uMoses noAron kuFaro; wathi kubo, Yiya, nikhonza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu; kodwa ningamitshela ukuthi ngubani ozoya.
Wathi uMoses, Sizohamba nabangane bethu nabadala bethu, namantombazane ethu namadodakazi ethu, nezingulube zethu nezinkomo zethu; ngoba sinomkhosi woNkulunkulu.
Wathi uFaro: UNkulunkulu uzobe nawe, uma nje ngikushiyela wena nomndeni wakho. Kubonakala sengathi isinqumo sakho siyisinqumo esibi.
Amadoda kuphela azoya, akhonze iNkosi; ngoba lokhu kungenxa yenu. Waphuma ke uMoses noAron ebusweni bukaFaro. Bathi kuMosis, "Ubani lo muntu?"
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho phezu kweYiputa, ukuze izingulube zikhuphuke phezulu ezweni lonke, zidle yonke imifino, konke okushisayo.
Wamisa uMoses inkomishi yakhe phezu kweYiputa; iNkosi waveza umoya osuka eningizimu ezweni lonke lona usuku, nobusuku bonke. Kwafika isihlwa, umoya waba nezinhlanzi.
Kwafika amakhowe phezu kwezwe lonke laseYiputa, wahlala kuwo wonke indawo. Akukho makhowe anjalo ngaphambilini, futhi ngeke kube namakhowe anjalo.

Zazifihla zonke izingxenye zezwe, kuze kube yimnyama; zadla zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni zomhlaba, nazo zonke izithelo zezinhlamvu, konke okushiwo imvula yomlilo. Akukabikho okunye okuluhlaza kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlamvu, noma kwezinhlamvu eziphilayo, ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Wathi uFaro, ehamba ngokushesha, wabiza uMoses noHaarnau, wathi, Ngihlulekile kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, nani na.
Manje ke, ngiyakucela, usindise isono sami ngaleso sikhathi nje kuphela; nithandazani kuYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, ukuba asuse kum lo monakalo wokufa.
Waphuma uMoses kuFaro, wathandaza kuYehova.
UNkulunkulu washintsha umoya ube wumoya onamandla kakhulu osuka enyakatho, uthathe izingulube, waza uzisusa emfuleni oMnyama. Akukho isingulube esisodwa esishiyeka ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Kodwa iNkosi wenza intliziyo kaFaro iqinile, akaze avumele abantu bakaSirayeli bahambe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho esibhakabhakeni, ukuze kube nokukhanya ezweni laseYiputa, ukukhanya okuncane kakhulu, okungukuthi, kungabikho muntu ongakulingisa.
UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, kwafika ubusuku obumnyama ezweni lonke laseYiputa nsuku ezintathu.
Wonke umuntu angeke abone omunye umuntu, futhi akukho muntu osuka endaweni yakhe izinsuku ezintathu; kodwa bonke abantu bakaSirayeli babe nelanga lapho behlala khona.
UFaro wabiza uMoses, wathi, Yiya, nisebenzele iNkosi; futhi izingane zenu zingaya nani; izingulube zenu kuphela nezimbuzi zenu zihlale.
Wathi uMoses, Uzodinga futhi ukuthi usinikeze izinkomo zokudla kanye nezinkomo zokudla okuthosiwe, ukuze sizinikela kuYehova uNkulunkulu wethu.

Futhi izilwane zethu kumele zihambe nathi; akufanele sishiye ikhanda elilodwa lazo, ukuze sisebenzise ezinye zazo ukukhonza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wethu; futhi kuze sifike khona, asikaze sikwazi ukuthi yiziphi ezidingekayo ukuba sisebenzele iNkosi.
Kodwa iNkosi wamisa intliziyo kaFaro, akaze avumele ukuthi bahambe.
Wathi uFaro kuMoses, Yiya kude nami; qiniseka ukuthi ngeke ubone isithombe sami futhi; ngoba lapho ubona khona isithombe sami, uzofa.
Wathi uMoses, "Ngakho-ke usho ukuthi: ngeke ngibona isithombe sakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Ngizoletha igciwane elilodwa ePharao naseYiputa; ngemuva kwalokho uzowashiya niphume lapha; futhi uma ekwenzela njalo, uzokuphoqa ukuthi nihambe.
Uzokhuluma abantu ukuthi wonke umuntu, indoda nowesifazane, kufanele abuze izihlobo zakhe zaseMisiya izinto zesiliva negolide.
Nokho iNkosi wenza abantu bathandeke ebusweni bamaMishi; futhi noMoses waba mkhulu kakhulu ezweni lakwaMishi, phambi kwabaphathi bakaFiraun, nangaphambili kwabantu.
Wathi uMoses, Usho lokhu iNkosi: Ngobusuku obuphakathi, ngizodlula emiphakathini yaseYiputa.

Wonke umzali wesifazane ezweni laseYiputa uzofa, kusukela kumzali wesifazane kaFaro, ohlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, kuze kube ngumzali wesifazane wendodakazi yowesifazane, obhaka imbewu emgodini wakhe, nanoma yimuphi umzali wesifazane wezilwane.
Kuzobe khona ubuhlungu obukhulu ezweni lonke laseYiputa, obubi kunawo wonke ngaphambilini, noma kuzoba njalo.
Kodwa kuzobe kungabi khona inja eshaya wonke amakhosikazi aseSirayeli, noma zonke izilwane zabo; ukuze nikwazi ukuthi iNkosi unquma phakathi kweMisiya neSirayeli.
Bazofika lapha kimi bonke abaphathi bakho, babhujiswa phambi kwami, bethi, Yiya wena, nawe wonke umuntu olandelana nawe; futhi ngemuva kwalokho ngizophuma. Washiya uMoses uFaro, ehlukumezeka.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, UFaro ngeke akulalelani, ukuze ngiphinde ngikwenze izimanga zami ezweni laseYiputa.
UMoses no-Aron bazenza zonke lezi zinto ezimangazayo phambi kukaFaro; kodwa iNkosi wakwenza intliziyo kaFaro ibe yindida, aze avumele izingane zakwaSirayeli ziphume ezweni lakhe.
Wakhuluma iNkosi kuMoses noHaroni eYiputa, wathi,
"Le nyanga kumele ibe ngukuqala kwezinyanga kuwe. Kuzobe yinyanga yokuqala yonyaka wakho.
Bheka, ngikhuluma emphakathini wonke waseSirayeli: Ngosuku oluyishumi lwale nyanga, umuntu ngamunye athathe inkomo eyodwa ngendlu yakhe, inkomo eyodwa ngendlu ngayinye.

Uma ikhaya lincane kakhulu ukuthi lidle inkomo ephelele, kumele bahlukanise nenye nomngane wabo ohamba phambili, ngokuya ngenani labantu. Sebenzisa inani lenyama yenkomo edingekayo ngokwenani lomuntu ngamunye ozodla.
Inja oyikhethayo kumele ibe yindoda eneminyaka engu-1 ubudala ngaphandle kokungalungile kuyo. Ungayithola kusuka ezimvu noma ezinkomo.
Niyigcine kuze kube yimini eyisishiyagalombili yale nyanga; khona-ke bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bazozibulala izinyamazane zabo, uma ilanga liphuma.
Bazothatha ezinye zalezi gazi, bazibeke emadolweni nakwesobunxele komnyango wendlu lapho bedla khona izingulube.
Ngobusuku obufanayo kufanele baphuze inyama ethosiwe emanzini, kanye nezithelo ezijulile nenyama eyenziwe ngaphandle kommbila.
Ungadli inyama ethosiwe noma ethosiwe emanzini. Nciphisa inhlanzi yonke phezu komlilo, ikhanda layo, izinyawo zayo, nezicubu zaso.
Musa ukushiya noma yini kuyo kuze kube ekuseni. Uma kukhona okushiwo kuze kube kusasa, kufanele umlilo.
Ngale ndlela nizoyidla; ugqozi lwakhe luyimisiwe, izicathulo zakhe ezinyawo zakhoni, nentambo yakhe esandlani sakho. Niyidle ngokushesha, ngoba yiPasha kaYehova.
Ngizodlula ezweni laseYiputa ngalolu busuku, futhi ngizobulala wonke umzali omusha, kusukela kumuntu kuze kube yinyama; futhi ngizolungisa isinqumo phezu kwamasiko aseYiputa onke. Ngiye iNkosi.
Uma ngibona igazi ezindaweni zenu, ngiyakudlulani; ngeke kube khona ubhubhane olubulalayo, uma ngishaya iMisri. Uzothola ukuthi igazi likhona ezindlini zenu, futhi ngizokubona igazi.
Lemini kumele ibe ngusuku lokukhumbula kwenu; kufanele niyigcine njengosuku lokuphumula kukaNkulunkulu, kuze kube yiminyaka yonke ezayo. Lolu hlelo luzohlala njalo.

Izinsuku ezisixhenxe kufanele nidle ukudla okungenaziqhamo. Ngosuku lokuqala kumele nisuse iziqhamo ezindaweni zenu; ngoba wonke umuntu odla ukudla okungezincibilikisiwe, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala kuze kube usuku oluyisixhenxe, lowo muntu uzosuswa ezweni laseSirayeli.

Ngosuku lokuqala uzoba nengqungquthela engcwele, futhi ngosuku lwesixhenxe uzoba nengqungquthela engcwele. Akukho msebenzi ozowenza ngalolu suku, ngaphandle kokulungiselela ukudla komuntu ngamunye. Lokho konke ongayikwenza.

Uzogcina usuku lwezithelo ezingenawo umhluzi; ngoba ngalolu busuku ngibakhipha abantu bakho ezweni laseMisiya, ngohlobo lwabo; uzogcina lo mhla kuze kube yisikhathi sakho samanje. Lo ngumthetho ohlala njalo.
Ngonyaka wokuqala, kusukela ngemini eyisishiyagalombili yokuhlwa kuze kube yimini yeshumi nanye yokuhlwa, nidla ubisi olungenamhluzi.

Izinsuku ezisixhenxe akufanele kube khona ukhilimu ezindaweni zenu; ngoba wonke umuntu odla noma yini enokhilimu, lowo muntu uzosuswa emphakathini wakwaSirayeli, noma ngabe ungumhlali wasezweni, noma ngabe ngumzali walo.
Ungadla noma yini eyenziwe nge-lemongrass; kuzo zonke izindlu zenu, kufanele nidle ubisi olungena-lemongrass.
UMoses wababiza bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Yeni, nithathe inkomo ngemindeni yenu, nifile inkomo yepasha.

Uzothatha iqoqo le-hyssop, uyifake emlonyeni wegazi elingena emgodini, uthele emanzini okungena emgqeni womnyango, nakwezinye izingxenye zomngcele womgwaqo; futhi akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ozophuma emgqeni wendlu yakhe kuze kube ekuseni.

Uma iNkosi ehamba, ehlasela ama-Egipta, bese ebona igazi emgodini womnyango nakwezinye izingxenye zomnyango, khona-ke uzodlula kulowo mnyango, futhi ngeke avumele lowo obulalayo ukuba afike ezindlini zenu, ahlasele.
Wena nabantwana bakho kumele nithobele le mithetho, ibe ngumthetho ohlala njalo.
Uma nifika ezweni iNkosi ozokunika lona, njengokuba wathi, kufanele nigcine lo mthetho.
Uma izingane zakho zibuza ukuthi, 'Iyini incazelo yalo mcimbi?'

Uzothi kubo, Le yinyama yepasha kaYehova; ngenxa yokuthi wadlula phezu kwezindlu zakwaSirayeli eYiputa, lapho abulala khona ama-Egipta, futhi wagcina izindlu zethu. Abantu ke babhujululwa, bakhonza iNkosi.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bakwenza njalo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses noAron.

Ngobusuku obuphakathi, iNkosi wabulala wonke umzali wesifazane ezweni laseYiputa, kusukela kumzali wesifazane kaFaro ohlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, kuze kube ngumzali wesifazane wowesifazane obekwe emgodini; wabulala futhi wonke umzali wesifazane wenyama.
UFaro wavuka ngobusuku, naye wonke umphathi wakhe, nabo bonke abantu baseMisiya; kwabe sengathi kungenxa yobuhlungu obukhulu eMisiya; ngoba kwakungeke kube khona indlu engafile kuyo.
UFaro wabiza uMoses noHaarnau ngobusuku, wathi, Yiya, phuma phakathi kwabantu bam, niye nabantwana bakaSirayeli; chofoza, nikhonze iNkosi, njengoba nithe.
Nizithathe izingulube zenu, nezimbuzi zenu, njengoba nithi, nihambe; futhi nimi, ngibabusise.
Bathi abantu base-Egypt: "Kuyashesha ukuthi niphume ezweni lenu; uma ningaphumanga, sizofa bonke!"
Bathi ke abantu, bathathe ukhilimu wabo ngaphambili kokuba ukhilimu usetshenziswe, bagqoke amabhodlela abo okudla ngezinto zabo zokugqoka, bazithwale ezinyaweni zabo.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bakwenza ngokusho kwelizwi likaMoses, becela abaMishithi izinto zesiliva negolide, nezigqoko.
UYehova wabeka abantu ebusweni beziYiputa, ukuze babe nabo; ngakho abaSirayeli bathatha izimpahla zabaseYiputa.
Basuka ke abantu bakaSirayeli eRameshe, bafika eSukhothi; kwakungumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili amawaka amadoda ahamba ngezinyawo, ngaphandle kwabancane.
Abanye abantu abaningi bahamba nabo, kanye nezilwane ezifuywayo ezinkulu nezilwane.

Bapheka imbewu yabo, ebengayitholile emazweni aseYiputa, ibe yizingulube ezincane; ngoba imbewu yabo yayingenawo umhluzi, ngenxa yokuthi babethunyelwe emazweni aseYiputa, futhi abazange balungiselele ukudla.
Bahlala abantu bakaSirayeli eYiputa iminyaka engumakhulu amane namathathu.
Kwathi ngemuva kweminyaka engumakhulu amane namashumi amathathu, ngalolusuku oluthile, abantu bonke bakaYehova baphuma eYiputa, njengamabutho.
UYehova wagcina ubusuku balo, ukuba awakhiphe emazweni aseYiputa; ngakho bonke abantwana bakaSirayeli bagcine lo busuku, ukuze bagweme iNkosi, kuze kube sekuphele izinsuku.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses noAron, Lokho wumthetho wosuku lwepasha: Akunamuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe azowudla.
Omunye umkhonzi wakho othengiwe, uma usuwutholile, uzodla wona.
Omunye umuntu ohlala nawe isikhathi eside, noma umqashi, akakwazi ukuyidla.
Kudingeka idlalwe ngaphakathi kwendlu eyodwa. Ungathatha noma yiluphi uhlobo lwenyama ngaphandle kwendlu. Ngakho-ke, ungaphula noma iyiphi yemisipha yayo.
Umphakathi wonke wase-Israyeli kufanele ujabulele.

Uma ehlala phakathi kwenu umuntu ovela kwelinye izwe, efuna ukwenza uPasha kaYehova, kufanele wonke indodana yakhe itholwe inkulumo, ukuze akwazi ukuyidla njengomuntu owazalwa kulo mhlaba; kodwa akukho muntu ongatholwe inkulumo angayidla.
Umthetho owodwa uzobe ukhona kulowo ozalwa ezweni lenu, nomunye ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Bakwenza njalo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses noAron.
Kwathi ngalolusuku olulodwa, iNkosi wakhipha amadodana aseSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa, ngeqembu ngalinye, njengeqhwa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi iNkosi kuMoses: "Nquma ngimi wonke umuntu ovula ibele lakhe; wonke umuntu ovula ibele lakhe phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, ngabe ngumntu noma ibe yinyama, uzongiwo mina.

Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu, Khumbulani namuhla, usuku lokuphuma kwenu ezweni laseYiputa, lapho bebengabe abakhonzi khona; iNkosi wakhipha khona isandla sakhe esinamandla; ngeke nidle noma yini eyenziwe nge-lemu.
Namhlanje, kunyaka we-Abib, usuka.

Uma iNkosi ekhuluma kubaba bakho, ukuthi uzokunika izwe lamaKanana, namaHeti, nama-Amoreti, namaHivi, namaJebhusi, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nengulube; uma ekulethela khona, kufanele wenze lo mcimbi kulo nyaka.
Izinsuku ezisithupha uzodla inyama engabhakiwe, futhi ngosuku oluyisixhenxe uzoba nemini yokuphumula kuYehova.
Uzodla ukudla okungenazithelo ezinoshukela nsuku ezisixhenxe; ngeke kube khona ubisi olunoshukela phakathi kwakho, futhi ngeke kube khona ubisi olunoshukela ezweni lakho lonke.
Uzotshela unyana wakho ngalolu busuku, uthi: Ngikwenza lokhu ngenxa yokuthi iNkosi wenza kimi, lapho ngiphuma eYiputa.

Ngiyakwenza kube nguphawu esandlani sakho, futhi ube yisiqongo esiphakathi kwekhanda lakho, ukuze umthetho kaYehova uhlale emlonyeni wakho; ngoba isandla esinamandla soMoya oNgcwele waphuma wena eYiputa.
Ngakho-ke kufanele ugcine lo mthetho ngesikhathi esifanele ngonyaka wonke.
Uma iNkosi ekulethela izwe lakwaKanana, akunika lona, njengokuthi wakhuluma kuwe nababa bakho.
Uzonikela kukaNkulunkulu wonke owesifazane wesifazane; wonke owesifazane wesifazane wezinto zakho eziphilayo uzowunikela kuNkulunkulu.

Uzokwazi ukuthenga ibhokhwe ngayinye ezalwa kuqala, ukunikeza inkomo endaweni yayo. Uma ungayithenganga, kufanele uvule umlomo wayo; futhi wonke owesifazane ozalwa kuqala phakathi kwabantwana bakho uzowuthenga.
Ngosuku oluzayo, uma unyana wakho ebuza wena, ethi, Yikuphi lokhu? Uzothi kuye, UNkulunkulu wawusikhuphe ngesandla sakhe esinamandla ezweni laseMisiya, lapho sahlala khona njengezikhonzi.

Uma uFaro enqaba ukusivumela ukuba sihambe, iNkosi wabulala wonke umuntu oqale ibele ezweni laseYiputa, kusukela kumuntu kuze kube yinyama; ngakho-ke nginikela ngazo zonke izinja eziqala ibele kuYehova, futhi wonke indodana yami eqala ibele ngiyithenga.
Kuzobe sekuyiphawu esandlani sakho, futhi ibe yimiqondiso emehlweni akho; ngoba iNkosi usikhuphule eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.

Kwathi lapho uFarawo evumela abantu ukuba bahambe, uNkulunkulu akawaqondisi ngendlela yezwe lamaFilistimi, nakuba incane kakhulu; wathi uNkulunkulu, Ngabe uma bebona umkhosi, bangase bashintshe inhliziyo yabo, babuye eYiputa.
UNkulunkulu waholela abantu emgwaqeni obanzi, ezweni laseNdiya, kuze kube yilwandle olumnyama. Abantu bakaSirayeli baphuma eYiputa, belungiselela ukulwa.

Wathatha uMoses amathambo ka-Yusufu naye; ngoba uYusufu wayewuthathele umnqumo amadodana aseSirayeli, wathi kubo, Uma uNkulunkulu efika ngokuqinisekile ukukusiza, khona-ke nizikhuphule izitho zami lapha nani.
Basuka eSukhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Ethame, enkabeni yesiqhingi.
UYehova wayehamba phambi kwabo ngemini, emgodini wezulu, ukuba abaqondise indlela; ngasebusuku, emgodini womlilo, ukuba ajabulise, ukuze bahambe ekuseni nakusihlwa.
Uphahla lwesibhakabhaka usuku lonke, nophahla lwesibhakabhaka somlilo ngobusuku bonke, aluzange lushiye indawo yalo phambi kwalabo bantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 23"Utshonalela izingane zakwaSirayeli ukuthi zishintshe futhi zenze isikhashana ePi-Hahiroth, phakathi kweMigdoli nelwandle; zezenze isikhashana emfuleni obhekene noBaalesephon.
UFaro uzothi, Abantwana bakaSirayeli bahamba ezweni; isiqhingi siwuvala umnyango wabo.
Ngizomisa inhliziyo kaFaro, aze alandela emuva kwabo; futhi ngizoba nomhlonishwa kuFaro nomndeni wakhe wonke; futhi bayazi abantu baseMijipi ukuthi ngingiNkosi. Bakwenza njalo oonyana bakaSirayeli.

Bathi kubo ukumkani waseMisri, bathi abantu baphuma; uFaro nabangane bakhe bashintsha inhliziyo yabo ngalabo bantu, besithi, Sikwenze yini lokhu, ukuthi sivumele amakhosikazi aseSirayeli ukuba ahambe? Akekho osebenza nathi.
UFaro walungisa imoto yakhe, wathatha inkosi yakhe naye.
Wathatha izimoto zakhe ezihamba phambili eziyikhulu nesishiyagalombili, nazo zonke izimoto zakwaYiputa, nabangane babo bonke.
Wakwenza iNkosi inhliziyo kaFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, ibe yindida; walandela izingane zakwaSirayeli, ziphuma ngamandla.

Bathi abaMishi bayawalandela, bafinyelela kubo zonke izibhamu zikaFaro, nezithuthi zakhe zokulwa, nabangane bakhe abahamba ngezikebhe, nomndeni wakhe wonke, lapho behlala khona emfuleni, ePi-Hahirothi, ngaphesheya kukaBaale-zephon.
Uma uFaro efika, abantu bakaSirayeli baphakamisa amehlo abo, bebona ukuthi amaMijipi ehamba kulandelana nabo; bakhathazeka kakhulu, bathandaza kuYehova.
Bathi kuMosesi, Akukhona yini eYiputa amagobho, ukuze ukhiphe siphume sife esiqhingini? Ukwenzeni kuphi lokhu, ukuthi ukhiphe siphuma eYiputa?
Asikutsheleni yini lapho eYiputa, sithi, Sishiyeke, sisebenzele ama-Egyptians? Kungcono ukuba sisebenzele ama-Egyptians, kunalokho ukuthi siphele kulo mfula womhlaba.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Musani ukukhathazeka; hlalani, nibone ukuthi iNkosi uzokusindisa nini namuhla; ngoba aBamisrayeli ababonayo namuhla, ngeke nibabone futhi.
UNkulunkulu uzobhekana nabanye ngenxa yenu, kodwa nihlale nihlala phansi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Kungani na ukuthi unqume ngami? Beka izingane zakwaSirayeli zihambe.
Kodwa wena, uphakamise inkomishi yakho, ubambe isandla sakho phezu kolwandle, uhlukanise amanzi, ukuze izingane zakwaSirayeli zihambe phakathi kolwandle ngeqhwa.
Ngizomisa inhliziyo yama-Egipta, bafike kulandelana kwabo; futhi ngizoba nomhlonishwa kuFaro, nenkosi yakhe yonke, namabhayisikili akhe, nabahamba ngezinyawo bakhe.
Bayazi ukuthi nginguYehova abantu baseMijipi, uma ngibona ubuhle ngaphesheya kukaFaro, namabhayisikili akhe, nabahhashi bakhe.
Umbingeleli kaThixo, owahamba phambi kweqhwa lakwaSirayeli, wehla waya ngasemva kwabo; futhi umbhoshongo wezulu wehla wasuka ngaphambili labo, wahlala ngasemva kwabo.

Wafika phakathi kweqembu lakwaMisiriya neqembu lakwaSirayeli. Ngobusuku bonke udaba lwaba mnyama ngasohlangothini olulodwa, futhi lukhanya ngasohlangothini olulodwa; ngoko ke, akukho okunye okufinyelela kolunye usuku lonke.
Wamisa uMoses isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, futhi iNkosi wehlisa umfula ngomoya onamandla wasempumalanga yonke le busuku, wakwenza kube yindawo emnyama; amanzi ahlukaniswa.
Baye badlula emiphakathini yolwandle, behamba ngomhlaba omnyama, futhi amanzi abe ngudonga ngakwesokudla kwabo nakwesobunxele babo.
Bathi ama-Egipta awalandela, ayewalandela phakathi kolwandle, wonke amahhashi kaFaro, namabhayisikili akhe, nabangane bakhe abahamba ngezinyawo.
Ngaphambi kokuvuka kwelanga, iNkosi wabheka umkhosi wama-Egipta, esuka emgodini womlilo nezulu, wabasusa, wathi:
Wakwenza ukuthi amasondo emoto yabo aphume, bakwazi ukugibela ngosayizi. Bathi abaMishi: "Sizophuma phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, ngoba iNkosi ubhekana nabo emazweni aseMishi."
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho phezu kolwandle, ukuze amanzi abuye abe ngaphesheya kwabaYiputa, namabhasi abo, namabhayisikili abo.

UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, nolwandle luye lwabuyela endaweni yalo lapho kuvuka khona ubusuku; abaMishi bafuna ukugibela ngaphandle kwalo, kodwa iNkosi wabasusa emaphakathi olwandle.
Ulwandle lwabuyela, lwagquma izimoto zokulwa, namabhayisikili, wonke umkhosi kaFaro, owawungene emfuleni ngemuva kwabo; kwakungekho umuntu owodwa wabo owahlala.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli ayehamba phakathi kolwandle, ezindaweni ezishisayo; futhi amanzi abe ngudonga ngakwesokudla kwabo nakwesobunxele babo.
Ngomhla lowo, iNkosi wasindisa amaSirayeli esandla sama-Egipta; futhi amaSirayeli abona ama-Egipta enkabeni yolwandle.
Babona amadoda aseSirayeli isandla esikhulu iNkosi asenza kuma-Egipta, bakhathazeka ngenxa kaYehova; bakholwa kuYehova, noMoses umkhonzi wakhe.
Wathi uMoses, nabantwana bakaSirayeli, bakhuluma ngalolu limi kuYehova, besithi: Ngizokhuluma kuYehova, ngoba wabhida kakhulu; ingulube nowesifazane wayo wabeka emfuleni.
UNkulunkulu unamandla ami, nengoma yami. Wangisindisa; Nguye uNkulunkulu wami, futhi ngizowubonga; UThixo kababa wami, futhi ngizowuphakamisa.
UNkulunkulu ungumnqobi, igama lakhe nguThixo.
Wabeka elwandle izimoto zikaFiraun, nemikhosi yakhe. Abaphathi abangcono kaFiraun baqhutshwa emfuleni omnyama.
Izintaba-mlilo zazigqoka, Zazishiya zibuyele phansi njengetshe.
Isandla sakho sakwesokudla, Nkosi, sidumile ngokunamandla; isandla sakho sakwesokudla, Nkosi, sishaya isibhamu.
Ngenkundla yakho enkulu, ubeke phansi labo abaphikisayo wena; wathumela inkohliso yakho ekhanyayo, yababulala njengamatshe afile.
Ngomoya ophuma emlonyeni wakho, amanzi akhuphuka. Amanzi ahlanzekile aphakama njengedonga. Amanzi amahle ayeqinile phakathi kolwandle.
Uzothi umfowabo, Ngizowalandela, ngiwathole; ngizohlukanisa konke okusemandleni ami; ngizothatha konke okufunayo; ngizokhipha ikebhe lami, futhi isandla sami sizobabulala.
Waphuza umphefumulo wakho, ulwandle lwabafihla; bahlanganiswa njengamapuleti emanzini amakhulu.
Ubani phakathi kwamasiko ofana nawe, Nkosi yami? Ubani ofana nawe, onesithunzi esingcwele, onothando olukhulu, owenza izimanga?
Ubambe isandla sakho sokudla, futhi izwe liwudlulisa.
Ngothando lwakho uzoba nomqondisi wabo bonke abantu obabambisene nabo, futhi ngokunamandla akho uzobaqondisa ezweni lakho elingcwele.
Izizwe zizozizwa, zize ziqhekeke; ubuhlungu buzothatha abantu bakaFilisti.
Bazokhathazeka abaphathi base-Edom, futhi labo abanamandla aseMowabhi bazogxeka; bonke abantu baseKanana bazogxeka izandla zabo.

Ubuhlungu nokukhathazeka kuzoba phezu kwabo; ngenxa yobukhazikhazi besandla sakho, bazobe bengakhululeki njengamatshe, kuze kube yilapho abantu bakho bedlula, Nkosi, kuze kube yilapho abantu abathengise wena bedlula.
Uzowangenisa, uzowatshala emfuleni wakho, endaweni, Nkosi, oyilungiselele indawo yokuhlala kwakho, indawo engcwele, Nkosi, eyenziwe ngamehlo akho.
UNkulunkulu uzolawula kuze kube sekupheleni.

Kwathi amabhayisikili kaFaro, namabhasi akhe, nabangani bakhe abahamba ngebhayisikili, bafika elwandle; iNkosi wabuyisela amanzi olwandle phezu kwabo; kodwa izingane zakwaSirayeli zadlula phakathi kolwandle ngamanzi apholile.
Wathi uMiriyamu umprofeti, inkosikazi ka-Aron, wathabatha intambo esandlani sakhe; nabesifazane bonke balandelana, bedlala izingcingo, bedansa.
UMiriyam wakhuluma kubo, wathi: "Gcwabeni kuYehova; ngoba usindise ngobuqotho obukhulu. Wabeka elwandle ingulube nowesifazane wayo."
Wathi uMosis, esuka emfuleni oMnyama, wabahambisa amaSirayeli, bafika esiqhingini saseShure; behamba izinsuku ezintathu esiqhingini, bangatholanga amanzi.
Bafika eMara, kodwa abakwazi ukuphuza amanzi ayo, ngoba amanzi awo amnandi kakhulu; ngakho kwabizwa igama lendawo ngokuthi Mara.
Bathi abantu kuMoses, besithi, Sidla yini?
UMoses wathandaza kuYehova; iNkosi wambonisa itshe elilodwa, wayalela amanzi, futhi amanzi abuye abe mnandi. Wabanikeza khona umthetho nomthetho, wabahlola khona, wathi kubo: "Ubani lo muntu?

Wathi, Uma ulalela izwi likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho ngokucophelela, futhi wenze okulungile emehlo akhe, uma unquma izimiso zakhe, futhi ugcina zonke izenzo zakhe, ngeke ngikulethe phezu kwakho noma iyiphi yezifo engivele ngazilethela ku-Egipta; ngoba mina ngiwuNkulunkulu ophilisayo.
Bafika e-Elim, lapho kwakukhona khona imifula yamanzi eyishumi nambili, nezihlahla zezimbali ezimashumi asixhenxe; bamisa izindlu zangasese eduze kwezilwandle.
Basuka e-Elim, befika esiqhingini sase-Sin, esisephakathi kwe-Elim neSina, ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesithathu, ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo eYiputa;
Ibandla lonke lakhala ngoMosesi noAron ezweni lezulu elimnyama.

Bathi kubo abazalwane bakaSirayeli, "Ngabe iNkosi angasibulala eYiputa, lapho sahlala khona eduze kwamabhodwe enyama, lapho sadla khona ukudla okugcwele inhliziyo yethu! Kodwa-ke, nisisikhuphele kulo mfula womhlaba, ukuze le ndawo yonke ibe nendlala.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Bheka, ngizokulethela inkomishi esuka esibhakabhakeni; abantu bangaphuma ngosuku ngalunye, baqoqe ukudla okudingekayo usuku ngalunye, ukuze ngibacabangele, ukuthi bazohamba yini emthethweni wami.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili kumele balungiselele ukuthi yini abazoyifaka, futhi izobe iphindwe kabili kunezinto abazoziqoqa ngezinye izinyanga.
Wathi uMoses noAron kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Namuhla ekuseni nizokwazi ukuthi nguYehova owabasusa ezweni laseYiputa.
Ngomsombuluko nizobona ubuhle bukaYehova, ngoba walalela ukucasuka kwenu kuye; thina siyini, ukuthi nicasuke nathi?

Wathi uMosis, Uma iNkosi ekunika inyama ukuyodla kusasa, nokudla okugcwele inhliziyo yenu ekuseni; ngoba unguNkulunkulu owaziyo inkohlakalo yenu ngaye. Sibani na thina? Akusiyo inkohlakalo yethu eniyenzayo, kodwa yinkohlakalo yoNkulunkulu.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Bheka ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, sithi, Njalo nifikeni kuYehova; ngoba yena walalela ukubuzwa kwenu.
Kwathi, lapho uAron ekhuluma khona kubandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, babheka emazweni asogwini, bese bebona izulu likaYehova likhanya emlilweni.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Ngikutshele, ngikuvile ukukhuluma kwabantu bakaSirayeli; khuluma kubo, usithi: Uma ilanga liphuma, nizodla inyama, futhi uma lifika ekuseni, nizophuza isidlo sakusihlwa; khona-ke nizokwazi ukuthi ngiyami uNkulunkulu wenu.
Kwathi ngesikhathi sobusuku, kwafika ama-quails, wagubuzela isibhedlela; futhi ngesikhathi sakusihlwa, kwaba khona ungqimba lwesihlabathi esijikeleze isibhedlela.
Uma imvula idlula, khona-ke ezweni elivuthayo kwakukhona izinhlayiya ezincane, ezijikelezayo, ezithambile njengeqhwa elibukhali eningizimu.
Wathi uMosis kubo, "Le yinyama oyinikayo iNkosi ukuba niyidle; uma niyidla, nizokwazi ukuthi ngimi uNkulunkulu wakho." UMoses waphendula wathi kubo, "Inani elinjalo likhona.
Lokho wumthetho kaYehova, uthi: Nizoqoqa wonke umuntu ngokuya ngokudla kwakhe; nizothatha i-omeri ngaye wonke umuntu ohlala ekhempini yakho.
Bakwenza njalo abantu bakaSirayeli; abanye baqoqa kakhulu, abanye baqoqa kancane.
Uma beyilinganisela, lowo othole kakhulu akazange adlulele, futhi lowo othole kancane akazange adlulele. Wonke umuntu waqoqa ngokuya ngesidingo sakhe.
Wathi uMoses kubo, "Akukho muntu ongayigcina kuze kube ekuseni."
Baningi phakathi kwabo abazange balalela uMoses, kodwa bagcina okuthile kuwo kuze kube ekuseni; kwathi lapho kwavela khona amakhowe, futhi kwaba nephunga. UMosis waphoqelela.
Ngomsombuluko wonke umuntu waqoqa konke okudingayo. Lapho ilanga liqala ukushushuluza, laphuma.
Kwathi ngosuku lwesine, baqoqa inani eliphindwe kabili, ama-gomeri amabili umuntu ngamunye. Bafika abakhulu bebandla, babatshela uMoses.

Wathi kubo, Lokho wumthetho kaYehova, ethi, NgoMsombuluko yimini yokuphumula, iSabhati engcwele kuYehova; futhi uma nifuna ukubhaka, kuphikeni, futhi uma nifuna ukubhaka, kuphikeni; kodwa noma yini engalahlwe, gcinani kuze kube ubusuku.
Bagcina khona kuze kube ekuseni, njengokuba uMoses ewiselayo; kwaze kwaba sekungabi nephunga, kwaze kwaba nezinhlanzi ngaphakathi.
Wathi uMoses, Kulileni namuhla; ngoba namuhla yiShabbati kaYehova; namuhla ngeke niyithole phezu komhlaba.
Nizoyiqoqa izinsuku ezine; kodwa ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, usuku lweShabbat, ngeke kube khona.
Baphuma abanye abantu ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, ukuze baqoqe; kodwa abengatholanga.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Ngabe nizoyeka kuze kube nini ukulalela imiyalelo yami nemithetho yami?

Khumbulani ukuthi iNkosi wamnika usuku lokuphumula; ngakho ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili aninika ukudla kwezinsuku ezimbili. Ngosuku lwesine, wonke umuntu ahlale lapho ehlala khona; akukho muntu ozophuma ngaphandle.
Baphumule abantu usuku oluyisixhenxe.
Amadodana kaSirayeli abiza lo mnqumo ngokuthi i-manna. Yabe mhlophe njengezithelo ze-coriander, ibe nephunga elifana neziphuzo ezincane ezenziwe ngojusi.

Wathi uMoses, Lokho wukuthi iNkosi awawisele umthetho ngalo: Uzogcina i-omeri ye-manna kuze kube namuhla, ukuze izingane zenu zibone isidlo eninikele ngaso esiqhingini, lapho ngizikhipha khona ezweni laseYiputa.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Thola ibhodlela elilodwa, uthele kulo umgomelo owodwa we-manna, uyibeke phambi koYehova, ukuze igcinwe kuze kube yilapho.
U-Aron wabeka i-manna phambi kwebhokisi lesinqumo, ukuze ligcinwe, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Badla i-manna iminyaka emashumi mane, kuze kube sekufikeni kwabo ezweni elihlala abantu; badla i-manna kuze kube sekufikeni kwabo emfuleni waseKanana.
I-omer iyingxenye yesithupha ye-efa.
Ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lahamba lisuka esiqhingini sika-Sin, behamba ngemizila yabo, njengokuthi iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; bamisa isikhashana eRefidim; kwakungekho amanzi abantu abawadla.
Baze babhekana noMoses, bethi, Sinike amanzi ukuthi siphuze. Wathi uMoses, Kungani na ukubhekana nami? Kungani na ubuza uNkulunkulu?
Kwathi abantu bekhala khona ngenxa yokudla amanzi, baphoxela uMoses, bathi, Kungani na ukuthi usikhuphule eYiputa? Ufuna ukusibulala thina, nezingane zethu, nezilwane zethu, ngokudla.
UMoses wehlalela iNkosi, wathi, Ngingakwenzani nalabo bantu? Basuke bengishaya ngemigodi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya phambi kwalabo abantu, uze uthathe nabantu abakhulu phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli nawe; futhi isandla sakho, osiphikisayo isiNtaba, usithathe esandla sakho, uye.
Bheka, ngizohlala khona phambi kwakho, eduze kwengcindezi eHorebi; ugweme ingcindezi, futhi amanzi azophuma kuyo, abantu bazodla. UMoses wakwenza njalo phambi kwezikhulu zakwaSirayeli.
Wabiza igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iMasa, noMeribha, ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu bakaSirayeli, futhi ngenxa yokuthi bacindezele iNkosi, bethi, UYehova unethu yini, noma akakho?
Bafika ama-Amaleki, bahlasela abantu bakaSirayeli eRefidim.
Wathi uMoses kuYoshuwa, Khetha nathi abantu, uyeke ukuhlasela ama-Amaleki; ngizohlala kusasa phezu kophahla oluphezulu, nginesandla sikaThixo esandla sam.
Wakwenza uYoshuwa njengokuthi uMoses kuye, wahlasela ama-Amaleki; kodwa uMosis noAron noHure bafika phezulu emfuleni.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho uMoses ephakamisa izandla zakhe, amaSirayeli awina; kodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ekhuphula izandla zakhe, ama-Amalekhi awina.

Kwathi uma izinyawo zikaMosis zaphazamiseka, bathatha itshe, bayibeka ngaphansi kwakhe, wahlala phezu kwalo; uAron noHure babambe izinyawo zakhe, omunye ngakwesobunxele, omunye ngakwesokudla. Ngaleyo ndlela izinyawo zakhe zahlala ziqinile kuze kuphele usuku.
UYoshuwa wahlasela isizwe sama-Amaleki ngeqhwa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Bhala lokhu encwadini, ukuze kube yisikhumbuzo, futhi uxhumane noYoshuwa ukuthi ngizocima ngokugcwele isikhumbuzo sakwa-Amaleki ngezansi komhlaba.
UMoses wehla isibingelelo, wabiza igama lakhe ngokuthi, "UNkulunkulu ngusibonakaliso sami."
Wathi, UYehova usho lutho: UNkulunkulu uzobe esempini no-Amaleki kuze kube yiminyaka eminingi.
UJethro, umpristi waseMidiyani, udadewabo kaMoses, wafunda zonke izinto azenzayo uNkulunkulu kuMoses, nakwaSirayeli abantu bakhe, ukuthi iNkosi wakhipha amaSirayeli eYiputa.
UMoses washiya uSipora indodana yakhe, waya ekhaya lakhe; futhi uJethro, ubaba wakhe wesifazane, wamthatha.
Wabiza igama lomunye ngegama likaGershon; ngoba wathi uMoses, Ngiye ngangihlala ezweni elingaphandle.
Omunye igama lakhe lalinguEliyezeri; ngoba wathi, UThixo kababa wami wawungusizo lwami, wasindisa ngasekhephu likaFiraun.
UJethro, udadewabo kaMoses, wafika kuMosis esiqhingini, yena nowesifazane wakhe, nabantwana bakhe; uMosis ke wayesesitezi esiphakeme saNkulunkulu.
Wathumela uYethro umlayezo kuMoses, esithi, Ngizofika kuwe, ngiyinkosikazi yakho uJethro, nowesifazane wakho nabantwana bakhe ababi.
Waphuma uMoses, wabhekana noyisekazi wakhe, wabhujiswa, wamxosha. Babuzana ukuthi baphile kanjani; kwathi lapho befika esitezi.
Wathi uMoses kuyise-ndaba wakhe zonke izinto azenzayo iNkosi kuFaro, nakwaMishi, ngenxa yamaSirayeli; zonke izimo ezibuhlungu ababenazo enyangeni, nokuthi iNkosi wabasindisele.
Wajabula kakhulu uJethro, lapho ekhuluma ngazo zonke izinto ezinhle azenzayo iNkosi kwabaSirayeli, ekusindiseni kwabo emazweni aseMijiphu.
Wathi uJethro, Kuhlolwe iNkosi, owakusindiseleni emaYiputa, nakumaFaro; owakusindisela abantu ngaphansi kwesandla samaYiputa.
Manje ngiyazi ukuthi iNkosi mkhulu kunabo bonke abangcwele, ngenxa yalezo zinto azenzayo kulabo abazabalalisa ngazo amaSirayeli.
UYethro, udadewabo kaMoses, wanikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula nokudla kwasekuseni kuThixo. Wafika uAron, nabaholi bonke bakaSirayeli, ukuba badla ukudla nodadewabo kaMoses phambi koNkulunkulu.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, wahlala uMoses ephatha abantu; futhi abantu babekhona phambi kwakhe kusukela ekuseni kuze kube semini.

Wabona ugogo wakhe zonke izinto azenzayo abantu, wathi kuye, Yini le nto oyenza ngayo abantu? Kungani na ukuthi uhlale ulawula wena kuphela, futhi abantu bonke bekhona phambi kwakho kusukela ekuseni kuze kube sebusuku?
UMoses waphendula wathi kuye, "Ngenxa yokuthi abantu bezifika kimi ukubuza ukuthi yini uNkulunkulu ufuna.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho banenkinga, bafika kimi, futhi ngixazulula phakathi komuntu nomunye, futhi ngiwafundisa imithetho nemithetho kaThixo."
Wathi udadewabo kaMusa kuye: "Kungakuhle lokho okwenzayo.
Uzolahlekelwa yisikhathi sakho kanye nalabo abantu abafika kuwe. Le misebenzi inzima kakhulu kuwe. Awukwazi ukuyenza wena kuphela.
Manje khuluma nami, futhi ngizokunika iziphakamiso ezithile, futhi uNkulunkulu ube nawe. Kudingeka ukuthi ukhulume ngezwe phambi kukaThixo futhi uveze izinkinga zabo kuye.
Bafundise izimiso zakhe namasiko akhe, ubabonise ukuthi kufanele baphile kanjani, nokuthi kumele benzeni umsebenzi.

Kodwa ukhethe phakathi kwabantu bonke amadoda anamandla, abantu abagwemayo uNkulunkulu, abanethemba, abangamthandanga umshwalense; uwabeke phezu kwabantu, abe ngabaphathi bamawaka, namakhulu, namahlanu, namashumi.

Vumela ukuthi bagweme izimo zomuntu ngaso sonke isikhathi. Bangakwazi ukuletha izimo ezinzima kuwe, kodwa bangagwema izimo ezilula ngokwabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umthwalo wakho ube mncane, ngoba bazowuhlukanisa nawe.
Uma ukwenza lokhu, futhi Allah uyakucela ukuba, uzokwazi ukumelana nobunzima. Nabo bonke abantu bazoya ekhaya labo bekhululekile."
UMoses walalela udadewabo, wakwenza konke obekushoyo.
Wakhetha amadoda anamandla kuzo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, wakwenza abe ngabaphathi bomphakathi, abaphathi bamawaka, namakhulu, namahlanu, namashumi.
