Bathi balungisa abantu ngaso sonke isikhathi; izingxabano ezinzima babeziletha kuMoses, kodwa izingqungquthela ezilula babezilungisa bona.
Wathi uMosis, ashiye udadewabo, wahamba; waya ezweni lakhe lakhe.
Ngonyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo eYiputa, ngomhla owodwa bafika emfuleni iSinayi.
Besuka eRefidim, befika emfuleni iSina; bamisa khona amaSirayeli esihlabathini, phambi kombhoshongo.
UMoses wanyuka waya kuThixo, iNkosi wambiza emfuleni, wathi, Kulokhu ozothi emndenini kaYakobi, futhi uzokutshela izingane zakwaSirayeli:
Wabona ukuthi ngikwenze kanjani eYiputa, nokuthi ngakuthwala kanjani phezu kwamaphiko omnqumo, futhi ngakuletha kimi.
Uma ningilalela ngeqiniso, futhi nigcina isivumelwano sami, khona-ke ningaba impahla yami ekhethekile phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe; ngoba umhlaba wonke ungumkhaya wami.
kodwa nizobe ngumbuso wami wamabhishobhi, nezwe elingcwele. Lawa amazwi ozokhuluma ngawo kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wabuyela uMoses, wahlanganisa bonke abakhulu bomphakathi, wabatshela zonke lezi zinto iNkosi abemwisile ukuthi azikhulume.
Baphendula bonke abantu ndawonye, bethi, Zonke izinto akhuluma ngazo iNkosi sizozenza. UMoses waveza kukaNkulunkulu impendulo yabantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, "Njengoba ngizofika kuwe entwasahlobo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukungilalela uma bekhuluma nawe, futhi bakholwa kuwe nsuku zonke." UMosesi waveza iNkosi amazwi abantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Iya kubo abantu, ubangcwelele namuhla nakusasa; bahlanze izigqoko zabo;
Uzobe ulungile ngosuku olulandelayo, emini yesithathu. Ngosuku olulodwa iNkosi uzowela phezu komfula iSinayi phambi kwamehlo abantu bonke.

Uthi uMoses kuMosis: "Nquma umkhawulo phakathi kwalabo abantu, bese ukhuluma kubo, usithi: 'Khumbulani ukuthi ningayikhuphuka intaba-mlilo, noma ukuthi ningayifinyeleli isiphetho sayo; wonke umuntu ozoyifinyelela intaba-mlilo uzofa.

Akukho muntu ozowushaya lowo muntu; kufanele agwegwe ngetshe, noma aqhutshwe ngamabhodlela. Noma ngabe umuntu, noma ngabe isilwane, ngeke siphile. Uma nje isidumbu sengulube siphuza umsindo omde, kumele bafike emfuleni."
UMoses wehla emfuleni, waya kulabo abantu, wabahlanza; futhi bahlamba izigqoko zabo.
Wathi ke kubo abantu, Bukelani kuze kube yimini yesithathu; akufanele nihlangane nendodakazi.

Ngosuku lwesithathu, ekuseni, kwabe sengathi kunezingqimba-ngqimba, nezingqimba-ngqimba, nezivunguvungu, namafu abandayo emfuleni; futhi kwabe sengathi kukhona umsindo omkhulu kakhulu wezinhlamvu; abantu bonke abasemakhazeni bakhathazeka.
Wakhipha uMoses abantu ezindaweni zokuhlala, ukuba bahlangane noNkulunkulu; behlala eduze komfula.
futhi iNtaba iSinayi yaqhuma ngomlilo, ngoba iNkosi wakhuphuka phezu kwayo emlilweni; futhi iphunga layo likhuphuka, njengephunga lefuthe, futhi intaba yonke yaqhuma kakhulu.
Izwi lempophoma lakhula, likhula; uMoses wakhuluma, futhi uNkulunkulu wamphendula ngezwi elifana nelanga.
Wakhuphuka iNkosi esigabeni esiphezulu somfula iSina, wayalela uMoses esigabeni esiphezulu somfula; wanyuka uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Thola, uxhumane nabantu, ukuthi bangaphazamisi indlela yabo, babone iNkosi, ukuze abaningi babo bangafa.
Nakuba ababhishobhi, abafikayo kuYehova, kumele bahlanzeke; noma ngabe iNkosi uzowaphonsa kuwo.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Abantu bangayinyuka intaba iSinayi; ngoba wena wawuthumelele isivivinyo, uthi, Yibeke umkhawulo enkabeni yentaba, uyigcine ibe ngcwele.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Thola phezulu no-Aron nawe; kodwa ababhishobhi nabantu kumele bagweme ukunyuka befike kukaNkulunkulu, ukuze angeke abe nengozi kubo.
Wathi uMoses, ehla kuye abantu, wabatshela.
Wathi uNkulunkulu la mazwi onke:
Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, owenza ukuba niphume ezweni laseMisiyani, ukuze ningabi ngabakhonzi.
Awunawo amanye ama-Gods ngaphandle kwami.
Musa ukwenza wena itshe elibi, noma uhlobo lwanoma yini elikhona ezulu phezulu, noma elikhona ezweni ngezansi, noma elikhona emanzini angaphansi komhlaba.

Ungazibophezela ngazo, ungazinikela ngazo; ngoba ngimi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, uNkulunkulu othandana nothando, enquma isono samababa ezinganeni, kuze kube yiminyaka emithathu namashumi amane yalabo abangikhohlisa.
futhi ngibonisa uthando labo abamithandayo, nalabo abagcina imiyalo yami, kuze kube yiminyaka emikhulu.
Mhlawumbe ngeke usebenzise igama likaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho ngendlela engalungile; ngoba iNkosi ngeke agweme umonakalo lowo osebenzisa igama lakhe ngendlela engalungile.
Khumbula usuku lweSonto, ugcine lungcwele.
Unezinsuku ezingu-6 zokusebenzela futhi wenze imisebenzi yakho yonke

kodwa usuku oluyisixhenxe ngusuku lokuphumula kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; ungakwenzanga umsebenzi othile, wena, noma unyana wakho, noma intombi yakho, noma umkhonzi wakho, noma indodakazi yakho, noma inkomo yakho, noma wonke umuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe ohlala ezindaweni zakho.
ngoba ngosuku olune, iNkosi wenze izulu, nezwe, nolwandle, nanoma yini ekhona kuzo, waphumula usuku lwesine; ngakho iNkosi wabambisa usuku lokuphumula, wawungcwele.
Hlala ubaba wakho nomama wakho, ukuze uhlale isikhathi eside ezweni iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
Musa ukubulala.
Musa ukubhema.
Musa ukudlwengula.
Ungasho ubugebengu mayelana nomngane wakho enkantolo.
Ungayifuna indlu yomngane wakho, ungayifuna indodana yomngane wakho, noma umkhonzi wakhe, noma intombazane yakhe, noma inkomo yakhe, noma idlovukazi yakhe, noma into yonke yomngane wakho.
Kwathi lapho abantu beva khona umlilo, nezwi lebhodlela, nokukhanya, nentaba eqhumayo, baphoqeleka ukuba bakhathazeke, bahlale eduze.
Bathi kuMoses, Ukhuluma nathi wena, futhi sizolalela; kodwa angeke uNkulunkulu akhulume nathi, ukuze singafa.
UMusa wathi kulabo abantu: "Ungabikho ukhathazeka, ngoba u-Allaah wafika nje ukuze akuxhumaneni nani, futhi abeke engqondweni yenu ukukhathazeka Kwakhe.
Bahlala abantu eduze, kanti uMoses wafinyelela emthunzini omkhulu lapho uNkulunkulu ekhona khona.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uzothi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Nibona ukuthi ngikhuluma nani kusuka ezulu.
Akufanele ukwenze nabangani bakho begolide noma besiliva, ukuze nibe nabo.
Uzongilungisa isibingelelo somhlaba, uzonginikela kuso izipho zakho ezibomvu, nezipho zakho zokuthula, izinkomo zakho, namakhowe akho; lapho ngibeka khona igama lami, ngizofika kuwe, ngikusindise.
Uma ungenza isibingelelo sami samatshe, ungawukwakhanga ngamatshe aqoshiwe; ngoba uma usebenzisa isandla sakho kuyo, uzoyisusa ibe yindawo engcwele.
Akufanele ukhuphuke ezinyathelweni zesibingelelo sami, ukuze kungabikho okuboniswa khona ikhanda lakho.
"Lezi yizimiso okufanele uzibeke phambi kwabantu:
Uma uthenga umkhonzi waseHebhere, uzosebenza nawe iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili; kodwa ngonyaka wesixhenxe uzophuma ekhululekile, ngaphandle kokukhokha.
Uma efika yena kuphela, kufanele ahambe yena kuphela; uma efika enenkosikazi, kumele ihambe naye.
Uma umnikazi wakhe emnika indodakazi, futhi yena ezala unyana noma izingane, khona-ke indodakazi nezingane zayo zizobe ziye kumnikazi wayo; yena kuphela ozophuma.
Uma lo mkhonzi esho ngokucacile, ethi, Ngithanda umnikazi wami, nowesifazane wami, nezingane zami; angeke ngiphume ngikhululekile:
lapho-ke umnikazi wakhe kufanele amveze kuThixo, afike emgwaqweni noma enkabeni yomgwaqo, afake isandla esiqinile endlebeni lakhe. Uzobe ngumkhonzi wakhe nsuku zonke.
Uma umuntu ethengisa intombi yakhe ibe ngumkhonzi, angeke ihambe ikhululekile ngendlela abakhonzi abangasekho ngayo.
Uma engathandeki kumnikazi wakhe, owazikhethela yena, khona-ke kufanele amthengele; ngeke akwazi ukumthengisa kwabanye abantu, ngoba waphula isinqumo sakhe kuye.
Uma ekhetha yena njengomntwana wakhe, kufanele amphathe njengendodana.
Uma eshada omunye indodakazi, akudingeki ukuthi athathe isidlo sayo, noma izigqoko zayo, noma ilungelo lakhe likamfazi.
Uma engazininika lezi zinto ezintathu, khona-ke izophuma ikhululekile ngaphandle kokukhokha imali.
Wonke umuntu oshaya umuntu bese ebulala yena kumele abulawa.
Kodwa uma engazange akwenze, futhi uNkulunkulu evumela ukuthi kwenzeke, khona-ke angaya endaweni ngizoyikhetha wena.
Uma umuntu efuna ukumbulala omunye umuntu ngenhloso, uzowususa kulesi sibhedlela sami, ugweme umonakalo.
Uma umuntu ehlasela ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe, kumele abulawa.
Wonke umuntu obulala omunye umuntu kufanele agwenywe, noma ngabe wathengisa lowo muntu noma uhlala naye.
Uma umuntu ebulala ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe, kumele abulawa.
Kubhekwe ukuthi abantu ababini babhekana, futhi omunye ushaya owodwa ngetshe noma ngomlomo wakhe. Umsolwa akafanga kodwa kufanele ahlale embhedeni.

Uma ngemuva kwalokho evuka futhi ehamba ngaphandle ngentambo yokuhamba, umuntu owushayayo ngeke agwenywe. Kodwa-ke kufanele akhokhele umsolwa isikhathi sakhe esilahlekile, futhi abhekane naye kuze kube sekuhleliwe ngokuphelele.
Uma umuntu eshaya umkhonyovu wakhe owesifazane noma owesifazane ngentambo, futhi umkhonyovu wehla emgwaqeni, lowo muntu kufanele agwenywe.
Uma evuka ngemuva kosuku noma usuku olulodwa, umnikazi wakhe ngeke agwenywe, ngoba umkhonyovu ungumnini wakhe.

Uma amadoda ebhekana nowesifazane okhulelwe, futhi ubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa akukho buhlungu obukhulu, lowo owayemdlwengula kufanele akhokhele noma yini oyifunayo indodakazi yakhe futhi abameli bavumele.
Kodwa uma kunengozi enkulu, kufanele uthathe impilo ngempilo,
ikhanda ngekhanda, izinyo ngezinyo, isandla ngesandla, ingalo ngengalo,
umlilo ngomlilo, umkhuhlane ngomkhuhlane, ikhanda ngekhanda.
Uma umuntu eshaya umkhonzi wakhe owesifazane noma owesifazane emlonyeni wakhe, ewususa, kufanele avumele umkhonzi ukuba ahambe ngokukhululekileyo ukuze akhokhele ikhanda.
Uma edonsa izinyo lomkhonzi wakhe owesifazane noma owesifazane, kufanele avumele umkhonzi ukuba ahambe mahhala ukuze akhokhele izinyo.
Uma ingulube ibulala indoda noma indodakazi ngezinkomo zayo, ingulube kumele igcwaliswe ngamatshe, futhi inyama yayo kufanele ingadlalwanga; kodwa umnikazi wengulube ngeke agwenywe.

Uma ingulube ingumdlavuza, futhi umnikazi wayo uphoqelwe ukuba agcine ingulube ephephile, kodwa akagcinanga ingulube emgwaqeni, bese ibulala indoda noma indodakazi, khona-ke ingulube kufanele iqhutshwe ngamatshe, nomnikazi wayo kumele abulawa.
Kodwa uma umnikazi evunyelwe ukukhokha imali endaweni, kufanele akhokhele noma yini edingekayo ukuvikela impilo yakhe.
Umthetho ofanayo usebenza uma inkomo ihlasele indodana noma intombi.
Uma inkomo ihlasela umkhonzi owesifazane noma wesifazane, unikazi kufanele akhokhele uMphathi we-slave amaphuzu angama-30 egolide, futhi inkomo kumele ihlelwe.
Uma umuntu evula intaba-mlilo, noma eqoqa intaba-mlilo, futhi engayiqoqi, khona-ke ingulube noma isimbuzi siwela kuyo.
Umnikazi we-pit kufanele akhokhele ukulahleka. Kudingeka akhokhise umnikazi wayo, futhi inhlanzi efile izobe ikhona kuye.
Uma ingulube yomuntu ebulala ingulube yomunye umuntu, kufanele bathengise ingulube ephilayo futhi bahlukanise imali. Bahlukanise nenyama efile.

Kodwa-ke uma wonke umuntu eyazi ukuthi ingulube inesimo sokuhlaselwa, futhi umnikazi wayo akazange ayigcine ihlanganiswe phezulu, umnikazi kufanele akhokhele, ingulube ephilayo yelinye elifile, futhi inhlanzi efile izobe yakhe.
Uma umuntu ephuca inkomo, noma ingulube, bese uyibulala, noma iyithengisa, kufanele abuyisele inkomo emihlanu ngengulube, noma ingulube eyisikhombisa ngengulube.
Uma umdlavuza etholakalela ukungena ekhaya ekuseni futhi ehlaselwa futhi ebulawa, umuntu obulalayo akabi necala lokubulala.

Kodwa uma kwenzeka ngemuva kokuba ilanga liphuma, umuntu obulalayo uzoba necala lokudlwengula. Umshayeli kufanele abuyisele emuva lokho okudlwengulayo. Uma akakho, kumele athengiswe abe ngumkhonzi ukuze akhokhelwe lokho okudlwengulayo.
Uma etholakele ephila naye, noma ngabe ingulube, noma inkomo, noma inkomo, kufanele ayibuyisele ngokuphindaphinda.
Uma umuntu eshiya izilwane zakhe zidlale emhlabathini noma emvinini, futhi azisandise ukuze zidle emhlabathini wesifazane, kufanele akhokhele ukulahleka okungcono emhlabathini wakhe noma emvini.

Uma umlilo uphuma futhi wasakazeka ezindaweni ezinamahlombe, ngakho-ke waphoqa ukudlidliza izinkomishi zezinkomo, noma izinkomo ezihambayo, noma indawo yonke, lowo oqale umlilo kufanele akhokhele ilahleko.
Uma umuntu enikeza umngane wakhe imali noma izinto zokuzivikela, futhi zitholwe efulethini lomngane wakhe, uma utholakale, kufanele abuyisele iphindwe kabili.
Uma ke umgibeli engatholakali, khona-ke umnikazi wendlu kumele afike kukaNkulunkulu, ukuze abone ukuthi ngabe yena wathatha izinto zomndeni wakhe.

Uma kukhulunywa nganoma yisiphi isinqumo mayelana nempahla, noma kube inkomo, noma idlalwa, noma ingulube, noma izicathulo, noma iyiphi into elahlekile, futhi umuntu uthi: 'Lena lingane yami', khona-ke uveze isinqumo sabo bonke phambi kuka-Allah. Owesifazane ohlonishwa ngu-Allah kufanele abuyisele owesifazane ohlonishwayo amaphesenti amabili.

Uma umuntu enikeza umngane wakhe inkomo, noma ingulube, noma udoti, noma iyiphi enye inyama yenkomo, ukuthi ayilondoloze, ibe seyifile, noma ibe seyilahlekile, noma ibe seyithathwe, ngaphandle komuntu obhekene nayo,
umngane wakhe kufanele aphike phambi kukaYehova ukuthi akathathenga impahla yomngane wakhe. Umnikazi kumele avume lokhu, futhi akudingeki ukukhokha.
Kodwa-ke uma inhlanzi itholwe emgwaqweni, kumele akhokhele umnikazi wayo.
Uma ihlukaniswe ngezingxenye yinyamakazi emnyama, kufanele aveze izicubu njengesibopho. Akudingeki ukuthi akhokhele ngento ehlukaniswe ngezingxenye.
Uma umuntu ethatha inhlanzi evela kumngane wakhe, futhi inhlanzi ilahlekile noma ifile ngesikhathi umnikazi wayo engakhona, kufanele akhokhele.
Kodwa uma umnikazi wayekhona, umqashi akadingi ukukhokha. Uma isilwane saqeshwa, imali ekhokhwayo yokuqasha ihlanganisa ukulimala.

Uma umuntu etshela indodakazi yakhe ukuba ibe nocansi naye, futhi yena ube yindodana yowesifazane ongeke aqinisekiswe ukuthi uzoshada naye, khona-ke kufanele akhokhele izindleko zomtshali-zimali futhi amshade.
Uma ubaba wakhe engavumelani ngokugcwele ukuthi azinikele kuye, kufanele akhokhele izindleko eziphelele zenkosikazi ekhokhwa yindodana.
Akufanele uvumele indodana yowesifazane ukuba iphile.
Wonke umuntu osebenza ngesondo nenyama kumele agwenywe.
Wonke umuntu onikela ngesihluthulelo nganoma yimuphi uNkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaYehova, kufanele aphelelwe.
Umuntu ovela kwelinye izwe akufanele ugweme, angeke ugweme; ngoba nibe bangaphandle ezweni lakwaMisiya.
Uma ungumkakhe noma uninakazi, khona-ke ungawuxhaphazi.
Uma uyenza, futhi bacela kuye, ngizozizwa ngokuqinisekile izingcezu zabo.
futhi ubuhlungu bami ngeke kuqhume, futhi ngizokubulala ngeqhwa; futhi izifazane zakho zizobe ziyindodakazi, futhi izingane zakho - abafa.
Uma udlulisa imali kumuntu omnyama emndenini wami, ungayiphatha njengomsebenzi webhizinisi, futhi awudingi ukukhokha inzalo.
Uma uthatha isigqoko senkosikazi yakho njengobufakazi bokuthi uzokukhokhela, uyibuyisele kuye ngaphambi kokuba ilanga livale.
ngoba i-coat iyinto eyingqayizivele yokuvikela umzimba wakhe. Ingabe uzolala kuphi? Uma ekhala ngami, ngizokulalela, ngoba ngiyiqiniso.
Musa ukukhuluma ngokubi ku-Allah, futhi ungamabulali umphathi wezwe lakho.
Ungayivimbeli inzalo yakho, noma iwayini lakho elisha, noma uphethiloli wakho; umzali wesifazane wezingane zakho uzonginika.
Ngokufana nalokho uzokwenza nezingulube zakho, nezinkomo zakho; kufanele zihlale ngosuku olusixhenxe ezinja zabo, futhi usuku lwesibhozo uzinikeze.
Nizoba abantu bami abangcwele. Ngakho-ke, ngeke nidle inyama yomuntu obulalayo izinyamazane ezindaweni zomhlaba; kumele niyithule ezinja.
"Musa ukusakaza izindaba ezingekho emthethweni. Musa ukusiza umuntu owinile ngokutshela ubugebengu enkantolo.
Uma ukhuluma emthethweni, akufanele uthathe isikhundla sabantu abathile ukuze ushintshe inkohliso.
Uma umfowabo efuna usizo, awukwazi ukuwunika ngenxa yokuthi ungakwazi.
Uma ubona inkomo noma ingulube yomshayeli wakho ihamba, qiniseka ukuthi uyibuyisela kuye.
Uma ubona inkomo yomuntu ofuna ukukukhohlisa ilala ngaphansi kwesisindo sayo, akufanele uhambe kude. Qiniseka ukuthi uyisiza ngayo.
Musa ukukhohlisa abantu abafileyo ngecala labo enkantolo.
Uzohlala eduze kwecala elibi; ngeke ukhulule umuntu ongenacala, futhi olungile; ngoba ngingeke ngivumele lowo onecala ukuthi aphume.
Musa ukuthatha inkokhelo, ngoba inkokhelo iphikisa labo ababonayo, futhi iguqula amazwi abantu abalungile.
Uma ukhuluma nomuntu ongaphandle kwezwe, ungamcindezeli; ngoba niyazi ukuthi kungathiwa umuntu ongaphandle kwezwe, ngoba nibe bantu abangaphandle eYiputa.
Uzotshala izitshalo zakho iminyaka eyisithupha, uqoqe izithelo zabo.

Kodwa ngonyaka wesixhenxe ushiye izwe liphumule, ungayitshalanga; ukuze abantu bakho abahlwempu bakwazi ukuyodla, futhi izilwane eziphila ezindaweni ezishisayo zidle lokho okushiwo ngazo. Ngokufana nalokho wenze nezihlahla zakho zewayini, nezitshalo zakho ze-olive.
Izinsuku ezine kwenze umsebenzi wakho, kodwa ngosuku oluyisixhenxe uphumule, ukuze ingulube yakho nebhokhwe lakho ziphumule, futhi umkhonzi wakho nomunye ohlala phakathi kwakho aphumule.
Uzobhekana, ukwenze konke okungiwisele kuwe; ngeke ubize amagama amanye amagugu, noma abizwa ngegama labo emlonyeni wakho.
Kathathu ngonyaka kufanele ugcine isidlo sami.

Yenza izinsuku ezisithupha ukudla ukudla okungalethwa ngamanzi, njengoba ngikuwisela umthetho ngalo, ngesikhathi senyanga ka-Abib; ngoba kulo nyaka waphuma eYiputa. Akukho muntu ozofika phambi kwami enesandla esingenalutho. Uzogcina izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili ukudla ukudla okungalethwa ngamanzi, njengokuba ngikuwisele umthetho ngawo.

Uzogcina isikhumbuzo sokukhuliswa kwezithelo zakho, kanye nesikhumbuzo sokuqoqwa kwazo zonke izitshalo zakho ezikhula ezweni lakho; futhi uzogcina isikhumbuzo sokuqoqwa konyaka ophelile, lapho uqoqa khona imbewu yakho ezweni.
Kathathu ngonyaka kufanele bafike bonke amadodana akho phambi koNkosi uNkulunkulu.
Ungayinikelanga igazi lento engiyisayo, kanye nokudla okuhlanganisiwe; futhi ushukela wosuku lwami ongawushiyanga kuze kube ekuseni.
Izinto ezinhle kakhulu zezithelo zokuqala zezwe lakho uzozifaka endlwini kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho; awukwazi ukubhaka ingulube emthethweni womama wayo.
Bheka, ngithumela isithunywa ngaphambili kwakho, ukuba akugcinele enyangeni yakho, futhi akungenise endaweni engiyinikele.
Ngiyakucela, ucabangele amazwi akhe; ungamkhohlisi; ngeke alungise ukukhohlisa kwenu, ngoba igama lami likhona ngaphakathi kwakhe.
Uma ulalela ngokucophelela lokho akushoyo, futhi wenze konke ongangikutshela ngawo, ngizobe ngumfowabo wabafowabo bakho, futhi ngizobhekana nalabo ababhekana nawe.
Futhi ngithi kuwe, UNkulunkulu uthi lokhu: "Izinja zami zizohamba phambi kwakho, futhi ngizokungenisa ezweni lama-Amori, nama-Hethi, nama-Perizi, nama-Kanana, nama-Hivi, namaJebhusi.
Ungawukhonzi uNkulunkulu wabo, ungawukhonza, futhi ungahamba ngezinqumo zabo; kodwa kufanele ubhubhise wonke uNkulunkulu wabo, nophahla lwawo olungcwele.
Uzokhonza iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho, futhi uzosindisa ukudla kwakho namanzi akho; futhi ngizosusa izifo phakathi kwakho.
Akuzoba khona indodakazi engekho, noma indodakazi engazalwanga, ezweni lakho; ngizokunika izinsuku ezigcwele.
Ngizothumela ukukhathazeka kwami phambi kwakho, futhi ngizophazamisa izwe ngalinye elibhekene nawe; futhi ngizobeka izitha zakho zonke zihambe.
Ngizothumela izinyosi phambi kwakho, zikhuphule amaHivi, namaKanana, namaHethi, phambi kwakho.
Ngizowasusa enyaka owodwa, ukuze izwe lingabi yindawo yokugcina izinto, futhi izilwane eziphilayo zezulu zingaba yizinyamazane kuwe.
Ngizowasusa kancane kancane, kuze kube sengathi nikhule kakhulu, nikwazi ukuphatha izwe.

Ngizobeka umkhawulo wakho kusukela emfuleni omnyama, kuze kube emfuleni wamaFilisti; futhi ngizobeka umkhawulo wakho kusuka ezweni elibandayo kuya komfula i-Euphrates. Ngizobanikela phambi kwakho abantu abahlala kulolu lizwe, wena uzowasusa phambi kwakho.
Musa ukwenza noma iyiphi inkontileka nabo noma ngemikhosi yabo.
Akufanele bahlale ezweni lakho, ukuze bangakubangela ukwenzele isono ngami; ngoba uma ukhonza amasiko abo, ngeke kube yingozi kuwe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ufike kukaNkulunkulu wena no-Aron, noNadabu no-Abihu, namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli amashumi asixhenxe; nizibophezele kude.
UMoses kuphela ozofika kukaNkulunkulu; abanye ngeke bafike, futhi abantu ngeke bakhuphuke naye.
Wafika uMoses, wabatshela bonke abantu amazwi kaYehova, nezimiso zakhe zonke. Baphendula bonke ngezwi elilodwa, bethi, Zonke izinto akhuluma ngazo iNkosi, sizozenza.
Wabhala ke uMoses amazwi onke kaYehova, wavuka ekuseni kakhulu, wakwakha isibingelelo ngaphansi komfula, namahlombe alishumi elinambini, ngokwemindeni elishumi elinambini yamaSirayeli.
Wathumela amantombazane aseSirayeli, banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa, banikela ngezingulube ezincane njengenhlanhla yokuthula kuYehova.
Wathatha uMoses inqwaba yegazi, wayibeka emabhodlelani; kanti enye inqwaba yaleyo gazi wayithambisa phezu kwesibingelelo.
Wathatha ke incwadi yesivumelwano, wayifunda emlonyeni wabo bonke abantu. Bathi: Zonke izinto akhuluma ngazo iNkosi sizozenza; sizozilungisa.
Wathi uMoses, ethatha igazi, wageza abantu, wathi, Bheka, leli yigazi lesivumelwano, obekwenzela lona iNkosi ngalezo zinto zonke.
UMoses no-Aron, uNadabhi no-Abihu, namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli amashumi asixhenxe, banyuka befika emfuleni.
Babona uNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli, futhi ngaphansi kwezinyawo zakhe kwakukhona into efana nophahla lwe-sapphire, elicacile njengezulu.
UNkulunkulu akazange aphakamise isandla sakhe phezu kwalabo abaphathi bakaSirayeli; bakubona uNkulunkulu, badla, baphuze.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Nquma phezulu nginge enhliziyweni yami, ube khona lapha; ngizokulethela izicwebezeli zegolide, nomthetho, namalungiselelo, engibhalela, ukuze ubafundise.
Waphuma ke uMoses, noYoshuwa umkhonzi wakhe; wanyuka uMosis phezu komfula kaThixo.
Wathi kubo abakhulu, Silinde lapha, kuze sibuye kuthini; bona, uAron noHure nabo bakhona; uma kukhona umuntu onecala, afike kubo.
Uma uMoses efika emfuleni, izulu liwugubuzela.
Ubuhle bukaYehova buhlala phezu kwentaba iSinayi; udaba lwaliwufihla intaba iminyaka emine. Ngosuku lwesixhenxe wabiza iNkosi uMoses kusuka ngaphakathi kwelanga.
Ubuhle bukaYehova belufana nomlilo oqhumayo phezulu emfuleni, kwabesilisa bakaSirayeli.
Wathi uMoses, efika enhliziyweni yezulu, wenyuka phezu komfula; wahlala emfuleni izinyanga ezine nezinsuku eziyisithupha.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi kuSirayeli: Ninikele emini, ninikeze iminikelo yenu. Kuwo wonke umuntu ofuna ukunikela ngenhliziyo yakhe, niyithathe le minikelo yami.
Lezo yizinto ongazithola kubo: igolide, nesiliva, nensimbi;
luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, i-purple, kanye nendwangu ebomvu; ilinen enhle; inkomo;
isikhumba se-ram emnyama; isikhumba esincane; acacia wood;
i-oyile ye-olive yezibani; izithako ze-oyile yokunquma, kanye ne-incense emnandi;
namatshe e-onyx, namanye amathoyizi, ukuze afakwe ku-ephod, nengxenye yekhanda lombingeleli omkhulu.
Bangilungiselele indawo engcwele, ukuze ngihlale phakathi kwabo.
Yenza ikamelo elingcwele, nezinto zayo zonke, ngokusho komfanekiso ongeke ngikubonise wona.

Bayenze ibhokisi, isibhakabhaka, emthini we-acacia. Kube yimitha eyodwa namasentimitha alishumi ubude bayo, futhi ibe ngamasentimitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili ububanzi bawo namashumi ayisishiyagalolunye ubude babo.
Uzoyigqoka ngegolide elihlanzekile, ngaphakathi nangaphandle; uzobeka icala legolide ngaso.
Yenza izikhonkwane zegolide ezine, uyibeke ezinyaweni zayo ezinhlanu; izikhonkwane ezimbili ngakwesokudla, nezikhonkwane ezimbili ngakwesobunxele.
Ngemuva kwalokho yenza izintambo zokhuni lwe-acacia, uzibuthe ngegolide.
Faka ama-poles phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezindaweni ezingemuva zesibhakabhaka, ukuze uyiphathe.
Ama-poles kufanele ahlale emigodini ye-arch. Akufanele athathwe ngaphandle.
Uzobeka ngaphakathi kodoti izicwebezelo zomnqophiso, ozozinika wena.

Yenza isigqoko somnyango webhokisi, igolide elihlanzekile. Liyindawo yokuthula; ubude bayo kumele bube ngamasentimitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, futhi ububanzi bawo kufanele bube ngamasentimitha ayisishiyagalolunye.
Uzozenza izikerubi ezimbili zegolide elihlanganisiwe, ezindaweni ezimbili zezingxenye zesibuko.
Yenza ikherubi elilodwa esiphethweni esisodwa, nekherubi elilodwa esiphethweni esisha; yenza amakerubi kanye nophahla abe yingxenye eyodwa.
Amakerubi kufanele abe namaphiko abo avulekile phezulu, agqoke isipho ngephiko labo; kumele babhekene omunye nomunye, bese bebheka phansi ebusweni.
Uzobeka isipho sezulu phezu kwebhokisi, ubeke ngaphakathi kwebhokisi izinhlamvu zomnqophiso ozozinika wena.

Ngizohlangana nawe khona lapho, ngaphesheya komgwaqo, phakathi kwezikerubi ezimbili ezibekwe phezu kwebhokisi lesivumelwano; ngizokhuluma nawe khona lapho ngezinto zonke engizokuwisela kuzo izingane zakwaSirayeli.
Yenza ithebhu eyenziwe ngomthi we-acacia. Kuzoba ngamasentimitha angu-90 ubude, amasentimitha angama-45 ububanzi, namasentimitha angu-70 ubude.
Yigqume ngegolide elihlanzekile bese ufaka umkhawulo wegolide ngaso.
Yenza i-rim eduze kwayo ebanzi njengesandla, bese ufaka umkhawulo wegolide ku-rim.
Uzozenza izikhonkwane zegolide ezine, uzibeke emazingeni amane, lapho zihlala khona izinyawo ezine.
Izinhlamvu kufanele zibekwe eduze kwe-rim, ukuze zibambe amapuleti asetshenziswa ukuthwala ithebula.
Yenza amapuleti emthini we-acacia, uzigqoke ngegolide. Ithebulethi kumele ithwalwe ngazo.
Yakha izitsha, namabhodwe, namathawula, namazipho, enziwe ngegolide elihlanzekile; futhi ugcine izandla zakho ziqinile.
Ngizohlala ngigcina isidlo sakusihlwa esikhethekile ethebeni phambi kwami.
Yenza isibani segolide elihlanzekile, ukhiphe isisekelo saso nesiqu saso; amakhopho alo afana nezinhlamvu, namaqabunga alo, nezimbali zalo kumele zibe ingxenye eyodwa.
Izihlahla eziyisishiyagalombili zizophuma emaphethelweni ophahla lwesibani, ezintathu ngakwesobunxele, kanye nezithathu ngakwesokudla.
Yonke inxanxathela eyisishiyagalombili kufanele ibe nebhodlela elilodwa elibukeka njengezimbali ze-almond, enezinhlamvu nezithelo.
Kuyo i-lampstand ngokwayo kufanele kube neziphuzo ezine ezenziwe njengezimbali ze-almond, ezinama-buds ne-blooms.

Imbewu eyodwa izobe ngezansi kwengxenye yokuqala, nembewu yesibili ngezansi kwengxenye yesithathu, nembewu yesithathu ngezansi kwengxenye yesithathu. Zonke izitshalo eziyisishiyagalombili zizophuma emgodini.
Izinhlamvu nezihlahla zizobe ziyingxenye eyodwa nesihlalo somlilo, zinegolide elihlanzekile.
Yakha izibani zayo eziyisixhenxe, uyibeke phezu kwayo, ukuze zikhanyise indawo engaphambili yayo.
Ama-wick cutters ayo nama-trays azokwenziwa ngegolide elihlanzekile.
Sebenzisa amakhilogremu amashumi amathathu anesihlanu wegolide elihlanzekile ukwenza isibambo sokukhanya, nezinto zonke lezi.
Ziqiniseke ukuthi uzenza ngokucacile njengendlela obonakaliswe ngayo emfuleni.
Uzokwenza isikhala esingcwele, izitezi ezingu-10 zelinen ethosiwe, noboya obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nokubomvu obomvu, nezingwevu; umuntu owaziyo enze amakerubi.
I-curtain ngayinye kufanele ibe nobude obufanayo, cishe amasentimitha ayishumi nambili namasentimitha amabili ububanzi.
Xhuma ama-curtains amane ndawonye, futhi wenze okufanayo namanye amahlanu.
Yenza ama-loops wendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka eduze kokuphela kwe-curtain kuset yokuqala, futhi wenze okufanayo ku-curtain yokuphela kweset yesithathu.
Yenza izintambo ezingu-50 emgodini owodwa, nezintambo ezingu-50 ekugcineni komgwaqo wesithathu; lezi zinto zibhekene ngazo.
Uzozenza izikhonkwane zegolide ezingu-50, uzisebenzisele ukuxhuma amafasitela aphindwe kabili ndawonye; ukuze indawo engcwele ibe yinye.
Yenza amafasitela ezinwele zengulube, enze itente phezu kwekamelo elingcwele; yenza amafasitela alishumi elinanye.
Zonke izigcawu eziyishumi nambili kufanele zibe nobude obufanayo, cishe amasentimitha angama-13 namasentimitha amabili ububanzi.
Xhuma ama-curtains amane ndawonye ibe yiyunithi elilodwa, futhi amanye ayisishiyagalombili abe yinhlanganisela enye. Nquma i-curtain yesixhenxe ngokuphindwe kabili ngaphambili kwethenda.
Yenza izintambo ezingu-50 ngaphesheya kwesobunxele lwesibuko esisodwa, futhi yenza izintambo ezingu-50 ngaphesheya kwesobunxele lwesibuko esisodwa.
Yenza izikhonkwane zesiliva ezingu-50, uzifake emigodini yokuxhuma itente ndawonye, ukuze ibe yinye.
Ingxenye engaphezulu ye-curtain esele kufanele ikhonjwe ngezansi emuva kwekamelo elingcwele.
Izingqungquthela zendlu yokudlela zizoba zide ngemitha elilodwa ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla, futhi okunye okushiwo kuzoba ngaphezu kwezinhlangothi zendlu yokudlela engcwele, ukuze liyigqoke.
Yenza isigqoko sendlu yokuphumula, esinamafutha omnqumo amhlophe, bese uyenza isigqoko sesikhumba esihle.
Yenza izintambo ezimile zesihlahla sika-Asika, ukuze zibekwe endaweni engcwele.
Iphrofayela ngayinye kufanele ibe ngamasentimitha amane nengxenye ubude kanye namasentimitha ayisishiyagalolunye ububanzi.
Kuzomele kube nezingcezu ezimbili esitezi ngasinye, ukuze zixhunywe ndawonye. Uzozenza njalo zonke izitezi zesibhedlela.
Yenza izindwangu ezingu-20 engxenyeni esenyakatho yendlu yokungcwele.
Yenza izisekelo zesiliva ezimashumi mane, zifike ngezansi kwezinhlamvu eziyishumi nambili; izisekelo ezimbili ngasinye sezinhlamvu ezintathu, enye ngaphansi kombhoshongo ngamnye.
Ngakwesobunxele, ngasenyakatho yendlu yokuphumula, wenze izindwangu eziyishumi nambili;
futhi izisekelo zesiliva ezimashumi amane, ezimbili ngezansi kwebhodi ngalinye.
Yenza izindwangu eziyisishiyagalombili emuva kwekamelo elingcwele, engxenyeni yasenyakatho.
Uzokwenza amabhokisi amabili ezindaweni ezingemuva zesitezi esingcwele.
Kulezi ziqongo ezimbili amafreyimu kufanele abe ngokuphindaphindiwe kusuka phansi yonke indlela ukuya phezulu, agcinwe yiringi elilodwa. Yenza iziqongo zombili zinjalo.
Kuzoba khona amabhodi ayisishiyagalombili, nezingqungquthela zesiliva ezingu-16, izingqungquthela ezimbili ngezansi kombhoshongo ngamunye.
Yenza futhi izikhonkwane zokhuni lwe-acacia, eziyisihlanu ezitsheni zengxenye eyodwa yendlu yokuphumula;
eziyisishiyagalombili zezingcezu ezikwesobunxele, kanye nezishiyagalombili zezingcezu ezikwesokunxele ngasemva.
I-crossbar ephakathi kufanele ihambe yonke indlela kusuka esiphethweni esisodwa kuya kwesinye, ngaphesheya kwefreyimu.
Khusela ama-frames ngodayimane, futhi yenza izindandatho zodayimane ukuze ubambe ama-crossbars. Khusela ama-crossbars ngodayimane.
Nciphisa itente elingcwele, ngendlela okubonisa ngayo emfuleni.
Yenza ifasitela ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengwevu, nesibomvu, noboya obunombala obomvu obunqunywe kahle. Umuntu owaziyo enze amakherubi kuwo.
Ikhonjiswe ngezinhlamvu zegolide ezindaweni ezine zokhuni lwe-acacia olugqugquzelwe ngazo igolide, lisezinhlabeni ezine zesiliva.
Uzophonsa ifasitela emigodini, ubeke isibambo sesivumelwano eduze kwefasitela; futhi ifasitela lizohlukanisa indawo engcwele nendawo engcwele kakhulu.
Uzobeka isibuko, indawo yobulungisa, phezu kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, endaweni engcwele kakhulu.
Uzobeka ithebhu ngaphandle kwethenda, engxenyeni yasenyakatho yendlu yokuphumula. Uzobeka isibani esibhekene nethebhu, engxenyeni esempumalanga.
Uzokwenza emnyango wesitezi isibuko esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nesibhakabhaka, nesibomvu, kanye nelinen engenisiwe, umsebenzi womuntu othungayo.
Yenza ama-hook egolide kulo mhlobiso, nama-poste amabili amnyama, afakwe igolide; yenza izisekelo zabo ezihlanu zesiliva.

Uzokwakha isibingelelo semithi ye-acacia; kufanele sibe nesikwere, ibe yizinyawo ezimbili ezingu-1/4 ubude bayo, nezinyawo ezimbini ezingu-1/4 ububanzi bawo, futhi iphakame izinyawo eziyisithupha ezingu-1/3.
Uzozenza izingulube ezinhlanu, ngaso sonke isikhunta sayo, ukuze izingulube zayo nesihlalo somlilo zibe ingxenye eyodwa; uzoyigqoka ngesiliva.
Uzozenza zonke izinto zayo zibe yizinsimbi ezibomvu, namabhodwe ayo okususa inkungu, nezitsha zalo, namabhodlela alo, nama-forks awo omnqumo, nama-pans abo.
Uzoyenza i-grate yayo, intambo yegolide, futhi uzoba nezinkinobho zegolide ngaso sonke isikhunta sentambo.
Uzobeka ikhebula ngezansi kophahla lwesibingelelo, ukuze lifike engxenyeni yophahla.
Yenza izintambo zemithi ye-acacia, ukuze kwenziwe isibhedlela, uzigqugquzele ngegolide.
Uzobeka izintambo phakathi kwezinhlamvu, ukuze zibe ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla kwesibingelelo uma kuthwalwa.
Yenza isibambo esingenalutho, esinamadwala; yenza njalo njengoba kuboniswe kuwe emzini.
Uzoyenza nendlu yangasese yesitezi esingcwele, engxenyeni esenyakatho; ubude bayo bube ngamasentimitha amashumi amane nahlanu.
Kuzoba nezingqungquthela ezingu-20, nezifunda zegolide ezingu-20, ezinezikhonkwane zosiliva namabhande emigqeni.
Ingxenye yasenyakatho kufanele ibe nemitha emashumi amane anesihlanu ubude, nama-curtains, ama-posts angama-20 nama-bronze bases angama-20, nama-hook amhlophe namabhande kuma-posts.
Isiphequluli sasentshonalanga sesitezi sokuqala kufanele sibe yizimitha ezingu-22 ububanzi, ibe nezingqungquthela, izikhonkwane eziyisithupha, nezifunda ezingama-10.
Isiphequluli esisenyakatho, esibheke ukuphuma kwelanga, kufanele sibe nemitha eyishumi nambili ububanzi.
Ngakwesobunxele kokungena kufanele kube nama-curtains angaphezu kwamamitha ayisishiyagalombili ubude, anezinhlamvu ezintathu nezindawo eziphansi ezintathu.
Ngakwesobunxele kukhona futhi ama-curtains angaphezu kwamamitha ayisithupha ubude, anezinhlamvu ezintathu kanye nezindawo ezimbili eziphansi.

Ukungena esitezi, yenza isikrini esiyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili ubude ngendwangu ebomvu neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka noboya obubomvu kanye namafutha omnqumo aphindwe kabili, umsebenzi womuntu ogqoka izitayela ezinhle. Kuzobe kunezinhlamvu ezine nezisekelo ezine.
Zonke izibopho ezijikeleze isibhedlela kumele zibe nezintambo zegolide, nama-hook, kanye nezinhlangothi zesiliva.

Igumbi lokuphumula kufanele libe ngamamitha angu-45 ubude nobubanzi bamasentimitha angama-22, ngemibhede eyenziwe ngokhuni oluqinile olubomvu ngaphezu kwamakhilomitha amabini aphezulu, nezinsiza zegolide.
Zonke izinto ezisetshenziswayo ekusebenzeni kwendlu engcwele, nazo zonke izikhonkwane zayo, nezikhonkwane zesibhedlela sangaphandle, kufanele ziqokwe ngesiliva.
Uthi uMoses kuMosis: "Uthize abantu bakaSirayeli ukuthi bakulethe uphethiloli ohlanzekile, we-olive ephukile, ukuze kwenziwe izibani, ukuze ziqhume njalo.

Esitezi sokubambisana, ngaphandle kwethenda elibhekene nebhokisi lesivumelwano, uAron nonyana bakhe bazozimisa izibani phambi koYehova, kusukela emini kuze kube ngasekuseni; kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, emiphakathini yabo.
Uzobeka phambi kwakho uAron, umngane wakho, noNadabhi, no-Abihu, no-Eleazarhi, no-Ithamari, oonyana bakhe, phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, ukuze basebenze kimi njengobaba.
Uzozenza izigqoko ezingcwele uAron, umngane wakho, ukuze abe nomhlonishwa nobuhle.
Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu abanolwazi, abami ngibagcwele ubuhlakani, ukuthi benze izigqoko ku-Aron, ukuze amsindise, asebenze kimi njengompristi.

Lezi yizinto abazozenza izigqoko: isifuba, ne-ephodi, nesibhakabhaka, nesibhakabhaka esiyindilinga, ne-tiara, nesibhakabhaka; bazozenza izigqoko ezingcwele uAron umngane wakho, nabenzana bakhe, ukuze basebenze kimi njengobaba.
Bangasebenzisa igolide, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nombala omnyama, nokubomvu, namatshe alula.
Bazoyenza i-ephodi yegolide, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nendwangu ensundu, nendwangu ebomvu, nendwangu emhlophe ethosiwe, ngemisebenzi yomuntu owaziyo.
Kuzodingeka kube nezinhlamvu ezimbili zesifuba ezixhunywe emakhoneni ayo amabili, ukuze ikwazi ukubopha ndawonye.
Umlenze wayo oqinile kufanele wenziwe ngendlela efanayo, ube yingxenye eyodwa nayo, ngegolide, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nendwangu ensundu, nendwangu ebomvu, nendwangu yelinen eyindilinga.
Uzothatha amatshe amabili e-onyx, udwebe kuwo amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Faka amagama ayisishiyagalombili etsheni elilodwa namanye ayisishiyagalombili etsheni elilodwa, ngokulandelelana kokufa kwabo.
Uzodweba ematsheni amabini amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengokudweba umhlobiso wegolide; uzobabeka ematsheni abo emigodini yegolide.
Uzobeka amatshe amabili emilenzeni ye-ephod, abe ngamatshe okukhumbula izingane zakwaSirayeli; uAron uzothwala amagama abo emlenzeni wakhe phambi koYehova, abe ngumlando.
Yenza izilungiselelo zegolide,
kanye nezibopho ezimbili zegolide elihlanzekile, exhunywe njengentambo. Nciphisa izibopho kulezi zimo.
Uzoyenza ikhanda lomthetho, umsebenzi womuntu oqeqeshiwe; uyenze ngendlela ye-ephod, ngegolide, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nendwangu ensundu, nendwangu ebomvu, nendwangu emhlophe ethosiwe.
Kuzobe kuyisikwere, siphindwe kabili, cishe amasentimitha angama-23 ubude kanye namasentimitha angama-23 ububanzi.
Faka iziqongo ezine zezintaba-mlilo ezisezingeni eliphakeme phezu kwayo. Esigabeni sokuqala ufake i-ruby, i-topaz, ne-beryl.
Emgqeni wesithathu kubeka i-turquoise, i-sapphire, ne-emerald.
Kumugqa wesithathu kubeka i-hyacinth, i-agate, ne-amethyst.
Emgqeni wesine kubeka i-chrysolite, i-onyx, ne-jasper. Faka kuzo izilungiselelo zegolide.
Kuzobe kukhona amatshe alishumi elinambini, ngamagama oonyana bakaSirayeli; kuzoba khona igolide eliboshwe ngegama lalowo wesizwe esiyishumi nambili.
Uzokwenza izibopho zegolide elihlanzekile, uzigqugquzele njengentambo.
Yenza izindandatho ezimbili zegolide bese uzifaka emakhoneni amabili aphezulu engxenyeni yesifuba.
Nciphisa ama-chains amabili egolide kuzinhlamvu ezimbili ezinqolobaneni zengxenye yesifuba.
Ezinye izikhundla zezingcezu zazo uzigqugquzela emazingeni amabini, uzixhume kumaphuzu ekhanda le-ephod ngaphesheya.
Uzozenza izibopho ezimbili zegolide, uzibeke emakhoneni amabini ekhanda lesifuba, engxenyeni yangaphakathi ebhekene ne-ephod.
Uzozenza ezinye izikhonkwane ezimbili zegolide, uzibeke ngezansi kwezinhlamvu zesifuba esingaphambilini se-ephod, eduze kokuqhekeka kwayo, ngaphesheya komgogodla.
Uzozibophezela izikhonkwane zesifuba ezikhonkwaneni se-ephod ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuze isikhunta sihlale phezulu komgogodla we-ephod, futhi singasakazeka ngaphandle kwe-ephod.
U-Aron uzozithwala amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli emlonyeni wakhe, emgodini wesinqumo, lapho ephuma khona endaweni engcwele, ukuze abe ngukumbuso kubo phambi koYehova.

Uzobeka i-Urim ne-Thummim emlonyeni, ukuze zibe phezu kwenhliziyo ka-Aron, lapho ephuma khona phambi koYehova; ukuze u-Aron athathe impahla yomthetho yabantwana bakaSirayeli phezu kwenhliziyo yakhe, phambi koNkulunkulu, njalo.
Yenza isigqoko se-ephodi, yenziwe ngendwangu emnyama.
Kudingeka kube nokuvula kwekhanda engxenyeni yaphakathi, nge-edge ethosiwe ngaphesheya kokuvula njenge-collar, ukuze angeke iqhume
Ngaphakathi kwengxenye engezansi ye-roba yenza ama-granates aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nama-purple, nama-red yarn, nezingcingo zegolide phakathi kwazo.
Izinhlamvu zegolide nezithelo ze-granate, izinhlamvu zegolide nezithelo ze-granate, kufanele zihambe ngaso sonke isibambo se-roba.
U-Aron uzoyigqoka lapho esebenza khona njengompristi, ukuze umsindo wezinhlamvu uzwakale uma efika endaweni engcwele phambi koNkulunkulu, futhi uma ephuma, ukuze angafanga.
Uzoyenza iphakethe legolide elihlanzekile, ubhale phezu kwalo, njengokubhala isitifiketi: Kungcwele kuYehova.
Nciphisa ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka phambi kwe-turban.

Kuzohlala phezu kobuso buka-Aron, ukuze u-Aron athwale isono ngaso sonke isibopho esingcwele sabantu bakaSirayeli; kuzohlala phezu kobuso bakhe nsuku zonke, ukuze izibopho zabo zivunyelwe kukaNkulunkulu.
Uzoyigqoka ngendwangu ehlelekile, futhi uyenze i-turban ngendwangu ehlelekile. I-sash kumele ibe yimisebenzi yomuntu osebenza ngezitayela ezinhle.
Yenza oonyana baka-Aron izigqoko ezimhlophe, nezingwevu, namakhopho, ukuze babe yizipho nobuhle.
Uzozigqoka uAron, umngane wakho, kanye nabantwana bakhe; uzowabhaka, uzowabeka egunyani, uzowamisa abe ngumnikelo wokudla, ukuze basebenze kimi njengobaba.
Yenza kubo izigqoko ezincane zendwangu, ukuze bagqoke izimbambo zabo, zifinyelele emlenzeni kuya esifuba.

U-Aron nezingane zakhe bazozigqoka, uma bengena efulethini lengqungquthela, noma lapho befinyelela emgodini, ukuba basebenze endaweni engcwele; ukuze bangathatheki inkohliso, baphile. Kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside ku-Aron nomndeni wakhe ngemuva kwakhe.
Le yinto ongayikwenza, ukuze ungcwelele uAron nabantwana bakhe, ukuba babe ngabaphakeli bami: thola inkomo encane, nengulube ezimbili ezingenacala.
Uzokwenza ushokoledi ngenyama yengulube ehlanzekile, ngaphandle kwe-lemongrass; uzowenza amakhowe aqinile axhunywe ne-olive oil, nama-wafers ancane axutshwe ne-olive oil.
Uzozibeka emgodini, uzozifaka emgodini, kanye nengulube, namadodakazi amabili.
Uzobeka uAron nezingane zakhe emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, uzowahlamba ngamanzi.
Uzothatha izigqoko, uzozigqoka uAron isigqoko esimnyama, nesigqoko se-ephodi, ne-ephodi, nokugqugquzela kwesifuba; futhi uzowubopha umlenze we-ephodi.
Nciphisa i-turban phezu kwekhanda lakhe, futhi ubeke isiqu esingcwele ku-turban.
Bese uthathe i-oyile yokunquma, uyinqume ngokufaka kuyo ikhanda lakhe.
Nciphisa izingane zakhe futhi bagqoke izigqoko.

Uzobeka u-Aron nezingane zakhe izigxobo, futhi uzobeka amabhukwana izingane zakhe, ukuze kube ngumthetho wabo ohlala isikhathi eside ukuphatha umsebenzi wokubhema; nawe uzomisa u-Aron nezingane zakhe.
Uzoyisa ingulube phambi kwendlu yokuxoxa, uAron nabantwana bakhe babeke izinyawo zabo phezu kwesiqu sayo.
Uzobulala inkomo phambi kweNkosi, emgwaqweni womnyango wesitezi sokubonisa.
Uzothatha igazi lengulube, uyibeke ngesandla sakho ezindlebeni zesibhedlela; futhi okunye kwegazi uzoligeza ngezansi kwesibhedlela.
Uzothatha isisindo sayo sonke esijikeleze izitho zangaphakathi, kanye nengxenye engcono kakhulu yenhliziyo, nezilonda ezimbili, nesisindo sazo, uzozishisa phezu kwesibambo.
Kodwa inyama yengulube, nesikhumba sayo, nenyama yaso, uzozishisa ngomlilo ngaphandle komkhosi; yisondlo sesono.
Uzothatha omunye wamadodakazi, uAron nabantwana bakhe babeke izandla zabo phezu kwesiqu sakhe.
Uzoyibulala, uthathe igazi layo, ulayishe phezu kwesibingelelo ngaso sonke isikhala.
Uzomisa ingulube ibe yizingxenye, uhlanze isisu sayo nemilenze yayo, uyibeke nezingxenye nekhanda.
Uzowushisa wonke lo mkhwenyana phezu kwesibingelelo; yisondlo esishiswayo kuYehova, iphunga elimnandi, isiphuzo somlilo esilungiselelwe uNkosi.
Thola umnqumo owodwa, uAron nabantwana bakhe babeke izandla zabo phezu kwesifuba sakhe.

Uzoyibulala, uthathe igazi layo, uyifake emlonyeni wendlebe yesokudla ka-Aron, nowesifazane wesandla sawo sokudla, nasesifuba senyawo labo sokunene; futhi uthele igazi elisha phezu kwesibingelelo ngazo zonke izinhlangothi.

Uzothatha igazi elingene emgodini, nophethiloli wokufaka ukhilimu, uwuthele ku-Aron, nezigqoko zakhe, namadodana akhe, nezigqoko zamadodana akhe, naye, ukuze abe ngcwele, yena nendodana yakhe, nezigqoko zendodana yakhe.

Uzothatha isisindo salowo mnqumo, nomlenze onzima, nesisindo esijikeleze izitho zangasese, nengxenye engcono kakhulu yebele, nezilonda ezimbili nama-odolo aphezulu azo, kanye nonyawo olusokudla; lokhu kuzoba yinyama yomnqumo wokufaka isandla.
Uzothatha emgodini wenkukhu engaphekiwe, ongaphambilini kukaYehova, inkomishi eyodwa yenkomo, nebhodlela elilodwa le-oyile, nebhodlela elilodwa elincane.
Uzobeka zonke lezi zinto ezandleni zika-Aron, nasezandleni zabantwana bakhe; bazozishaya ngazo phambi koNkulunkulu.
Uzozithatha ezinyaweni zabo, uzisindise emgodini womlilo phezu kwesonka esishiswayo, ibe nguphunga elimnandi kuYehova; yisonka esiqhutshwa umlilo kuYehova.
Uzothatha isifuba sembuzi yokufaka isandla sika-Aron, uyenze ibe ngumnikelo oshiswayo phambi koYehova; izobe yingxenye yakho.
Uzozinikela ngazo zonke izingxenye zalowo mnqumo wokufaka isandla, eziwuwe-Aron nabenzana bakhe: isifuba esiqhutshwayo, nemilenze ephakanyisiwe.
Lokhu kuzoba yisibopho sika-Aron, nesibopho samadodana akhe, nsuku zonke, phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; yisibopho sezingane zakwaSirayeli esinikezwayo iNkosi, ezindaweni zabo zokuthula.
Izigqoko ezingcwele zika-Aron zizobe ziyizingane zakhe ngemuva kwakhe, ukuze bafakwe emanzini ngazo, futhi babekwe egunyani ngazo.
Izinsuku ezisixhenxe uzozigqoka lowo ozoba ngumpristi ngemuva kwakhe, osuka emndenini wakhe, ozongena esihlalweni sokuhlangana, ukuze asebenze endaweni engcwele.
Uzothatha ingulube yokunqunywa, uzokuthosa inyama yayo endaweni engcwele.
U-Aron nezingane zakhe bazodla inyama yomuntu omncane, nokudla okusemqoka ebhokisini, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Bazodla umnikelo wabo wokudla, owenza ukuxoshwa kwabo, lapho bebekwa khona egunyani labo, ukuze bangcwele; akukho mntu wesifazane ozodla wona, ngoba yizinto ezingcwele.
Uma kukhona okushiwo ngenyama yokufaka isandla, noma ngokudla, okusele kuze kube ekuseni, kufanele kuqhume; ngeke kulinywe, ngoba kuyinto engcwele.
Uzokwenza njalo ku-Aron namadodana akhe, njengoba ngikuwisele umthetho; usuku oluyisixhenxe uzowamisa.
Uzonikela ngaso sonke isikhathi inkomo eyodwa ibe yisonka sokudla, ukuze kwenziwe ukuxoshwa kwesono; futhi uzohlanza isibhedlela ngokunikela ngayo, uyenze ingcwele.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe kufanele uhlanze isibingelelo, futhi uyenze ibe ngcwele; futhi isibingelelo sizoba ngcwele kakhulu; nanoma yini eyithintayo izobe ingcwele.
Lezo zinto ozozinikela ngazo emgodini, ngosuku ngalunye: izinkomo ezimbili ezineminyaka eyodwa ubudala.
Uzonikela ngomntwana owodwa ekuseni, nomunye ekuseni.

Ngengane yokuqala yengulube uzonikela ngekhilogremu eyodwa nengxenye yobisi oluhlanzekile oluhlanganisiwe nelitha elilodwa le-oyile eyenziwe ngama-olive, nolitha elilodwa lewayini njengomnikelo wokudla.
Uzonikela isibeleko esisodwa emini, kanye nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesonka saso, njengokuthi ukwenze ekuseni; yiphunga elimnandi, iminikelo yomlilo kuYehova.
Lo mnikelo wokushiswa kufanele ulungiselelwe usuku nosuku, emiphakathini yenu yonke, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana phambi koYehova; ngizohlangana nawe khona lapho, ngikhuluma nawe.
Ngizohlangana khona nabantu bakaSirayeli, futhi indawo izobe ingcwele ngenxa yobuhle bam.
Ngizoyingcwelesa indlu yokuhlangana, nesihlalo somlilo; futhi ngizobangcwelesa uAron nonyana bakhe, ukuba babe ngabaphakeli bami.
Ngizohlala phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, ngibe nguThixo wabo.
Bazokwazi ukuthi ngimi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wabo, owabakhipha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngihlale phakathi kwabo; ngimi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wabo.
"Yenza isibingelelo semithi ye-acacia, ukudlidliza uvumba.
Kuzoba isikwere, cishe amasentimitha angu-45 ubude nobubanzi bamasentimitha angama-45, futhi kube ngamasentimitha angaba ngu-90 phezulu. Izingulube zayo zizobe ziyingxenye eyodwa nayo.
Uzoyigqoka phezulu, nezindonga zayo zonke, namahlombe ayo, ngegolide elihlanzekile; futhi uzoyenza inqwaba yegolide phezu kwayo.
Yenza izikhonkwane ezimbili zegolide esitezi esiphakeme ngezansi komgwaqo, emaphaketheni amabili ahlukene, ukuze zibambe amabhodlela asetshenziswa ukuthwala.
Yenza amapuleti omthi we-acacia bese uwagcoba ngegolide.
Uzobeka isibingelelo phambi kwesibuko esibhekene nebhokisi lesinqumo, phambi kophahla lwesinqumo; khona lapho ngizohlangana nawe.
U-Aron kufanele asindise uvumba elimnandi emgodini womlilo nsuku zonke, lapho ephatha khona izibani.
Uma emisa izibani ekuseni, kufanele aphinde afake uvumba, ukuze umlilo womlilo ube njalo phambi koYehova, kuze kube yiminyaka yonke.
Mhlawumbe ngeke ninikeze phezu kwalo isipho, noma insizakalo yokudlwengula, noma insizakalo yesonka, noma umnikelo wokudla, noma isiphuzo.

U-Aron uzoyihlanza isonto ngalinye, afake emanzini omnikelo wokudla wesono onqunywe phezu kwezingulube zayo; lokhu kuzokwenziwa nsuku zonke ezizukulwaneni zenu. Yindawo engcwele kakhulu kukaNkulunkulu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uma nibala izingane zakwaSirayeli, umuntu ngamunye kufanele akhokhele iNkosi inhlawulo yokuphila kwakhe, lapho ebalwa khona; ukuze kungabikho umonakalo phakathi kwabo, uma nibala.
Wonke umuntu okubalwa kuwo uzonikela ngeshekeli elilodwa, ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele; iShekeli ngayinye ibe yi-gera ezingu-20. Le ngxenye yeshekeli iyisibopho esiphakeme kuYehova.
Wonke umuntu okubalwa kuwo, oneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu, kufanele anikezele isipho kuYehova.
Uma ninika umnikelo wokudla kuYehova, ukukhokhela izimpilo zenu, lowo omnelisekayo ngeke akhokhe ngaphezu kwengxenye yeshekeli, futhi lowo ohlwempu ngeke akhokhe ngaphansi.
Uzithathe lezi zimali kubantwana bakaSirayeli, uzisebenzise ekwenzeni umsebenzi wesitezi sokuhlangana; ukuze zibe yimicimbi yokugcina phambi koYehova kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzokwenza nebhodlela lesiliva, nophahla lwayo lwegolide, ukubeka phakathi kwekamelo lokuhlangana nesihlalo somlilo, uthele amanzi kulo.
U-Aron nezingane zakhe kumele bahlanze izandla zabo nezinyawo zabo ngamanzi alo.
Uma bengena esihlalweni sokuhlangana, kumele bahlanzwe ngamanzi, ukuze bangafa; futhi uma befika esibhedlela, kufanele bahlanzwe ngamanzi, ukuze basebenzele umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Bahlanze izandla zabo nezinyawo zabo, ukuze bangafa; kube ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside ku-Aron nomndeni wakhe, emiphakathini yabo yonke.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

"Thina sithathe izithako ezingcono kakhulu: cishe amakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili we-myrrh emanzi, nengxenye efanayo, cishe amakhilogremu amathathu ka-cinnamon omnandi, cishe amakhilogremu amathathu we-cannabis omnandi,
futhi cishe amakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili cassia, zonke ezilinganiselwe ngesisindo sendawo engcwele. futhi uthathe mayelana nelitha elilodwa le-olive.
yenza ngazo i-oyile engcwele yokuncibilikisa, inhlanganisela enephunga elimnandi, umsebenzi wokwenza iziphuzo; ibe yi-oyela engcwele yokuncibilikisa.
Uzowusebenzisa ukubhaka khona itente lengqungquthela, nodoti womthetho,
nethebulethi, nezimpahla zayo zonke, nophahla lwesibani, nezimpahla zalo, nesibhedlela somlilo;
isibambo somnikelo wokushiswa, nezimpahla zayo zonke, nebhodwe lokugeza izitsha, nophahla lwayo.
Uzozenza zibe ngcwele, ukuze zibe ngcwele kakhulu; nanoma yini ezithintayo izobe ngcwele.
Uzowubhaka uAron nabantwana bakhe, ube yindawo engcwele kubo, ukuze basebenze kimi njengobaba.
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi: Lo nguwoyela wami ongcwele wokuncibilikisa, kuze kube yiminyaka yabo.
Mhlawumbe ngeke uyithumele kubantu abajwayelekile, futhi ngeke uyenze noma iyiphi enye i-oyile ngaleyo ndlela. Ingcwele, ngakho kufanele uyisebenzise njengengcwele.
Wonke umuntu owenza ukhilimu njengawo, noma owufaka kumuntu ongasekho emkhosini, kumele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Thola izithako ezimnandi, i-gum resin, ne-onycha, ne-galbanum, kanye nofulawa ohlanzekile, ngamanani alinganayo.
Yenza ibe ngusizi, isixuku esinomsoco omnandi, umsebenzi womkhiqizi weziphuzo; uthele khona umhluzi, ukuze ihlanzekile ibe ngcwele.
Uzoyibhaka ibe yimpuphu, uyibeke phambi kwebhodi lesinqumo, esitezi sokuhlangana, lapho ngizohlangana khona nawe; izobe iyingcwele kakhulu kuwe.
Mhlawumbe ngeke niyilungiselele insipho ngale mithetho; kumele ingcwele, ibe yinto ekhethekile iNkosi.
Wonke umuntu owenza inkomishi efana nayo ukujabulela iphunga lakhe kufanele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Bheka, ngithathe uBesaleyeli, indodana kaUri, indodana kaHuri, ezweni likaYuda.
Ngimgcwele umphefumulo kaThixo, futhi ngimwise ubuhlakani, nokuqonda, nemfundo, nokukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wonke.
Ungenza amamodeli amahle futhi asebenze negolide, isiliva, kanye nensimbi.
Ungakwazi ukusika nokubeka amatshe abalulekile, ukudweba imithi, futhi enze yonke imisebenzi esezingeni eliphakeme.

Ngabona ukuthi ngikhethe uAholihabhi, unyana ka-Ahisamakhi, wesizwe sikaDan, ukuba abe ngusizo lwakhe; ngabona futhi ukuthi wonke umuntu onekhono lokwenza umsebenzi, ngiwubeke enhliziyweni yakhe, ukuze akwenze konke okungiwisele umthetho ngalo:
itente lengqungquthela, nesivivinyo sesivumelwano, nesigqoko saso, nazo zonke izinto zetenti;
nethebulethi, nezimpahla zayo, nesibani segolide elihlanzekile, nezimpahla zayo zonke, nophahla lwesibingelelo somlilo;
isibambo somnikelo wokushiswa, nezinto zayo zonke, ibhodwe lokugeza izitsha, nophahla lwayo;
izigqoko ezifakiwe, nezigqoko ezingcwele zika-Aron umbingeleli, nezigqoko zabantwana bakhe, uma besebenza njengombhishobhi;
kanye nophethiloli wokuncibilikisa, nofuzo olunomsoco lwendawo engcwele; njengoba ngikuwisele umthetho ngayo, kumele bakwenze.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuSirayeli, sithi, Nizigcine zonke izinsuku zami zokuphumula, ukuze kube nguphawu phakathi kwami nenu ezizukulwaneni zenu, ukuze nikwazi ukuthi nginguYehova owenza ukuba ningangcwele.
Uzogcina iSonto, ngoba ngusuku olungcwele kuwe. Wonke umuntu onquma ukulikhohlisa kufanele abulawe; wonke umuntu owenza iyiphi imisebenzi ngalolu suku kumele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kumele kwenziwe umsebenzi; kodwa usuku lwesine luyiSabhati lokuphumula, lingcwele kukaNkulunkulu. Wonke umuntu owenza noma yini emini yeSabhati kufanele abulawa.
Abantu bakaSirayeli kumele bagcine iSabhati, bayenze ibe ngusuku lokuphumula phakathi kwezizukulwane zabo zonke ezizayo, njengesivumelwano esihlala isikhathi eside.
Uzobe nguphawu phakathi kwami nezingane zakwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni; ngoba ngezinsuku ezine iNkosi wenza izulu nezwe, ngosuku olusixhenxe waphumula, waphumla.
Wathi iNkosi, lapho eqedile ukukhuluma noMoses emfuleni iSinayi, wamnika izicwecwe ezimbili zomthetho, izicwecwe zegolide ezibhalwe ngesandla sikaThixo.

Bathe babona abantu ukuthi uMoses usede ehla emfuleni, bahlanganisana noHaarnaun, bethi kuye: "Yazisa, yenzani nathi izitha ezizohamba phambi kwethu; ngoba lo Musa owenza ukuba sikhuphuke ezweni laseMizithini, asiyazi ukuthi kwenzekani kuye."
Wathi uAron kubo, Nciphisani izikhonkwane zegolide ezizigqokile izinkomo zenu, namadodakazi yenu, nabantwana benu, nezingane zenu, nizithumelele.
Bathi bonke abantu, basusa izikhonkwane zabo zegolide, bazisa ku-Aron.
Wazithatha, wazenza yizingulube ezifana nomuntu; wathi: "Lawo amasiko akho, isiSirayeli, owazikhuphule ezweni laseMisiya!"
U-Aron, lapho ebona khona lokhu, wakwakha isibingelelo phambi kwengulube, wathi, NgoMsombuluko kuzoba yimikhosi yoNkulunkulu.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, abantu bavuka ekuseni kakhulu, banikela ngezipho ezibomvu nezipho zokuthula; bese behlala bedla futhi bephuza, bavuka baphumule.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Thola, zula; ngoba abantu bakho, abawukhuphule ezweni laseYiputa, bakwenza kabi.

Basheshe basuka ekwenzeni lokho engibawisele ngawo; bakwenza ingulube eyenziwe ngomdwebo, beyihlangula, beyinikela ngenhlanhla kuyo, bethi, Lowo nguThixo wakho, Isirayeli, owakulethela phezulu ezweni laseMiziphu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ngabona abantu labo; bona, babantu abanemilenze emide.
Ngiyakushiya manje, ukuze ubuhlungu bami buqhume phezu kwabo, ngibakhulule; futhi ngizokwenza ube yizwe elikhulu.
UMosis wathandaza kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakhe, wathi, Nkosi, kungani liqhuma inkohliso yakho phezu kwabantu bakho, owabakhipha ezweni laseYiputa ngenkani enkulu nesandla esiqinile?

Kungani na ukuthi abaMijipida bathi, Wabakhipha ukuze akwenze kabi kubo, ukubababula emadolobheni abo, futhi ukubabasusa ebusweni bezwe? Uzobuya ngempela emlonyeni wakho onamandla, ushintshe inhliziyo yakho, ungabangele le nhlekelele abantu bakho.

Khumbula abakhonzi bakho, uAbrahama noIsake noSirayeli, owabakhuluma ngaye, wabhema ngegama lakho, wathi, Ngizokwenza izizukulwane zenu zibe yizinkanyezi ezisezulu; futhi leli lizwe lonke engikusho lona ngilinikeza izizukulwane zenu, ibe yindawo yabo yomhlaba kuze kube sekupheleni.
UYehova wehlulekile, akabi nalowo monakalo obewusho phezu kwabantu bakhe.
Wabuyela uMoses, waphuma emfuleni, enezibhodi ezimbili zomnqumo esandla sakhe; zazibhalwe ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla, ngaphambili nasemva.
Lezi zinto ziyimisebenzi kaThixo, futhi ukubhala kwazo kwakuwukubhala kukaThixo, okucwebezelwe ezitsheni.
UYoshuwa, lapho elalela khona umsindo wabo bonke abantu bekhala, wathi kuMosesi, "Kukhona umsindo wokulwa esiteji."
Wathi uMoses, Lokho akuyona inkulumo yabantu bekhala ngenxa yokunqoba kwabo, futhi akuyona inkulumo yabantu bekhala ngenxa yokulahleka kwabo; kodwa inkulumo yomculo ngiyizwa.
Wafika ke uMoses esitezi, wabona ingulube nokudlalwa, waphoqwa ngumoya kaMosis, wakhipha izicwecwe ezisezandlani zakhe, wazibhaka-bhaka ngezansi komfula.
Wathatha ingulube abayenzayo, wayibopha emlilweni, wayithambisa kuze kube yimpuphu, wayisa ebusweni bamanzi, wawadlalisa oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Bakwenzani wena labo bantu, ukuthi wabeka phezu kwabo isono esikhulu?
Waphendula uHaron, wathi, Unkosi wami, angeke inhliziyo yakho ibe buhlungu; wena uyazi ukuthi abantu balokhu bekwenza okubi.
Bathi kuye, Yenzani thina izitha eziya phambi kwethu; ngoba lo Mosesi, lowo owayesikhuphule ezweni laseYiputa, asiwazi ukuthi kwenzekani kuye.
Ngathi kubo: "Uma umuntu enegolide, ayisetshenzise." Banginikeza igolide, ngalibeka emgodini, kwaphuma lo mntwana!"
UMoses wabona ukuthi abantu baphuma engqondweni yabo, futhi u-Aron wabavumela ukuba baphume engqondweni yabo, ukuze babe yindawo yokugxekwa yabaphikisi babo.
Wahlala uMoses emgwaqeni, wathi, Wonke umuntu osuka kukaNkulunkulu, afike lapha kimi. Bahlangana naye bonke abaLevi.

Wathi kubo, Usho lokhu iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli, uthi: "Umuntu ngamnye agqoke ikhebula lakhe emlenzeni wakhe; bese nihamba phakathi kwekhabhinethi kusukela enhliziyweni eyodwa kuya enhliziyweni enye, nibulala umuntu ngamnye umngane wakhe, nomngane wakhe, nomndeni wakhe."
Bakwenza njalo, njengoba uMosis abewisela umthetho ngawo; bafa ngalolu suku abantu abangamakhulu amathathu.
Wathi uMoses, Nizibophezeleni namuhla kuYehova; ngoba nakuba niyindodana yomuntu, nakuba yinkosi yomuntu; ngakho-ke uNkosi ikunika insindiso namuhla.
Ngosuku olulandelayo uMoses wathi kulabo abantu, Nikwenzele isono esibi kakhulu; kodwa manje ngizonyuka ngiye kuYehova; kungase kube khona ukuthi ngiyilungise isono yenu.
Wabuyela uMoses kuYehova, wathi, Ngikutshele, abantu labo bakwenze isono esibi kakhulu; benze kubo unkulunkulu begolide.
Kodwa manje, ngiyakucela, usindise isono sabo; kodwa uma ungasindisi isono sabo, cindezela igama lami encwadini oyibhalayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Wonke umuntu owenza isono ngami, ngizocisha igama lakhe encwadini yami.
Hamba ke, uveze abantu lapho ngikutshele khona; iNkosi yami izohamba phambi kwakho; kodwa uma kufika usuku lwami lokuwabhekana nabo, ngizobabhekana nabo ngenxa yesono sabo.
Wathumela iNkosi isibambo ebantwini, ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo owenzayo ngengulube ka-Aron.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Yiya lapha, wena nomphakathi owazikhuphule ezweni laseYiputa, uye ezweni engikhuluma ngalo ku-Abrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, ngithi, Ngizolibazisa isizukulwane sakho.
Ngizothumela isithunywa phambi kwakho, futhi ngizokhipha abaKanana, nabaAmoreyi, namaHeti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
Hambani nifike ezweni elifulathelayo ubisi nengulube; ngoba angizohamba phakathi kwenu, ngenxa yokuthi ningabantu abanemilenze emide, ukuze ngikulahlekise endleleni.
Uma abantu beva la mazwi anzima, bahlupheka kakhulu, futhi akukho muntu ogqoke izicathulo.

Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Uthi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli: Nibantu abanemilenze emide; uma ngihamba phakathi kwenu ekuseni nje kuphela, ngizokulahla. Ngokuba nizisuse izigqoko zenu, ngibone ukuthi yini engikwenzayo kuwe.
Ngokho, kusukela emfuleni iHorebhi kuya phambili, abantu bakaSirayeli basusa izipho zabo.

UMoses wathatha itente, wayimisa ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi, eduze kakhulu; wayaziwa ngokuthi yiTenda Yokuxoxa. Wonke umuntu ofuna ukubuza iNkosi, wayephuma ekhempini yokuxoxa engaphandle kwekhabhinethi.
Kwathi lapho uMoses ephuma ekhempini, abantu bonke bevuka, behlala emgwaqweni wekhempini yabo, babheka uMoses, kuze afike ekhempini.
Kwathi lapho uMoses ephuma esitezi, ikholomu yezulu yakhuphuka, yahlala emgwaqweni wokungena; wakhuluma noMoses.
Uma abantu bebona isikhala sezulu sihlala emgwaqeni wendawo yokuphumula, khona-ke bonke abantu babuyela emuva, ngaso sonke isikhathi, wonke umuntu emgwaqeni wakhe.

UNkulunkulu wayekhuluma noMoses ngobuso-ku-buso, njengokuba umuntu ekhuluma nomngane wakhe. UMoses wabuyela esikhungweni; kodwa uJoshua, indodana kaNune, umkhonzi wakhe omncane, akazange aphume phakathi kwendlu.
Wathi uMoses kukaNkulunkulu, "Ungitshela ukuthi: 'Thina abantu sizohamba'; kodwa awubonisi ukuthi ubani ozowuthumela nami. Nakuba uthi: 'Ngikuyazi ngegama lakho, futhi uthole inhlonipho ngami.'
Uma ngithole inhlonipho phambi kwakho, ngicela ufundise indlela yakho, ukuze ngikwazi wena, ngithole inhlonipho phambi kwakho; futhi khumbula ukuthi leli lizwe liyizwe lakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Ubuso bami buzohamba nawe, ngikunikeze isikhala.
Wathi uMoses kuye, Uma ungahamba nathi, ungenzi sikhuphuke lapha; uma ungahamba nathi, ungenzi sikhuphuke.
Ngizokwazi kanjani ukuthi uthanda mina nomndeni wakho, uma usuya nathi? Ngalokho ngizohlukaniswa nami nomndeni wakho ngaso sonke isizwe esikhona phezu kobuso bomhlaba.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ngizokwenza lokhu okushoyo; ngoba uthole inhlonipho phambi kwami, futhi ngikuyazi ngegama.
Wathi uMoses, Ngicela, ngibonise ubucwebe bakho.

Wathi iNkosi, Ngizokwenza konke okuhle kwami kudlule phambi kwakho, futhi ngizobiza igama lami, iNkosi, phambi kwakho; futhi ngizoba nenhlonipho kulowo engifuna ukuba nenhlonipho kuye, futhi ngizobabalisa lowo engifuna ukubabalisa.
Kodwa-ke, awukwazi ukubona ubuso bam; ngoba akukho muntu ongangibona futhi aphile.
Wathi iNkosi, Kukhona indawo eduze kwami, lapho uzohlala khona phezu kodonga.
Uma ubuhle bami budlula, ngizokubeka emgodini weqhwa, futhi ngizokugcoba ngesandla sami, kuze kube yilapho ngidlule khona.
Ngizoyisusa isandla sami, futhi uzongibona emuva kwami; kodwa ubuso bam abubonwe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Khusela wena izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe ezifana nalezi zakuqala; ngizobhala phezu kwezinhlamvu lezi amagama akhona ezinhlamvini zokuqala, owazibopha.
Uzobe ulungiselelwe ekuseni, bese uya eMfuleni iSina, uhlale phambi kwami lapho, phezu komfula.
Akukho muntu ozokwehla nawe, noma uzobonakaliswa kuphi naphi emfuleni; ngisho nengulube noma inkomo ayidingi ukubhema phambi komfula.

UMoses wehlisa izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe ezifana nalezi zakuqala, wavuka ekuseni kakhulu, waphuma emfuleni iSinayi, njengoba iNkosi abemwisele umthetho ngawo, ethatha izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe ezandleni zakhe.
UYehova wehla emlilweni, wahlala khona naye, wababiza igama lakhe ngokuthi, UYehova.
Wadlula iNkosi phambi kukaMoses, wathi, UYehova, iNkosi, uNkulunkulu othandekayo, onobulungisa, osheshayo ukucasuka, ogcwele inhlonipho neqiniso.

Ogcina ubulungisa bakhe kumakhulu eminyaka, oxosha ukudlwengula nokuphazamiseka nokubi; kodwa angeke agcine owinile engagwetywa; obhekana nobubi bomzali kubo bonke abantwana babo, nabangane babo, kuze kube yiminyaka emithathu neyesine.
Nokho, uMoses washaya phansi ngesandla sakhe ezweni, wathandaza.
Wathi, "Uma ngithole inhlonipho phambi kwakho, ngicela ungene nathi; futhi uma le ndoda iqinile, silungise izenzo zethu ezibi nezinkinga zethu, futhi uthathe nathi phakathi kwabantu bakho.

Wathi iNkosi, Bheka, ngizokwenza inxanxathela nawe; ngizozenza phambi kwabantu bakho bonke izinto ezimangazayo, ezingazange zenziwe nganoma iyiphi izwe ezweni lonke; futhi abantu bakho bonke abasendaweni yakho bazobona umsebenzi kaYehova; ngoba lokho engikwenzayo kuwe kumnandi kakhulu.
Ngiyakwenza konke ongangikutshela ngalolusuku; bona, ngizokhipha phambi kwakho ama-Amori, nama-Kanana, nama-Hethi, nama-Perizi, nama-Hivi, namaJebhusi.
Khumbula ukuthi ungakwenzanga inkontileka nabantu belizwe okungena kulo, ukuze bangabi yingozi phakathi kwenu; ngoba iNkosi uThixouNkulunkulu wenu, nizoyilungisa izwe.
Uzophonsa phansi izibingelelo zabo, uzophotha amatshe abo angcwele, uzosusa ama-Ashere abo.
Akufanele ukhonze omunye uNkulunkulu; ngoba iNkosi, igama lakhe liyi-Izitha, nguNkulunkulu oyisitha.
Ungase ukwenzenga isivumelwano nabantu basezweni, ukuze bangakubiza wena, uma behamba ekuphileni ngokwezinakekela, belandela izitha zabo, futhi benikela ezidinini zazo; nawe uzodla ezandleni zabo.
ukuze ungathatheni izingane zabo zibe ngamabhishobhi onyana bakho, zihambe zilandela izitha zabo, njengezinja ezihamba ngezinyoni, futhi zivumele izingane zakho ukuba zihambe ngazo.
Musa ukwenza imifanekiso eqingqiweyo.
Yenza izinsuku ezisixhenxe, udle ukudla okungenyama, njengokuba ngikuwisele umthetho ngawo; kuleso sikhathi senyanga ka-Abib, ngoba ngaleyo nyanga waphuma ezweni laseMisiya.
Owesifazane wesifazane ozalwa ngumzali wakhe, uyisizwe sami; kanye nowesifazane wesifazane wezinkomo zakho nezimvu.

Uzobuya uthenge isisu esincane, ubeke ingulube endaweni yayo. Uma ungathenganga, cindezela umlenze wayo. Uzobuya uthenge bonke oonyana bakho abakhulu; ngeke kube khona umuntu ozofika phambi kwami engenalutho.
Uzosebenza izinsuku eziyisithupha, kodwa uzophumula ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili. Naphezu kwesikhathi sokulima nokuvuna kufanele uphumle.
Uzobhikisha iholide lezinsuku ezine, ngezinto zokuqala zokuvuna izithelo zengulube, neholide lokuqoqwa ekugcineni konyaka.
Izinsuku ezintathu ngonyaka kuzovela bonke amadoda akho phambi kweNkosi iNkosi, uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli.

Ngizokhuphula izizwe phambi kwakho, futhi ngisize izwe lakho likhule; ngeke kubekho umuntu ofuna ukuthatha izwe lakho, uma usuya phezulu njalo ngonyaka izikhathi ezintathu, ukuboniswa phambi koNkulunkulu wakho.
Ungayinikelanga igazi lesonka sami kanye nanoma yini eyenziwe nge-lemu; noma ngabe iyiphi inhlanhla yosuku lwesikhumbuzo sePasika, ngeke ihlale kuze kube ubusuku.
Uzoletha endlwini kaYehova uNkulunkulu wakho okungcono kakhulu kwezithelo zokuqala zezwe lakho; awukwazi ukubhaka ingulube emlonyeni womzali wayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Bhala wena lezi zinto; ngoba ngalezi zinto ngikwenza inkohlakalo nawe, namadodana aseSirayeli.
UMoses waba khona lapho noYehova izinsuku ezimashumi mane nemini eyisithupha, engadla inyama angadli amanzi. Wabhala phezu kwezitebhisi amagama omnqophiso, amazwi alishumi.
Kwathi, lapho uMoses ephuma emfuleni iSinayi, ezicwecwe ezimbili zomnqophiso zisesandlani sakhe; uMoses akawazi ukuthi isikhumba sakhe sikhanya, ngenxa yokuthi wayekhuluma naye.
Babona uAron nomndeni wakwaSirayeli wonke uMoses, bebona ukuthi isikhumba sakhe sikhanya; bakhathazeka kakhulu ukuba bafike kuye.
Wababiza uMoses; wabuyela kuye uAron nabaholi bonke bebandla, wathi kubo uMoses.
Ngemuva kwalokho bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bafike, wabatshela konke iNkosi abemwiselayo emfuleni iSinayi.
Waphela uMoses ekhuluma nabo, wabeka isibuko phezu kobuso bakhe,
Kwathi lapho ephuma khona uMoses ukuba akhulume noYehova, wasusa isibuko, kuze kufike lapho ephuma khona; futhi lapho ephuma khona, wabatshela oonyana bakaSirayeli zonke izinto awagunyaziwe.
Babona ukuthi ubuso bakhe bukhanya; khona-ke uMoses wabeka isibuko phezu kobuso bakhe, kuze afike ekhuluma noNkulunkulu.
UMoses waqoqa ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Lawona amazwi iNkosi awawisela umthetho ngawo, ukuthi nikwenze.

Izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kuzokwenziwa umsebenzi, kodwa usuku oluyisixhenxe luyoba ngusuku olungcwele kuwe, usuku lokuphumula lokuthula kukaNkulunkulu. Wonke umuntu owenza kuphi nakuphi umsebenzi ngalolusuku kumele abulawa.
Ngakho-ke, qiniseka ukuthi uhlala endaweni ephephile, futhi ungasebenzisi izidakamizwa.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, ethi, Le yindlela iNkosi awisenzile ngayo:
Kuzo zonke izinto ongazitholayo, zinikele umnikelo wokudla kuYehova; wonke umuntu onenhliziyo ekhululekile, anikela ngomnikelo wokudla kuYehova: igolide, nesilivere, nesiliva;
luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, i-purple, kanye nendwangu ebomvu; ilinen enhle; inkomo;
isikhumba se-ram emnyama; isikhumba esincane; acacia wood;
i-oyile ye-olive yezibani; izithako ze-oyile yokunquma, kanye ne-incense emnandi;
namatshe e-onyx, namanye amathoyizi, ukuze afakwe ku-ephod nengxenye yekhanda.
Wonke umuntu owaziyo umsebenzi phakathi kwenu kufanele afike, akwenze konke iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo:
itente elingcwele, netende layo, nokugqugquzela kwayo, nama-hook ayo, nama-frames awo, nama-bars ayo, nama-posts ayo, nama-bases akhe;
isibambo, nezintambo zaso, nesibuko saso, nesitayela esiyifihla;
nethebulethi, namapuleti ayo, nezitsha zayo zonke, nenkukhu ekhethekile;
isibani sokukhanya, namathuluzi alo, nezibani zalo, nephethiloli yokukhanya;
isibambo somlilo, nezinkomishi zalo, nophethiloli wokufaka ukhilimu, nefuthe elimnandi lomlilo, nesibuko somngcele wendawo engcwele;
isibingelelo somnikelo wokushiswa, nesitezi sayo sesiliva, nezintambo zaso, namathuluzi ayo onke; ibhodwe lokugeza izitsha, nophahla lwalo;
ama-curtains esitezi esiphansi, nama-posts awo nama-bases, kanye ne-screen yokungeniswa kwesitezi esiphansi;
izibopho zesitezi esingcwele, nezibopho zesibhedlela, nezintambo zawo;
kanye nezigqoko ezithosiwe zokuphatha endaweni engcwele, izigqoko ezingcwele zika-Aron umbingeleli, nezigqoko zamadodana akhe, ukuze basebenze njengombingeleli.
Waphuma khona wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli kuMoses.

Wafika wonke umuntu, lowo inhliziyo yakhe ibimkhuthazayo, nomoya wakhe ubewufisayo, waba nesiphuzo somnikelo wokudla kuYehova, ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wesitezi sokuhlangana, nomsebenzi wayo onke, nezigqoko ezingcwele.

Wafika wonke umuntu, owesifazane nowesifazane, ongamthanda uNkulunkulu, waletha zonke izinhlobo zezinto zokuhlobisa zegolide, izibopho, nezikhonkwane, nezikhundla, nezintambo; wonke umuntu wanikela ngegolide lakhe njengomnikelo wokudla kuYehova.
Wonke umuntu onezinkuni ezibomvu, nezibomvu, nezibomvu, nelinen emhlophe, nezinwele zengulube, nesikhumba sembuzi esibomvu, nesikhumba esingwevu, wazisa.
Wonke umuntu okwaziyo ukunikela ngegolide noma ngesiliva, wazisa njengomnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu; nalowo wonke umuntu onemithi ye-acacia yokwenza iyiphi ingxenye yomsebenzi, wayaza.
Wonke uwesifazane owaziyo umsebenzi wakhe, wagqoka intambo ngezandla zakhe, waba nesigqoko esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nesigqoko esimnyama, nesigqoko esibomvu, nelinen emhlophe.
Nabo bonke abesifazane abafisayo futhi babe nekhono lokujika izinwele zembuzi.
Abaphathi bafaka amatshe e-onyx, namanye amafutha omnqumo, ukuze afakwe ku-ephod nengxenye yekhanda.
Bafaka futhi izithako, kanye ne-olive oil, ukuze kwenziwe isibani, kanye ne-olive yokuncibilikisa, kanye ne-incense emnandi.
Wonke umuntu waseSirayeli, indoda nowesifazane, ofuna ukunikela ngokuzithandela umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, waba nesiphuzo salowo msebenzi wonke owawugunyazwe nguYehova ngoMosesi.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Thola, uNdikhoyo wakhetha uBezaleleli, indodana kaUri, indodana kaHure, ezweni likaYuda.
Wamugcwalisa ngoMoya kaThixo, ngolwazi, nokuqonda, nolwazi, nokukwazi ukwenza zonke izinhlobo zemisebenzi.
Ungenza imibono ehlelekile, futhi asebenze ngegolide, nesiliva, nobhedu,
ukusika, nokubeka amatshe abalulekile, ukudweba imithi, nokwenza zonke izinhlobo zomsebenzi owaziyo.
UYehova wamnika yena no-Aholihabhi, unyana ka-Ahisamakhi, wesizwe sikaDani, amandla okufundisa abantu.

Wabagcwalisa ngolwazi lokwenza zonke izinhlobo zemisebenzi, njengezikhonkwane, kanye nalabo abaveza izifanekiso ezibukekayo ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengwevu, neyebomvu, noboya obunombala okhanyayo, futhi njengamathoyizi, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza zonke izinhlobo zemisebenzi, futhi benze izithombe ezinhle.

UBesaleyeli, no-Ahaliyabhi, nanoma yimuphi umuntu owaziyo umsebenzi, owabeka iNkosi engqondweni yakhe ubuhlakani nokuqonda, ukuze akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wonke wokwakha indawo engcwele, kumele bakwenze umsebenzi, njengokuthi iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
UMoses wabiza uBezalele, noAholihabhi, nalowo wonke umuntu owaziyo izinto, owabeka iNkosi engqondweni yakhe ubuhlakani, lowo wonke umuntu owenza intliziyo yakhe ifike isebenze umsebenzi.
Bathi, "Sizonikela ngezinto ezingcwele; sizonikela ngomnikelo wokudla kanye nomnikelo wewayini, futhi sizonikela ngomnikelo wokudla kanye nomnikelo wokudla."
Wathi wonke umuntu owaziyo umsebenzi, owenza umsebenzi ezindaweni ezingcwele, wayeka umsebenzi wakhe,
Bathi kuMoses, Abantu baletha okuningi kakhulu kunalokho okudingekayo ekwenzeni umsebenzi owawuthunyelwe nguYehova.
Wathi uMosis, wamemezela esitezi sonke, esithi, Amadodakazi noma amakhosikazi angabi nalutho ngaphezu kwalokho okunikezwayo esingcweleni; ngakho abantu baphoqwa ukuba bangabi nento.
ngoba lokho ababenakho kwakungaphezu kokunethezeka ukwenza umsebenzi wonke.

Wonke umuntu owaziyo umsebenzi, phakathi kwabo, wakwenza isikhala esingcwele: amathenda alishumi elinenni elithosiwe, noboya obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, noboya obubomvu, noboya obubomvu obomvu, namakerubi, enziwe ngomsebenzi owaziyo.
Zonke izigcawu zazinomthamo ofanayo, cishe amasentimitha ayishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ubude nangemva kwamasentimitha amabili ubanzi.
Wazibophezela amafasitela amane ndawonye, wakwenza njalo namanye amafasitela amane.
Bakwenza ama-loops endwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngaphesheya komngcele wesidlangalaleni esisemqoka, kanye nesimo esifanayo kwisidlangalaleni esisemqoka esakhiweni sesibili.
Wakwenza izibopho ezingu-50 emgodini owodwa, nezibopho eziyingqayizivele ezingaba ngu-50 engxenyeni yesiphelo somgwaqo wesithathu; lezi zibopho zazibhekene ngazo.
Wakwenza izikhonkwane zegolide ezingu-50, wasebenzisa lezi zinto ukuxhuma amafasitela amabili ngazo zonke izingxenye zawo ndawonye; ibe yindawo engcwele.
Wakwenza amafasitela ezinwele zengulube, ukuze abe yindawo yokuphumula phezu kwekamelo elingcwele, amafasitela ayishumi nanye.
Zonke izigcawu ezingu-11 zazinomthamo ofanayo, cishe amasentimitha angama-13 namasentimitha amabili ububanzi.
Baxhuma amafasitela amane ndawonye engxenyeni eyodwa, namafasitela ayisishiyagalombili engxenyeni enye.

Wakwenza izibopho ezingu-50 engxenyeni yesiphetho sesitayela esisodwa esixhunywe ndawonye, futhi wazenza izimbotshana eziyingqayizivele ezingaba ngu-50 engxenyeni sesiphelo sesitayela esakhiwe ngasinye.
Wakwenza izikhonkwane zesiliva ezingu-50, ukuze zixhume itente ndawonye, ibe yindawo eyodwa.
Wakwenza isigqoko sendlu yokuphumula, esinamafutha omnqumo amhlophe, futhi ngaso sigqoko sesikhumba somuntu.
Wakwenza izintambo ezimile zesihlahla sika-Asika, esitezi esiphakeme sendlu.
Ifreyimu ngayinye ibiyimitha ezingu-4.5 ubude nesentimitha eziyisixhenxe ububanzi.
Ibhodi ngalinye lalinezikhonkwane ezimbili, ukuze lixhunywe ndawonye. Ngale ndlela wazenza zonke izikhonkwane zendlu yokuphumula.
Wakwenza izindwangu ezingu-20 engxenyeni esenyakatho yendlu yokuphumula.
Wakwenza izinqola zesiliva ezimashumi mane ngezansi kwezikhonkwane eziyishumi nambili, izikhundla ezimbili ngaphansi kwesikhonkwane ngasinye.
Engxenyeni yesithathu, engxenyeni yasenyakatho yendlu yokuphumula, wakwenza izindwangu eziyishumi nambili;
futhi izisekelo zesiliva ezimashumi amane, ezimbili ngezansi kwebhodi ngalinye.
Wakwenza izindwangu eziyisishiyagalombili ngaphambili kwendlu yokuphumula, engxenyeni yasenyakatho.
Wakwenza izindwangu ezimbili ezingemuva kwendlu yokuphumula.
Kulezi zinhlangothi ezimbili amafreyimu ayephindwe kabili kusukela ngezansi yonke indlela ukuya phezulu, agcinwe yiringi elilodwa. Izinhlangothi zombili zakhiwa ngendlela efanayo.
Kwaba khona izindwangu eziyisishiyagalombili, nezikhonkwane zesiliva eziyishumi nanye nesixhenxe; izikhonkwane ezimbili ngezansi kwenqwaba.
Wakwenza izintambo zokhuni lwe-acacia, eziyisihlanu ezitsheni zengxenye eyodwa yendlu yokuphumula;
eziyisishiyagalombili zezingcezu ezikwesobunxele, kanye nezishiyagalombili zezingcezu ezikwesokunxele ngasemva.
Bakwenza umgwaqo ophakathi ukuze uhambe yonke indlela kusukela esiphethweni esisodwa kuya kwesiphequluli esisodwa, ngaphesheya komgwaqo.
Wazigqoka izindwangu ngegolide, wazenza izikhonkwane zegolide ukuze zifakwe kuzo amabhande, wazigqoka amabhande ngogolide.
Wakwenza ifasitela ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengwevu, nesibomvu, noboya obunombala okhanyayo, waveza kuyo amakerubi, enza umsebenzi omusha.
Wayenza imilenze emine yomnqumo, wazigqoka ngodwala; wazenza izikhonkwane zazo zegolide, wazibambisa izisekelo zazo zesilivere ezine.
Wakwenza ifasitela emgwaqeni wesitezi, ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nendwangu ensundu, nendwangu ebomvu, nendwangu emhlophe ethosiwe, umsebenzi womuntu owenza izimbobo.
Wakwenza izibambo eziyisishiyagalombili, namahlombe azo; wagqoka ngegolide imilenze yezibambo, nezibopho zazo; wazenza izinqola zawo eziyisishiyagalombili zesiliva.
UBesaleyeli wenza isithunywa segolide, esinamamitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili ubude, nemitha elilodwa nesishiyagalolunye ububanzi, nemitha elilodwa nesishiyagalombili ubude.
Wayigqoka ngegolide elihlanzekile, yangaphakathi nangaphandle; wayenza nemingcele yegolide ngazo zonke izinhlangothi.
Wayenza izikhonkwane zegolide ezine, wazifaka ezinyaweni zayo ezine; izikhonkwane ezimbili ngakwesobunxele, nezikhonkwane ezimbili ngakwesokudla.
Wakwenza izintambo zesihlahla sika-Asika, wazigqoka ngogolide.
Wabeka izintambo phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezisezindaweni zesithunywa, ukuze ziyithwale.
Wakwenza isibuko, indawo yokuxolisa, yegolide elihlanzekile; ubude bayo buyimitha eyodwa nesishiyagalombili, ububanzi bawo buyimitha eyisishiyagalolunye.
Wakwenza amakerubi amabili, egolide elihlanganisiwe, emaphaketheni amane ophahla,
ikherubi elilodwa esiphethweni esisodwa, nekherubi elilodwa esiphethweni esisodwa; wazenza izikerubi nezibuko zibe ingxenye eyodwa.
Amakerubi ahlukanise amaphiko abo phezulu, egqoka isipho ngephiko labo; bebhekene omunye nomunye, bebheka phansi kuleso sisipho.
Wayenza ithebulethi yesihlahla se-acacia; ubude bayo buyisentimitha eziyisishiyagalombili, ububanzi bayo buyisentimitha eziyisithupha, ubude bayo buyisentimitha eziyisishiyagalolunye.
Wayigqoka ngegolide elihlanzekile, wabeka umkhawulo wegolide ngaso.
Wakwenza isibambo sayo ngaso sonke isandla, wabeka ungqimba lwegolide esibambo.
Wakwenza izikhonkwane zegolide ezine, wazibeka emazingeni amane, ezindaweni zezinyawo zayo ezine.
Izinhlamvu zaziphakathi kwe-rim, ukuze zibambe amapuleti asetshenziswa ukuthwala ithebhu.
Wazenza izintambo zesihlahla se-acacia, wazigqugquzela ngegolide, ukuze zithwale ithebhu.
Wakwenza futhi izitsha zetafula, izingubo zayo, namabhodwe ayo, namabhodlela ayo, namakhopho awo, asetshenziselwa umnikelo wokudla, ngegolide elimhlophe.
Wakwenza isibani segolide elihlanzekile, wamisa isisekelo saso, nophahla lwaso; izinkomishi zaso, namaqabunga ayo, nezimbali zayo, zonke ziyinto eyodwa.
Izihlahla eziyisishiyagalombili zaphuma emigwaqweni yesikhashana, ezintathu ngakwesobunxele, kanye nezithathu ngakwesokudla.
Yonke inxanxathela eyisishiyagalombili ine-cups ezintathu ezihlanganisiwe njengezimbali ze-almond, nge-buds ne-blossoms, enkantini eyodwa nakwesinye isigaba.
Ngaso isibani sayo, kwakukhona amakhofi amane afana nezimbali ze-almond, anezinhlamvu nezimbali.

Kwaba khona inkomishi engezansi kwengxenye yokuqala, nekomishi yesibili engezansi kwengxenye yesithathu, nekomishi yesithathu engezansi kwengxenye yesithathu; zonke lezi zinkomishi ezine zaphuma emgodini.
Izinhlamvu, nezihlahla, zonke ziyingxenye eyodwa nesihlalo somshado, zikhishwe ngegolide elihlanzekile.
Wakwenza izibani zayo ezisixhenxe, namabhodwe ayo, nezitsha zalo, zegolide elihlanzekile.
Wasebenzisa amakhilogremu amashumi amathathu anesihlanu wegolide elihlanzekile, ukwenza isibambo sokukhanya nezinto zayo zonke.

Wakwenza isibhedlela somlilo semithi ye-acacia; sayizimitha ezingu-45 ubude, nezinyawo eziyisishiyagalombili ububanzi, futhi sazimitha ezingama-90 ukuphakama kwayo. Izingulube zayo zaziyinto eyodwa nayo.
Wayigqoka ngegolide elihlanzekile, futhi imilenze yayo yonke, nezinkomo zayo, wayenza inqwaba yegolide ngazo zonke izingcezu.
Wakwenza izikhonkwane ezimbili zegolide ngezansi komgwaqo, ezihlangothini zombili eziphikisanayo, ukuze zibekwe kuzo izinkomishi ezisetshenziselwa ukuthwala.
Wazenza izintambo zemithi ye-acacia, wazigcobisa ngegolide.
Wakwenza futhi uphethiloli ongcwele wokuncibilikisa, nofuzo oluhlanzekile olunomsoco, njengomsebenzi wokwenza iziphuzo.
Wakha isibingelelo somnikelo wokushiswa, eyenziwe ngomnqumo we-acacia; imilenze emihlanu ubude bayo, nemilenze emihlanu ububanzi bayo, ibe yizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili zamasentimitha.
Wakwenza izingulube ezindaweni zayo ezine, ngazo zonke izinhlangothi zayo ezine; lezi zingulube zaba yizingulube zaso isibingelelo; wasiza isibingelelo ngobhedu.
