Wakwenza zonke izinto zayo zesibingelelo zibe yizinsimbi, amabhodwe ayo, nezitsha zalo, namabhodlela alo, nama-forks awo, nama-pans alo.
Wakwenza nesitezi somlilo, intambo yesiliva, wayibeka ngezansi kophahla lwesitezi somlilo, yafinyelela emiphakathini yayo.
Wakwenza izibopho zesiliva ezine, ezimininingwaneni ezine zodonga lwegolide, ukuze zibambe amatshe.
Wazenza izintambo zesihlahla se-acacia, wazigqoka ngegolide.
Wabeka amabhande emigodini, ezindaweni ezingezansi zesihlalo somlilo, ukuze sithwalwe. Wayenza ibe yindilinga, ifakwe izindwangu.
Wakwenza nebhodlela legolide, nophahla lwayo lwegolide, esebenzisa izibuko zegolide zabesifazane abasebenza emgwaqeni wendlu yokuxoxa.
Wakwenza nendlu yangasese, engxenyeni esenyakatho, izingcezu eziyisishiyagalolunye ubude bayo; wazenza izitezi zendwangu engenisiwe.
Yabe nezingqungquthela ezingu-20, nezifunda zegolide ezingu-20, namahhashi esiliva namabhande emigqeni.
Ingxenye yasenyakatho nayo ibiyimitha ezingu-45 ubude, nezingqimba eziyisishiyagalombili nezisekelo zesiliva ezingaba ngu-20, namahhashi egolide namabhande emigqeni.

Isiphequluli sasentshonalanga saba ngamamitha ayimashumi amabili nambili ububanzi, nezingqungquthela, nezikhonkwane ezingu-10, nezingxenye eziyingqayizivele ezingama-10, namabhande aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezinkonzweni.
Isiphequluli esisenyakatho, esibheke ukuphuma kwelanga, sayizimitha eziyishumi nambili ububanzi.
Engxenyeni eyodwa yokungena kwakukhona ama-curtains angaphezu kwamamitha ayisithupha ubude, anezinhlamvu ezintathu nezifunda ezintathu.
Ngakwesobunxele kokungena esitezi sangaphakathi kwakukhona futhi ama-curtains angaphezu kwamamitha ayisithupha ubude, anezinhlamvu ezintathu nezindawo eziphansi ezintathu.
Wonke ama-curtains ajikeleze i-courtyard enziwe ngelinen eqinile.

Izintonga zalezi zintambo zazingwevu, izikhonkwane nezibopho zezintambo zazigolide, futhi imilenze yazo yayigqugquzelwe ngesiliva. Izingcingo zonke zesibhedlela sangaphakathi zazingqugquzelwe ngegolide.

Isikrini sokungena esitezi esiphansi sakhiwa ngezinkuni ezibomvu, neziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kanye nendwangu ebomvu noboya obunombala okhanyayo. Kuyimisebenzi yomuntu onemihlobiso emihle. Imamitha ayisishiyagalombili ubude futhi ingaphezu kwamamitha amabili phezulu, njengama-curtains asethebeni elingaphansi.
Izingqungquthela zayo zazinesihlanu, nezisekelo zazo zazinesiliva; izibopho zazo nezibopho zabo zaba yigolide, futhi imilenze yabo yagqokwa ngegolide.
Zonke izibopho zesitezi esingcwele, nezibopho zesibhedlela, kanye nendlu yangasese ejikelezayo, zaziyisiliva.
Lezi zinto ziyizinga lezinto ezisetshenziswa esitezi esingcwele, esitezi sesivumelwano, ngokusho komthetho kaMosis, ngamadodana aLevi, ngaphansi kwesandla sika-Ithamari unyana ka-Aron umpristi.
UBesaleyeli unyana kaUri, unyana kaHuri, wesizwe sakwaYuda, wenza konke iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses.
No-Ahaliyabhi unyana ka-Ahisamakhi, wesizwe sakwaDan, umdwebi, nomuntu osebenza ngezandla, waveza izimbobo eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nezibomvu, nezingwevu, nelinen emhlophe.
Igolide lonke elinikezelwe, elisetshenziswa ekwenzeni umsebenzi wendawo engcwele, lalingamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, ngokwenani lendawo engcwele.
Isiliva elinikezwa yibo bonke ababhaliswe emphakathini, lalingamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele.

Kwabe sekuyibheka elilodwa, ishekeli elilodwa nesishiyagalombili kumuntu ngamunye, ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele; Ngawo wonke umuntu okubalwa kuwo, oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, kwaba ngumakhulu amabili nanhlanu amawaka amathathu namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.

Kwaba ngamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili esiliva, kwathiwa, kwasetshenziswa ukubhoboza izinqola zendawo engcwele, nezinqola zesibhakabhaka, izinqola ezikhulu, ngamakhilogremu amashumi amathathu anesine isiqola esisodwa.
Wasebenzisa amanye amakhilogremu angama-20 esiliva ukwenza izikhonkwane zezingqimba, ukuze zigqugquzele izinhlangothi eziphezulu zezinqwaba, nokwenza izingubo zabo.
I-bronze enikezelwe njengomnikelo isisindo sayo cishe amakhilogremu ayizigidi ezimbili nekhulu.
Wakwenza ngaleyo nto izisekelo zokungena efulethini lengqungquthela, nesihlalo somlilo segolide, nesitezi sayo segolide, nezitsha zayo zonke;
kanye nezingcezu zendlu yangasese ejikelezayo, nokungena kwayo; nanoma yiziphi izibopho zezindlu zangasese ezingcwele, nezingasese elijikelezayo.
Bakwenza izigqoko ezibomvu, nezingwevu, nezingwevu, ukuze bazisebenzise ezindaweni ezingcwele; bazenza futhi izigqoko ezingcwele zika-Aron, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
UBesaleyeli wakwenza i-ephod ngegolide, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nombala omnyama ophuzi, nomnqumo obomvu, nesiketi esilula.
Bafaka igolide ezindaweni ezincane, baluka izintambo, ukuze zigqokwe ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengwevu, nengwevu ebomvu, nendwangu yelinen, umsebenzi womuntu owaziyo.
Wakwenza izimbobo zesifuba se-ephodi, wazigqugquzela ezindaweni zayo ezimbili, ukuze zixhunywe ndawonye.

Wakwenza futhi umcibisholo wayo, wawenza ngesandla sakhe sakudala, efana naye, wegolide, noboya obubomvu, noboya obumnyama, noboya obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nelinen elibomvu eliqoshiwe; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Babeka amatshe e-onyx emigodini yegolide, badweba phezu kwawo amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengokuthi umhlobisi wezinhlamvu udweba isipho.
Wazibeka ezinyaweni zesigqoko se-ephod, zibe izingcezu zokukhumbula izingane zakwaSirayeli; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Bakwenza ikhanda, kwenziwe ngomsebenzi omusha, njenge-ephod, ngegolide, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nendwangu ensundu, nendwangu yelinen ethosiwe.
Yabe isikwere, iphindwe kabili, cishe amasentimitha angu-23 ubude nobubanzi bamasentimitha angama-23.
Babeka phezu kwayo izingqimba ezine zezinhlamvu zegolide. Isingqimba sokuqala saba yi-ruby, ne-topaz, ne-beryl.
Emgqeni wesibili kwakuyi-turquoise, i-sapphire, ne-emerald.
Emgqeni wesithathu kwakuyi-hyacinth, i-agate, ne-amethyst.
Esigabeni sesine kwakukhona i-chrysolite, ne-onyx, ne-jasper; zafakwa ezitsheni zegolide.
Kwaba ngamatshe alishumi elinambini, ngamagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngamagama abo bonke. Ngawo wonke amatshe kwakuboniswa amagama abo, njengamacwecwe egolide, ngokwezizwe ezilishumi elinambini.
Bakwenza izibopho zegolide elihlanzekile, ezigqugquzelwe njengentambo.
Wakwenza izintambo ezimbili zegolide, nezikhonkwane ezimbili zegolide; wabeka izikhonkwane ezikunxele nakwesokudla kwesifuba.
Bafaka amabhande amabili egolide ezinyaweni ezimbili ezinqolobaneni zengxenye yesifuba.
Amanye amaphethini ezinkomishi awaxhuma emazingeni amabili, wawafaka emilenzeni ye-ephod ngaphesheya kwesokudla.
Bakwenza izikhonkwane ezimbili zegolide, bazibeka emigwaqweni emibini yesifuba, engxenyeni yangaphakathi engezansi kweephod.
Bakwenza izintambo ezimbili zegolide, bazibeka ngezansi kwezimbobo zesifuba esingaphambilini se-ephod, engxenyeni yaso esemqoka, ngaphesheya kwesigqoko sayo.

Wazibophezela izikhonkwane zesifuba ezikhonkwaneni se-ephod ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuze isikhunta sihlale phezulu komgogodla, futhi singahlukaniswa ne-ephod; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wakwenza futhi isigqoko se-ephod, esinamafutha aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
Kube khona ukuvula phakathi kweroba njenge-collar, ngengxenye egqokekayo ejikeleze ukuvula ukuze ingabi yindilinga.
Bakwenza ama-granates engxenyeni esingenhla yesigqoko, ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nendabuko, nengwevu, noboya obunombala omnyama.
Bakwenza izinhlamvu zegolide elihlanzekile, bazibeka phakathi kwezinhlamvu ze-granate, ngaso sonke isibambo sogqoka.
Kwaba nezinhlamvu nezithelo ze-pomelo, izinhlamvu nezithelo ze-pomelo, engxenyeni yesigqoko samadodakazi kambingeleli ngazo zonke izingcezu, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wakwenza izigqoko zika-Aron, namadodana akhe, ezingwevu elingenalutho,
kanye ne-turban eyenziwe ngelinen, nama-caps eyenziwe ngelinen, nezigqoko ezingaphansi zelinen eyenziwe ngocingo.
Wakwenza isigqoko segolide, nesingwevu, nesibhakabhaka, nesibomvu, esinamafutha aphindwe kabili, yenziwe ngomsebenzi wokusika, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Bakwenza isibhakabhaka, ikhanda elingcwele, ngegolide elihlanzekile; badweba phezu kwalo, njengokudweba umvimbo, bethi: Kungcwele kuYehova.
Bayibopha ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuze bayibeke emgodini, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Ngalokhu kwaqedwa umsebenzi wonke wesitezi esingcwele, isitezi sokuhlangana; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses, ngalokho bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bawenza.
Bathi baletha ikamelo kuMoses, ikamelo, nezinto zayo zonke, nezikhonkwane zalo, namabhodi alo, nama-bars alo, nama-postes alo, namathumbu alo;
kanye nokugqugquzela kwesikhumba sembuzi esibomvu, nokugqugquzela kwesikhumba esinombala omnandi, kanye nophahla olufihlayo ibhokisi;
ibhokisi lesivumelwano, nezingcezu zalo, nesigqoko salo;
ithebula ngazo zonke izingxenye zayo kanye nenyama ekhethekile;
isibani segolide elihlanzekile, nesibambo saso sokukhanya, namathuluzi alo onke, nophethiloli wokukhanya;
isibingelelo segolide, nama-oyile okubhaka, nofuzo olunomsoco, nesitayela sokungena esihlalweni sezulu;
isibingelelo sesiliva, nesitezi sayo segolide, namabhodlela ayo, nezitsha zayo zonke; nombhede wokugeza imilenze, nesikhala sawo;

amafasitela endlu yangasese, nezingqungquthela zazo, nezisekelo zazo, nophahla lokungena entshonalanga yendlu yangasese, namantambo ayo, nezibopho zayo, nazo zonke izinto zomsebenzi wendawo yokuphumula engcwele, ikamelo lokuxoxa;
kanye nezigqoko ezithosiwe zokuphatha ezindaweni ezingcwele, izigqoko ezingcwele zika-Aron umpristi, nezigqoko zamadodana akhe, ukuze basebenze njengomnikelo wokudla.
Ngokungafani nalokho iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses, ngakho bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bawenza umsebenzi wonke.
UMoses wabheka umsebenzi wonke, futhi ngalokho iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngalo, bona, bawenza. Wabasabisa uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yokuqala, uzomisa ikamelo elingcwele, ikamelo lokuhlangana.
Uzobeka khona isibambo sesivumelwano, ubeke ifasitela phambi kwesibambo, ukuze lifihlakale.
Nciphisa ithebhu, ubeke phezu kwayo konke okudingekayo; bese unciphisa isibani, ubeke phezu kwalo izibani.
Uzobeka isibingelelo segolide somlilo womlilo phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, ubeke ifasitela emgwaqeni wendawo engcwele.
Uzobeka isibingelelo somnikelo wokushiswa phambi komngcele wesitezi esingcwele, itente lokuhlangana;
Uzobeka ibhodwe lokugeza phakathi kwekamelo lokuxoxa nesihlalo somlilo, uthele amanzi kulo.
Sebenzisa igumbi lokuphumula eduze kwayo, bese uphonsa isibuko emnyango wegumbi lokuhlala.
Thola uphethiloli wokuncibilikisa, ukhiphe khona ikamelo elingcwele, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kulo; yenza libe yindawo engcwele, nayo yonke into yayo, ibe ngcwele.
Uzofaka ukhilimu esibhedlela somnikelo wokushiswa, nezinto zayo zonke; uzomisa isibhedlela, ibe ngcwele kakhulu.
Nciphisa ibhodwe lokuhlanza, nesitezi sayo, uzicime zibe ngcwele.
Uzodlulisa uAron nezingane zakhe emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, uzowahlamba amanzi.
Uzowugqoka uAron izicathulo ezingcwele, uzowuphazamisa, uzowulungisa abe ngumuntu ongcwele, ukuze asebenze kimi njengompristi.
Nciphisa izingane zakhe futhi bagqoke izigqoko.

Uzobeka ukhilimu phezu kwabo, njengokuthi wabeka ukhilimu phezu kukababa wabo, ukuze basebenze kimi njengombhishobhi; uzobeka ukhilimu phezu kwabo, ukuze basebenze njengombhishobhi kuze kube yiminyaka yabo yonke, kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wakwenza uMoses konke, njengokuba iNkosi wamwiselayo.
Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yokuqala, ngonyaka wesithathu, kwabekwa khona ikamelo elingcwele.
UMoses wamisa isibhedlela, wabeka izisekelo zayo endaweni yayo, wabeka amabhodi ayo, wafaka izikhonkwane zalo, wamisa imilenze yalo.
Wamisa itende phezu kwendlu engcwele, wabeka isigqoko setente phezu kwayo; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathatha izibhloko zomthetho, wazibeka ngaphakathi ebhokisini, wafaka amabhodlela ebhokisini, wabeka isipho sezulu phezu kwayo.
Wafaka ibhokisi egumbini elingcwele, wabeka isibuko esifihlayo, ukuze agqoke ibhokisi lesivumelwano, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
UMoses wabeka itafula esihlalweni sokuhlangana, engxenyeni yasenyakatho yendlu yokuphumula, ngaphesheya komgwaqo.
Wabeka phezu kwayo ukudla phambi koYehova, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
Wabeka isibani esitezi sokuhlangana, esibhekene netafula, engxenyeni esenyakatho yekamelo elingcwele.
Wabeka izibani phambi koYehova, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo.
Wabeka uMoses isibingelelo segolide esihlalweni sokuhlangana, phambi kophahla,
wamisa phezu kwayo insipho emnandi, njengoba iNkosi abemwisele umthetho.
Wabeka ifasitela emgwaqweni wokungena efulethini elingcwele.
Wabeka isibingelelo somnikelo wokushiswa emgwaqeni wesitezi esingcwele, esitezi sokuhlangana; wanikela phezu kwalo izipho zokushiswa, nezipho zokudla, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo.
Wabeka isitsha sokugeza phakathi kwekamelo lokuhlangana nesihlalo somlilo, wafaka amanzi kuwo ukuwahlanza.
UMoses no-Aron, nabantwana bakhe, basebenzisana nabo ukuwahlamba amehlo abo namadolo.
Uma bephuma esitezi sokuhlangana, noma befika esibingeleni, bahlamba, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi uMoses, wamisa isibhedlela esiseduze kwendlu yokuphumula nesihlalo somlilo, wabeka ifasitela emgwaqweni wesibhedlela; ngaleyo ndlela uMoses aqedile umsebenzi.
Kwathi lapho, imvula yavala indlu yokuhlangana, futhi ubuhle bukaYehova bugcwele indawo engcwele.
UMoses akakwazanga kungena entabeni yokuhlangana, ngoba izulu lihlala phezu kwayo, futhi ubuhle bukaYehova bugcwele itenda elingcwele.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi sokuhamba kwabo, lapho izulu likhuphuka phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, khona-ke abantu bakaSirayeli behamba.
Uma imvula ingakhuphuki, abazange bahambe kuze kube yilapho iyakhuphuka.
Izulu likaNdikhoyo lahlala phezu kwendlu engcwele ngosuku olulodwa, futhi umlilo wawukhona ekuseni, phambi kwamehlo abantu bakaSirayeli bonke, kuzo zonke izindiza zabo.
Lev: Wabiza iNkosi uMoses, wakhuluma naye esitezi sokuhlangana, esithi,
Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi: Uma kukhona umuntu phakathi kwenu ofuna ukunikela ngenhlanhla kuYehova, kufanele athathe isilwane esiphilayo sezinkomo zenu, noma sengulube zenu.
Uma umnikelo wakhe wokudla wumnikelo wokushiswa osuka ezilwaneni, kufanele ube ngumfana ongenacala; uzowuletha emgwaqeni wetente lengqungquthela, ukuze kuvunyelwe uNkulunkulu.
Uzobeka isandla sakho phezu kwekhanda layo, ukuze livunyelwe kuwe, ukulungisa iphutha lakho.
Uzobulala inkomo encane phambi kweNkosi; futhi unyana ka-Aron, ababingeleli, bazoletha igazi, baphuza phezu kwesibambo esiphezulu esiseduze komngcele wesitezi sokuhlangana ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ngemuva kwalokho ukhiphe isikhumba senyamazane bese uyijika ibe ngamatshe.
Bazomisa umlilo phezu kwesibingelelo, babeke imithi ehlanzekile phezu kwengcindezi.
Bazomisa amacwecwe, nekhanda, nenyama, ngohlelo oluhle kakhulu, phezu kwesihlahla esithunyelwa emgodini.
Kodwa izitho zangaphakathi, nezinyawo, uzozihlanza ngamanzi; umnikelo wokudla uzowushisa onqenqemeni lwesibingelelo; yisondlo esishiswayo, isiphuzo esivela emgodini, iphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uma umnikelo wakhe wokushiswa ube yizingulube, noma ibe yimvu, noma ibe yimbuzi, kufanele kube ngumfana ongenacala.
Uzoyibulala engxenyeni yasenyakatho yesitezi esiphezulu phambi koYehova; futhi unyana baka-Aron, ababingeleli, bazoyisusa igazi layo phezu kwesitezi esiphakeme ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Uzoyihlukanisa ibe yizingxenye zayo, nekhanda layo, namafutha ayo; umbingeleli uzozibeka ngokulinganayo phezu komlilo wokhuni osetshenzisiwe emgodini.

Kodwa izitho zangaphakathi, nezinyawo, uzozihlanza ngamanzi; futhi umbingeleli uzozisa zonke lezi zinto, aze azisindise phezu kwesibingelelo; yisondlo esishiswayo, isiphuzo esivela emlilweni, iphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uma isonka esishiswayo kuYehova siyisingulube, uzoba nenyama yenkomo noma inkunzi yemvu.
Umbingeleli uzoyiletha esihlalweni somlilo, futhi uzoyisusa ikhanda layo, ayenze ibe ngumlilo esihlalweni somlilo; igazi lakhe lizoqhutshwa engxenyeni eseceleni kwesihlalo.
Uzothatha ikhanda layo, nemilenze yayo, azoyifaka engxenyeni esenyakatho yesibingelelo, lapho kufakwa khona uthuli.

Nokho uma umnikelo wokudla usesandleni sakhe, angeke aphuze ngaso sonke isikhathi. Nokho uma umnikelo wokudla usesandleni sakhe, ngeke uphuze ngaso sonke isikhathi; kodwa uzowukhipha ngezandla zakhe, futhi uzowuphonsa emgodini ongcwele.
Uma umuntu enikeza umnikelo wokudla kuYehova, kufanele kube yimifino ehlanzekile; kumele ifakwe emanzini, ibe nefuthe.

Uzozisa kubo oonyana baka-Aron, ababingeleli; futhi umbingeleli kufanele athathe isandla sakhe esigcwele saleyo mifino nophethiloli, kanye nefuthe lonke, alifuthe phezu kwesibambo somlilo, njengento ephawulekayo; yisondlo esiqhutshwa ngamanzi, sinomsoco omnandi kuYehova.
Okunye okushiwo ngomnikelo wokudla kuzoba ngu-Aron, nezingane zakhe; kuyinto engcwele kakhulu phakathi kwezinto ezitholwe umlilo iNkosi.
Uma unikela ngomnikelo wesono ophekwe emgodini, kufanele kube yimifino ehlanzekile engaphazamiswanga, eyenziwe ngomhluzi omncane oxhunywe neoli, noma ama-wafers angaphazamiswanga, afakwe ioli.
Uma isiphuzo sakho sembewu siphekwe emgodini, kufanele sibe yimifino encane engabi nenyamakazi, ihlanganisene nophethiloli.
Uzoyinquma ibe yizingxenye, uthele phezu kwayo uphethiloli, ibe yisonka esilungiselelwe.
Uma isiphuzo sakho sembewu siphekwe ebhodweni, kufanele kwenziwe ngoshizi oluncane nophethiloli.
Uzoletha umnikelo wokudla, owenziwe ngalezi zinto, kuYehova; uzowunikeza umbhishobhi, abeke phezu kwesibopho.
Uzothatha umbingeleli isikhumbuzo salokho okunikezwayo, azowushisa phezu kwesibingelelo; yisondlo somlilo sephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Okunye okushiwo ngomnikelo wokudla kuzoba ngu-Aron, nezingane zakhe; kuyinto engcwele kakhulu phakathi kwezinto ezitholwe umlilo iNkosi.
Umnikelo wakho wokudla, uma unikela kuYehova, awudingi ukuba wenziwe nge-paste; awudingi ukudlidliza i-paste noma umnqumo njengomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Ungazinikeza umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, njengengxenye yokuqala yembewu yakho; kodwa ngeke ziqhume phezu kwesibingelelo, zibe ngumoya omnandi.
Uzobeka usawoti kuwo wonke umnikelo wakho wokudla; ngeke ushiye usawoti wesivumelwano soNkulunkulu wakho emlonyeni wakho wokudla; kuzo zonke izipho zakho uzofaka usawoti.
Uma unikeza umnikelo wokudla kuYehova, ovela engxenyeni yokuqala yokuvuna kwakho, udinga ukuletha amakhowe atshalwe emlilweni, namakhowe asetshenzisiwe.
Uzofaka phezu kwayo uphethiloli, uzobeka phezu kwayo insindiso; yisondlo sokudla.
Uzokhipha umnikelo wokudla, nomnikelo we-okhilimu, kanye nephunga elihlanzekile lonke; liyiminikelo yokuthosa eyenziwe ngomlilo kukaNkulunkulu.
Uma umuntu enikela ngenhlanhla yakhe, enyama yenkomo, indoda noma indodakazi, ngeke kube necala kulo, uma enikela ngalo kuYehova.
Uzobeka isandla sakhe phezu kwekhanda lenyama, futhi uzoyibulala emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana; unyana ka-Aron, ababingeleli, bazoyifafaza igazi phezu kwesibambo esiphezulu ngaso sonke isikhala.
Uzonikela ngaleyo minikelo yokuthula, ibe ngumnikelo oshiswayo kuYehova: isisindo esigqoka izitho zangasese, nesisindo sonke esingaphansi kwezitho zangasese;
kanye nemithambo yegazi emibini nenyama yayo engezansi kwesobunxele, nalapho isikhumba sayo esingenalutho siphuma khona kanye nemithambo.
Bazowushisa oonyana baka-Aron emgodini womlilo, phezu komnikelo wokushiswa obekwe emanzini; yisipho esiqhutshwa umlilo, siyiphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uma isondlo sakhe sokuthula esinikezwe iNkosi sisuka emihlambini, kube yindoda noma ibe yinkosikazi, ngeke kube necala kulo.
Uma eletha inkomo, kumele ayinikezele phambi koYehova.
Wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwekhanda lakhe, wabulala phambi komnyango wesitezi sokuhlangana; namadodana ka-Aron ageza igazi lalo phezu kwesibingelelo ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Uzonikela ngaleyo minikelo yokuthula, ibe ngumnikelo oshiswayo kuYehova: isisindo sayo, nemilenze yayo yonke emnyama, eqoshwe eduze kwethambo lomlenze, nesisindo esigqoka izitho zangasese, nesisindo sonke esingaphansi kwezitho zangaphakathi;
kanye nemithambo yegazi emibini nenyama yayo engezansi kwesobunxele, nalapho isikhumba sayo esingenalutho siphuma khona kanye nemithambo.
Umbingeleli uzowushisa phezu kwesibingelelo; wukudla, umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Uma umnikelo wakhe ube yibhokhwe, uzoyinikela phambi koYehova.
Uzobeka isandla sakhe phezu kwesiqu sayo, futhi uzoyibulala phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana; futhi izingane zika-Aron zizowudonsa umfutho wayo phezu kwesiqhingi ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ngayo uzoletha isonka sakhe esishiswa ngomlilo kuYehova: uphethiloli ogqoke izitho zangasese, nophethiloli onke abekwe ezitho zangaseseni;
kanye nemithambo yegazi emibini nenyama yayo engezansi kwesobunxele, nalapho isikhumba sayo esingenalutho siphuma khona kanye nemithambo.
Umbingeleli uzozishiswa ngazo phezu kwesibingelelo; yinyama, isonka esitholwe ngomlilo, sinomsoco othandekayo. Zonke izicubu zizobe ziyizinto zikaYehova.
Umthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo bonke abantu bakho ngemuva kwakho, kuwo wonke amadolobhana akho: Akufanele nidle noma yini encibilikayo, noma iyiphi igazi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi: Uma umuntu ephuca ngenxa yokungabaza, ekwenzeni noma yisiphi isinqumo sikaYehova esingakwenziwanga.
Uma umnikelo wokudla, umvikeli omkhulu webandla, enqume ukudlwengula abantu, yena uzoletha kuYehova inkomo encane engabi nephutha, ibe yisonka sesono ngenxa yesono sakhe.
Uzoyisa ingulube emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, phambi koYehova; uzobeka isandla sakhe phezu kwekhanda lengulube, futhi uzoyibulala phambi koNkosi.
Uzothatha umbingeleli okhethiwe igazi lengulube, aze alingenise efulethini lengqungquthela.
Uzobeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wegazi, aphuze ngaleyo gazi izikhathi ezisixhenxe phambi koYehova, ebusweni besitezi esingcwele.

Uzobeka ngaleyo gazi ezindlebeni zesibingelelo somlilo omnandi, esibekwe phambi koYehova esitezi sendlu yokuhlangana; futhi igazi elisele lengulube lizoqhutshwa ngaphansi kwesibingelelo somnqumo wokudlwengula, emgwaqweni wetende lokuhlangana.
Uzothatha isisindo sonke sengulube yomnikelo wokudla wesono, isisindo esigqoka izitho zangasese, nesisindo sonke esingaphansi kwezitho zangasese;
kanye nemithambo yegazi emibini, namafutha ayo abekwe phezu kwayo engxenyeni eseduze kwesobunxele lwekhanda, kanye nesikhumba esomile esibhekene nesisu; azozisusa lezi zinto namathambo.
njengoba zithathwa enyameni yesondlo sokuthula, khona-ke umbingeleli uzozisindisa phezu kwesibingelelo sesondlo sokushiswa.
Isikhumba sengulube, nenyama yayo yonke, nekhanda layo, namadolo ayo, nezitho zangaphakathi zayo, nokudla kwazo,

futhi imbewu yonke yengulube, kumele ayithathe ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi, ibe yindawo ehlanzekile lapho kuqhutshwa khona inkungu; kufanele ayisindise khona emlilweni wemithi, lapho kuqhutshwa khona inkungu.
Uma ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli liphelelwe yithemba, futhi bengazi ukuthi baphumile, bekwenzela iNkosi into engafanele kwenziwe, bazoba necala.
Uma bekwazi isono sabo, bazoletha inkomo encane ibe yisonka sesono, bese bayifaka phambi kwendlu yokuphumula.
Bazobeka abaholi bebandla izandla zabo phezu kwekhanda lengulube phambi koYehova, futhi bazobulala ingulube phambi koYehova.
Lo mpristi okhethiwe kufanele athathe igazi lengulube, aze alingenise efulethini lokuhlangana.
Uzobeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wegazi, aphuze ngaleyo gazi izikhathi ezisixhenxe phambi koYehova, ebusweni besitimela.

Uzobeka ingxenye yegazi layo ezindlebeni zesibingelelo esibekwe phambi koYehova, esitezi sokuhlangana; kodwa igazi elisele lizoqhutshwa ngaphansi kwesibingelelo sesonka esishiswayo, emnyango wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Uzothatha isisindo sayo sonke, uzosithutha phezu kwesibingelelo.
Uzokwenza nengulube yakhe, njengoba ekwenzele ingulube yesonka sesono sikambingeleli; khona-ke umbingeleli uzomisa abantu phambi koNkulunkulu, futhi bazoxoshwa.
Uzothwala ingulube ngaphandle komkhosi, ayenze ibe ngumlilo, njengoba ekwenzele ingulube yokuqala; yisondlo sesono sebandla lonke.
Uma umholi ephelelwe yithemba, ekwenzeni okuthile iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakhe awiselayo ukuthi akudingeki kwenziwe, uzobi.
Uma kukhulunywa ngaye ngodlavuza owenzayo, kufanele athathe inkomo encane engabi necala, ibe ngumnikelo wakhe.
Uzobeka isandla sakhe phezu kwekhanda lebhokhwe, futhi uzoyibulala phambi koYehova, endaweni lapho kudlalwa khona inhlanhla yokudlwengula; yisondlo sosono.
Uzothatha umbingeleli emlonyeni wakhe igazi lesibopho sesono, aze alifake ezindlebeni zesibingelelo sokudla okuthosiwe; futhi igazi elisele lizoqhutshwa phansi kwesibingelelo sokudla okuthosiwe.

Wonke umthwalo wayo uzowushisa phezu kwesibingelelo, njengokuthi umnikelo wokudla ube ngumthwalo wesonka esihlanzekile; ngaleyo ndlela umbingeleli uzolungisa isono sakhe phambi koYehova, naye uzotholwa.
Uma umuntu ephilayo enhliziyweni yakhe, engacabangi ukuthi uzinikele, ekwenzeni isinqumo soNkulunkulu esingafanele kwenziwe, uzobi.
Uma kukhulunywa ngaye ngodlavuza owenzayo, khona-ke kufanele aveze inkomo eyisifazane, engabi necala, njengomnikelo wakhe wodlavuza.
Uzobeka isandla sakhe phezu kwekhanda lenyama yesondlo sesono, futhi uzoyibulala endaweni yomnikelo wokudla.
Uzothatha umbingeleli igazi layo emlonyeni wakhe, alayishe phezu kwezinkomo zesibingelelo sokudla okuthosiwe; futhi konke okunye igazi lakhe lizophuzwa ngaphansi kwesibingelelo.

Uzoyisusa yonke i-fat yayo, njengoba kususwa i-fat yesondlo sokuthula; futhi umnikelo wesono uzowushisa phezu kwesibingelelo, njengephunga elimnandi kuYehova. Ngale ndlela umnikelo wesono uzomlungisa phambi koNkulunkulu wakhe, naye uzokhululwa.
Uma eletha inkomo njengomnikelo wakhe wokudla, kufanele ibe yindoda engabi necala.
Uzobeka isandla sakhe phezu kwekhanda lesonka sesono, futhi uzoyibulala ibe yisonka sosono endaweni lapho kudlalwa khona isintu esilahliwe.
Uzothatha umbingeleli emanzini omnikelo wesono ngesandla sakhe, awuthele ezindlebeni zesibingelelo sokudla okushiswayo; futhi igazi lakhe lonke uzolibazisa ngaphansi kwesibingelelo sokudla.

Wonke umthwalo wayo uzowususa, njengoba kususwa uphethiloli wengulube emcimbini wokuthula; khona-ke umbingeleli uzowushisa phezu kwesibopho esiphezulu sezinto ezitholwe ngomlilo kuYehova. Ubingelelo olunjalo luzokwenziwa ngumbhishobhi phambi koNdikhoyo ngenxa yesono sakhe ebesingenayo, futhi ngeke agwenywe.
Uma umuntu ebizwa esidlangalaleni ukuba aveze lokho owaziyo njengomshayeli, futhi wabona noma wayekwazi lutho kodwa akakhuluma, yena unephutha futhi kufanele athathe iphutha.

Uma umuntu ethinta noma yini engcolileyo, njengokudlwengula kwezilwane ezingcolileyo, noma isilwane esingcolileyo, noma isinyama esingcolileyo; noma ngabe akakwazi ukuqaphela, uzoba mnyama, ube necala.
noma uma ecindezela into engcolile yomuntu, noma iyiphi into ebangela ukuba umuntu abe nephunga elibi; noma ngabe akakwazi ukuyibona, lapho eyazi khona, uzobe esengenacala.
Okunye ukuthi umuntu angaba nesibopho sokwenza okuthile, okubi noma okuhle, uhlobo lwesibopho esibi abantu abasenzayo, futhi awazi. Uma ethola lokhu, uzoba nobubi kulolu daba.
Uma umuntu enecala nganoma iyiphi yalezi ndlela, kufanele avume isono sakhe.

Uzoletha umnikelo wakhe wokudla kuYehova, ngenxa yesono sakhe, inkomo encane noma ingulube encane evela ezindleleni, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; futhi umbingeleli uzomlungisa phambi koNkulunkulu ngenxa yesono sakhe.
Uma engeke akwazi ukunikeza inkomo, khona-ke azoletha kuYehova izimvu ezimbili, noma izinja ezincane ezimbili, ngenxa yesono sakhe esikwenzayo; enye ibe yisonka sesono, nenye ibe yisonka sokushiswa.
Uzozisa kubo kumbingeleli, futhi umbhishobhi uzonikela kuqala ngengulube yesondlo sesono; uzoba nemilenze ephindwe kabili, kodwa angeke athathe ikhanda.
Uzokhipha igazi lomnikelo wesono engxenyeni yesitezi esiphezulu, bese ugeza zonke izicubu zegazi ngezansi kwesitezi esiphezulu; yisondlo sesono.
Uzonikela nenyama yesithathu ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, ngokusho komthetho; khona-ke umbingeleli uzolungisa isono sakhe esikwenzelwe, aze akhululwe.

Uma engeke akwazi ukunikela ngezinkomo ezimbili, noma ngezingulube ezimbili ezincane, khona-ke azoletha isentimitha elilodwa neshumi nesishiyagalombili zesikhunta esiqinile, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla; ngeke afake phezu kwayo uphethiloli, futhi ngeke abeke phezu kwayo insindiso, ngoba yisondlo sokudla.

Uzoyiletha kumbingeleli, umbingeleli athathe isandla sakhe esigcwele sayo, ibe yindawo yokukhumbula, aze ayisindise phezu kwesibingelelo, ngaphezu kwezinhlamvu zomnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova; iyisondlo sesono.
Ngalokho umnikelo wokudla uzowulungisa phambi koNkulunkulu, ngenxa yanoma iyiphi yezinto azenzayo, ukuze akhululwe; futhi konke okushisayo kuzoba ngumnikelo wokudla, ozoba wumnikelo wesono.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uma umuntu ephelelwe yithemba, ephelelwe yithemba ngezinto ezingcwele zikaYehova, khona-ke kufanele aveze umnikelo wesono kukaNkulunkulu, umkhwenyana owodwa ongenacala osuka emihlambini; ukubalwa kwakhe kuzokwenziwa ngemali yegolide, ngokulinganiselwa kwendawo engcwele.

Uzophinde abuyisele isono sakhe ezintoni ezingcwele, futhi ahlanganise nengxenye yakhe yesihlanu, aze ayinikeze umbingeleli; futhi umbingeleli uzokwenza umonakalo wakhe phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngomuntu omncane womnikelo wesono, naye uzovuthwa.
Uma umuntu ephuca, ekwenzeni iyiphi imithetho kaYehova engafanele yenziwe, nakuba akayazi, uzoba necala; uzoyithwala inkohliso yakhe.

Uzoletha emndenini wakhe ingulube eyodwa engabi necala, ngokuya ngesilinganiso sakho, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla; futhi umbingeleli uzomlungisa phambi koNkulunkulu ngenxa yephutha lakhe, elalikwenza ngaphandle kokukwazi kwakhe, aze akhululwe.
Kuyisondlo sesono; yena ubenesono phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uma umuntu ephelelwe wububi, futhi ekhohlisa iNkosi, ngokudlwengula umngane wakhe; noma uma ekhohlisa ngento egcinwe engqondweni yakhe, noma ngebhizinisi lakhe, noma uma ephuza emzaneni wakhe, noma uma ekwenza ngokweqile kuye,
noma angathola into elahlekile futhi akhulume ngokungeqiniso ngayo, aphelelwe yithemba elikhohlisayo. Lezi zinto ziyingxenye yendlela abantu abayenza ngayo isono.
Uma ephuzile ngalolu hlobo, futhi eshonile, kufanele abuyisele lokho okudlwengulayo, noma okunye okudlwengulayo, noma okugcinwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwakhe, noma okulahlekile, noma okufunwayo;

noma nganoma iyiphi into akhuluma ngayo ngethemba, kufanele ayibuyisele ngokugcwele, engeza nengxenye yesishiyagalombili, futhi kumele ayinikeze umnikazi wayo ngosuku lapho ethola khona ukuthi unecala
Uzoletha umnikelo wakhe wokuhlukunyezwa kuYehova, umkhwenyana owodwa wengulube, ongenaphutha, ngokwesilinganiso sakho, kumpristi.
Wathi umbingeleli: "Uzokwenza umnikelo wesono kukaNkulunkulu phambi koYehova, futhi uzoxoshwa nganoma yini ayenze eyenza abe necala.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

UMoses wathi ku-Aron nonyana bakhe: "Le yimithetho ephathelene nesonka esiqhutshwayo: isonka esiqhutshwayo kufanele sihlale ekuseni nakusihlwa esandleni sezinkomo, futhi umlilo wesinkomo kumele ugcinwe.

Uzogqoka umbingeleli ihembe lakhe lelinen, nezicathulo zakhe zelinen ebusweni bakhe; futhi uzothatha inkungu yesondlo esiqhumayo, omlilo obewushibile phezu kwesibingelelo, aze azibeke ngaphesheya kwesibingelelo.
Uzozisusa izicathulo zakhe, agqoke ezinye izicathulo, athathe inkungu yaso, ayise endaweni ehlanzekile ngaphandle komkhosi.

Umlilo obekwe phezu kwesibopho kufanele ugcinwe uphila, awudingi ukuvalwa. Umpristi kumele afake imithi ngaso sonke isikhathi ekuseni, futhi alungise khona isiphuzo esiqhumayo, futhi asindise phezu kwayo ama-grains wezinto ezingcwele zokuthula.
Umlilo kufanele uqhume emgodini ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ngakho-ke akufanele uphuze
Le yimithetho yomnikelo wokudla: izingane zika-Aron zizoyinikela kuYehova phambi kwesibingelelo.

Uzothatha umbingeleli isandla sakhe esigcwele isikhunta, nophethiloli somnikelo wokudla, kanye nefuthe lonke elingenayo; uzowushisa phezu kwesibingelelo, njengento yokukhumbula, ibe ngumoya omnandi kuYehova.
U-Aron nezingane zakhe bazoyidla ithonya layo; kufanele lidlalwe ngaphandle kokudla okunomsoco, endaweni engcwele, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Akudingeki ukuthi kuphekwe nge-lemongrass; ngibanikela ngayo, njengengxenye yabo, emidlalweni yami eyenziwe ngomlilo; iyinto engcwele kakhulu, njengomnikelo wesono, nomnikelo wokudla.

Wonke umuntu owesifazane emndenini ka-Aron angayidla; le yindlela yabo yokuphila kuze kube sekupheleni, kubo bonke abazalwane babo, kusukela emikhondweni yomlilo kaYehova. Yonke into enqunyelwe ngazo izongcwele.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Le yiminikelo ka-Aron nendodana yakhe azoyinikela kuYehova, ngosuku lapho ekhonjisiwe khona wonke umbingeleli omkhulu: inkomishi elilodwa nesigamu sekhilogremu yobisi olunomsoco, njengomnikelo wokudla oqhubekayo; inhlamvu ngayinye ekuseni, nengxenye ngayinye kusasa.
Uzoyilungiselela nge-oyile emgodini, uyihlanganise kahle ne-oyela, uyenze ibe ngumnikelo wokudla ohlukaniswe ngezingxenye, njengephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Owesifazane, umndeni ka-Aron, obizwa ngegama lakhe, uzonikela ngalo. Lo ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside; kumele kuqhume ngokuphelele phambi koYehova.
Yonke iminikelo yokudla kambingeleli izothunyelwa emlilo, ingadlalwanga.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthe uMosis ku-Aron nonyana bakhe, sithi, Lokho wumthetho womnikelo wesono: lapho kubulawa khona isonka esishiswayo, khona-ke kumele kuqhunywe isenzo sesono phambi koYehova; lingcwele kakhulu.
Umpristi onikela ngayo ngesono, yena ozoyidla; kumele idliwa endaweni engcwele, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Nanoma yini ethinta inyama yayo, izobe ingcwele; noma ngabe isuka emlonyeni wayo insangu, uzoyihlamba endaweni engcwele.
I-pot yengilazi lapho kuthosiwe khona kufanele ihlukaniswe. Uma kuthosiwe kwi-pot yegolide, i-pot kumele ihlanzwe futhi ihlanzwe ngamanzi.
Wonke umuntu owesifazane phakathi kwabaphambukeli angayidla; iyingcwele kakhulu.
Uma kwenzeka ukuthi igazi lesonka sokuhlukunyezwa lithunyelwe entabeni yokuhlangana, ukuze kwenziwe ukuxoshwa ezindaweni ezingcwele, akufanele lidlalwe; kufanele liqhume emlilweni.
Lokho wumthetho womnikelo wesono, ungcwele kakhulu.
Kulapho kubulawa khona isonka sokuhlukunyezwa, khona-ke kumele kuqhunywe isiphuzo sesono esingenacala, futhi ugazi lwakhe kufanele lugoqwe phezu kwesibingelelo ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Wonke umthwalo wayo kufanele unikezelwe: ikhanda lomthwalo, nomthwalo ogqoka isisu,
ama-kidneys amabili ane-fat on them near the lower back, ne-fat covering of the liver, removed with the kidneys.
Umbingeleli uzozibulala zonke lezi zinto emgodini womlilo, ibe yisondlo esidlalwa ngomlilo kuYehova; iyisondlo sokuhlukana.
Wonke umuntu owesifazane phakathi kwabapristi angayidla; kufanele idlalwe endaweni engcwele; iyingcwele kakhulu.
Umnikelo wesono ufana nomnikelo wesono, mthetho owodwa ukhona kuwo onke. Yiwo umbhishobhi owenza isiqiniseko ngaye phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Umbingeleli onikela ngesondlo esiqhutshwayo somuntu, angagcina isikhumba saleyo nyama kuye.
Yonke inkomishi yokudla okuthosiwe, ephekwe emgodini, noma ephekwe ebhodweni, noma esiqandisini, izobe yiyo yena umbingeleli onikela ngayo.
Nawo wonke umnikelo wokudla, okhishwe ngephethiloli noma ongenamafutha, uzobe wuwabo bonke oonyana baka-Aron, ngokulinganayo.
Le yimithetho yomnikelo wokuthula, lapho umuntu eletha khona umnikelo wakhe kuYehova.
Uma ekulethela ukubonga, kufanele alungiselele ngazo izinkomishi ezincane ezihlanganisiwe ne-oyile, nezinkomishi ezinkulu ezihlanganisiwe ne-oyela, neziphuzo ezihlanganiswe ne-oyile.
Uma enikela ngokubonga kwakhe, kufanele athathe futhi izinkomishi zokudla okuhlanganisiwe.
Uzonikela ngayinye, ibe yisibopho esikhethekile kuYehova; izobe iyisibopho sikambingeleli ophikisayo igazi lesondlo sokuthula.
Inyama yesonka sokuzibophezela kufanele idlalwe mhla owawunikela ngawo; ngeke kube khona okushiwo kuze kube ubusuku.
Uma umnikelo wakhe wesono, noma umsondezo osuka enhliziyweni yakhe, ungadla ngalo usuku anikela ngawo; kodwa uma kusele okuthile, kungadla ngalo usuku olulandelayo.
Uma kunenyama engashiwo mhla wesithathu, kufanele iqhunywe emlilweni.

Uma umuntu edla inyama yesonka sokuthula mhla wesithathu, umnikelo wakhe wokudla ngeke uvunyelwe, futhi lowo onikela ngawo ngeke akhokhwe; kuzoba yinyama engcolileyo, nalowo ophila ngayo uzothwala inkohliso.
Inyama ehlobene nanoma iyiphi into engcolileyo, akufanele idlalwe; kufanele iqhume emlilweni. Kodwa-ke, noma yimuphi umuntu ohlanzekile angayidla.
Uma umuntu edla inyama yesondlo sokuthula, esibekiwe iNkosi, engekho emthethweni wakhe, lowo muntu kumele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.

Uma umuntu ecindezela noma yini engcolileyo, nokuba yinto engcolileyo yomuntu, noma inyama engcolileyo, noma iyiphi into engcolileyo engahlanzekile, futhi edla inyama yesondlo sokuthula esiyiso iNkosi, lowo muntu uzosuswa emiphakathini yakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu baka-Israyeli, usithi: Akufanele nidle noma iyiphi imifino, noma ingulube, noma inkomo.
I-fat yesilwane esifile ngokwaso, noma eshaywe izilwane ezifuywayo, ingasetshenziswa kwezinye izinto, kodwa awukwazi ukuyidla.
Wonke umuntu odla ubisi lwesilwane, esinikezwayo njengomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, lowo muntu uzosuswa emiphakathini yakhe.
Ungadlanga lutho lwegazi, noma izinyoni, noma izilwane, lapho nihlala khona.
Wonke umuntu odla igazi kumele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi: Wonke umuntu onikela ngeminikelo yokuthula kuYehova, kufanele athathe ingxenye yayo, ibe yisipho esiphakeme sikaYehova.
Uzozisa ngezandla zakhe izipho ezifakiwe ngomlilo kuYehova; uzoba nenyama kanye nebele, futhi uzoyisa ibele phambi kweNkosi, ibe yisondlo esiqhutshwa ngomsindo.
Umnikelo wokudla uzowushisa uphethiloli phezu kwesibingelelo, kodwa isisu sizoba ngu-Aron nabantwana bakhe.
Nceda ninikeze umlenze wesobunxele lwezipho zakho zokuthula kumpristi njengesipho esikhethekile.
Unyana ka-Aron onikela ngegazi, nenyama yesonka sokuthula, uzothola imilenze engezansi njengengxenye yakhe.

Ngokuba ngithathe isifuba sokunqunyelwe, nonyawo lokunqunyelwe, ezimininingwane zokuthula zabantwana bakaSirayeli, ngazinika uAron ukumkani, nabenzana bakhe; ibe yingxenye yabo ehlala isikhathi eside phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Le yingxenye ka-Aron, nengxenye yabantwana bakhe, evela ezimpahla eziboshwe ngomlilo zikaYehova, kusukela ngosuku lapho bafike khona ukuba babe ngabaphakeli kuYehova.
Ngosuku lapho bakhishwe khona, iNkosi wabawisela umthetho oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuthi bayinikeze le nto; ibe ngumnikelo wabo wokudla ohlala isikhathi eside, emindenini yabo.
Le yimithetho yomnikelo wokushiswa, nomnikelo wesonka, nomnikelo wokudla, nomnikelo wesono, nesibopho sesono, nesibopho sokuba ngumbhishobhi, nesibopho sokuthula.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, emfuleni iSinayi, ngalolusuku lapho awiselayo izingane zakwaSirayeli ukuba zinikeze izipho zabo iNkosi esiqhingini iSinayi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Thola uAron nabantwana bakhe, nezigqoko zobuLevi, nophethiloli bokuncibilikisa, nengulube yomnikelo wokudla wesono, namabele amabini, nebhokisi lenyama engaphekiwe.
Uzoqoqa ibandla lonke emgwaqweni wendawo yokuphumula, ungene kuyo.
Wakwenza ke uMoses, njengokuthi iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo; ibandla lahlangana emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Wathi kubo uMoses, Lokho wukuthi umthethosivivinywa kaYehova, ukuthi sikwenze.
UMoses waletha uHaarnau nabantwana bakhe, wabahlamba ngamanzi.
Wathi ku-Aron: "Uzogqoka isibhakabhaka, ubambe umlenze wakhe; uzogqoka ihembe lakhe; uzogqoka i-ephod yakhe; uzogqoka intambo eqinile ye-ephod yakhe, ukuze ihlale endaweni yayo.
Wabeka phezu kwakhe isifuba, wabeka i-Urim ne-Thummim esifuba.
Wabeka i-tiara phezu kwekhanda lakhe, wabeka engxenyeni yangaphambili ye-tiara iphakethe legolide, isibhakabhaka esingcwele; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
UMoses wathatha uphethiloli wokubhaka, wabhaka itente, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuyo, ukuze azingcwele.
Wageza isandla sakhe nge-oyile phezu kwesibingelelo izikhathi ezisixhenxe, wamisa isibingelelo nezinto zayo zonke, nombhede wokugeza nesisekelo saso, ukuze azinikele.
Wageza ikhanda lika-Aron ngamafutha okubhaka, wambhaka, ukuze abe ngungcwele.
UMoses wazisa oonyana baka-Aron, wabagqokisa izikibha, wabaveza amagobolondo, wababeka izigxobo ezandleni zabo; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Waletha ingulube yomnikelo wesono, uAron nonyana bakhe babeka izinyawo zabo phezu kwesiqu sayo.

UMoses wanyamalala, wathatha igazi layo, walimaza ngaso zonke izingulube zesibingelelo ngesandla sakhe, ukuze ahlanze isibingelelo; futhi konke okunye kwegazi walifutha ngezansi kwesibingelelo. Ngale ndlela uMosis wamisa isibingelelo esingcwele phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Wathatha isisindo sonke esibhekene nezitho zangaphakathi, kanye ne-lobe yenhliziyo, namabele amabili, nesisindo sazo; uMoses wasisindisa phezu kwesibambo.
Kodwa ingulube, nesikhumba sayo, nenyama yayo, nenhlanzi yayo, Uzomushisa ngomlilo ngaphandle kwesiqhingi; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Waletha unyana omncane womnikelo wokushiswa; no-Aron nabantwana bakhe babeka izandla zabo phezu kwesiqu sakhe.
UMoses wayibulala, wageza igazi layo ngaso sonke isibingelelo.
Wamisa umnqumo waba yiziqephu, uMoses wehlisa ikhanda, neziqephu, nenyama.

Wahlamba amanzi izitho zangaphakathi nezinyawo, wamisa uMoses ingulube yonke phezu kwesibingelelo; kwakuyisondlo esishiswayo sephunga elimnandi, insizakalo eyenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
UMoses waletha nenyama yenkomo yesibili, inyama yenkomo yokulungiselela; uAron nabantwana bakhe babeka izinyawo zabo phezu kwekhanda layo.
Wayibulala, wathatha uMoses igazi layo, wamfaka engxenyeni yendlebe ka-Aron esekhohlo, nasengxenyeni encane yesandla sakhe sokudla, nasengxenyeni encane yentamo yakhe esandleni sakhe sokudla.

UMoses wazisa oonyana baka-Aron, wabeka igazi elilodwa engxenyeni esekunene yendlebe yabo, nakwesobunxele lwesandla sabo sokudla, nakwesobunxele lwenyawo lwabo lokudla; uMoses wehlisa igazi phezu kwesibingelelo ngazo zonke izingcezu.
Wathatha ubisi, nengulube elibomvu, nobisi lwazo zonke izingxenye zangaphakathi, nokugqugquzela okubomvu kwenhliziyo, nezinso ezimbili nezinkomo zabo ezibomvu, kanye nomlenze osekudla.

Wathatha emgodini wenkukhu engaphazamiswanga, esengaphambilini kukaYehova, inkomishi elilodwa elibomvu, inkomishi elilodwa elincibilikisiwe ngophethiloli, nebhodlela elilodwa elibandayo, wabeka phezu kwezinhlanzi, naphezu kwesokudla.
Wazibeka zonke lezi zinto ezandleni zika-Aron, nasezandleni zabantwana bakhe; wazigqugquzela ngazo phambi koYehova njengento esigqugquzelwe.

Wazithatha ke uMoses ezinyaweni zabo, waza wazibonela emgodini ongcwele phezu komnikelo wokushiswa; kwakuyisondlo sokuzinikela kwabo njengombhishobhi, iphunga elimnandi, insipho eyenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova.
Wathi uMoses, athathe isifuba, wamisa phambi kukaNkulunkulu; yabe yingxenye kaMosis yomnikelo wokudla wenyama yenkomo, ukuze abe ngumpristi, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.

Wathatha uMoses i-oyile yokuncibilikisa, negazi elali phezu kwesibingelelo, walihlisa ku-Aron, nezigqoko zakhe, namadodana akhe, nezigqoko zamadodana akhe naye; wabangcwele u-Aron nezigqoko zakhe, namadodana akhe, nezigqoko zamadodana akhe naye.

Wathi uMoses ku-Aron namadodana akhe, Ubisisele inyama emgwaqweni wendlu yokuhlangana, niyidle khona, kanye nokudla okusemqoka ebhokisini lemisebenzi kambingeleli; njengokuba ngiwisela umthetho ngathi, U-Aron namadodana akhe bazoyidla.
Nciphisa konke okushiwo ngenyama nengulube.

Kusukela emgwaqweni wesitezi sokuhlangana ngeke niphume usuku oluyisithupha, kuze kube sekuphele izinsuku zokufaka izintambo zendlu yokwahlulela kwenu; usuku oluyisishiyagalombili luzobekwa khona izimpahla zenu.
Okwenzekile namuhla wukuthi, iNkosi wamwisela umthetho, ukuthi nibekezele kuThixo.
Bahlale emgwaqweni wesitezi sokuhlangana ekuseni nakusihlwa izinsuku ezisixhenxe, bagcine umyalo kaYehova, ukuze ningafa; ngoba lokhu kuvunyelwe ngami.
Wakwenza uAron nabantwana bakhe konke iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngalo ngoMoses.
Kwathi ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, uMoses wabiza uAron nezingane zakhe, nabakhulu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Thola ingulube encane yomnqumo wesono, nenyama yenkomo yomnikelo wokushiswa, zingenawo umonakalo, uzilungiselele kuYehova.
Uzokhuluma ngamadodana aseSirayeli, usithi, Nithathe inkomo yomnqumo, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; nengulube, nengane yenkomo, ezineminyaka emibili ubudala, ezingabi nankinga, zibe yisonka esishiswayo.
futhi uthathe inkomo kanye nomuntu wesifazane, zibe yizipho zokuthula, ukuze uzinikeze kuYehova, nesibopho sokudla esihlanganisiwe nephethiloli; ngoba namhlanje iNkosi uzobonakala kuwe.
Bathi ke, bathathe izinto awisenzile uMoses phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana; ibandla lonke lafika, lahlala phambi kukaYehova.
Wathi uMoses, Lokho wukuthi umthethosivivinywa kaYehova ukuthi nikwenze; futhi izulu likaYehova lizobonakala kuwe.

Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Yifike esibhedlela, wenze isiphuzo sakho sesono, nesibopho sakho somlilo, ukuze wenze ukuxoshwa kuwe, nawe abantu; futhi wenze isiphuzo sabantu, ukuze wenze ukuxoshwa kubo, njengoba iNkosi ewiselayo.
Wafika uAron esibhedlela, wabulala ingulube, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla wesono.

Wathi uYakobi: "Njengoba ubaba wakho efuna ukukwenza kube ngumnikelo wesono, kufanele athathe igazi lalowo osonkontileka, futhi alifake ezindlebeni zesibingelelo, bese ekhipha igazi elisha eduze kwesibingelelo.
Washiswa phezu kwesibingelelo isisindo sayo, nezinkomo zayo, nophethiloli lwesisu sesondlo sosono, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wakhipha inyama nesikhumba emgodini ongaphandle kwekamva.
Wabulala khona isonka esishiswayo, futhi unyana wakhe wamnika igazi; walibambisa phezu kwesibingelelo ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Bathi kuye isonka esiqhumayo, ingxenye ngengxenye, kanye nekhanda; wazisindisa phezu kwesibingelelo.
Wahlamba izitho zangaphakathi nezinyawo, waza wazishisa phezu komnikelo wokudla oshiswayo emgodini.
Waletha futhi isipho sabantu, wathatha inkomo yomnikelo wokudla wesono sabantu, wayibulala, wayinikela ngesondlo sosono, njengokuthi wenza neyesibili.
Wathatha isonka esiqhumayo, wanikela ngalo ngendlela ebekuvunyelwe ngayo.
Wafaka futhi isiphuzo sokudla, wathatha isandla sakhe esigcwele saso, waza wumlilo phezu kwesibingelelo, kanye nesibopho sokusihlwa.
Wabulala nengulube kanye nomuntu, njengento yokusindisa abantu; uMoses namadodana akhe bamnika igazi, walibambisa phezu kwesibingelelo ngazo zonke izingcezu.
Bathi ke kubo: "Inyama yengulube, nenyama yomuntu, kanye nophethiloli wayo, kanye nophethiloli ogqoke izitho zangaphakathi, namabele ayo, kanye nophethiloli ogqoke isisu.
Babeka ushukela phezu kwezindoda, wawusindisa ushukela emgodini wokudla.
U-Aron wehla imilenze, nonyawo lwesokudla, ebusweni beNkosi, njengomnikelo oshiswayo; njengoba uMoses ewiselayo.
U-Aron waphakamisa izandla zakhe ebantwini, wabambisana nabo; wehla ngemuva kokunikela ngenhlanhla yesono, nenhlanhla yokudlwengula, nenhlanhla yokuthula.
UMoses no-Aron bafika esihlalweni sokuhlangana; bese bephuma, babambisa abantu; khona-ke ubuhle bukaYehova buvela kubo bonke abantu.
Kwaphuma umlilo ebusweni bukaYehova, wabulala isonka esiqhumayo kanye nenyama emgodini; abantu bonke bakubona lokhu, baphoqa izingcweti zabo, babhujiswa ngobuso babo phansi.
UNadabhi no-Abhihu, oonyana baka-Aron, bathatha wonke umuntu inkomishi yakhe yomlilo, babeka umlilo kuyo, bafaka phezu kwayo umnqumo; banikela kuYehova ngomlilo ongavunyelwanga, owawungabawiselayo.
Kwaphuma khona umlilo esuka kuYehova, wababulala bonke; bafa phambi koYehova.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Lokho wukuthi okushoyo iNkosi, ethi, Ngizobe ngingcwele kubo abasenyakatho yami, futhi ngizoba mkhulu phambi kwalabo bonke abantu. Wathi u-Aron akazange aphendule;
UMoses wabiza uMishayeli noElzaphane, oonyana bakaUziyele, umyeni ka-Aron, wathi kubo, Yeni, nizithathe izihlobo zenu zisuka phambi kwendawo engcwele, ziphuma emgwaqeni.
Bafika ke, babathwala phandle kwekhabhinethi, ngemigqomo yabo, njengokuthi uMoses.

Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, noElazare na-Ithamari, oonyana bakhe: Mhlawumbe izinwele zenu ngeke zivuleke, futhi izigqoko zenu ngeke zisuswe, ukuze nifile; kodwa abazalwane benu bonke amadodana aseSirayeli azolile ngenxa yomlilo owenzayo uNkulunkulu.
Uma niphuma emgwaqeni wesitezi sokubambisana, ngeke nife; ngoba uphethiloli wokuncibilikisa kaYehova ukhona phezu kwenu. Bakwenza ngokomthetho kaMoses.
Wathi iNkosi ku-Aron,
Uma ningena esihlalweni sokuhlangana, ningadla utshwala noma isiphuzo esisha, wena nabantwana bakho, ukuze ningafa; kube ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside phakathi komndeni wenu wonke.
Uzokwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwento engcwele nento ejwayelekile, futhi phakathi kwento engalungile nento ehlanzekile.
futhi nifundise oonyana bakaSirayeli yonke imibandela iNkosi abewisela yona ngoMosesi.

Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, no-Elazare na-Ithamari, oonyana bakhe abaseleyo, Nithathe isiphuzo sokudla esishisayo, esisetshenzisiwe emikhondweni yomlilo kaYehova, niyidle ngaphandle kweleyisi eduze kwesibingelelo; ngoba iyingcwele kakhulu.
Uzoyidla endaweni engcwele; ngoba yisibopho sakho, nesibopho sabantwana bakho, phakathi kwezibopho zomnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova; njengoba ngiyezwa.

Kodwa ikhanda eliqhutshwayo, nemilenze ephakanyisweyo, ungayidla wena, nabangane bakho, namantombazane akho, kuwo wonke indawo ehlanzekile; zinikezelwe kuwe, nawe izingane zakho, njengengxenye yenu, ezingxenyeni zokuthula zabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Ikhanda eliphakanyisiwe, nebele elihlanganisiwe, kufanele lithunyelwe kanye noshukela njengezipho eziqhutshwa umlilo; kumele lishiywe phambi koYehova njengomnikelo oshiswayo. Ziye zibe zakho wena nabantwana bakho, ibe yinkontileka yenu kuze kube sekupheleni, njengoba umthethosivivinywa nguNkosi.
UMoses wabheka ngokucophelela inkomo yesonka sesono, yabona ukuthi iqhume. Waxosha uElazarhu noIthamari, oonyana baka-Aron abasele, wathi,

Kungani na ukuthi ningadla isonka sesono ezindaweni ezingcwele? Kuyinto engcwele kakhulu, futhi uNkulunkulu uyinikeze wena, ukuze uthathe ububi bebandla, ukuze ubalungise kukaNkulunkulu phambi koYehova.
Uma igazi layo alithunyelwe ngaphakathi kwendawo engcwele, kufanele ukuthi ulidle emgodini ongcwele, njengoba ngiwisele umthetho.

Wathi uAron kuMoses, Thola, namuhla banikela ngenhlanhla yabo yokusindisa, nenhlanhla yabo yokudlwengula phambi koYehova; futhi lokhu okubi kwangithinta; uma ngidla inhlanhla yokusindisa namuhla, ngabe iNkosi ungithande?
UMoses, lapho ezwa lokhu, wavuthwa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi: Kuzo zonke izilwane eziphilayo ezweni, lezi nizozidla.
Ungadla noma yiluphi uhlobo lwenyama elinonyawo oluhlukaniswe ngamaqembu amabili futhi liphuze i-cud
Kodwa kukhona ezinye izilwane ezidla inyama, noma ezinamazinyo aphindwe kabili kuphela, ngakho-ke ngeke nizidle. Ingulube idla inyama, kodwa ayinamazinyo aphindwe kabili, ngakho-ke ayibi kuwe.
I-rock badger igaya i-cud kodwa ayinaso isisu esihlukanisiwe, ngakho akulungile kuwe.
Ingulube igaya i-cud kodwa ayinaso isisu esihlukanisiwe, ngakho ayihlanzekile kuwe.
Ingulube inekhanda elihlukanisiwe, lihlukaniswe ngamaphiko amabili, kodwa ayidlanga inyama; ngakho iyinto engalungile kuwe.
Musani ukudla inyama yazo, noma ukungena emthini wazo; ziyinyama engcolile kwenu.
Kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo emanzini, emabhishi nasezilwandle, nizodla konke okunezinkinobho nezingcindezi.

Naphezu kwalokho, yonke into elwandle, noma emfuleni, okuyinto ayikho imilenze kanye nezingqimba, noma izilwane ezincane amanzi, noma nanoma iyiphi enye into ephilayo emanzini, kufanele kube ubuhlungu kuwe.
Kudingeka ucabange ngazo njengezinhlekelele. Ungadli inyama yazo, futhi cabanga ngenyama yabo efile njengezinhlekelele.
Nanoma yini emanzini engekho ama-fins nama-scales iyinto ebuhlungu kuwe.
Lezi yizo izinhlanzi okufanele nizithathe njengezinhlekelele. Ungazidla, ngoba zinhlekelele: i-eagle, ne-vulture, ne-black vulture;
i-kite ebomvu, nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-kite emnyama,
noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-raven
i-horned owl, i-screech owl, i-seagull, nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwehawk,
i-owl encane, i-cormorant, i-owl enkulu,
i-white owl, i-desert owl, i-osprey,
i-stork, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-heron, i-hoopee, ne-bat.
Zonke izinhlanzi ezindizayo ezihamba ngezinyawo ezine zibuhlungu kuwe.
Kodwa-ke ungadla ezinye izilwane ezinamaphiko ezihamba ngemilenze emine: labo abanemilenze exhunywe ngaphesheya kwemilenze yabo ukugibela phansi.
Ngalezi ungadla noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-locust, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-katydid, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-cricket, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-grasshopper.
Zonke ezinye izinhlanzi ezinamaphiko ezinezinyawo ezinhlanu zibuhlungu kuwe.
Ngalezo zinto nizoba namakhemikhali; wonke umuntu othinta izitho zabo ezifileyo, uzoba namakhemikhali kuze kube sebusuku.
Wonke umuntu othwala impahla yabo efile, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, abe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Zonke izilwane eziphilayo ezinezinyawo ezimbili, kodwa ezingahlukanisi, noma ezingadla ngokudla okuthosiwe, zizoba zimbi kuwe; wonke umuntu ozozicindezela kuzo, uzobi.
Kuzo zonke izilwane ezihamba ngezinyawo ezine, konke okuhamba ngezinyawo zenu kuzoba namafutha; wonke umuntu onquma ukugoqa isidumbu sabo, uzoba namanzi kuze kube semini.
Wonke umuntu ozothwala isidumbu sabo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, futhi abe namakanca kuze kube sebusuku; zizoba yizinyamazane kuwe.
Kuzo zonke izinhlanzi ezihamba phezu komhlaba, lezi ziyizinto ezingalungile kuwe: inkomo, nengulube, nanoma iyiphi ingulube enkulu,
i-gekko, i-monitor lizard, i-wall lizard, i-skink, kanye ne-chameleon.
Kuzo zonke izinto ezihamba phezu komhlaba, lezi zinto zizoba namanzi kuni; wonke umuntu ozozicindezela uma zifile, uzobe namanzi kuze kube semini.

Uma esinye sazo sifa, futhi siwela ngaso sonke isitho, singabi namanzi; noma yisiphi isitho esiyenziwe ngomnqumo, noma ngendwangu, noma ngesikhumba, noma ngesithuthuthu, noma yini esetshenziswa ngayo, kufanele sifakwe emanzini, sihlale singenawo amanzi kuze kube ekuseni, bese sihlanzwa.
Uma esinye sazo siwela emgodini wokhuni, konke okungaphakathi komgodini kuzoba mnyama, futhi kufanele uvule umgodi.
Noma yisiphi isidlo esidlakayo, uma kungena amanzi kulolu hlobo lwesitsha, sizoba singcolile. Nanoma yiluphi utshwala oluvela kulolu hlobo lwesithako, luzoba singcolile.

Nanoma yini ehla phezu kwayo ithonya labo elifileyo, lizoba lingcolile. Uma liyi-oveni noma i-stovetop, kumele lihlukaniswe libe yizingxenye. Zingcolile, futhi kufanele uzithathe njengezinto ezingcolile.
Uma kukhona umfula, noma ifulethi eligcwele amanzi, lizohlala lihlanzekile; kodwa umuntu onquma impahla yakhe efile kuyo, uzobe unqunywa.
Uma ingxenye yomdlavuza iwela ezitshalweni ezizotshala, izitsha zizohlala zihlanzekile.
Kodwa uma amanzi efakwe phezu kwembewu, bese kwenzeka ukuthi kukhona okuthile emfileni wayo kuwela phezu kwayo, izobe ingcolile kuwe.
Uma isilwane esinaso, esidlalwa ngaso, sifile, lowo ozoyigoqa insangu yayo, uzongenawo uthuli kuze kube sebusuku.

Wonke umuntu odla inyama yalo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, abe namafutha kuze kube sebusuku; futhi wonke umuntu othwala inyama yalo, kumele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, abe namanzi kuze kube sebusuku.
Wonke umuntu omncane ohamba phezu komhlaba ubuhlungu. Ungawudli.
Ungadla noma iyiphi inyamakazi ehamba ngaphaya komhlaba, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ihamba ngebele layo, noma ihamba ngezinyawo ezine, noma inezandla eziningi.
Mhlawumbe ngeke nizinikele, noma ningabi namanzi nganoma yini yalezi zinyama ezihamba ngezinyawo, ukuze zingaba yingozi kuwe.
NginguYehova uNkulunkulu wenu; ziningcwele, nibe bangcwele, ngoba ngingcwele; futhi ningabi nenyama emnyama nganoma yisiphi isilwane esihamba phansi.
Ngiye iNkosi, owazikhipha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngibe uNkulunkulu wenu; ngakho nihlale ningcwele, ngoba ngingcwele.
Le yimfundiso mayelana nezilwane, izinhlanzi, zonke izinto eziphilayo ezihamba emanzini, nazo zonke izinto ezihamba phezu komhlaba.
Lokhu kusiza ukuba wazi ukuthi yini engcolile nokuthi yini ehlanzekile, futhi phakathi kwezilwane ezidla ukudla nalezi ezingadla ukudla."
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 24"Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli: Uma indodakazi ikhulelwa futhi izala umntwana owesifazane, izobe ingabi namanzi izinyanga ezisixhenxe.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, umfana kufanele atholwe.

Uzohlala usuku olunezinsuku ezingu-33, ukuze ahlanzeke ngenxa yegazi lakhe eliphumayo. Akudingeki ukuthi enze noma yini engcwele, akudingeki ukuba afike endaweni engcwele, kuze kuphele izinsuku zokunakekelwa kwakhe.
Uma ezala indodakazi, khona-ke kumele abe nezinsuku ezingu-60 nosuku oluyisishiyagalombili lokuhlanzeka kwakhe; futhi uma ekhulelwa kufanele alinde isonto elilodwa.

Uma izinsuku zokuhlanzwa kwakhe ziphele, ngendodakazi noma ngenkosikazi, uzoletha emnyango wesitezi sokuhlangana umngane wakhe oneminyaka eyodwa ubudala, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, nowesifazane omncane, noma inkomo, ibe yisondlo sesono.
Ubaba-ke uzozinikela kubo kuYehova, akwenze umnikelo wesono kuye; futhi uzohlanzwa ngenxa yokuphuma kwegazi lakhe. Lo ngumthetho wowesifazane ozala indodana noma indodakazi.

Uma engakwazi ukukhokhela ingulube, khona-ke athathe izinkomo ezimbili, noma izimvu ezincane ezimbili, enye ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, nenye ibe ngumnikelo wokudla; futhi umbingeleli uzomlungisa phambi koNkulunkulu wakhe, aze abe mhlophe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Uma umuntu enesilonda, noma inkungu, noma indawo ekhanyayo esikhumbani sakhe, ibe yisifo esibi kakhulu sesikhumba, kufanele athathelwe ku-Aron ukumkani, noma kubo bonke oonyana bakhe, abapristi.

Ubabakazi uzobheka ubuhlungu esikhumbani, futhi uma izinwele ebusweni besikhumba zishintshile zibe mhlophe, futhi ubuhlungu bubonakale bungaphezulu kwesikhumba, khona-ke kuyisifo esibi kakhulu sesikhumba. Uma ubabakazi ekubona, uzothi ungcolile;
Uma ikhanda limhlophe esikhumbani, futhi lingabonakali likhulu kunesikhumba, namazinyo alo angeke abe mnyama, khona-ke umbingeleli uzowufihla usuku oluyisithupha.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, umbingeleli uzobhekana naye kathathu; uma ebona ukuthi igciwane alishintshile, futhi lingekho emlonyeni, khona-ke umbingeleli kumele agcine lo muntu ekuseni nakusihlwa.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, umbingeleli uzobhekana naye kathathu; uma isifo sihlelile, futhi asikhokelele esikhumbani, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi unempilo, ngoba yisifo esibi kakhulu; kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, aze abe nokuthula.
Uma ke isilonda sikhula kakhulu esikhumbani, ngemuva kokubonisana kwakhe nombingeleli ukuba ahlanzeke, kufanele aphinde abonakaliswe kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uzomubheka, bese ubona ukuthi, uma isilonda sikhuphuka esikhumbani, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi lowo muntu usenamanzi; yisifo esibi kakhulu sesikhumba.
Uma umuntu enesifo esinzima sesikhumba, kufanele athathelwe udokotela.
umbingeleli uzombheka, bese kuthi uma kukhona ikhanda elimhlophe esikhumbani, liguqule inwele ibe mnyama, futhi kunenyama emfushane ekhanda,
isifo sesikhumba esihlala isikhathi eside, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi unciphile; ngeke afune ukuwufihla, ngoba usencane kakhulu.
Uma igciwane likhuphuka esikhumbani sonke, futhi lishisa isikhumba sakhe sonke, kusukela enkundleni kuye emilenzeni, kuwo wonke amehlo kambingeleli;

umbingeleli uzobhekana naye, bese kuthi uma igciwane ligcwele umzimba wakhe wonke, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi, Uhlanzekile ngenxa yesifo sakhe. Igciwane lonke lishintshile libe mhlophe; yena uhlanzekile.
Kodwa uma ebona inyama ephilayo, uzoba ongenawo umoya.
Umbingeleli uzobheka inyama emnyama, futhi uzothi ungcolile. Inyama emnyama ingcolile; yisifo esibuhlungu sesikhumba.
Uma isikhumba senyama sishintshe, sibe mhlophe, kumele afike kumbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uzobhekana naye, bese ubona ukuthi isilonda sishintshile sibe mhlophe; khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi yena uhlanzekile esihlalweni sakhe; uhlanzekile.
Uma umuntu ethola ubuhlungu esikhumbeni sakhe, futhi kukhulule,
uma ezindaweni zalesi sifo kukhona ukuvuvukala okumhlophe, noma uphawu olukhanyayo olubomvu-bomvu, kufanele abonisane nalo nobaba.
Ubabakazi uzoyibheka. Uma ibona ukuthi inkulu kunesikhumba, futhi izinwele zaso zimnyama, ubabakazi uzothi ngumuntu ongcolile. Yisifo esibi kakhulu sesikhumba esisekhona lapho isilonda sakhona.
Uma ke umbingeleli ebheka, bese kubona ukuthi akukhona khona izinwele ezimhlophe kulo, futhi akubi ngaphezu kwesikhumba, kodwa kumnyama kakhulu, khona-ke umbingeleli uzowufihla usuku oluyisithupha.
Uma ikhula kakhulu esikhumbani, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi ngumuntu ongcolile; yisifo.
Uma isikhumba sihlala endaweni saso, futhi singasakazwanga, khona-ke kuyisilonda somkhuhlane; umbingeleli kufanele akhulume ngokuthi uhlanzekile.
Noma umuntu angaba ne-burn on his skin from fire, and the raw meat of the burn becomes a shiny spot, reddish-white or white.

Ubabali uzoyibheka. Uma izinwele ezindaweni ezikhanyayo ziye zaba mhlophe, futhi zibonakale zibukhali kunesikhumba, khona-ke kuyisifo esibi kakhulu sesikhumba esiphuma emgodini. Ubabali uzothi ungcolile. Yisifo esibi kakhulu sesikhumba.

Uma ke umbingeleli ebheka, bese kubona ukuthi ayikho izinwele ezimhlophe kulolu hlobo lwesilonda, futhi alukho lutho olungaphansi kwesikhumba, kodwa lumnyama kakhulu, khona-ke umbingeleli uzowufihla usuku oluyisithupha.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe umbingeleli uzobhekana naye; uma ikhula esikhumbani, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi ungcolile; yisifo esibuhlungu sesikhumba.
Kodwa uma isikhumba sihlala endaweni saso, futhi singaphazamiseki esikhumbani, kodwa simnyama kakhulu, khona-ke wubuhlungu bomlilo; umbingeleli uzothi uyahlanzwa, ngoba yisimo somlilo.
Uma umuntu owesifazane noma uwesifazane enesilonda ekhanda lakhe noma emlonyeni wakhe,

umbingeleli uzobheka isilonda. Uma ibona ukuthi inkulu kunesikhumba, futhi izinwele zayo zimnyama nezincane, umbingeleli uzothi lowo muntu usengenawo ubuthi. Yisifo esibuhlungu sesikhumba esisekhanda noma emlonyeni.
Uma ke umbingeleli ebheka isilonda, bese ubona ukuthi asikho esingaphansi kwesikhumba, futhi asikho izinwele ezimnyama kuso, khona-ke umbingeleli uzowuvala usuku oluyisithupha.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, umbingeleli uzobheka isilonda; bese kuthi uma isilonda singekho kuphindwephindwe, futhi asikho izinwele ezibomvu kulo, futhi ukubukeka kwayo akude kakhulu nesikhumba,
Uzowususa, kodwa ngeke ususe ikhanda lakhe; khona-ke umnikelo wokudla uzowufihla usuku olulandelayo.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, umbingeleli uzobheka isilonda; uma isilonda singekho ebusweni besikhumba, futhi isithombe saso singaphansi kunesikhumba, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi lowo muntu uhlanzekile; kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, aze ahlanzwe.
Kodwa uma ubuhlungu besikhumba bukhula kancane kancane, ngemuva kokubhekwa kwakhe ehlanzekile,
umbingeleli uzobhekana naye futhi. Uma ikhanda likhula esikhumbani, umbingeleli akadingi ukubheka amazinyo amnyama; lowo muntu ungcolile.

Uma ke umbingeleli ebheka, besebona ukuthi isilonda asishintshi, futhi izinwele ezimnyama zikhula kuso, khona-ke isilonda siphelile; lowo muntu uhlanzekile; umbingeleli kumele akhulume ngokuthi uhlanzekile.
Uma umuntu owesifazane noma owesifazane unezibopho ezimhlophe ezishisayo esikhumba,
umbingeleli uzobhekana nazo. Uma izibopho zimnyama, zingabonakali, khona-ke kuyisilonda esingenangozi esiphuma esikhumba; lowo muntu uyahlanzwa.
Uma umuntu elahleka izinwele eziphezulu zekhanda lakhe, umnyama, kodwa uhlanzekile.
Uma elahleka izinwele ezingaphambili zekhanda lakhe, khona-ke unekhanda elibi, kodwa uhlanzekile.
Kodwa uma kunesilonda esimhlophe esibomvu ekhanda noma emlonyeni, khona-ke kukhona isifo esibucayi sesikhumba.
Uma ikhanda lakhe, noma intamo yakhe, ibonakale iphuzi elimnyama, njengegciwane elibi lesikhumba emlonyeni wakhe, khona-ke umbingeleli uzobhekana nalo;
uma kukhona umuntu onegciwane elibi ebusweni bakhe, yena ungcolile; khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi ungcolile, ngenxa yesifo esisekhanda lakhe.

Owesifazane onesifo esibuhlungu sesikhumba kufanele agqoke izicathulo eziphukile, futhi avumele izinwele zakhe zihambe ngokukhululekile. Kudingeka agqoke ingxenye engezansi yobuso bakhe, bese ekhuluma ngokuthi, 'Akunamanzi! Akunamanzi!'
Ngazo zonke izinsuku azoba negciwane lakhe, uzobe engalungile; kufanele ahlale ekamelweni lakhe elilodwa, ngaphandle komkhosi.
Izigqoko zingaba ne-mold ngazo, noma ngabe zinendwangu noma izigqoko zelinen,
noma impahla ethosiwe noma eyenziwe ngendwangu, noma isikhumba, noma iyiphi into eyenziwe ngesikhumba.

Uma isibopho kulowo mgqomo, noma kuleyo ndwangu, noma kuleyo ndwangu ethosiwe, noma kuleyo ndwangu ethengwe, noma kuleyo ndwangu ethengwe iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, noma iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, khona-ke yisifo esikhulayo, futhi kufanele siboniswe ubaba.
Umbingeleli uzobheka i-mold futhi abeke impahla endaweni ephephile iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe uzoyibheka; uma igciwane lisasazeke egqokeni, noma emlonyeni, noma enjolobeni, noma esikhumbani, noma yini eyenziwe ngayo, khona-ke yigciwane elibulalayo, lingcolile.
Uzowucima umgqomo, noma intambo, noma uboya, noma isiketi, noma into eyenziwe ngesikhumba, enesilonda kuso; ngoba yisifo esibulalayo; kufanele kuqhume emlilweni.
Uma ke umbingeleli ebheka, bese ubona ukuthi igciwane alisakazakali emlilweni, noma embuzweni, noma engotini, noma kunoma iyiphi into yesikhumba,
khona-ke umbingeleli uzocela ukuthi kuhlanzwe impahla enesikhunta, futhi izogcinwa izinsuku eziyisithupha.

Ngemuva kokuhlanzwa, umpristi uzoyibheka futhi. Uma i-mold ingashintshi umbala wayo, noma ngabe ayisakazeki, le mpahla ayihlanzekile. Uzoyibopha emlilweni, noma ngabe inhlekelele ingaphakathi noma ngaphandle.
Uma umbingeleli ebheka, bese ebona ukuthi igciwane lifihle ngemuva kokuzihlamba, kufanele aphuze igciwane elibi emlilweni, noma esikhumbani, noma ezintoni ezifakiwe, noma ezenziwe ngesandla.
Uma kwenzeka ivela egqokeni, noma ku-woven, noma ku-knitted, noma engxenyeni yesikhumba, khona-ke iyasakazeka. Nanoma yini ene-mollusc, uyithumele emanzini.
Uma uhlamba iingubo, noma impahla ethosiwe, noma impahla eyenziwe ngesikhumba, bese i-mold iphuma kuyo, kufanele uyihlanze kabili, futhi izohlanzekile.

Lokho wumthetho wokuthi uma kunegciwane egqokeni lengulube, noma ilinen, noma intambo, noma ukhonkolo, noma iyiphi impahla eyenziwe ngesikhumba, kufanele kuhlolwe ukuthi lihlanzekile yini, noma alihle.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Lokho wumthetho womuntu onegciwane, ngosuku lokuhlanzwa kwakhe; kufanele athathwe abe ngumpristi,
futhi umbingeleli kufanele aphume ngaphandle kwesibhedlela, ukuze abhekane naye. Uma umuntu ephelile isifo sakhe,
khona-ke umbingeleli uzocela ukuthi athathelwe izinyoni eziphilayo ezimbili ezinamanzi, namatshe aseduzane, nendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nomnqumo.
Umpristi uzocela ukuthi ingulube eyodwa ibotshelwe emanzini abandayo aphuma emgodini wokhuni.
Uzothatha izinyoni eziphilayo, nokhuni lwesiqalo, nentambo emnyama, ne-hysop; uzozibeka zonke lezi zinto, kanye nezinyoni eziphilayo, emlilweni wesilwane esifile phezu kwamanzi aphumayo.
Uzowususa umlomo wakhe, aphuze igazi lakhe phezu komuntu ohlanzwa ngaso isixhenxe, futhi uzothi uhlanzekile; bese uvumela intaka ephilayo ukuba ihambe ezindaweni ezivulekile.

Uzohlamba izigqoko zakhe, uzozisusa zonke iinwele zakhe, futhi uzohlanza umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze ahlanzeke. Ngemuva kwalokho angaya esiteji; kodwa kufanele ahlale ngaphandle kwendlu yakhe iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, uzoba nezinwele zakhe zonke, ikhanda lakhe, nemilenze yakhe, namazinyo akhe; uzozihlamba izigqoko zakhe, futhi ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, aze abe mkhulu.

Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili uzoletha amaqanda amabili, namaqanda amane aneminyaka emibili ubudala, angabi nenkinga kuwo wonke, kanye nekhilogremu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili yoshizi olubomvu oluhlanganiswe nophethiloli, ibe yisipho sokudla, kanye nelitha elilodwa nengxenye yelitha le-oyile.
Umbingeleli owenza ukuhlanzwa kumele abeke lowo muntu, kanye nezipho zakhe, phambi kukaNkulunkulu, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Umbingeleli uzothatha inkunzi yengulube eyodwa, ayenze ibe yisonka sokuhlukunyezwa, kanye nephethiloli; azozishaya ngazo phambi koYehova njengesonka esiqhutshwa.

Uzobulala inkomo endaweni engcwele, lapho kubulawa khona isonka sesono, kanye nesonka sokudla okuthosiwe. Isonka sokuhlukunyezwa sizoba ngumnikelo wesono, njengesonka sokudla okuthosiwe; lingcwele kakhulu.
Uzothatha umbingeleli emanzini omnikelo wesono, awuthele emlonyeni womlomo womuntu ohlanzwa, nakwesokudla kwesandla sakhe sokudla, nakwesobunxele benyawo lakhe lokunene.
Umnikelo wokudla uzowususa, futhi umnikelo wesono uzowufaka emlonyeni wakhe osekhohlo.
Uzobeka umlenze wakhe wesandla sakhe sokudla emlilweni wophethiloli okwisandla sakhe sesobunxele, futhi uzowufafaza ngomlenze wakhe izikhathi ezisixhenxe phambi koYehova.

Ngaleyo mafutha asele esandlani sakhe, umnikelo wokudla uzowufaka emlonyeni wakhe wesobunxele, nasenkundleni yezandla zakhe zesobunxele, nasenkundleni yentamo yakhe yesobunxele, phezu kwegazi lesibopho sokuhlukunyezwa.
Okunye kwaleyo mafutha asele esandlani sakhe, umnikelo wokudla uzowufaka phezu kwekhanda lomuntu ozohlanzwa; futhi umnikelo wokudla uzowulungisa phambi koYehova.
Ubaba-ke uzonikela ngenhlanhla yesono, ukuze alungise isono sakhe ngenxa yokunambitheka kwakhe; futhi ngemuva kwalokho uzobulala inhlanhla yokudlwengula.
Umbingeleli uzonikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula, nomnikelo wokudla, phezu kwesibambo somlilo; futhi umbingeleli uzokwenza ukuxoshwa kuye kukaNkulunkulu, aze ahlanzwe.
, kodwa angeke akwazi ukukhokhela konke okudingekayo, kufanele athole ishumi legolide, intengo yegolide ekhokhisa ibhajethe, kanye ne-euro eyodwa, euros, ikhadi legolide elihamba ngebhajethe..
Uzothatha izinyoni ezimbili, noma izingulube ezimbili ezincane, ngaso sonke isifiso sakhe; enye ibe yisonka sosono, nenye ibe yisonka sokushiswa.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili azoziletha kulowo mpristi, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, phambi koYehova, ukuze ahlanzwe.
Umbingeleli uzothatha inkomo yesonka sokuhlukunyezwa, nephethiloli yayo, azigqugquzele ngazo phambi koYehova njengento esigqugquzelwe.

Uzobulala unyana womnikelo wesono, futhi uzothatha igazi lakhe, alayishe phezu kwesokudla sendlebe yomuntu ohlanzwayo, naphezu kwesobunxele lwesandla sakhe sokudla, naphezu kwesobunxele lwenyawo lakhe lokudla.
Umbingeleli uzogeza isandla sakhe sesobunxele ngaleyo mafutha, afakwe emlonyeni wakhe.
Uzothi, ngesandla sakhe sesokudla, ahlanze ngaleyo mafutha ezandla zakhe zesobunxele izikhathi ezisixhenxe phambi koYehova.

Uzobeka engxenyeni yale phethiloli esesandlani sakhe, emlonyeni wendlebe yakhe yesobunxele, nasezinhlamvu zesandla sakhe sesobunxele, nasezinhlamvu zezinyawo zakhe zesobunxele, endaweni yegazi lesibopho sokuhlukunyezwa.
Okuseleyo kwe-oyile esandlani sakhe, umbingeleli uzowubeka phezu kwesifuba somholi welowo ohlanzwa, ukuze alungise isono sakhe kukaNkulunkulu phambi koYehova.
Ake anikela ngezinkomo, noma ngezinkomo ezincane, ngaso sonke isifiso sakhe;
Omunye ube ngumnikelo wesono, owodwa ube ngumnikelo wokushiswa, kanye nomnikelo wokudla; futhi umbingeleli kufanele alungise lowo muntu phambi koNkulunkulu.
Le yimfundiso yomuntu onesifo esibuhlungu sesikhumba ongeke akwazi ukukhokhela izipho ezijwayelekile zokuhlanzwa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Uma ufika ezweni laseKanana, engikunika lona ukuthi libe yikhaya lakho, ngizobeka iphunga elibandayo endaweni yendlu ezweni labo.
Uzohamba khona umnikazi wendlu, futhi uzokutshela umbingeleli, uthi: "Ngicabanga ukuthi ngibona into efana ne-moth ekhaya lami."
Uma umnyango wendlu ivulekile, umpristi kufanele avumele ukuthi ifulethi lihlanzwe, ngaphambi kokuba umpristi engene ukubheka igciwane, ukuze akukho okubi kuyo.
Uzobheka i-mold. Uma ikhona emgwaqweni ezindaweni eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka noma ezinombala obomvu obonakala uphakeme kunendawo yodonga,
khona-ke umbingeleli uzophuma, afike emgwaqweni womnyango wendlu, avule indlu ngezinsuku ezisithupha.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, umnikelo wokudla uzobuya, abhekane nalo; futhi uma igciwane lisakazeka ezindaweni zokuhlala,
khona-ke umbingeleli uzocela ukuthi bakhiphe amatshe anesilonda, bazibeke endaweni engcolileyo ngaphandle komzi.
Uzobeka amadonga angaphakathi endlu, azowasusa ngaso sonke isikhathi; futhi ingilazi elahlekile izothunyelwa endaweni engalungile ngaphandle komfula.
Ngakho-ke kufanele bathathe ezinye izintaba ukuze zishintshe ezidala, futhi basebenzise i-plaster entsha ukuvala indlu.
Uma i-mold ibuyela futhi iphuma ekhaya ngemuva kokukhishwa kwamatshe nendlu ikhishwe ibe yi-plastered,
khona-ke umnikelo wokudla uzofika, abhekane nalo; uma igciwane lithe lasakazeka endluni, khona-ke yigciwane elibulalayo; indlu iyinakene.
Kuzothunyelwa phansi, namatshe ayo, nemithi yawo, nengilazi yakhe yonke; kuzothunyelwa ngaphandle komgwaqo endaweni engcolile.
Wonke umuntu ozongena efulethini uma livaleliwe, uzobe unqunywa kuze kube semini.
Wonke umuntu ohlala noma edla ekhaya kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe.
Uma ke yena umbingeleli efika, ebheka, besebona ukuthi igciwane alisakazwanga endlini, ngemuva kokuqhuma kwayo, khona-ke umbingeleli uzothi lihlanzekile indlu, ngoba leli gciwane lifihle.
Ukwenza indlu ihlanzekile, kufanele athathe izinja ezimbili, nokhuni lwesiqalo, nendwangu ebomvu, ne-hysop.
Uzobulala inhlanzi eyodwa ngamanzi abandayo aphuma emgodini wokhuni.
Uzothatha ukhuni lwesiqalo, ne-hysop, ne-scarlet, nenyamakazi eliphilayo, azozibeka emlilweni wenyamakazi elibiwe, namanzi abandayo, aze ahlanze indlu izikhathi ezisithupha.
Uzohlanza ikhaya ngegazi lenyamakazi, namanzi abandayo, nenyamakazi eliphilayo, nokhuni lwesiqalo, ne-hysop, nendwangu emnyama.
Uzokhipha isibhakabhaka esiphilayo, sihambe ngaphandle komgwaqo ezindaweni ezivulekile; futhi uzoba nendlu ihlanzekile, futhi izohlanzwa.
Le mfundiso isetshenziswa nganoma yisiphi isifo sesikhumba esibuhlungu kanye nokulimala,
for mould on clothes or in a home,
kanye ne-swelling, i-scab, noma indawo ekhanyayo.
Ifundisa ukuthi yini engcolile nokuthi yini ehlanzekile. Le mfundiso ikhuluma ngezinkinga ezinkulu zesikhumba kanye ne-mollusc.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Bheka, ngikutshele izingane zakwaSirayeli ukuthi, Uma umuntu ethola ukuphuma kwegazi emlonyeni wakhe, lo kuphuma kwakhe kuzoba wubuthi.
Uma igazi liqhubeka liphuma, noma lihlala likhona, uzoba nobuthi. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi ube nobuthi.
Wonke umbhede lapho ehlala khona uzoba mnyama, futhi yonke into ahlala kuyo ibe mnyama.
Wonke umuntu othinta isibhedlela sakhe, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, futhi ahlanzwe ngamanzi, abe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Wonke umuntu ohlala phezu kwanoma yini ahlala kuyo lowo onezinto ezingcolileyo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanzeke ngamanzi, abe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Wonke umuntu othinta umzimba wakhe, kumele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, futhi ahlanzwe ngamanzi, abe nakanjani kuze kube semini.
Uma umuntu onesifo sokuphuma ephuza phezu komuntu ohlanzekile, lowo muntu kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanzwe ngamanzi, abe namakanca kuze kube semini.
Nanoma iyiphi i-saddle owesifazane ehamba kuyo, ayihlanzeki.

Wonke umuntu othinta noma iyiphi into ekhona ngaphansi kwakhe, uzobe unqunywe kuze kube sebusuku; nalowo ozoyithwala kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanzwe ngamanzi, abe nanqunywa kuze kube sebusuku.
Wonke umuntu owesifazane ozowugoqa, ngaphandle kokugeza izandla zakhe ngamanzi, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanzwe ngamanzi, abe namakanca kuze kube semini.
Ibhodwe lodonga owesifazane eligcotshwa ngalo kufanele liqhutshekwe, futhi noma iyiphi ibhodlela lemithi kumele lihlanzwe ngamanzi.
Uma umuntu ephiliswa emgodini wakhe, uzobala izinsuku ezisixhenxe zokuhlanzeka kwakhe, futhi agqoke izicathulo zakhe, ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi aphumayo; khona-ke uzohlanzeka.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, kufanele athathe izingulube ezimbili, noma izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, afike emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana phambi koYehova, azinikeze umbingeleli.
Umbingeleli uzonikela ngomnye njengomnikelo wesono, nomunye njengomnikelo wokushiswa; futhi umbingeleli uzokwenza ukuxoshwa kuye phambi koYehova ngenxa yokuphuma kwakhe.
Uma umuntu ephuza isisu sakhe, kufanele ahlanze umzimba wakhe wonke ngamanzi, futhi abe nakanjani kuze kube semini.
Noma yisiphi isigqoko, noma iyiphi isikhumba, uma kunembewu kuyona, kufanele sihlanzwe ngamanzi, futhi sibe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Uma umuntu nowesifazane behlangana, futhi kube khona ukuphuma kwesisu, kufanele bahlanzwe ngamanzi, futhi babe namalahle kuze kube semini.
Uma uwesifazane ephuza igazi lakhe, uzobe unqunywe usuku olusixhenxe; wonke umuntu owuthintayo uzobe unqunywa kuze kube sebusuku.
Nanoma yini ahlala kuyo ngesikhathi sokuphelelwa yinyanga yakhe, ingcolile; nanoma yini ehlala kuyo, ingcolile.
Wonke umuntu othinta isibhedlela sakhe, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, futhi ahlanzwe ngamanzi, abe nakanjani kuze kube semini.
Wonke umuntu othinta noma iyiphi into ahlala phezu kwayo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, abe nakanjani kuze kube semini.
Nakuba yimibhede yakhe, noma yisiphi isinqumo sakhe, noma yisiphi isiqu sakhe, umuntu onquma ukusondela kuyo, uzobe unqunywe kuze kube semini.
Uma umuntu ethandana naye, futhi ukuphuma kwakhe kungena kuye, uzobe unqunywe izinsuku ezisixhenxe; nanoma yisiphi isibhedlela ahlala kuso uzobe unqunywa.

Uma uwesifazane ephuza igazi usuku lonke ngaphandle kosuku lwakhe lokuphuma, noma uma kuqhubeka ukuphuza ngemuva kosuku lwakhe lokuphuma, uzobiwa zonke izinsuku zokuphuza kwakhe, njengokuba ephuza ngesikhathi sokuphuma.
Nanoma yisiphi isibhedlela ahlala kuso ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwakhe, singcolile, njengokuba nesifo sakhe; futhi noma yini ahlala kuyo, ingcolile, njengokuba nesifo sakhe.
Wonke umuntu ozoziqhenya lezi zinto, uzobi namanzi; kumele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanzwe ngamanzi, abe namanzi kuze kube semini.
Uma ephelile ukuphuma kwakhe, uzobala izinsuku ezisixhenxe; ngemuva kwazo uzohlanzeka.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, kufanele athathe izingulube ezimbili ezincane, noma izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, aziveze kumpristi, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Ubaba-ke uzonikela ngayinye ibe yisonka sokudla, nenye ibe yisonka esishiswayo; futhi ubaba-ke uzolungisa isono sakhe phambi koYehova, ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwegazi lakhe.
Uzogcina izingane zakwaSirayeli zingaphandle kokubi kwazo, ukuze zingafa, uma zibulala isikhala sami esingcwele, esisephakathi kwabo.
Lokho wumthetho womuntu ophumayo, nomuntu ongcolile ngenxa yokuphuma kwesisu sakhe,
futhi ngowesifazane ngesikhathi sonyaka wakhe, kanye nowesifazane noma uwesifazane ophumayo, kanye nowesifazane ohlala nomkakhe ongcolile.
Wakhuluma iNkosi kuMoses, ngemuva kokufa kwabantwana ababini baka-Aron, lapho befika khona phambi kukaNkulunkulu.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uthe kuye: Bheka uAron umngane wakho, ukuthi angangeni ngaso sonke isikhathi ezindaweni ezingcwele kakhulu, eduze komgquba obekwe phezu kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, ukuze aphile; ngoba ngizovela emlilweni phezu komgquba.
U-Aron kufanele afike endaweni engcwele ngale ndlela: ngengulube encane ibe yisonka sesono, nomuntu wesifazane abe yisonka somlilo.

Uzogqoka isigqoko esingcwele selinen, nezicathulo zelinen ezingaphansi kwesikhumba sakhe. Uzoxhuma umlenze welinen phezu kwakhe, futhi uzogqoka i-turban yelinen. Lezi zinto ziyimpahla engcwele. Uzohlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi bese uzigqoka.
Emphakathini wakwaSirayeli, kufanele athathe izinkomo ezimbili zibe yisondlo sesono, nengulube eyodwa ibe yisondlo somlilo.
U-Aron uzonikela ngengulube, ibe yisondlo sesono sakhe, ukuze alungise yena nomndeni wakhe phambi kuThixo.
Uzothatha amakhowe amabili, azowabeka phambi koYehova, emgwaqweni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Uzophonsa izinqumo ngezinkomo ezimbili, inqumo eyodwa yoYehova, nenye yenqumo yezinkomo eziboshwe.
U-Aron kufanele athathe imbuzi ehlonishwayo iNkosi, ayilungiselele ibe yisondlo sesono.
Kodwa ibhokhwe elithathwe ngesinqumo, ukuze lithunyelwe ezweni elisha, kumele libekwe liphila phambi koYehova, ukuze likhishwe ezweni elisha, libe yibhokhwe elithathela isono.
