U-Aron uzoletha inkomo yesonka sakhe sesono, ukuze alungise yena nomndeni wakhe phambi kukaThixo; futhi uzobulala inkomo yesonka sakhe sesono.
Uzothatha ibhodwe eligcwele amakhowe omlilo, asuka esitezi esiphezulu esibhekene noYehova, namacwecwe akhe amabili agcwele uvumba olumnandi, elinqunyelwe kancane, azowafaka ngaphakathi kwesibuko.
Uzobeka umnqumo phezu komlilo phambi kweNkosi, ukuze uthuli lomnqumo lugweme isibuko esingaphansi kwesiqokobhe sesivumelwano, ukuze angafanga.
Uzothatha igazi lengulube, alifuthe ngesandla sakhe ebusweni bobuso besipho, ngasenyakatho; uzofuthe negazi ngesandla sakhe izikhathi ezisixhenxe phambi kobuso bobuso besipho.

Uzobulala umbhoshongo wesonka sesono sabantu, afake igazi lakhe ngaphakathi kwethenda; futhi uzokwenza negazi lombhoshongo njengoba ekwenzele ngegazi lengulube; uzobaphuza phezu kophahla, naphezu kophahla.

Ngale ndlela uzolungisa indawo engcwele kakhulu, ngenxa yezinto ezingcolile zomndeni wakwaSirayeli, futhi ngenxa yobugebengu babo ngazo zonke izigwebo zabo; ngokufana nalokho azokwenza nethenda lokuhlangana eliphakathi kwabo phakathi kwezinhlanzi zabo.

Akufanele kube khona umuntu othile efulethini lengqungquthela, kusukela lapho uAron ephuma khona ukuze alungiselele indawo engcwele kakhulu, kuze kufike lapho ephuma khona; kumele alungiselele yena nomndeni wakhe, nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli.
Uzophuma, afike esibhedlela esingaphambilini kweNkosi, akwenze umnikelo wokudla; futhi uzothatha igazi lenkomo, negazi lebhokhwe, aze alifake ezindlebeni zonke zesibhedlela.
Wathi uMosis kulowo muntu: "Uzokhipha igazi elingenalutho emlonyeni wakho, uzolihlanza ngesandla sakhe, ukuze lihlanzekile, futhi libe ngumnikelo ongcwele, ngenxa yezinhlekelele zakwaSirayeli.
Uma eseqedile ukwenza indawo engcwele kakhulu, nesitezi sokubambisana, nesihlalo esiphezulu, kufanele athathe inkomo ephilayo.

U-Aron uzobeka izandla zakhe zombili phezu kwekhanda lebhokhwe eliphilayo, azozinikela ngazo zonke izigebengu zabantwana bakaSirayeli, ngobubi babo bonke, ngezinkohlakalo zabo zonke; ezozitholela ezindlebeni zebhokhwe, aze ashiye inkomo ezweni elibi ngesandla somntu ofanele.
Ingulube izothwala zonke izimo zabo ezibi phezu kwayo, ifike ezindaweni ezinokuthula; futhi umuntu uzovumela ingulube ukuba ihambe ezweni elimnyama.
U-Aron uzongena entabeni yokuhlangana, agqoke izicathulo zelinen, ezozigqoka lapho ephuma khona endaweni engcwele kakhulu, aze azibeke khona.

Uzohlanza umzimba wakhe ngamanzi endaweni engcwele, agqoke izicathulo zakhe, aze aphume; futhi uzonikela ngesonka sakhe esishiswayo, nesonka sabantu esishiswayo, ukuze alungise yena nomphakathi phambi kukaThixo.
Uzokhipha ushukela wesonka sokuhlukunyezwa phezu kwesibingelelo.
Owesifazane lowo owawuya ezweni elimnyama, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, futhi ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi; ngemva kwalokho uzongena entabeni.

Ingulube yomnikelo wesono, nobhontshisi womnikelo wesono, igazi labo lafakwa ezindaweni ezingcwele kakhulu ukuze kwenziwe ukuxoshwa, kumele lithunyelwe ngaphandle komkhosi; amasikhumba abo, nemifino yabo, nenyama yabo, kufanele kuqhunywe ngomlilo.
Owenza umlilo azozihlamba izigqoko zakhe, futhi ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi; ngemuva kwalokho uzoya esiteshini.
Le nyanga iyisishiyagalombili, ngomhla wesithupha wenyanga, kufanele niphumule; ngeke nisebenze umsebenzi othile, noma ngabe ungumdabu noma ngabe ungumhlali phakathi kwenu.
Ngokuba ngalolu suku nizocaciswa phambi kukaNkulunkulu, nizohlanzwa; kuzo zonke izigebengu zenu enhliziyweni kaYehova nizohlanzwa.
Usuku lokuphumula oluphelele luzobe lukhona kuwe; ngeke nidla ukudla. Lolu mthetho uhlala njalo.
Ubaba wakhe, umbhishobhi okhishwe ngesonka, owabekwa endaweni yakhe, uzoba ngumvikeli wabo; uzozigqoka izicathulo zelinen, izicathulo ezingcwele.
Uzolungisa indawo engcwele kakhulu, nesihlalo sokuhlangana, nesibingelelo; futhi uzolungisa abapristi, nomndeni wonke webandla, ukuze babe nguNkulunkulu wabo.
Lokhu kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala njalo kuwe, ukuthi uphinde uhlanze izingane zakwaSirayeli ngazo zonke izigebengu zabo ngonyaka owodwa. Wakwenza njalo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Usho ku-Aron, nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe, nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Le yindlela iNkosi awisenzile ngayo:
Wonke umuntu waseSirayeli obulala inkomo, noma ingulube, noma imbuzi, ngaphakathi emgodini, noma ngaphandle kwawo,

futhi ayibeke emgwaqweni wesitezi sokuhlangana, ukuba inikezelwe njengomnikelo kukaNkulunkulu phambi kwendlu yakhe engcwele, lowo muntu uzoba necala lokuhlukunyezwa kwegazi; wahlukunyeza igazi, futhi lowo muntu uzosuswa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.

Futhi, uma abantu baseSirayeli banikela ngenyama yabo emgwaqweni, bazoyiletha kukaNkulunkulu; futhi, uma beyizibulala ezindaweni ezivulekile, bazozithatha ziye kumbhoshongo wendlu yokuphumula, bazinikeze umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu.
Umbingeleli uzobasusa igazi phezu kwesibopho seNkosi, esisemnyango wendlu yokuhlangabeza; futhi uzodlidliza isilonda, ibe ngumoya omnandi kuYehova.
Bazothi: "Akekho umuntu ophilayo ozonikela ngenyama yakhe ezilwaneni zezinkomo, abazithobela njengamabhishobhi; lokhu kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Wathi kubo: Wonke umuntu waseSirayeli, noma wonke umhlali ohlala phakathi kwenu, uma enikela ngesonka esishiswayo, noma nganoma iyiphi enye insizakalo,
futhi angeke ayiveze emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, ukuze ayinikeze iNkosi, lowo muntu kufanele aphelelwe yizwe lakhe.
Uma kukhona umuntu waseSirayeli, noma umhlali ohlala phakathi kwenu, edla igazi naliphi na uhlobo, ngizobhekana nalo muntu, ngiwuqubuke emiphakathini yawo.
Ngokuba inhliziyo yomuntu ophilayo egazi. Ngininikeze igazi phezu isiqalo, ukuze uqinise wena nami. Yiye igazi, ngoba liyimpilo, ukuthi uqinisa abantu noNkulunkulu.
Ngakho ngithi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Akunamuntu othile phakathi kwenu ozodla igazi; futhi noma ngubani ohlala ezweni eliphakathi kwenu, ngeke adle igazi.
Uma umuntu wesizwe samaSirayeli, noma umningi ohlala phakathi kwabo, ehlasela inkomo, noma ingulube, engadlalwa, kufanele aphuze igazi layo, futhi ayigqoke ngothuli.

Ngokuba inhliziyo yomuntu wonke yigazi lakhe; ngakho ngithi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Ningadlanga igazi lomuntu onke; ngoba inhliziyo yomuntu wonke yigazi lakhe; lowo okudlayo kufanele aphelelwe.

Wonke umuntu, noma ngabe uvela ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma ngabe ungumhambi ohlala kulo mhlaba, uma edla isilwane esifile, noma isilwane esidlwengulayo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanzeke ngamanzi; uzobe unqunywe kuze kube semini, futhi ngemuva kwalokho uzohlanzekile.
Kodwa uma engahlanzi izigqoko zakhe, futhi ahlanze umzimba wakhe, uzoba necala.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhuluma nabantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: NginguYehova uNkulunkulu wenu.

Mhlawumbe ngeke nihambe ngendlela abayenzayo ezweni laseYiputa, lapho nihlala khona; noma indlela abayenzayo ezweni laseKanana, lapho ngizokulethela khona, ngeke nihambe ngayo, futhi amasiko abo ngeke niwalandele.
Nizigcine izimiso zami, nizilondoloze imithetho yami, niyilandele. Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Nizigcine izimiso zami nemithetho yami; umuntu ozenzayo, uzophila ngazo. Ngiye uNkulunkulu.
Akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ongeke afike emndenini wakhe, ukuze abe nendodana yakhe. Ngiye iNkosi.
Umama wakho ngumama wakho, ngakho-ke akufanele uvule ikhanda lakhe; umama wakho ungubaba wakho, ngakho-ke akufanele uvule ikhanda lakhe.
Awunakufinyelela indodakazi yobaba wakho, ngoba lokhu kungenxa yokugxeka ubaba wakho.
Umama wakho, noma indodakazi yomkakhe, noma indodana yenkosikazi yakho, noma inkosikazi yowesifazane wakho, noma intombi yabazali bakho, noma ingane ezalwa ekhaya lakho.
Umfazi wendodakazi yakho, noma intombazane yenkosikazi yakho, akufanele ube nayo inkanuko; ngoba lokhu kuyingozi kuwe.
Umfazi wenkosikazi yobaba wakho, ozalwa ngubaba wakho, awudingi ukuwuveza umlomo wakhe; udadewabo yena.
Akufanele uthathe inkosikazi yobaba wakho, ngoba yena umndeni kababa wakho.
Umama wakho udadewabo, awukwazi ukubhekana nayo.
Uma uthandana nowesifazane wenkosikazi yakho, akufanele ube nendodakazi yomndeni wakho.
Akufanele uthathe intombazane yomndeni wakho, ngoba indodakazi yomntwana wakho; akufanele uthathe intombazane yomndeni wakho, ngoba indodana yomntwana wakho.
Uma uthandana nowesifazane wenkosikazi yakho, awukwazi ukufinyelela emlonyeni wakhe.
Uzothatha indodakazi yomntwana wakhe, noma intombi yomntwana wakhe, ukuze uthathe intombazane yakhe; ngoba bangamakhoboka akhe. Lokhu kuyingozi kakhulu.
Uma uthandana nowesifazane, kufanele ube nendodakazi yowesifazane wakho. Uma uthandana nowesifazane, kufanele ube nowesifazane wenkosikazi yakho.
Ngakho-ke, abesifazane, uma bekhulelwe, kufanele bagqoke izicathulo zabo zesifazane.
Uma uthandana nowesifazane wenkosikazi yakho, awukwazi ukuba nendodakazi yakhe.
Uma kukhona owesifazane emndenini wakho, ungamnikanga uMoleki; igama likaThixo wakho ngeke uliphuze. Ngimi iNkosi.
Uma uthandana nowesifazane, kufanele ube nomyeni wakhe futhi uma uthandana nowesifazane, kumele ube nomyeni wakhe.
Ngakho-ke, akufanele uhlangane nanoma iyiphi inhlanzi futhi ube nezinkinga ngaye. Abesifazane kufanele babeke isandla sabo kumuntu ophilayo ukuze babe nobudlelwane naye; lokhu kuyingozi enkulu.
Mhlawumbe ngeke nizihlanze ngazo zonke lezi zinto; njengoba izizwe ezi Uzinquma ukuzikhipha phambi kwenu, zazihlanza ngazo.
Futhi izwe lalimaza, ngathi ngiyiphoqelela inkohliso yayo; futhi izwe likhupha abantu bayo, njengokuba umuntu evuthayo.
Futhi nigcine imibandela yami, namasiko ami; ningakwenza lutho lwazo zonke lezi zinto ezingathandeki, noma ngabe ungumzali wasezweni, noma ngabe unomhlalaphansi phakathi kwenu.
Ngenxa yazo zonke lezi zinto ezingathandeki abantu ababehlala kulolu mhlaba phambi kwenu bazenza, futhi izwe lalimaza.
Uma niyiphazamisa izwe, lizokuxosha, njengokuthi laxosha isizwe esisekhona phambi kwenu.
Wonke umuntu owenza noma iyiphi yalezi izinto ezingathandeki, kufanele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Kuze nigcine izimiso zami, ukuthi ningazisebenzisi noma iyiphi yazo zonke izenzo ezingathandeki, ezakwenziwa phambi kwenu; futhi ningabi namanzi ngazo. Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Nibe bangcwele; ngoba ngingcwele mina, iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Uzohlonipha wonke umuntu ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe, futhi uzogcina izinsuku zami zokuphumula. Ngiye uNkulunkulu wenu iNkosi.
Musani ukubhekana namathoyizi, nize nizilungiselele izinhlamvu ezibomvu zemimoya; ngingiNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Uma ninikela ngenhlanhla umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, kufanele uyinikeze ngendlela efanele, ukuze ivunyelwe.
Kuyodlalwa ngalolusuku lokunikela ngalo, noma ngosuku olulandelayo; kodwa uma kunezinto ezishisayo kuze kube ngusuku lwesithathu, kumele ziqhume emgodini.
Uma kukhona okudlalwa ngalo ngosuku lwesithathu, khona-ke kuyinto engathandeki futhi ayivunyelwanga.
Wonke umuntu ozodla wona, uzothwala inkohliso yakhe; ngenxa yokuthi wenza izinto ezingcwele zikaYehova zibe yizinyamazane zakhe; lowo muntu kufanele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Uma uqoqa izithelo zezwe lakho, akufanele uqoqe kuze kuphele isiphetho sendawo yakho yokulima, futhi akufanele ubuye uqoqe imbewu ethosiwe.
Ngiyakutshela ukuthi ngeke uthathe imbewu yewayini lakho, futhi ngeke uqoqe izithelo zayo ezifileyo; uzozishiya kulowo ohlwempu, nakwesolwandle. Ngiye uNkulunkulu wenu iNkosi.
Musa ukudlwengula. Musa ukusho lutho. Musa ukukhohlisa.
Mhlawumbe nizokhuluma ngegama lami ngokungeqiniso, ningabi necala igama lami uNkulunkulu wakho. Ngiye iNkosi.
Musa ukuphatha umngane wakho ngendlela engafanele, noma ukumdlwengula. Ungayigcinanga imali yomqashi ekuseni kuze kube ubusuku.
Mhlawumbe ngeke uphuze isidumbu, futhi ngeke ubeke ngaphambili umuntu omnyama into eyenza ukuba ahambe; kodwa uzogwema uNkulunkulu wakho. Ngimi iNkosi.
Uma ulungisa, akufanele ube necala. Uma ulungisa, akufanele ukhethe omnyama; uma ulungisa, akufanele ukhethe onamandla.
Mhlawumbe ngeke uhambe ukhuluma ngokungeqiniso ngezwe lakho, futhi angeke ubeke impilo yomngane wakho engozini. Ngimi iNkosi.
Mhlawumbe ngeke ugweme inkosikazi yakho enhliziyweni yakho, kodwa kufanele ugweme umngane wakho phambi kwamehlo akho lapho ekhohlwa khona, ukuze ungabi nesibopho sesono sakhe.
Uzothanda umngane wakho njengokuba ukuthanda wena ngokwakho. Ngiye nginguYehova.
Gcwalisa izimiso zami. Ungadlalwa yizilwane ezimbili ezahlukene ndawonye. Ngakho-ke, ungatshali isitshalo sakho ngezinhlobo ezimbili zembewu. Ungagqoki izingubo ezikhiqizwe ngezinto ezimbili.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nowesifazane osemkhondweni wakhe, futhi angeke athengiswe, noma avunyelwe ukuba abe ngumuntu wesifazane, kufanele bagwenywe; kodwa ngeke bafa, ngoba yena akawesabikanga.
Uzoletha indodana yomnqumo kuYehova, emgwaqweni wesitezi sokuhlangana, ibe yisondlo sesono.
Uzothi umbingeleli, ngendodakazi yomnikelo wesono, ayenze inhlanhla kuye phambi koYehova, ngenxa yesono sakhe esenzayo; futhi isono sakhe sizotholwa.
Uma ufika ezweni futhi utshala noma yiluphi uhlobo lomnqumo, bheka izithelo zayo njengezi haramu; iminyaka emithathu izobe iyiharamu kuwe, ngeke nidle.
Ngomnyaka wesine, zonke izithelo zayo zizobe zingcwele, zibe yizipho zokubonga kuYehova.
Ngomnyaka wesishiyagalombili uzodla umkhiqizo wayo, ukuze umnqumo wakhe ube mkhulu kakhulu kuwe. Ngiye uNkulunkulu wenu iNkosi.
Ungadli noma yiluphi uhlobo lwenyama lapho igazi likhona. Ngakho-ke, ungasebenzisi izimfihlakalo noma uzame ukuchaza okuzokwenzeka.
Ungagquma izinwele ezinhlangothini zekhanda lakho noma ungagquma izingcezu zembeba yakho.
Mhlawumbe nizozibulala, noma nizozishaya izandla zenu, noma nizozibophezela emilenzeni yenu; ngiyami iNkosi.
Ungayiphazamisi inkosikazi yakho, uyenze ibe yindodana yowesifazane, ukuze izwe lize libe yindodana yowesifazane, liphele ngobubi.
Zigcineni izinsuku zami zokuphumula, niyihlole indawo yami engcwele. Ngiye iNkosi.
Musa ukubhekana nalabo abakhuluma ngezinkanyezi, noma nalabo abanezinhlamvu zezulu; ungaba khona kubo, ukuze bangakuhlanza. Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Uzohlala phambi kwamadoda amakhulu, uzoba nomhloni womuntu omdala; uzogwema uNkulunkulu wakho. Ngimi uNkulunkulu.
Uma ehlala nawe ezweni lakho umuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke ugweme ukumbulala.
Uzothi kulowo ohlala eduze kwakho, njengomuntu owazalwa phakathi kwenu; uzomthanda njengokuba ukuthanda wena ngokwakho; ngoba nibe bangaphandle ezweni laseMiziphu. Ngiye uNkulunkulu wenu iNkosi.
Ungakhohlisi uma ulinganisela ubude, isisindo noma inani.
Uzosebenzisa izilinganiso ezilungile, nezithako ezilungile, namaphakethe afanele, okushisayo namanzi. Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, owabasusa ezweni laseYiputa.
Nizigcine izimiso zami zonke, nemithetho yami yonke, niyenze. Ngiye iNkosi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 24"Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli, uthi: 'Uma umuntu othile ezweni lakwaSirayeli noma phakathi kwabanye abahlali bezwe laseSirayeli anikela nganoma yisiphi isizukulwane sakhe emkhondweni kaMoleki, kufanele abulawe. Abantu bomhlaba kumele bagweme ukumbulala ngetshe.
Ngizobhekana nomuntu lowo, ngiwususe emphakathini wakhe, ngenxa yokuthi wamisa indawo yami engcwele, wanikela isizukulwane sakhe ku-Molekhi, ukuze aphuze igama lami elingcwele.
Uma abantu balo mhlaba bebona ukuthi lowo muntu unikeza izingane zakhe ku-Molekh, futhi bangawubulalanga,
Ngizobhekana nomuntu lowo, nendlu yakhe; ngizowususa emphakathini wakhe, naye wonke umuntu olandela uMoleki, engiphula umthetho ngaye, ngiwususe.
Uma umuntu ebhekane nalabo abakhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo, noma nalabo abazazelayo, engikhohlakele ngazo, ngizobhekana nomuntu onjalo, futhi ngiwususe emlandweni wakhe.
Bangcwele ke, nibe ngcwele; ngoba ngingiNkosi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Nizigcine izimiso zami, nizisebenzele; ngiyami iNkosi owenza ukuba ngungcwele.
Uma umuntu ebulala ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe, kufanele abulawe; ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe usewubulale; kumele aphele.
Uma umuntu eqhatha ngenkosikazi yomunye umuntu, nenkosikazi yomngane wakhe, kumele bafa bonke, indodakazi nomfazi.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nendodana yobaba wakhe, ubekezela indodana yobaba wakhe; kumele babulawe bobabili. Kubo icala lokufa kwabo.
Uma umuntu ethandana nenkosikazi yakhe, kumele babulawe bobabili. Bakwenza okubi kakhulu; ukubulala kwabo kuzoba yingozi yabo.
Uma umuntu exhumana nowesifazane njengomuntu oxhumana nowesifazane, khona-ke bobabili bakwenze okubi kakhulu. Bazophoqwa ukufa. Ukufa kwabo kuzoba yicala labo.
Uma umuntu ethatha indodakazi yakhe noyise wakhe, kuyinto engalungile; kumele aqhunywe ngomlilo yena nodadewabo bonke, ukuze kungabekho okubi phakathi kwenu.
Uma umuntu exhumana ngesondo nenyama, kumele abulawa, futhi kufanele ubulala nenyama nayo.
Uma uwesifazane ehamba kumuntu ophilayo ukuze abe nezenzo zocansi naye, kufanele ubulala lowo muntu kanye nomuntu ophilayo. Kudingeka bafa. Ukufa kwabo kuyiphutha labo.

Uma umuntu ethatha inkosikazi yakhe, indodana yobaba wakhe, noma indodana yomama wakhe, bese bebona ikhanda lakhe, kuyinto engalungile; kumele bakhululwe phambi kwamadodana abo; ubeke ikhanda lenkosikazi yakhe emlonyeni wakhe; bazothwala isono sabo.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nendoda ngesikhathi se-hajj yakhe, futhi waveza isisu sakhe, futhi intombazane yabonisa isisu sayo, khona-ke kufanele bahlukaniswe phakathi kwabantu babo.
Uma uthandana nenkosikazi yomama wakho, noma nenkosikazi yobaba wakho, kufanele ugweme ukuzibophezela kulezi zinto, ngoba lokhu kuyingozi empilweni yakho.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nowesifazane wenkosikazi yomngane wakhe, umfana womngane wakhe usemfihlakele; bazothwala inkohliso yabo; bazofa bengenabantwana.
Uma umuntu ethatha indodakazi yomngane wakhe, kuyinto engcolileyo; umngane wakhe uphukile; ngeke babe nezingane.
Nizigcine izimiso zami zonke, nemibandela yami yonke, niyenze; ukuze izwe engikulethela lona ukuthi lihlale kulo, lingakuxosha.
Musani ukuhamba ngezimiso zezizwe, engizozisa phambi kwenu; ngenxa yokuthi bazenza zonke lezi zinto, ngakho ngazixolisa.
Ngithi kuni, Nizoyithola izwe labo libe yikhaya lenu; futhi ngizokulinika libe yikhaya lenu, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nojusi. Ngiye uNkulunkulu wenu iNkosi, owazikhethela phakathi kwamazwe.

Uzokwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwenyama ehlanzekile nenyama engahlanzekile, futhi phakathi kwezinyoni ezihlanzekile nezinyoni ezingahlanzekile, ukuze nize nigweme ukwenza inhliziyo yenu ibe yinhlekelele ngokudla nganoma iyiphi inhlanzi, noma izinyoni, noma izilwane ezihamba ngezinyawo, eniyihlukanisile kwenu njengezinto ezingahlanzekile.
Babe bangcwele ngami; ngoba mina, iNkosi, ngingcwele, futhi ngiyabahlukanisa nisuka ezizwe zonke, ukuze nibe ngiye.
Owesifazane noma owesifazane, uma ekhuluma nalabo abafileyo, noma enquma ikusasa labo, kumele abulawe; kufanele abulawe ngetshe. Ukufa kwabo kuyicala labo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ukhulume nababhishobhi, oonyana baka-Aron, uthi kubo, Akufanele umbhishobhi abe nenyama yomuntu ophilayo phakathi kwabantu bakhe, ukuze ahlanzeke;
ngaphandle komngane osonhlalakahle: ubaba wakhe, indodana yakhe, inkosikazi yakhe, udadewabo,
noma inkosikazi yakhe engabhishi, ehlala ngaphansi kwakhe, ngoba angeke abe nowesifazane; ngenxa yakhe angaba nesono.
Akudingeki ukuthi ahlanze ubuso bakhe ngezinto eziphathelene nomndeni wakhe, ukuze angasebenzi emisebenzini engcwele.
Abapristi ngeke baphuze ikhanda labo, noma baphuze amaphiko emilenze yabo, noma baphuze isisu sabo.
Bazobe bengcwele kuThixo wabo, bangabi namahloni igama lakhe; bazonikela ngenhlanhla yomlilo kaYehova, ukudla kukaThixo wabo; ngakho bazobe bengcwele.
Angeke athathe indodana yowesifazane, noma indodana yowesifazane engahlanzekile, noma indodana yowesifazane eshaywe ngumfazi wakhe; ngoba yena ungcwele kuThixo wakhe.
Ngiyakwenza abe ngungcwele kuwe, ngoba unikeza ukudla kukaThixo wakho; kufanele abe ngungcwele kuwe; ngoba ngingcwele mina, iNkosi, owenza nibe ngungcwele.
Uma indodakazi yompristi iphazamisa umndeni wayo, ibe yindodana yowesifazane, iphazamisa ubaba wakhe; kumele iqhutshwe emlilweni.

Omkhulu phakathi kwabazalwane bakhe, owafakwa phezu kwekhanda lakhe uphethiloli wokuncibilikisa, wahlukaniswa ukuba agqoke izicathulo zobungcwele bukambingeleli, ngeke avule izinwele zakhe, futhi ngeke aphuze izicathulo zakhe.
Akudingeki ukuthi afike kumuntu ofile, futhi akudingeki ukuthi abe necala ngenxa yobaba wakhe noma ngenxa yenkosi yakhe.

Akudingeki ukuthi aphume endaweni engcwele, abe nobuhlungu, ukuze angabi yingozi indawo engcwele kaThixo wakhe; ngoba uphethiloli wokuncibilikisa uMoya kaThixo wakhe unesibhakabhaka phezu kwakhe. Ngimi iNkosi.
Owesifazane owenza umtshali-zimali kumele abe yindodakazi.

Akudingeki ukuthi athathe indodakazi yowesifazane, noma intombazane eshaywe, noma intombazane engahlanjwanga, noma indodana yowesifazane; kodwa kufanele athathe indodakazi yowesifazane phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
ukuze agweme ukudlwengula izingane zakhe phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Ngiye iNkosi owenza abe ngcwele.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uHaroni, Uzokhuluma ku-Aron, utshilo ukuthi: Wonke umuntu othile emndenini wakho, uma enephutha, angeke afinyelele ukunikela ngokudla kukaThixo wakhe, kuze kube yiminyaka yonke.
Wonke umuntu onenkinga empilweni yakhe, ngeke afike; noma omnyama, noma ophithizelayo, noma onobuso obudlwengulayo, noma obomvu,
akukho mntu onenyawo noma isandla esifile,

akukho umuntu onekhanda elihlanganisiwe noma oncane kakhulu, akukho muntu onezinkinga zesibhakabhaka, isifo sesikhumba esicasulayo, noma izilonda, futhi akukho muntu ongaba nengxenye yakhe yobumfihlo elahlekile.
Wonke umuntu ovela emndenini ka-Aron, umbingeleli, uma enephutha, angeke afike anikela ngezipho zomlilo zikaYehova; ngoba kukhona iphutha kuye; ngeke afike anikela ukudla kukaThixo wakhe.
Uzodla ukudla kukaThixo wakhe, ukudla okungcwele kakhulu nokudla okungcwele.
Kodwa angeke afike emgodini, noma afike esibhedlela; ngoba kukhona okubi kuye, ukuze angabi nento engcwele yami; ngoba ngimi iNkosi oyenza ibe ngungcwele.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe, nabo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Usho ku-Aron namadodana akhe, ukuthi bagcine izinto ezingcwele zakwaSirayeli, abazinikela ngazo kimi; ukuze bangabi necala igama lami elingcwele: Ngiye iNkosi.

Uzothi kubo, Uma kukhona umuntu othile emndenini wenu, uma esengenawo uthuli, efinyelela ezinhlamvini ezingcwele, abazinikela ngazo izingane zakwaSirayeli kuYehova, yena lowo muntu uzosuswa phambi kwami; ngiyami iNkosi.

Nanoma yimuphi umuntu emndenini ka-Aron, uma enegciwane, noma isifo sokuphuma kwegazi emlonyeni wakhe, ngeke aphuze izinto ezingcwele, kuze kube sengathi uhlanzekile; nanoma ubani othintana nento enobungozi ngenxa yokufa, noma umuntu onesifo sokukhishwa kwegazi emlonyeni wakhe,
noma wonke umuntu othinta isilwane esihamba ngezinyawo esenza abe mnyama, noma umuntu owenza abe mnyama nganoma iyiphi indlela,
uzobe engcolile kuze kube semini; angadla lutho olungcwele, ngaphandle kokuthi ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi.
Uma ilanga liphuma, uzohlanzwa; futhi ngemuva kwalokho angadla izinto ezingcwele, ngoba yikudla kwakhe.
Akudingeki ukuthi aphuze inyama ethosiwe, noma ethosiwe izilwane ezifuywayo; ngoba lokhu kuzoba yingozi kuye. Ngiye iNkosi.
Bazogcina imithetho yami, ukuze bangabi necala, baphile ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwabo; ngiyami iNkosi owenza babe ngcwele.
Wonke umuntu ongaphandle kwendlu kambingeleli angeke aphuze izinto ezingcwele; noma ngubani ohlala nombingeleli, noma ngubani osebenza naye, angazidla.
Uma ke umpristi ethenga umuntu ngemali yakhe, lo muntu uzodla kuwo; nalabo abazalwa ekhaya lakhe nabo bazodla ukudla kwakhe.
Uma inkosikazi yompristi ishada nomuntu ongeke abe ngumpristi, ngeke akwazi ukudla izipho ezikhethekile ezisuka emithonjeni engcwele.

Uma indodakazi yompristi ibulawe, noma inqatshiwe, ingabi nendodana, yabuyela endlwini yobaba wakhe, iyadla ukudla kukababa wakhe, njengokuba wayencane; kodwa akukho muntu ongaphandle kwendlu yakhe ozodla kuwo.
Uma umuntu edla isonka esingcwele ngephutha, kufanele amnike umnikelo wesono esingcwele, kanye nengxenye yesihlanu.
Abaphazamisi kumele bagweme ukudlwengula izipho ezingcwele abantu bakaSirayeli abazinikela kuYehova.
ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuzidla, ukuze kube yingozi kubo; ngoba ngiyiNkosi eyenza ukuba ngcwele.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Usho ku-Aron, nabantwana bakhe, nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Wonke umuntu ovela ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma onqunywayo phakathi kwabaseSirayeli, uma enikela ngenhlanhla yakhe emlilweni womlilo kaYehova, nokuba ngumnikelo wakhe wesivivinyo, noma yisipho sakhe esikhululekile.
Ukuze kuvunyelwe kuwe, kumele kube yindoda yengulube, inkomo, noma inkomo engenanto embi ngayo.
Musa ukunikela nganoma yini engekho kahle ngayo, ngoba ngeke ivunyelwe kuwe.

Uma umuntu enikeza umnikelo wokuthula kuYehova, kufaka phakathi izinkomo noma izingulube, ukufeza isibopho sakhe, noma njengesibopho esikhululekileyo, kufanele sibe silungile, ukuze kuvunyelwe; ngeke kube nephutha kulo.

Akufanele ninikeze iNkosi isilwane esimnyama, noma esifile, noma esinamacala amancane, noma esinomkhuhlane, noma esinobuhlungu, noma esinamagciwane; akufanele nibeke ngazo zonke lezi zinto phezu kwesibingelelo, njengento yokunikela ngemlilo kukaNkulunkulu.
Ungakwazi ukunikela ngengulube noma inkomo enengxenye yesikhumba eside kakhulu noma esincane kakhulu, njengomnikelo onikezelwe ngokukhululekileyo, kodwa ngeke kuvunyelwe ukuba ugcine isinqumo.
Akufanele ninikeze iNkosi isilwane esiboshwe, noma esibiwe, noma esilahliwe, noma esicutshiwe; ngeke nikwenze lokhu ezweni lenu.
Ngiyakutshela ukuthi ngeke nizithathe kumuntu wesizwe, ukuze zibe ukudla kukaThixo wenu; ngoba kukhona okubi kuzo, kunenkinga ngazo; ngeke zithandeke kuwe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uma kuzalwa ingulube, noma inkomo, noma inkomo encane, izohlala ngosuku oluyisixhenxe noyise; kusukela mhla wesibhozo nangaphezulu kuzovunyelwa ukuba ibe yisonka esishiswayo iNkosi.
Ungayibulala inkomo noma ingulube ngosuku olufanayo nengane yayo.
Uma ninikela ngomnikelo wokubonga kuYehova, nizonikela ngayo ngendlela efanele, ukuze ivunyelwe kuwe.
Kuyodlalwa ngalolusuku olulodwa; ngeke nishiye lutho kulo kuze kube ubusuku. Ngimi iNkosi.
Zigcineni izimiso zami, nizisebenzele. Ngiye iNkosi.
Mhlawumbe ngeke niphuze igama lami elingcwele, ukuze ngibhekwe njengongcwele phakathi kwabazalwane bakaSirayeli. Ngiye iNkosi owenza kube ngcwele,
owazikhipha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngibe uNkulunkulu wenu. Ngiye iNkosi."
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo, usithi: Lawa masuku ami angcwele, amasonto kaYehova, okufanele nizimemezele njengezingqungquthela ezingcwele.

Izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili nizosebenza, kodwa usuku lwesine ngusuku lokuphumula, usuku lokuphumula oluphelele, usuku lokuhlangana olungcwele. Akukho msebenzi omele wenzeke ngalolu suku; liwusuku lokuphumula kukaNkulunkulu kuwo wonke amakhaya akho.
Lezi yizinsuku ezikhethekile zikaYehova, izingqungquthela ezingcwele, okufanele nizazise ngezikhathi zabo.
Usuku lwePasha lukaYehova luqala ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili lwenyanga yokuqala, lapho ilanga liphuma khona.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga, usuku lwezithelo ezingenawo umhluzi kukaNkulunkulu; usuku oluyisixhenxe nidla izithelo ezingenawo umhluzi.
Ngosuku lokuqala, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze lutho olujwayelekile.
Izinsuku eziyisithupha nizonikela ngenhlanhla ngomlilo kuYehova; ngosuku olusixhenxe kuzobe kukhona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi omusha.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo, uthi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni engikunika lona, futhi niyivuna imbewu yayo, nizoletha kumbingeleli inkomishi eyodwa yezinto zokuqala zembewu yenu.
Uzowushaya umquba phambi kweNkosi, ukuze uvunyelwe kuwe; ngosuku olulandelayo ngeSonto, uzowushaya umquba, ukuze uvumeleke kuwe.
Ngosuku olulodwa lokwethula inkomishi, kufanele ninikeze ingulube eneminyaka eyodwa ubudala, engabi necala, ibe yisonka esishiswayo kuYehova.
Nakho uzoba nesibopho sokudla, ilitha elilodwa lomhluzi omuncu oxhumene nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, njengephunga elimnandi, kanye nelitha elilodwa lomhluzi wokudla.

Ungadla inkomishi, noma imbewu ethosiwe, noma imbewu ehlanzekile, kuze kube yilapho ninikela ngayo umnikelo wokudla kuThixo wenu; kumele kube wumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside phakathi kosuku nosuku, kuzo zonke izindawo zendlu yenu.
Ngosuku olulandelayo iSabhati, ngosuku lapho niletha khona inkomishi yengulube yokuthuthuka, nizobala izinyanga eziyisithupha.
Uzobala izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili, kuze kube usuku olulandelayo ngeSonto lesixhenxe; khona-ke uzoletha umnikelo wokudla wembewu entsha kuYehova.

Nakwezinye izakhiwo zendlu yenu, nizothola amakhowe amabili okudla okunqunyelwe umnikelo wokudla, afakwe i-epha yobisi oluhlanzekile, aphekwe nge-lemongrass; kuzoba ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, ovela emidlalweni yembewu yenu.

Nase ulungiselele, kanye nenyama, izinkomo ezimbili ezineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, ezingabi nephutha, nomntwana omncane wesifazane owodwa, nezimvu ezimbili; zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, kanye nomnikelo wazo wokudla, nama-odolo abo okuphuza, isipho esiqhutshwa ngomlilo, isiphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uzonikela ngobhontshisi owodwa njengomnikelo wesono, nezingulube ezimbili ezineminyaka eyodwa ubudala, zibe yizipho zoxolo.
Umbingeleli uzozisakaza izinkomo ezimbili, kanye nenyama yezinto zokuqala zokuvuna, phambi kweNkosi; zingcwele kuYehova, zizobe ziwumnikelo wokudla kambingeleli.
Kuzobe kukhona isibingelelo esingcwele kulolu suku; ngeke nikwenze umsebenzi ojwayelekile. Kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside emindenini yenu yonke, kuwo wonke amadolobhana akho.

Uma nivuna izithelo zezwe lenu, ngeke nivune kuze kuphele isiphetho somhlaba wakho, futhi ngeke niqoqe imbewu ethosiwe; uzoyishiya yowesifazane nalowo ovela kwamanye amazwe. Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 21"Ukhulume nabantu bakaSirayeli uthi: Ngonyaka wesixhenxe ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga kumele kube khona usuku lokuphumula oluphelele; kufanele kube nengqungquthela engcwele yokukhumbuza ngezingcingo.
Akufanele nikwenze umsebenzi ojwayelekile, kodwa ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga yesixhenxe, ngusuku lokuxoshwa, usuku lokulungisa; kumele kube khona isibingelelo esingcwele; kufanele niphumule, ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Akukho msebenzi ozowenza ngalolusuku, ngoba ngusuku lokuxoshwa, ukuze ubuyiselwe kuYehova uNkulunkulu wakho.
Wonke umuntu ongeke ahlale engadla ukudla ngalolu busuku, kumele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Nalowo wonke umuntu owenza umsebenzi onke ngalolu suku, ngiwususa emphakathini wakhe.
Akufanele nisebenze lutho. Le yimithetho ehlala isikhathi eside yomndeni wenu wonke, lapho nihlala khona.
Izinsuku zeSabhati zokuphumula ezigcwele zizobe zikhona kuwe; ngeke nidle ukudla; kusukela ngemini yesithoba yenyanga, emini, kuze kube ekuseni, kumele nizigcine.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuSirayeli: "Kule nyanga yesixhenxe, ngomhla ka-15 wonyaka, izinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kuzoqala usuku lwezindlu zangasese loNkulunkulu.
Ngosuku lokuqala, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze lutho olujwayelekile.

Ngezinsuku ezisithupha ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova. Ngosuku lwesibhozo nibe nengqungquthela engcwele, ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova; kuyingqungquthela ekhethekile; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi ojwayelekile.

Lezi yizinsuku ezingcwele zikaYehova, omele nizimemezele zibe izingqungquthela ezingcwele, ukuze ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kukaNkulunkulu, isonka esiqhumayo, nesibopho sokudla, nezibopho zokudla, nezibopho zokuphuza, ngosuku ngalunye.
Lezo zinto zihlanganisa nezinsuku zokuphumula zikaYehova, nezipho zenu, nazo zonke izibopho zenu, nezibopho zenu ezithandekayo, niziveze kukaNkulunkulu.

Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesixhenxe, lapho nizoqoqa khona izithelo zezwe, kufanele nigcine isikhumbuzo sikaYehova izinsuku ezisithupha; usuku lokuqala kumele lube wusuku lokuphumula, futhi usuku lwesine kumele lube usuku lokuphumula.
Ngosuku lokuqala nizothatha ubisi oluhle lwezihlahla, amaqabunga omnqumo, namaqabunga akhanyayo, nama-willows asuka emfuleni; futhi nizojabulela phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wenu izinsuku ezisithupha.
Niyigcine izinsuku ezisixhenxe ngonyaka wonke, ibe ngusuku lokuphumula kuYehova; kube yisinqumo esihlala isikhathi eside phakathi komndeni wenu wonke. Kunyanga yesithupha niyigcine.
Nihlale ezindaweni zokuhlala usuku oluyisixhenxe. Wonke umuntu ozalwa eSirayeli kumele ahlale ezindaweni zokuhlala,
ukuze bakwazi izingane zenu ngemuva kwenu, ukuthi ngibeke amadodana aseSirayeli ezindaweni zokuhlala, lapho ngawakhipha ezweni laseYiputa; ngiyami iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli ngezinsuku zosuku lokuphumula likaYehova.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuSolomoni: "Ubatshele abantu bakaSirayeli ukuthi bakulethe uphethiloli ohlanzekile we-olive, okhishwe ngesandla, ukuze kwenziwe izibani, ukuze zihlale zishisa.

Esitezi sokubambisana, ngaphandle kwethenda elibhekene nebhokisi lesivumelwano, uAron kufanele agcine izibani zishisayo phambi koYehova, kusukela emini kuze kube ngasekuseni, njalo. Kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo bonke abahlobo bakho.
Uzogcina izibani zesibhakabhaka esihlanzekile, nsuku zonke, phambi koYehova.
Nciphisa umhluzi bese ubhaka izinkomishi ezingu-12, usebenzisa amakhilogremu amathathu omhluzi ngayinye.
Uzozibeka emgqeni owodwa, ezinhlanu emgqeni owodwa, phezu kwetafula legolide elihlanzekile phambi koYehova.
Uzobeka umnqumo ohlanzekile eduze komugqa ngamnye, ukuze kube yindawo yokukhumbula isonka, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Ngosuku ngalunye lwesiSonto kumele kube khona umnikelo wokudla obekwe phambi kukaNkulunkulu, nsuku zonke. Kuye kwaba ngumthetho wamaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kuzoba ngukudla kuka-Aron, nokudla kwamadodana akhe; bazokula endaweni engcwele. Yinto engcwele kakhulu phakathi kwezinto ezitholwe ngomlilo kuYehova, isinqumo sabo esihlala njalo.

Kwabe kukhona umuntu owesifazane waseSirayeli, futhi ubaba wakhe ubengumYiputa; waphuma waya phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, kwaqala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwakhe nowesifazane wesiSirayeli esikhungweni.
Wakhuluma unyana wale ndodakazi yaseSirayeli igama likaNkulunkulu, wathi: "Igama lami lihlanzekile." Bamwisela kuMoses. Igama lonina lalinguShelomithi, intombi kaDibri, waseDhani.
Babeka ngaphansi kwengcindezi, kuze kube yilapho iNkosi awazise khona ukuthi bakwenzeni.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhipha umprofeti ngaphandle kwesiqhingi; bonke abakubonayo babeke izandla zabo phezu kwekhanda lakhe, futhi ibandla lonke ligweme.
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, ukusho ukuthi, Wonke umuntu obulala uNkulunkulu wakhe, uzothwala isono sakhe.
Wonke umuntu okhuluma ngegama likaYehova, kufanele aphele; ibandla lonke kumele ligweme. Uma ekhuluma ngegama lakhe, noma ngabe ungumzweli, noma ngabe uzalwa kulo mhlaba, kufanele aphile.
Wonke umuntu obulala omunye umuntu kumele abulawa.
Wonke umuntu obulala inhlanzi yomuntu kufanele ayibuyisele, impilo ngempilo.
Uma umuntu ebulala umngane wakhe, kufanele kwenzeke kuye okufanayo nokwenza kwakhe:
ithambo elibusayo ngethambo elibusayo, intamo ngesandla, inkomo ngengulube; nanoma yikuphi ukudlwengula akwenzayo, kumele kwenziwe kuye.
Uma umuntu ebulala inhlanzi, kumele ayibuyisele; kodwa uma umuntu ebulala umuntu, kufanele abulawa.
Umthetho owodwa uzobe ukhona phakathi kwenu, phakathi komhlali nomuntu ozalwa kulo mhlaba; ngimi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bathi: "Bamkhipha ngaphandle kwesiqhingi lowo obulalayo, bamwisela amatshe, wafa." Bakwenza njalo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wakhuluma iNkosi kuMoses emfuleni iSina, wathi,
Uthi uMosis kuSolomoni: "Ukhulume nabantu bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: 'Uma nifika ezweni engikunika lona, izwe lizophumula, libe yiSabhati kaYehova.
iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili uzotshala izitshalo zakho, futhi uzomisa izivini zakho, futhi uzoqoqa imbewu yazo.

Kodwa ngonyaka wesixhenxe kumele ube wusuku lokuphumula oluphelele lwezwe, usuku lokuphumula kukaNkulunkulu; awukwazi ukutshala izihlahla zakho kulo nyaka, futhi awukwazi ukusika izimbali zakho zewayini.
Uma uvuna imbewu ekhula ngayo, ungayiqoqi, futhi uma uvuna izithelo zesihlahla sakho sewayini esingeke sihlolwe, ungaziqoqi; kumele kube ngunyaka wokuphumula kwezwe.
Wonke umkhiqizo ovela ezweni ngesikhathi sosuku lwakhe lokuphumula uzoba ukudla kwenu, nani nabangani bakho, nabangani benu, nalabo abasebenza ngemali yenu, nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Kuzoba yindawo yokudla yezilwane zakho, nezilwane eziphila ezweni lakho; konke okuvela kuyo kuzodlalwa.
Uzobala iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili yesiSonto, iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili kanye neminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye.
Ngonyaka wesixhenxe, ngomhla wamashumi wenyanga yesishiyagalombili, uzophonsa isibhamu esinamandla; ngemini yokuhlanza, uzophonsa isibhamu ezweni lakho lonke.

Uzomisa unyaka oyisishiyagalombili, ube ngusuku olungcwele; uzomemezela inkululeko ezweni lonke, kuwo wonke umuntu ohlala kulo. Lo nyaka uzobe wumnyaka weshumi nesishiyagalombili kwenu; nizobuya niya ezweni lemindeni yenu, niye ezindlini zemindeni yenu.

Unyaka oyisishiyagalombili uzobe ngumnyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye kuwe; ngeke nitshale, futhi ngeke nikhulise lokho okukhulela ngokuzimela, futhi ngeke niqoqe izithelo zezimbali zesilimo esingenakulinywa.
Yiminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, ibe ngusuku olungcwele kuwe. Ukudla kwakho kufanele kube yizinto eziphilayo zesihlabathi.
Kulesi sikhathi sonyaka omusha, wonke umuntu phakathi kwenu kufanele abuye ezweni lakhe.
Uma uthengisa izwe umngane wakho, noma uma uthenga izwe kuye, awudingi ukukhohlisa.
Uma uthenga kusuka kumngane wakho, hlela intengo ngenani leminyaka kusukela kwiJubilee edlule. Uzohlela izindleko zakhe zokuthengisa ngokuya ngenani lokudla okusele.
Uma kuneminyaka eminingi esele, intengo iyaphezulu. Uma kuneminyaka embalwa kuphela esele, intengo iyaphansi. Okusho ukuthi uthengisa inani lezithelo.
Mhlawumbe nizokhohlisana, kodwa nigweme uNkulunkulu wenu; ngoba ngingiNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Nizigcine izimiso zami, nizigcine imithetho yami, futhi nihlale ezweni eliphephile.
Izwe lizonikela ngembewu yayo, nidla ngokugcwele inhliziyo yenu, nihlale khona niphephile.
Uma nithi, Sizodla kuphi ngonyaka wesixhenxe, uma singatshalanga, siyiqoqa kanjani imbewu yethu?
Ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili ngizokulethela insindiso yami phezu kwenu, ukuze izwe likhiqize izithelo zeminyaka emithathu.
Uma utshala ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili, uzoqhubeka nokudla izithelo zakudala. Uzoqhubeka nokudla ukudla okudala kuze kube yilapho imbewu yonyaka wesithoba ifika.
Izwe alithengiswe kangako, ngoba izwe lingane yami; niyimihlali nabangani engangihlala nabo.
Kuyo yonke indawo ezweni lakho, kufanele uvumele ukuthi izwe lithengiswe kabusha.
Uma umuntu othile phakathi kwenu efisa ukuthengisa ingxenye yembewu yakhe, kufanele afike umngane wakhe ongasekho futhi athenge.
Uma engeke abe nomuntu ozoyithenga kabusha, kodwa ekugcineni akwenze kahle futhi abe nemali eyaneleyo yokuyithenga kabusha yena,
uzobala iminyaka edlule kusukela lapho athengise khona, futhi ubuyisele umuntu owathengisa kuye izindleko zeminyaka esele; bese ubuyela ezweni lakhe.
Uma engakwazi ukuyothenga, khona-ke le ndawo izohlala yomuntu othengise yona kuze kube yiminyaka yenkulumo enkulu; ngonyaka wenkulumo enkulu izobuyiselwa kuye, aze abuye ezweni lakhe.
Uma umuntu ethengisa indlu emzini onezindonga, uzoba nonyaka owodwa ogcwele ngemuva kokuthengiswa kwayo ukuthi ayithengise kabusha. Uzokwazi ukuyithenga emuva ngonyaka owodwa.

Uma kungekho ukubuyiselwa kulo nyaka wonke, khona-ke ikhaya elisemaphandleni elinezindonga lizohlala liyimpahla yomuntu othengayo, nomndeni wakhe ngemuva kwakhe, kuze kube yiminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili; ngeke libuyiselwe.
Kodwa izindlu ezindaweni ezingenazingqalasizinda, zibhekwa njengezitshalo zendawo yasendle; zingathengwa futhi, kufanele zibuyiselwe emkhosini wonyaka omusha.
Kodwa-ke, labo abaLevi bangathenga kabusha izakhiwo zabo ezindaweni zabo zokuhlala.

Uma ikhaya likaLevi lithengiswe, futhi lingabuyiselwa emuva, noma yikuphi phakathi kwamadolobha abo, kufanele liphinde libuyiselwe emuva ngonyaka weshumi nesishiyagalombili; ngoba izindlu zezindawo zakwaLevi ziyindawo yabo yobunikazi phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Kodwa imifula yabo, nezindawo zabo zokudlela ezijikeleze idolobhana labo, ngeke zithengiswe; ngoba yindawo yabo ehlala kuyo.
Uma umuntu esinye sezingxenye zenu etholakale emnothweni futhi engakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zakhe, khona-ke umnikeze usizo; ahlale nawe njengomuntu ovela kwelinye izwe noma njengomhambi.
Musa ukuwubeka phezu kwakhe umshwalense, noma uthathe inzuzo kuye; kodwa ugweme uNkulunkulu wakho, ahlale phakathi kwakho.
Ungamnikezi imali ngemvuzo, futhi ungamthengi ukudla ukuze uthole inzuzo.
Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, owazikhuphule ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngikunike izwe likaKanana, ngibe uNkulunkulu wenu.
Uma umuntu esinye sezingxenye zenu efisa ukuhweba ngokwakhe kuwe, akufanele ukwenze abe ngumkhonzi.
Uzosebenza naye njengomuntu okhokhelwa umsebenzi, noma njengomhambi ohlala nawe; uzosebenzela wena kuze kube ngunyaka weminyaka emibili.
Uzokwazi ukuphuma kuwe, yena nobantwana bakhe, babuye emndenini wabo, bebuyela ezweni lababa babo.
Bami abantu bakaSirayeli, abakhonzi bam, abaye baphuma ezweni laseYiputa; ngeke bathengiswe njengamakhoboka.
Musa ukumlawula ngokubi, kodwa ukhathazeke ngoNkulunkulu wakho.
Amakhosikazi akho namadodakazi akho azovela ezizweni ezingcezu zenu; kuzona uzothenga amakhosikazi.
Nasezinganeni zabanye abantu abahlala phakathi kwenu, nizothenga kubo, nasezintwini zabo ezizalwa ezweni lenu; futhi bazobe yimpahla yenu.
Uzokwazi ukuzishiya zibe yimpahla yabantwana bakho ngemuva kwakho, bahlale besebenza kuwe nsuku zonke; kodwa ngeke ugweme ukuphatha abazalwane bakho ngesandla esibi.
Uma umuntu ovela kwelinye izwe, noma umuntu ohlala ezweni lakho, ethola ubuhle, futhi omunye wabangane bakho, uma ethola ububi, ethengisa yena kuye, noma kulowo muntu ovela kwelinye izwe.
Uma ethengiswe, khona-ke uzokwazi ukubuyiselwa emuva; omunye wabangane bakhe angawuthenga kabusha.
noma umyeni wakhe, noma inkosikazi yakhe, noma omunye omndenini wakhe. Okanye uma ethola izimali, angazikhokhela.

Uzobala iminyaka yakhe, yena nomuntu owathengayo, kusukela ngonyaka lapho wathengisa khona ngokwakhe, kuze kube ngunyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Intengo yokukhululwa kwakhe izomiswa ngokuya ngenani leminyaka, njengokuba wayekhokhelwa njengomsebenzi okhokhelwayo ngalo nyaka.
Uma sekusele iminyaka eminingi, kufanele abuyisele emuva ingxenye enkulu yentengo ayethengwa ngayo.
Uma ihlala iminyaka embalwa kuphela kuze kube yiminyaka yosuku lokuzalwa, kufanele ayibalo futhi abuyisele inani elincane, ngokuya ngeminyaka ekhona.
Kudingeka athathwe njengomsebenzi osebenza ngonyaka nonyaka. Kudingeka uqiniseke ukuthi umnikazi wakhe akalawulanga ngaye ngokubi.
Uma engabuyiselwa nganoma iyiphi yalezi ndlela, khona-ke kufanele aphume yena nezingane zakhe ngonyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.
Ngokuba izingane zakwaSirayeli ziyimisebenzi yami; ziyimisebenzi yami, ngazikhipha ezweni laseYiputa. Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.

Mhlawumbe ngeke nikwenze izigodlo-mlilo, noma nibeke isithombe esicwebezelayo, noma isibonisi, noma nibeke ezweni lenu itshe elicwebezelayo, ukuze nizibophezele kulo; ngoba ngimi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
Zigcineni izinsuku zami zokuphumula, niyihlole indawo yami engcwele. Ngiye iNkosi.
Uma nihamba ngezimiso zami, nithobe imiyalo yami,
Ngizokulethela imvula ngesikhathi sayo, futhi izwe lizonikeza izithelo zayo, namajikijolo ezindaweni zomhlaba azonikela ngembewu yawo.

Uma uvuna izithelo zakho, uzozigcina kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvuna imbewu; futhi uma uvuna imbewu yakho, uzozigcina kuze kube yisikhathi sokulima. Uzodla ukudla okugcwele, futhi uzohlala ezweni lakho ngokuphephile.
Ngizobeka ukuthula ezweni, futhi nizophumula, futhi akukho muntu ozokukhathaza; ngizosusa izinyamazane ezibulalayo ezweni, futhi umkhosi awuzodlula ezweni lenu.
Uzolandela izitha zakho, futhi bazobulawa ngekhebula phambi kwakho.
Abantu abahlanu phakathi kwenu bazolandela amakhulu, futhi abantu abangukhulu phakathi kwenu bazolandela amawaka angama-10. Abaphikisi bakho bazobulawa ngeqhwa phambi kwenu.
Ngizobhekana nawe, futhi ngizokwenza ube mkhulu, futhi ngizokwenza ukhule, futhi ngizogcina umnqophiso wami nawe.
Uzohlala udla izithelo zonyaka odlule uma ufuna ukuzihlanza ukuze wenze indawo yezitshalo ezintsha.
Ngizobeka ikhaya lami phakathi kwenu, futhi ngeke ngikushiye.
Ngizohamba phakathi kwenu, futhi ngizoba uNkulunkulu wenu, nibe abantu bam.
Ngimi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, owazikhuphule ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ningabi ngabakhonzi babo; futhi ngibopha izintambo ezishisayo ezandleni zenu, ngakwenza nihambe ngekhanda liphakeme.
Uma ke ningangilalela, nikwenze la mazwi onke,
uma niyikhohlisa imibandela yami, noma ningathandabuzi izimiso zami, noma ningeke nigcine yonke imiyalelo yami, ukuze niphuze umnqophiso wami;

Ngizokwenza lokhu kuwe: ngizokulethela ubuhlungu obungenakulindeleka, isifo esibulalayo, negciwane elibulalayo, ukuze amehlo akho aphuze, futhi umoya wakho uphuze. Uzotshala isitshalo sakho ngaphandle kokudla, ngoba izitha zakho zizozidla.
Ngizobhekana nawe, futhi izitha zakho zizokunqoba; labo abakukhohlisayo bazokuba ngubukhosi bakho; futhi uzohamba, nakuba akukho ozokulandela.
Uma nami, nalokhu konke, ningilalelanga, ngizokuzibophezela kuni ngokuphindaphindiwe izikhathi ezisixhenxe ngenxa yezinkohliso zenu.
Ngizophula ikhono lakho eliphakeme, futhi ngizokwenza ukuthi umoya ophezulu kwakho ube njengensimbi, angabi nemvula; futhi indawo engaphansi kwakho ibe namandla afana negolide.
Zonke izenzo zesandla sakho zizoba yingozi, ngoba izwe lakho alizosinikeza isitshalo sayo, namajikijolo akho ngeke athole ubisi lwawo.
Uma niqhubeka nihamba ngami, futhi ningathandanga ukungilalela, ngizokuzibophezela ekuphileni kwenu izibulala-zinambuzane izikhathi ezisixhenxe, ngokwezinkohliso zenu.
Ngizothumela phakathi kwenu izinyamazane zendabuko, zithathe izingane zenu, ziqhekeze izinkomo zenu, zibe nenani elincane kuwe; futhi imizila yenu izoba yindawo yokungena.
Uma, futhi ngemuva kwalezi zinto, ngeke nibuye ngami, kodwa nizoqhubeka nihamba ngokuphikisana nami;
futhi ngizohamba ngaphezu kwenu; futhi ngizokuhlasela nani kathathu namashumi asixhenxe ngenxa yezinsolo zenu.

Ngizokulethela inkohlakalo phezu kwenu, ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa komnqophiso wami; futhi uma niphuma ezindaweni zenu, ngizothumela ubhubhane phakathi kwenu, futhi nizobekwa esidlangalaleni ezimpini zenu.
Kuze kube yilapho ngizokucisha khona inkomishi yenu yokudla, besifazane abalishumi baya kubhaka ubisi lwakho emgodini owodwa; futhi bazokubuyisela ngosayizi; uzodla, kodwa ngeke uzidle.
Uma, ngalokhu konke, ningeke ningilalela, kodwa nizoqhubeka nihamba ngaphezu kwami;
futhi ngizohamba ngamehlo ami enhliziyweni yami; futhi ngizokuphoqelela izinsuku ezisixhenxe ngenxa yezinto zenu.
Uzodla inyama yamadodana akho namakhosikazi akho.
Ngizophula izindlu zenu eziphakeme, futhi ngizobopha izingosi zenu zomlilo, futhi ngizobeka izicubu zenu phezu kwezicubu zezicubu zezinhlamvu zenu, futhi ngizobuya ngami enhliziyweni yami.
Ngizozenza izifundazwe zenu zibe yizikhukhula, nezindawo zenu ezingcwele zibe yindawo elahlekile; futhi ngeke ngijabulele iphunga elimnandi lezinto zenu.
Ngizoyenza izwe lakho libe yindawo engenalutho, ukuze nabo bonke abasolwa bakho abafikayo ukuba bahlale kuyo, bakhathazeke.
Ngizokusakaza phakathi kwezizwe, futhi ngizokhipha ikhebula lami, ngizokulandela; izwe lakho lizoba yindawo elahlekile, namadolobha akho azoba yizikhukhula.
Ngazo zonke izinsuku lapho izwe lihlala khona elingenalutho, nisezweni labangani benu, lizojabulela iminyaka yayo yesiSonto; izwe lizophumula, lizojabulela iziSonto zayo.
Isikhathi sonke lapho ihlala khona ingasebenzi, izokwazi ukuphumula njengoba bekungazange kwenzeke eminyakeni yenu yeSabhati lapho nihlala khona.

Nalabo abasele phakathi kwenu, ezweni labathandi bakho, ngizobaphazamisa; futhi iphunga lembewu elifihliwe emkhathini lizobaphazamisa; futhi bazophazanyiswa njengephazamiseka kweqhwa, futhi bazowela, nakuba akukho ozowalandela.
Bazophoqeleka ukuba bahambe ngabanye, njengabahamba phambi kweqhwa, naphezu kokuba akukho ozowalandela; futhi ngeke nikwazi ukumelana nabaphikisi benu.
Uzofa phakathi kwezizwe, futhi izwe labathandi bakho lizokutholisa.
Nalabo abasele phakathi kwenu, bazophuza igazi labo ezweni labathandi benu, ngenxa yobubi babo, futhi ngenxa yobubi bamababa abo.
Bazovuma ubugebengu babo, nobugebengu bamababa abo, ngokwenza okubi ngami, futhi behamba ngokuphikisana nami;
futhi, uma inhliziyo yabo ephakeme ihamba phansi, futhi bathathe ukuvinjwa kwabo ngenxa yobubi babo,
Ngizokhumbula isivumelwano sami noYakobi, futhi isivumelwano sami noIsake, futhi isivumelwano sami noAbrahamu; ngizokhumbula nezwe.

Izwe lizoshiywa libe yindawo elahlekile ngenxa yabo, lijabulele izinsuku zayo zokuphumula, uma lihlala lilahlekile ngaphandle kwabo; futhi labo bazozizwa beshonile ngenxa yobugebengu babo, ngenxa yokuthi bagweme izimiso zami, futhi bazixolele izenzo zam.

Nokho nalapho, lapho bekhona ezweni lababushizi babo, ngeke ngibaphuze, noma ngibabandezele, kuze kube wukuphela kwabo, kuze kube wukuphelelwa umnqophiso wami nabo; ngoba ngiwuYehova uNkulunkulu wabo.
Ngizokhumbula, ngenxa yabo, umnqophiso wami nababa babo, abebephuma ezweni laseYiputa phambi kwezizwe zonke, ukuze ngibe uNkulunkulu wabo; mina uNkulunkulu.
Lawa amalungiselelo, namasiko, nezimiso, akhuluma ngazo iNkosi emfuleni iSina, ngesandla sikaMoses, phakathi kwakhe nomndeni kaSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Uma umuntu enikela ngesipho esikhethekile, ukuthi anikezele umuntu kuYehova, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso lakhe.
Uma umuntu eneminyaka engu-20 kuya ku-60 ubudala, isisindo sakhe kufanele sibe ngamaphesenti angama-50 wegolide, ngokuya ngenani elisemthethweni lendawo enhle.
Uwesifazane onobude obunjalo, ixabiso elisetshenzisiwe liyingxenye ezingu-30 zesiliva.
Kumuntu oneminyaka emihlanu kuya kwengu-20 ubudala, inani elisetshenzisiwe liyizingxenye eziyisishiyagalombili zegolide lowesifazane nozinhlamvu ezilishumi zomfana.
Ngengane eneminyaka engunyaka owodwa kuya kweyisihlanu ubudala, inani elisetshenzisiwe liyizingxenye eziyisishiyagalombili zesiliva lowesifazane kanye nezingxenye ezintathu zegolide lentombazane.
Uma umuntu eneminyaka engu-60 ubudala noma ngaphezulu, ixabiso elisetshenzisiwe liyizinhlamvu ezingu-15 zesilivere kumuntu wesifazane kanye nezingcezu eziyisishiyagalombili kwabesifazane.

Uma umuntu encane kakhulu, angeke akwazi ukukhokha inani elilinganiselwe, kufanele afike kumbingeleli, futhi umbingeleli azolilinganisela; umbingeleli uzolilinganisela ngokuya ngalokho owenza isibopho.
Uma isinqumo siyinyama evunyelwe umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, khona-ke noma iyiphi lenyama enikezwe iNkosi izobe iyingcwele.
Akudingeki ukuthi ayishintshe noma ayiguqule, engcono ngenye ebi noma ebi ngenye ebi. Uma eshintsha inyamazane enye ngenye, khona-ke inyamazane kanye nenyamazana elishintshiwe lizoba ngcwele.
Uma umnikelo wakho wokudla ube yinyama engalungile, engeke inikezelwe kukaNkulunkulu, kufanele uyiveze kumpristi.
Umbingeleli uzothi uma kulungile noma kubi, lokho okusho umbingeleli kumele kube yiqiniso.
Uma umnikazi efuna ukuyithenga kabusha, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesithupha.

Uma umuntu enikela ngendlu yakhe ibe ngumnikelo ongcwele kuYehova, khona-ke umbingeleli uzoyilinganisela, ukuthi iyilungile yini noma ayibi; njengoba umbingeleli egcizelela ngayo, njalo kufanele ihlukaniswe.
Uma lowo owanikela ngendlu efuna ukuyithenga kabusha, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesishiyagalombili yazo, bese izobe yakhe.

Uma umuntu enikela ngengxenye yendawo yakhe yomndeni wakhe kuYehova, khona-ke kufanele ubalolwe ngokwenani lembewu elidingekayo ukutshala kuyo: amaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili esiliva ngamakhulu amabili amashumi amane amalitha embewu yeshubhu.
Uma enikeza indawo yakhe kunyaka we-Jubilee, inani eliphelele leset likhona.

Uma enikeza indawo yakhe ngemuva konyaka omusha, khona-ke umbingeleli kufanele alinganise intengo yayo ngokuya ngenani leminyaka elisele kuze kube ngunyaka omusha olandelayo; futhi ixabiso lakhe lizoncishiswa.
Uma lowo owanikela ngendawo efuna ukuyithenga kabusha, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesishiyagalombili, futhi izobe yakhe.
Kodwa uma akayithenga kabusha indawo, noma uma ithengiswe omunye umuntu, ayikwazi ukuthengwa emuva.
Uma isitshalo siphuma enyaka omusha, kufanele sibe ngcwele kuYehova, njengesitshalo esinikezwe umnikelo wokudla; kumele ibe yiyo yamaLevi.
Uma umuntu enikela kukaNkulunkulu indawo athengise yona, engase ibe yindawo yomndeni wakhe,
umbingeleli uzobala isilinganiso sayo kuze kube ngunyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Umuntu kufanele akhokhele le ntengo ngalolusuku olulodwa, njengomnikelo ongcwele kuYehova.
Ngonyaka we-Jubilee, indawo izobuyela kumuntu owathenga yona kuye, umuntu obeyindawo yemindeni yakhe.
Zonke izibalo ezisetshenzisiwe kufanele zisebenzise ubunzima obusemthethweni bendawo engcwele, amasisindo ancane angama-20 kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yegolide.
Kodwa umuntu angeke anikeze umzali wesifazane wenyama, ngoba umzali wesifazane nguwe iNkosi; noma ngabe ingulube, noma ngabe inkomo, yiyo yoNkulunkulu.

Uma kuyinyama engahlanzekile, umnikazi ungayithenga kabusha ngokukhokha ixabiso layo elisetshenzisiwe kanye nengxenye yesihlanu engaphezulu. Uma ingathengiswanga emuva, kufanele ithengiswe ngentengo yayo esetshenzisiwe.

Uma umuntu enikela ngokugcwele kuYehova ngezinto zakhe, nokuba ngumuntu, noma ibe yinyama, noma ibe yindawo yomndeni wakhe, ngeke ithengiswe, futhi ngeke ibuyiselwe; yonke into enikezwe ngokugcwele ngale ndlela ingcwele kakhulu kukaNkulunkulu.
Uma umuntu enikezelwe ukufa, ngeke kubuyiselwe emuva; kumele abulawe ngokugcwele.
Ishumi lazo zonke izinto ezikhiqizwa yizwe, nokuba yimbewu yezulu noma imbewu yomthi, liyilungelo likaYehova; lingcwele kukaNkulunkulu.
Uma umuntu efuna ukuthenga emuva noma iyiphi yeshumi lakhe, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesihlanu.
Ishumi elilodwa lengulube, neshumi elilodwa lembuzi, kanye neshumi elilodwa lazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezidlula ngezansi kwentambo yomlimi, uma zibalwa, zizongcwele kuYehova.

Umnikazi awudingi ukuhlukanisa olungile nobi, futhi awudingi ukuguqula noma iyiphi yazo. Uma eguqula enye, khona-ke isilwane kanye nalokho okushintshwe ngaso kuzobe kungcwele; ngeke zibuyiselwe emuva.
Lokho wumthetho iNkosi abewisela ngawo uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, emfuleni iSina.
Num: Kwathi ngonyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo ezweni laseYiputa, ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesibili, iNkosi wathi kuMoses, emfuleni iSina, esitezi sokuhlangana, esithi,
Ukubalwa kwamadodana kaSirayeli konke, ngomndeni wabo, ngemindeni yabo; ukubalwa kwegama ngalinye lowesifazane, ngomlomo wakhe,
bonke abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini ezweni laseSirayeli; wena noAron nibala labo ngokwemikhosi yabo.
Owesifazane oyedwa wesizwe ngasinye, umholi weqembu lakhe lemindeni yakhe, uzokusiza.
Lawona amagama amadoda azosebenza nawe: eRubheni, uElisuri unyana kaShedeure.
kuSimeoni, uShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishadai.
kuYuda, uNahshon unyana ka-Aminadabhi.
ku-Issakhar, uNathaneli unyana kaSuwari.
KwaZebulun, nguEliyaba unyana kaHeloni.
Ngabo oonyana bakaYosefu: ngaseEphrayim, uElishama unyana ka-Amihudi; ngaseManase, uGamaliyeli unyana ka-Pedasuri.
kuBhenjamini, uAbidan unyana kaGideoni.
KwaDani, nguAhiezer unyana ka-Ammisadai.
ku-Ashere, nguPagiyeli unyana ka-Okran.
KwaGadi, nguEliyasaphe unyana kaDeuyeli.
ENaphtali, ngu-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.
Lawa madoda athathwe engqungqutheleni, abe yibo abaphathi bezizwe zabazali babo; babe yibo abaphathi bemikhosi yamaSirayeli.
UMoses no-Aron bathatha labo madoda abizwa ngegama,

Kwathi ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesibili, bahlangana bonke abantu; futhi babhaliswa ngokwemindeni yabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo; wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu wabhalwa ngegama lakhe.
Wababala uMoses esiqhingi saseSinai, njengoba iNkosi abemwisele umthetho ngawo.

NgoweRubhen, omkhulu kwabaSirayeli; bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu, abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana kaRubhen, labo ababalwa kubo, babe ngamaphesenti angama-46 namakhulu amane.
AbakwaSimeoni, bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, labo abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana kaSimeoni, labo ababalolwe kubo bayizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili namashumi amathathu.
Kumadodana kaGadi, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, ongakwazi ukuphuma emkhosini, wahlukaniswa ngegama lakhe, ngohlobo lwakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Amadodana kaGadi, labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-45 namakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye.
Abafazi bakaSirayeli, bonke abaneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amanani abo, ababalolwe ezweni likaYuda, ayizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili nesikhombisa namashumi mane.
Abafazi baka-Issakare, bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana ka-Issakhar, labo ababalolwe kubo, babe ngumakhulu amahlanu anamashumi amane namawaka amabili nane.

Ezweni lakwaZabuloni, ngomndeni wakwaZabuloni, ngamadodakazi abo, ngemindeni yabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo, ngokwezinani zabo, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu ongakwazi ukuphuma emkhosini.
Amadodana kaZebuloni, labo ababalolwe kubo beyishumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye amawaka nekhulu.

Ngomndeni wakwaSirayeli, ngomndeni ka-Efrayim, ngamadodakazi kaYosefu, aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngezizwe zabo, ngemindeni yabo, ngokwemindeni yabo.
Amadodana ka-Ephrayimi, labo ababalolwe kubo belikhulu elinamakhulu mane.
Abafazi bakaManase, abahlukaniswe ngezizwe zabo, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wakwababa babo, ngamagama abo, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, ongaba khona ezweni.
Amadodana kaManase, labo ababalolwe kubo, babe ngamaphesenti angama-32 namakhulu amabili.
Ngabo bonke abazalwane bakaBhenjamini, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala noma ngaphezulu, ongakwazi ukuphuma emkhosini, wabhalwa ngegama lakhe, ngamunye ngohlobo lwakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Amanani abo, ababalolwe ezweni likaBhenjamini, ayizinkulungwane eziyisithathu nesishiyagalombili namakhulu amane.
Abafazi bonke abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke ababili abakwaziyo uku inteliga emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
labo ababalolwe kubo, ezweni likaDani, kwaba ngumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anamashumi amabili nanye amahlanu.
Ngabo bonke abazalwane baka-Ashere, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, ongaba khona ezweni, wabhalwa ngegama lakhe, ngohlobo lwakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Amadodana ka-Asere, labo ababhekwa kubo beyishumi nambili elilodwa nenkulungwane namahlanu.
Abafazi baka-Naphtali, bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, labo abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana kaNaphethali, labo ababalolwe kubo, kwaba ngumakhulu mane anamashumi amahlanu nathathu amawaka, anamakhulu amane.
Lokho kulabo ababalolwe nguMoses no-Aron, ngesandla samabhishobhi aseSirayeli alishumi elinambini, ngalowo mzali wesifazane.
Bonke abantu baseSirayeli abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswe ngezindlu zababa babo.
Inani eliphelele lalingumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, amashumi amathathu ananye amakhulu amane nesihlanu.
Kodwa amaLevi, ngokwesizwe sakwababa babo, awabalwa phakathi kwabo.
UNkulunkulu wathi kuMosesi,
Usukuzwe lwakwaLevi ungalibala, ungayihlanganisa nenani lamadodana kaSirayeli.

Uzobeka amaLevi esikoleni esingcwele, lapho kugcinwa khona umthetho womthetho wesivumelwano, nezinto zayo zonke, nezimpahla zayo zonke. Bazothwala isikolo esingcwele, nezinto zayo zonke; bazoyilungisa, futhi bazohlala ezindaweni ezishisayo ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Uma itabernakele ihamba, labo abaLevi bazoyisusa, futhi uma ibekwe, labo abaLevi bazoyimisa; noma ubani ongeke afinyelele kuyo, kufanele abulawa.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bazomisa amatende abo, wonke umuntu esitezi sakhe, futhi ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka sakhe, ngokwemikhosi yabo.

Kodwa amaLevi azohlala ezindaweni zokucampana ezijikeleze itente elingcwele, lapho kugcinwa khona umthetho womhlangano, ukuze kungabikho ubuhlungu phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ngoba amaLevi kumele agcine itenti elisha.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bakwenza njalo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,

Abantu bakaSirayeli basuke behlala ezindaweni zokucampana ezijikeleze itente lengqungquthela, ngaphesheya kwayo; wonke umuntu ahlale ezindaweni zakhe zokucampana ngaphansi kwebhande lakhe, ngebhande lomndeni wakhe.
Ngasenyakatho, ngaphesheya kokuphuma kwelanga, kuzohlala itente likaSirayeli ngemikhosi yawo; futhi uNahashon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi, uzobe nguMengameli wabo bonke abantu baseSirayeli.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linamaphesenti angama-74,000 namakhulu ayisithupha.
Ngasohlangothini lwawo kuzohlala isizwe sika-Issakha; uNethaneli, unyana ka-Zuare, uzobe nguMengameli wabo.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-54, izikhulu ezine.
Usuku lomndeni wakwaZabuloni luzofika; umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaZabuloni uElibha, unyana kaHeloni.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-57, izinkulungwane ezine.
Wonke umkhawulo wesitezi sikaYuda, ngokwemikhosi yawo, ngumakhulu amabili anamashumi asibhozo anesithandathu amawaka, namakhulu amane; bazohamba kuqala.
Ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga kuzoba khona isibhakabhaka somkhosi kaRubhen, ngokuya ngemikhosi yawo; futhi uMengameli wamaRubheni uzobe nguElisuri unyana kaShedeure.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linamaphesenti angama-46,000 angu-500.
Kuzohlala eduze kwabo isizwe sakwaSimeoni; uShelumiyeli, unyana kaZurishaddai, uzobe nguMengameli wamadodana kaSimeoni.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-59 namakhulu amathathu.
Usuku lwesizwe sikaGadi luzofika, futhi umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaGadi uEliasafo unyana kaRehuyeli.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-45, izinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wonke amanani asesiteji sikaRubhen, ngokwemikhosi yawo, ngumakhulu amane anamashumi amahlanu ananye amawaka, namakhulu amane anamashumi mahlanu.
Futhi ikamelo lokuhlangana lizohamba, nesitezi sakwaLevi siphakathi kwezitezi. Ngokuya ngohlelo lwabo lokucampana bazohamba, wonke umuntu ezindaweni zakhe, ngasezinhlamvini zakhe.
Ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga, kuzoba khona isibhakabhaka somkhosi kaEphrayimi, ngokuya ngamaqembu abo; uElishama unyana ka-Amihude ube yisikhulu samadodakazi kaEfrayim.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linamaphesenti angama-40,.
Ngasenyakatho yabo kuzoba khona isizwe sikaManase; uGamaliyeli, unyana kaPedashuri, ube nguMengameli wabo bonke abantu bakaManase.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-32 namakhulu amabili.
Usuku lomndeni kaBhenjamin luzofika; umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaBhenjamin uAbidan, unyana kaGideoni.
Iqembu lakhe lemikhosi linezinombolo ezingu-35 namakhulu amane.
Wonke amanani esiteji sika-Ephrayim, ngokwemikhosi yawo, yikhulu nesishiyagalolunye amaphesenti ayishumi nambili. Bazohamba bethathu.
Ngasenyakatho kuzoba khona isibhakabhaka somkhosi kaDan, ngohlobo lwamaqembu abo; uAhiezer unyana ka-Ammisadai ube yisikhulu samadodana kaDan.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-62 nezigidi eziyisithupha.
Ngasenyakatho yabo kuzoba khona isizwe sika-Ashere; uPagiyeli, unyana ka-Okran, ube yisikhulu sabantu baka-Ashere.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-41.
Usuku lwesizwe sikaNaphtali; umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaNaphtali, nguAhira unyana ka-Enani.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-53 nezigidi ezine.
Wonke umkhawulo womkhosi kaDan wumakhulu amabili anamashumi amahlanu anesibhozo amawaka, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili. Bazophuma abaphesheya, ngokwezibhamu zabo.

Lawa amalungu omndeni kaSirayeli, ngokubhaliswa kwabo ngokwemindeni yabo; labo bonke ababhaliswe ezindaweni zokuhlala zabo zonke, ngemikhosi yabo, kwaba ngumakhulu amathandathu, anamawaka amathathu, anamakhulu mahlanu, namashumi amane.
Kodwa amaLevi awabalwa phakathi kwabantu bakaSirayeli, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Bakwenza njalo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngokwezinto zonke awisenzileyo iNkosi kuMoses; ngale ndlela bamisa iziqhingi zabo, futhi ngale ndlela basuka, wonke umuntu ngendlu yakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Lokho wumlando wamadodana ka-Aron noMoses, ngesikhathi iNkosi ekhuluma noMosis emfuleni iSina.
Lawona amagama oonyana baka-Aron: uNadabu omkhulu, no-Abihu, no-Eleazarhi, no-Ithamari.
Baye bona oonyana baka-Aron, ababhishobhi abakhishwe ngamafutha omnqumo, abahlukaniswe ukuba babe ngababingeleli.

UNadabhi no-Abhihu bafa phambi koYehova, lapho benikela khona ngomlilo ongavunyelwanga, esiqhingini saseSinayi; babengenabantwana. Wathi uElazarhi no-Ithamari baphatha umsebenzi kambingeleli ngesikhathi uAron, ubaba wabo, ephila.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Landisa isizwe sikaLevi, ubeke ngezansi kuka-Aron umpristi, ukuze basebenze naye.
Bazowenza umsebenzi wakhe, kanye nomsebenzi webandla lonke, esitezi sokuhlangana, besebenza emgodini ongcwele.
Bazobhekana nezinto zonke zesihlalo sokuhlangana, futhi basebenzele imisebenzi yabantu bakaSirayeli, besebenza esitezi esingcwele.
Uzobeka labo baLevi ku-Aron, nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe; bazobe bethathwe kuwo wonke amadodana aseSirayeli.
Uzobeka uAron nabenzana bakhe ukuba babe ngabapristi; futhi wonke umuntu ofika ezindleleni ezingcwele, kumele aphele.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Bheka, ngithathe amaLevi phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, ukuze abe yimi endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli; bami amaLevi.

ngoba bonke abazalwa kuqala bami. Ngosuku lapho ngibulala khona bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseYiputa, ngazinikela mina bonke abazalwa kuqala eSirayeli, phakathi komuntu nenyama; banami: ngiyangiNkosi.
Wakhuluma iNkosi kuMoses esiqhingini saseSina, wathi,
Linani labo abaLevi ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo; linani labo bonke amadoda aneminyaka emibili nangaphezulu.
Wababala uMoses, njengokuthi iNkosi wamwisela.
Babo oonyana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
Lezi ziyimindeni yezingane zikaGershoni: uLibni noShimehi.
Izizwe zabantwana bakaKahati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli.
Abafazi bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi; labo abafazi bamaLevi, ngokwemindeni yabo.
Ku-Gershoni kwakukhona amabandla kaLibni noShimehi. Lawa ngamabandla eGershoni.
Inombolo yabo, bonke amadodana abo aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, yaba ngumakhulu asixhenxe, anamakhulu amane.
Imindeni yakwaGershoni izohlala esitezi sasentshonalanga, eduze kweTenda Elingcwele.
Umholi wemindeni yamaGershoni ube nguEliyasaphe unyana kaLayeli.
Esitezi sokubambisana, abaGershoni babe nesibopho sesitezi esingcwele, kanye nesitezi sayo, nokugqugquzela kwayo, nophahla lomngcele wesitezi sokubambisana;
kanye nezingqungquthela zendlu yangasese, nezingqungquthela zomngcele wendlu yangasese ojikeleze ikamelo elingcwele, nesihlalo somlilo, nezintambo; bakwenza yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nalezi zinto.
NgaseKohati kwakukhona amaqembu amakhosikazi ka-Amram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli; la maqembu emindeni yamaKohati.
Ngokubalwa kwabo, bonke amadodana abo aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, kwaba ngumakhulu asibhozo, anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili; babe nesibopho sendawo enhle.
Imindeni yama-Kohati kufanele icamp engxenyeni esenyakatho yeTenda Elingcwele.
UMengameli wemindeni yamaKahati ube nguElizaphane unyana kaUziyeli.
Basebenza ngebhokisi lesinqumo, nethebulethi, nophahla lwesibani, nezibingelelo, namathuluzi asetshenziswa endaweni engcwele, kanye nesibuko; bakwenza yonke imisebenzi yazo.
UElazaru, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, ube yinhloko yamaLevi; waba nguMengameli wabo bonke labo abaphethe imisebenzi engcwele.
KuMerariya kwasuka amaqembu amakhosikazi kaMahli noMushi; la maqembu amakhosikazi kaMerariya.
Inombolo yabo, bonke amadodana abo aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, ibiyizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili nekhulu.
Umholi wezindlu zakwaMerari ube nguSuriyeli unyana ka-Abhihayili; behlala engxenyeni yasenyakatho yendawo yokuphumula.
Amadodana kaMerariya ayephatha ifenisha yendlu yokuphumula, nama-bars ayo, nama-postes ayo, nama-bases ayo, nezinto zayo zonke; bakwenza yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nazo,
kanye nezingqimba zendlu yangasese ezijikelezayo, nezikhundla zazo, namahlombe azo, namantambo.

UMoses no-Aron, nabantwana baka-Aron, bamisa amakamelo engxenyeni esenyakatho yendlu yokuphumula, phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana, lapho ilanga liphuma khona; futhi babe nesibopho esikoleni sabantu baseSirayeli. Wonke umuntu ofinyelele kuyo, kufanele aphele.
Wonke umkhawulo wamaLevi, amadoda aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, ababalolwe nguMoses noAron ngokuya ngemindeni yabo, ngomyalo kaYehova, kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Bhala bonke abazalwa kuqala amadodana aseSirayeli, kusukela emnyangweni wenyanga naphezu kwayo, uthathe inani lamagama abo.
Uzithathe iziLevi ngimi, endaweni yazo zonke izinkomo ezivula ibele ezweni lakwaSirayeli, nezilwane zakwaSirayeli, endaweni yazo zonke izinkomo ezivula ibele ezweni lakwaSirayeli: ngiyangiNkosi.
Wathi uMoses, njengokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo, wababala bonke abazalwa kuqala ebantwini bakaSirayeli.
Inani eliphelele lamadoda azalwa kuqala eneminyaka yonyaka owodwa noma ngaphezulu, ahlukaniswe ngegama, kwaba ngamawaka ayishumi nambili namakhulu amabili nesishiyagalombili.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Thola amaLevi endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni lakwaSirayeli, nenyama yabantu bakaLevi endaweni yenyama yabo; futhi amaLevi azongiwo mina, ngiyami iNkosi.
Bangaphezu kwabaLevi, abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli, abangamakhulu amabili namashumi asixhenxe namathathu.
uqoqe amaphuzu amane egolide ngalinye, usebenzisa isisindo esisemthethweni sendawo engcwele, okungumashumi amabili amaphuzu amancane ngayinye.
Uzobeka izimali zokuthengwa kwazo zonke izifakazi ezingaphezulu, ku-Aron nabantwana bakhe.
Wathola uMoses imali kulabo abazalwa kuqala, labo abangaphezu kwalaba baLevi ababehlala endaweni yabo.
Ngabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli, waqoqa isiliva elilodwa elinamakhulu amathathu, anamashumi ayisishiyagalombili anesihlanu, ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele.
Nokho uMoses wanikela ngalolu zimali ku-Aron nabantwana bakhe, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Linani lamadodana kaKahati phakathi kwaLevi, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Uzobala bonke amadoda, kusukela eminyakeni emashumi amathathu kuya kwezingu-50 ubudala, labo abaphumayo ukuba basebenze esitezi sokuhlangana.
Le yimisebenzi yamaKahati esitezi sokuhlangana; bazophatha izinto ezingcwele kakhulu, ukuze zigcinwe.
Uma isibhedlela sikulungele ukuhanjiswa, u-Aron nonyana bakhe kumele bafike, bakhuphule ifasitela elihlanganisiwe ngaphambilini, bagqoke ngaso isikhwama sesivumelwano.
Bazobeka phezu kwayo isigqoko sesikhumba esithambile, bese befaka phezu kwayo isikhwama sombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka esiqinile, bese befaka amabhodlela ayo okuthwala endaweni.

Bazobeka phezu kwetafula lenyama elibekwe phambi koNdikhoyo ingubo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, futhi babeke phezu kwayo izitsha, nezipuni, namabhodwe, namabhodlela okudla okuphuzwayo; umnikelo wokudla ohlala njalo uzobe ukhona phezu kwalo.
Bazofaka phezu kwalokhu intambo ebomvu, bayigqoke ngesikhumba esihle, babeke izintambo zayo endaweni.
Bazothatha isiketi esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bagqoke isihlalo somshado, nezibani zayo, namahhashi ayo, namabhodwe awo, nezitsha zonke zophethiloli ezisetshenziswa kuyo.
Bazoyigqoka nayo yonke imishini yayo ngendwangu yesikhumba esithambile, bese bayibeka emgodini wokuthwala.
Bazofaka phezu kwesibingelelo segolide isigqoko esibomvu, bazosigqoka ngesikhumba esihle, bese bebeka izintambo zayo endaweni yayo.
Bazothatha zonke izinto ezisetshenziswayo ekusebenzeni endaweni engcwele, bazigqoke ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bazigqugquzele ngesikhumba esithambile, bazibeke emgodini wokuthwala.
Kudingeka bahlanze i-ashes kusuka ku-bronze altar bese befaka i-purple cloth phezu kwayo.
Bazobeka phezu kwayo zonke izimpahla zayo ezisetshenziswa kuyo, ama-pans, nama-forks, nama-spades, nama-basins; futhi bazofaka phezu kwayo isigqoko sesikhumba esimnyama, bese befaka izintambo zayo.

Uma u-Aron nonyana bakhe beqedile ukugqoka izinto ezingcwele, nanoma yiziphi izimpahla ezingcwele, lapho umkhosi ehamba khona, khona-ke abaKahati bazofika bazithwalereigni; kodwa ngeke baphuze izitho ezingcwele, ukuze bangafa. Lezo zinto ziyizinto zetekisi yokuhlangana, abakwaKahati bazozithwala.

U-Eleazaru, unyana ka-Aron umbhishobhi, uzobe enesibopho se-oyile yokukhanya, nefuthe elimnandi, nomnikelo wokudla oqhubekayo, ne-oyile yoku ukubhaka; izobe inesibopho sendlu yonke engcwele, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuyo, nalapho kungcwele khona, nezimpahla zayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Umndeni wakwa-Kehati awudingi ukulahleka phakathi kwabaLevi.
Ukwenze lokhu kubo, ukuze baphile futhi bangafa, uma befinyelela ezingcwele kakhulu: uAron nonyana bakhe bazofika, babeke wonke umuntu emisebenzini yakhe, nabo bonke abebethwala.
Amadodana ka-Kehati angeke afike ebona izinto ezingcwele, noma ihora elilodwa, ukuze bangafa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzobala nabangani bakaGershoni, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngezizwe zabo.
Uzobala bonke amadoda, kusukela eminyaka eyisikhombisa kuya kweyishumi nambili ubudala, abaphumayo ukuba basebenzele emkhosini.
Lokho wumsebenzi wemindeni yakwaGershoni, ngomsebenzi wabo, nokuthwala kwabo.
Bazothwala amafasitela ethempelini elingcwele, ikamelo lokuphumula, nokugqugquzela kwalo, nokugqugquzela kwesikhumba esimhlophe, kanye nophahla lomngcele wegumbi lokuphumula;

kanye nezingqungquthela zendlu yangasese ejikeleze ikamelo elingcwele, nesihlalo somlilo, nezingqungquthela zokungena kwendlu yangasese, nezintambo, nanoma yiziphi izinto ezisetshenziswa kulolu msebenzi. Bazosebenza kuwo wonke umsebenzi ophathelene nalezi zinto.
Wonke umsebenzi wamadodana kaGershoni, ukuthwala nanoma iyiphi enye imisebenzi yabo, kumele kwenziwe ngaphansi kwesandla sika-Aron nomndeni wakhe. Uzobe ukhuluma nabo ngomsebenzi wabo wokuthwala.
Lowo ngumsebenzi wemindeni yamaGershoni esitezi sokuhlangana, ngaphansi kwesandla sika-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, bazosebenza wona.
Linani lamadodana kaMerariya ngokwemindeni yabo, ngezindlu zabo.
Uzobala bonke amadoda, kusukela eminyakeni emashumi amathathu kuya kwezingu-50 ubudala, labo abaphumayo ukuba basebenze esitezi sokuhlangana.
Lezo zinto kumele bazithwale, njengengxenye yomsebenzi wabo esitezi sokuhlangana: izindonga zesitezi esingcwele, nezikhonkwane zaso, nezingcingo zaso, nezinqwaba zayo;

kanye nezingcezu zesibhedlela ezijikelezayo, nezisekelo zazo, namahlombe azo, namathumbu awo, namathuluzi abo onke, nanoma iyiphi into esetshenziswa ngazo; utshele wonke umuntu ngegama lakhe, ukuthi yini okufanele ayithwale.
Lowo ngumsebenzi wezindlu zakwaMerari esitezi sokuhlangana, ngaphansi kokulawula kuka-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umpristi.
UMoses no-Aron, namadoda amakhulu ebandla, babala amadodana kaKahati ngokwemindeni yabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo.
Babala bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka engama-30 kuya kwengama-50 ubudala, labo ababengena ukusebenzela esitezi sokuhlangana.
Babalwa ngohlobo lwabo, bayizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namashumi amahlanu.
Lokho kwakungubo bonke abangamaKahati, abasebenza esitezi sokuhlangana; uMoses noAron babala labo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngoMoses.
Amadodana kaGershoni abalwa ngokwezinhlanga zabo, ngomndeni wabo.
bonke amadoda asuka eminyaka eyimashumi amathathu kuya kweyishumi nambili, abafikayo ukusebenzela itente lokuhlangana
babalwa ngokwezinhlanga zabo, ngemindeni yabo; babe yizigidi ezimbili namakhulu amathandathu namathathu.
Lokho kwakungubo bonke abakwaGershoni, abasebenza esitezi sokuhlangana; uMoses noAron babala labo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
Amadodana kaMerariya abalwa ngezizwe zabo, ngomndeni wabo.
bonke amadoda asuka eminyaka eyimashumi amathathu kuya kweyishumi nambili, abafikayo ukusebenzela itente lokuhlangana
babalwa ngokwezinhlanga zabo, futhi balinganiselwa ngamakhulu amathathu anamashumi amabili.
Lokho kwakungubo bonke abahlukaniswe izihlobo zakwaMerari; uMoses no-Aron babala, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngoMoses.
Wathi uMoses no-Aron, nabaholi bakaSirayeli, babala bonke labo abaLevi, ngokwemindeni yabo, ngomndeni wabo.
bonke amadoda asuka eminyakeni emashumi amathathu kuya kuminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, labo abafikayo ukwenza umsebenzi wokuphatha, nokuthwala emgodini wokuhlangana
amanani esiyisishiyagalombili yizinkulungwane eziyisithupha nesigamu.

Ngokungafani nalokho iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo ngoMoses, babhekwa bonke abantu, futhi kwanikezwa wonke umuntu umsebenzi wakhe nempahla yakhe yokuthwala; babhekwa, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngayo uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses: "Ubatshele abantu bakaSirayeli ukuthi bakhuphe ngaphandle komkhosi, wonke umuntu onegciwane, nanoma ubani onegazi eliphuma emlonyeni wakhe, nanoma ubani ongcolile ngenxa yokufa.
Hamba, ushiye amadoda nabesifazane; ushiye ngaphandle kwekhampasi, ukuze bangabi nobuthi ekampheni, ngoba ngihlala phakathi kwabantu bam.
Wakwenza njalo uSirayeli, wabasusa ngaphandle kwesiqhingi, njengokuthi iNkosi wathi kuMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi kuSirayeli: Uma umuntu, indoda noma uwesifazane, esenza into engalungile ngomuntu wakhe nganoma iyiphi indlela, bakwenza ngokungemthetho phambi koYehova; lowo muntu uzobi.
Uma ushone isilwane, kufanele aqinisekise ubugebengu bakhe, futhi kumele abuyisele ngokugcwele owinile, kanye nengxenye yakhe yesishiyagalombili, futhi kufanele anikeze lowo owinile.

Uma umuntu esefa, futhi angeke abe nendodana noma indodakazi ekwazi ukukhokhela umnikelo wakhe wokudla, khona-ke umnikelo wakhe wokudla uzobe wuweNkosi, uzonikezwa umbhishobhi, ngaphezu kwengulube yomkhonzi owawuzoyinikela ukuze alungise isono sakhe.
Zonke izipho ezingcwele ezikhethekile, abantu bakaSirayeli abazinikeza umbingeleli, zizobe ziye kuye.
Wonke umuntu unesibopho sokunikela ngezinto zakhe ezingcwele; kodwa konke okunikezwayo umbhishobhi kumele kube ngumbhishobhi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses: "Ukhulume nabantu bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma indodana yomntu ihamba icala, ingase ibe necala kuye.
Uma ethandana nomuntu othile, futhi indodakazi yakhe ayiqondi le nto; noma ngabe izinzipho zakhe zihlanzekile, kodwa asikho isiqiniseko salokho, nakuba akukho umshayeli ngaye, naye akagwetshwa.

Uma umyeni wakhe ethanda indodakazi yakhe, futhi ucabanga ukuthi ibhinqa lakhe lithobile; noma uma owesifazane enquma ukuba yindodana yenkosikazi yakhe, kodwa akayihloniphi inkosikazi yakhe; noma uma owesifazane enquma ukuba ngumfazi wenkosikazi yakhe, kepha yena akabi nobuthi.

Uma kwenzeka lokhu noma lokho, kufanele athathe indodana yakhe aze ayiveze kumbingeleli; futhi kumele amnikeze umnikelo wakhe wokudla: ikhilogramu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili yoshizi oluhlanzekile. Akudingeki ukuthi anikeze uphethiloli phezu kwayo, akudingeki ukuba anciphise umnqumo wayo; ngoba yisondlo sokudla sokujabula, isiphuzo sokuveza inkohliso efihlakele.
Umbingeleli uzoba nomkakhe, abeke phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
