Uzobeka amanzi angcwele emgodini wokhuni, futhi uzothatha umhlabathi osuka eqhingini lendawo engcwele, awubeke emanzini.

Ubaba-ke uzomisa indodana yakhe phambi koYehova, avule izinwele zayo, abeke emlonyeni wakhe isiphuzo sokudla sezinkohliso, isiphuzo esidala ukulimala; futhi ubaba-ke uzobeka emanzini okunambitheka okubi, abangela insindiso.

Ubaba-ke uzobatshela indodakazi yakhe, athi kuye: Uma kukhona umuntu ohlala nawe, futhi uma ungabi nento engekho emthethweni yomuntu wakho, ukuze ube nobuthi; khona-ke lawa amanzi aphuzayo, abangela ilangazana, angakubi kuwe.
Kodwa uma ukhohliwe ngesikhathi umshado wakho, futhi wahlanza ngokwakho ngokuhlala nowesifazane ngaphandle kowesifazane wakho...'
Ubaba-ke uzothi kulowo indodakazi, UYehova akwenze igama lakho libe yicala phakathi kwabantu bakho, futhi abe yisipho, uma ekwenza isibeleko sakho sibe sincane, futhi ikhanda lakho likhule.
Lawa manzi abangela ukubi afike ekhanda lakho, akwenze isisu sakho siphuze, futhi ibele lakho likhulule. Uwesifazane uzothi, Amen, kube njalo;
Umbingeleli uzobhala lezi zinkohlakalo ku-scrolling bese uhlanza amagama emanzini amnandi.
Uzothi kulowo owesifazane ukuthi aphuze amanzi abuhlungu, abangela ukubi; futhi amanzi azongena kuye, abe buhlungu.
Umbingeleli uzothatha emlenzeni wakhe isiphuzo sokudla sokuzethemba, azosiphakamisa phambi kweNkosi, aze asibeke esihlalweni sezulu.
Uzothatha isandla sakhe esigcwele saleyo mnikelo wokudla, njengento ephawulekayo, aze ayishise phezu kwesibingelelo; futhi ngemuva kwalokho uzodlalela indodana amanzi.

Uma ephukile, futhi ephikisane nowesifazane wakhe, lapho edla amanzi abangela ukubi, azongena kuye, aze abe wubuhlungu obukhulu; isisu sakhe sizovuvuka, nesibeletho sakhe sizoba sincane; futhi igama lakhe lizoba yicala phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Kodwa uma indodakazi yakhe ingabi necala, ihlanzekile, ngeke kube khona ukulimala kuyo, futhi izothola izingane.
Le mfundiso iphathelene nothando, ukuthi uma indodakazi ihamba ngokungemthetho, ibe nendodakazi yakhe, futhi ihlanzeke,
noma uma umuntu ebona indodana yakhe, futhi ethandane nayo; kufanele ayibeke phambi kweNkosi; khona-ke umbingeleli kumele akwenze konke okushiwo ngalolu mthetho.
Umyeni wakhe uzoba ngekho emthethweni, kodwa indodana yakhe izoba nomthwalo wecala.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Uma umuntu, indoda noma indodakazi, esenza isibopho esikhethekile, ukuba nguNazirithi kuYehova,

Uzohlala engaphandle kwewayini nakwezinye iziphuzo ezishisayo; ngeke aphuze iviniga eyenziwe ngewayini nakwezinye iziphuzo ezishisayo; ngeke aphuze ijusi lezinkomo, futhi ngeke adla izinkomo, ezitshalile noma ezifile.
Wonke ubusuku obunguNaziri, ngeke aphuze lutho oluvela evinini, noma imbewu, noma isikhumba sayo.
Kuzo zonke izinsuku zomsebenzi wakhe, angeke kube khona umqhele ekhanda lakhe; kuze kuphele usuku lwakhe lokuzinikela kukaNkulunkulu, ungcwele; kufanele avumele izinwele zakhe zikhule.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ehlonishwa khona iNkosi, angeke afike kumuntu ofile.
Uma ubaba wakhe, noma umama wakhe, noma udadewabo, noma inkosikazi yakhe, befa, angeke enze isono ngenxa yabo; ngoba isibopho sakhe sokuba nguNazirethi sikaThixo sikhona ekhanda lakhe.
Ngazo zonke izinsuku zobuNazirethi bakhe, ungcwele kuYehova.
Uma umuntu efa ngaso sonke isikhathi phambi kwakhe, futhi enze izinwele zakhe zibe nephunga elingcolile, kufanele awele ikhanda lakhe ngosuku lwakhe lokuhlanzeka, usuku oluyisixhenxe.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, kufanele athathe izinkomo ezimbili, noma izingulube ezimbili ezincane, aze aziveze kumpristi, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Ubaba-ke uzonikela ngayinye ibe yisonka, nenye ibe yisonka esiqhutshwayo, ukuze alungise isono sakhe, ngenxa yokufa kwakhe; futhi ngosuku olulodwa uzomisa isisu sakhe.

Uzophinde ahlukanise yena ngokwakhe kuYehova, kuze kube yisikhathi esiphelele sesinqumo sakhe; futhi uzoletha inkomo eneminyaka eyodwa ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wesono. Izinsuku zangaphambilini ngeke zibalolwe, ngoba izinsuku zokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe zazingenawo uthuli.
Lokho wumthetho weNazirethi, uma izinsuku zokuzibophezela kwakhe ziphelile; kumele athathwe emnyango wetente lengqungquthela,

Ake afake khona iminikelo yakhe kuYehova: inkomo eyodwa yonyaka owodwa, engabi necala, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa; inkomo eyodwa yonyaka owodwa, engabi necala, ibe yi yizipho zesono; nomuntu oyedwa, ongabi necala, abe ngumnikelo wokudla.

Uzothatha futhi ibhokisi elilodwa lemifino engaphekwanga, imifino eyenziwe ngesikhunta esiqinile, encibilikisiwe ngophethiloli, nama-waffles ancibilikisiwe ngophethiloli, kanye nomnikelo wabo wokudla, neminikelo yabo yokushiswa.
Umbingeleli uzozinikela phambi kukaNkulunkulu, alungiselele isonka sesono, nomnikelo wokushiswa.
Uzonikela ngomuntu wesifazane njengomnikelo wokuthula kuYehova, kanye nebhodlela lenyama engaphekiwe; futhi umbingeleli uzonikela ngesondlo sayo sokudla nesiphuzo.

Uzothatha izinwele zakhe, azigqugquzele emgodini wesitezi sokuhlangana, aze azibeke emlilweni ongaphansi komnikelo wokudla. Uzokhipha futhi izinwele zakhe, azigqugquzele emgodini wesitezi sokuhlangana.

Uma uNazireli egqoke izinwele zakhe, khona-ke umbingeleli uzobeka emlonyeni wakhe isifuba sembuzi esithosiwe, nekhekhe elilodwa elingenakho ukhilimu, kanye nomquba owodwa ongenakho ukhilimu osuka ebhokisini.
Uzozishaya ngazo phambi koYehova, zibe ngumnikelo oshiswayo. Zingcwele, ziwuwe umbingeleli, kanye nebele elifihliwe, nemilenze enikeziwe; futhi ngemuva kwalokho uzodla iwayini loNaziri.

Lokho wumthetho weNaziri, owenza isibopho, ngomnikelo wakhe ozowuletha kuYehova ngenxa yobungcwele bakhe, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto angakwazi ukuzithola; ngazo zonke izibopho zakhe azozenza, ngokwemithetho yeNaziri.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis ku-Aron nonyana bakhe: "Kule ndlela nizobabalisa abantu bakaSirayeli.
UYehova akubabazise, futhi akugcine.
UNkulunkulu angakuxwayisa futhi akuthande.
UNkulunkulu akubonakalise wena, futhi akunikeze uxolo.
Ngale ndlela bazobeka igama lami phezu kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, futhi ngizobasiza.
UMoses, lapho eqedile ukumisa itente, wayithambisa, wayingcwelela, nayo yonke impahla yayo; wayithambisa futhi isibingelelo, nezinto zayo zonke, wayazingcwelela.
Ngosuku olulodwa, abaphathi bakaSirayeli banikela ngesipho; laba baholi bezindlu zabazali babo, abaphathi bezizwe zabo, labo abaye babhaliswa kubo.

Bathi, "Sizonikela ngomnikelo wethu kuYehova: izimoto eziyisishiyagalombili ezigqugquzelwe, nezinkomo eziyishumi nambili; imoto ngayinye ngamadodana amabili, nengulube ngayinye ngamadodana amabini; sizonikela ngazo phambi kwekamelo elingcwele.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzozithola kuzo, ukuze zisetshenziselwe umsebenzi wendawo yokudlela yokuhlangana; uzozinikeza amaLevi, ngaso sonke isikole, ngokuya ngomsebenzi wabo.
Wathi uMoses, athathe izimoto nezingulube, wazisabalalisa kumaLevi.
Wabanikeza amabhayisikili amabili, nezingulube ezine, abaGershoni, ngokwemisebenzi yabo.
kanye namabhayisikili amane, nezinkomo eziyisishiyagalombili, zamadodana kaMerari, ngokwemisebenzi yabo; basebenza ngaphansi kwesandla sika-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umpristi.
Amadodakazi ka-Kohati uMoses akayinika, ngoba babeziphatha izinto ezingcwele, bezithwala emlenzeni wabo.
Kwathi lapho isibingelelo sibhakwe khona, abakhulu banikela ngezinto zokuyilungiselela; banikela ngomnikelo wabo phambi kwesibingelelo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uzonikela umholi ngamunye isipho sakhe sokuzibophezela kwesibhedlela, ngosuku ngalunye.
Ngosuku lokuqala wanikela ngomnikelo wakhe uNahshon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi, waseYuda.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula, izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka emihlanu ubudala. Lowo ngumnikelo kaNahshon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi.
Ngosuku lwesibili wanikela uNethaneli unyana ka-Zuare, umholi wakwa-Issakare.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaNathaneli unyana ka-Suwari.
Ngosuku lwesithathu wanikela uElibha, unyana kaHeloni, umholi wamaZabuloni, ngomnikelo wakhe.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaEliyaba unyana kaHeloni.
Ngosuku lwesine wanikela uElisuri unyana ka-Shedeure, umholi wamaRubheni, ngesipho sakhe.

Ngosuku lwesihlanu wanikela uShelumiyeli, unyana kaZurisadai, umphathi wezingane zikaSimeoni.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe wanikela uElishama unyana ka-Amihude, umholi wabaLevi baseEphrayim.

Ngosuku lwesine wanikela uAbidan, unyana kaGideoni, umholi wamaBhenjamini, ngomnikelo wakhe.

inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula, izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka emihlanu ubudala. Lowo ngumnikelo ka-Abidan unyana kaGideoni.
Ngosuku oluyishumi wanikela u-Ahiezer, unyana ka-Ammisadai, umphathi wabangane bakaDani.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo ka-Ahiezer unyana ka-Amishadai.
Ngosuku oluyishumi nanye, wanikela uPagiyeli unyana ka-Okran, umholi wabaLevi baseAsheri.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaPagiyeli unyana ka-Okrane.
Ngosuku oluyishumi nambili wanikela u-Ahira, unyana ka-Enani, umholi wabafazi bakaNafetali.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo ka-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.
Lokho kwakungumnikelo wamadodana aseSirayeli, wokuzibophezela kwesihlalo somlilo ngosuku lokuyinquma: izinkomishi zesiliva ezingu-12, namabhodwe egolide ayizi-12.

Umthamo wesinkwa esisodwa sesilivere wawungushekeli elilodwa neshumi namashumi amathathu, nomthamo wombhoshongo ngamunye ube yishekeli elilodwa nesishiyagalombili; wonke umthamo wezithelo zesilivere waba ngushekeli ezinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu amane, ngokweshekeli engcwele.
Izitsha zegolide eziyishumi nambili, ezigcwele uvumba, isisindo sazo zonke izitsha zegolide kwakuyishekeli elilodwa nesishiyagalombili, ngokweshekeli yendawo engcwele.
Inyama yomnikelo wokushiswa yaba yizingulube ezingu-12, nezimvu eziyisithupha, namabele aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala ayi-12, kanye nesibopho sazo sokudla; amabhokhwe amane abe yisonka.

Inyama yomnikelo wokuthula ibiyizingulube ezingu-24, nezimvu ezingu-60, nezinkomo ezingu-60, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala ayi-60. Lowo ngumnikelo wokuqokwa kwesihlalo somlilo, ngemuva kokuyibhaka.

Uma uMoses efika entabeni yokuhlangana, ukuba akhulume noYehova, walalela ilizwi elikhuluma naye phezulu emgodini womthetho, phakathi kwezilwane eziphilayo ezimbili. Wathetha naye ngoNkulunkulu, wathi:
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Usho ku-Aron: Uma umisa izibani eziyisixhenxe, kufanele zikhanya ezindaweni ezingaphambili zesibani.
Wakwenza njalo uAron; wamisa izibani, ukuze zikhanya phambi kwesibambo sokukhanya, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
UMoses wayenza ngegolide, eyenziwe ngokhonkolo, kusukela esinqeni sayo kuze kube amabhulukwe ayo. Wayenza ngokwesifanekiso iNkosi abemwise sona.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Thola amaLevi phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, uwahlanze.
Ngale ndlela uzowahlanza: uzobaphilisa ngamanzi, bahlanzwe; bahlanze isikhumba sabo sonke, bahlanze izingubo zabo, bahlanzeke.
Bazothatha inkomo encane, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, ubisi olufino oluhlanganisiwe nephethiloli; futhi uzothatha inkomo encane eyesibili, ibe yisonka sosono.
Bheka amaLevi phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana, uhlanganise khona ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli.
Uzobeka amaLevi phambi koYehova, futhi izingane zakwaSirayeli zibeke izandla zabo phezu kwabo.
U-Aron uzowaphakamisa amaLevi kuYehova, abe ngumnikelo oshiswayo ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ukuze basebenze umsebenzi kaYehova.
Lawa maLevi azobeka izandla zawo ezindlebeni zezinkomo, futhi uzonikela ngayinye ibe yisonka sesono, nenye ibe yisonka esishiswayo kuYehova, ukuze alungise amaLevi.
Uzobeka amaLevi phambi kuka-Aron, futhi phambi kwabantwana bakhe; uzobanikela kubo ngomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Ngaleyo ndlela uzohlukanisa amaLevi phakathi kwamadodakazi aseSirayeli, ukuze abe yimi labo abaLevi.
Uzozihlanza ngazo, uzozinikela ngazo njengomnikelo oshiswayo; bese befika labo abaLevi, basebenzele umsebenzi wabo efulethini lengqungquthela.
Bami abanikezelwe ngempela phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ngibathathe ngami, endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala emiphakathini yabantu bakaSirayeli.
Wonke ozalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli, umuntu nomuntu kanye nenyama, yimi. Ngosuku lapho ngabulala khona wonke ozalwa kuqala ezweni lakwaYiputa, ngawamisa ngesandla sami.
Ngibathathe labaLevi endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ebantwini bakaSirayeli.

Ngibanikela ku-Aron nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe, phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli bonke, abaLevi; ukuze basebenzele umsebenzi wabo bonke abantwana bakaSirayeli esitezi sokubonisareigni, ukuze benze ukuxoshwa kwabo, ukuze kungabikho ubuhlungu phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, uma befika endaweni engcwele.
UMoses no-Aron, kanye nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, bakwenza ngalawa maLevi konke iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses.
Bahlanza izandla zabo, bahlamba izigqoko zabo; uAron wanikela ngazo ngenhlanhla phambi koYehova, wabalungisa ebusweni bakhe, ukuba bangabi necala.
Ngemuva kwalokho, baphuma labaLevi ukuba benze umsebenzi wabo esitezi sokuhlangana, ngaphansi kuka-Aron nezingane zakhe; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses, njalo bakwenza labo abaLevi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Lokho wumthetho wamaLevi: kusukela eminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ubudala nangaphezulu, kumele afike asebenzele esitezi sokubonisa.
Eneminyaka engu-50 ubudala kufanele baphume emsebenzini wabo ojwayelekile bese beyeka ukusebenza.
Bazosiza abazalwane babo emisebenzini yabo esitezi sokuhlangana, kodwa bangeke benze umsebenzi wabo; ngakho-ke kufanele ubeke imithetho yomsebenzi wamaLevi."
Ngonyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo ezweni laseYiputa, ngonyaka wokuqala wenyanga yokuqala, iNkosi wathi kuMoses esiqhingi saseSinayi, esithi,
Abantu bakaSirayeli kumele bagcine iPasha ngesikhathi sayo esifanele.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili lwalenyanga, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, niyigcine ngesikhathi sayo; niyenze yonke imibandela yayo nemithetho yayo.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli ukuthi bagcine izinsuku zokugcina.

Bakwenza njalo emfuleni iSina, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yokuqala, lapho ilanga liphuma khona. Ngokungafani nalokho iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMosese, kanjalo bakwenze oonyana baka-Israyeli.
Kwaba khona abantu abathile ababengenawo uthuli ngenxa yokufa, ukuze bangakwenza iPasha ngalolusuku. Bafike kuMosesi noAron ngalolusuku olulodwa,
Bathi, Singcolile thina, ngoba sithole umuntu ofile; kungani ke singavunyelwa ukuba sinikeze umnikelo kaYehova ngesikhathi sakhe, phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli?
Wathi kubo uMoses, Nqabe lapha, kuze ngibone ukuthi iNkosi unqume kuphi mayelana nani.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uthi iNkosi kuMosis, 21"Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli, uthi: Uma umuntu othile phakathi kwenu noma phakathi kwezizukulwana zenu engekho emthethweni ngenxa yokufa komuntu, noma uma esehamba ngendlela ende, ungayenza iPasha kaYehova.
Ngonyaka wesithathu, ngomhla wama-14 wenyanga yesibili, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, niyigcine. Niyidle inkomo nenyama eyenziwe ngengxube yamafutha omnqumo;
Akufanele nishiye lutho kulo kuze kube ubusuku, namathambo alo angeke niwaphuze; kufanele nigcine yonke imibandela kaPashu.

Kodwa uma umuntu ehlanzekile, angasekho emgwaqeni, akwenzele iPasha, lowo muntu kufanele ahlonipheke emiphakathini yakhe; ngenxa yokuthi akahlinzekeli umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu ngesikhathi esifanele, yena uzothwala isono sakhe.
Uma ehlala phakathi kwenu umuntu ovela kwelinye izwe, efuna ukwenza uPasha kuYehova, kufanele akwenze ngokuya ngemithetho yayo, nomthetho wayo; inqubekela phambili yakhe izofana naleyo yomzali wakhe.

Ngosuku lapho ikamelo elingcwele lamiswa khona, icloud yayifihla, itabernakele yomthetho wesivumelwano; kusukela emini kuze kube ekuseni, ukubonakala kwecloud ngaphezu kwegumbi elingcwele kwakufana nomlilo.
Kunganjalo njalo. Imvula yayigqoka ngemini, futhi ngobusuku yayifana nomlilo.
Uma izulu likhuphuka phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, abantu bakaSirayeli basuka; lapho izulu lihlala khona, abantu bakaSirayeli bafudukela lapho.

Ngokusho kwamazwi kaYehova abaSirayeli babehamba, futhi ngokusho kwamazwi kaYehova babesezindaweni zabo zokucampa; ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho izulu lihlala khona phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, babesezindaweni zabo zokucampa.
Uma imvula ihlala isikhathi eside phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, khona-ke abantu bakaSirayeli bephula umthetho kaYehova, bangahambanga.
Ngamanye amaxesha icloud yahlala phezu kwendlu yokuphumula izinsuku ezimbalwa kuphela. Ngokusho komthetho kaYehova, bahlale esiteshini, futhi ngokusho komthetho wakhe, bahambe.

Ngamanye amaxesha icloud ihlala kuphela kusukela ekuseni kuze kube ngasekupheleni kwemini, futhi uma ikhuphuka ekuseni, basuka; noma ngabe ngobusuku noma ngemini, lapho icloud ikhuphuka khona, basuka.

Noma izinsuku ezimbili, noma unyaka owodwa, noma iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, uma izulu lihlala phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, abantu bakaSirayeli behlala esiqhingini, bangahamba; kodwa lapho likhuphuka khona, basuka.
Ngokusho komthetho kaYehova bamisa iziqhingi, futhi ngokusho komthetho kaYehova basuka; balandela umthetho kaYehova, njengoba ewiselayo ngoMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
"Yenza ama-trumpets amabili enziwe ngegolide elihlanganisiwe. Sebenzisa ukubiza imindeni ibe ndawonye futhi utshele izikole ukuthi zingahamba nini.
Uma bephuza amabhungane amabili, khona-ke ibandla lonke lizohlangana phambi kwakho emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Uma kuqhuma enye kuphela, khona-ke abaholi, abaphathi bezizwe zamaSirayeli, kumele bahlangane phambi kwakho.
Uma ama-trumpets ephonsa umsindo omkhulu, izizwe ezicampe engxenyeni esenyakatho kumele ziphume.
Uma i-alarm izwakala kathathu, izizwe ezihlala engxenyeni esenyakatho kumele zihambe. I-alarm izobe yisikhombisi sokuhamba.
Uma ubambe abantu bonke, khona-ke cindezela i-trumpet ngaphandle kokushayela umsindo.
Amadodana ka-Aron, ababingeleli, kumele baphuze amabhungane. Lo mthetho uzobe uhlala kuze kube sekupheleni, kuwe nakwabo bonke abazalwane bakho.

Uma niphuma emidlalweni, ezweni lenu, enkundleni yomshayeli ophikisayo, nizophonsa inqwaba yezinhlamvu zesibhakabhaka; futhi iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu uzokukhumbulani, futhi uzokusindisa ebusweni bomshayeli.

Nakuzo zonke izinsuku zenu ezijabulisayo, nasezimisweni zenu ezidume kakhulu, nangemva kokuqala kwenyanga ngayinye, kufanele niphuze amabhungane phezu kwezipho zenu ezibomvu, nezipho zenu zokuthula; futhi kuzokukhumbula uNkulunkulu wenu. Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wakho.
Ngonyaka wesithathu, ngomhla wama-20 wenyanga yesibili, imvula yakhuphuka phezu kweTenda loMthetho woMhlangano.
Basuka esiqhingini saseSinayi, bahamba behamba, kuze kube yilapho isibhakabhaka sihlala esiqhingini saseParan.
Lokhu kwakungukuqala kokuhamba kwabo, ngokusho komyalo kaYehova ngoMoses.
Kwathi lapho, kwaqala ukuboshwa iqembu lamadodana kaYuda; uNahshon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi, waba ngumkhuluwa walo mkhosi.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sika-Issakha, kwaba nguNathaneli unyana kaZuare.
Ngaphesheya komkhosi wesizwe sikaZebulun, uElibha unyana kaHeloni.
Bakhupha khona itente, basuka abaGershoni nabaseMerari, bethwala itenti.
Kusukela lapho kwasuka umkhosi, ngohlobo lwawo, ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka sesitena sikaRubhen; uElisuri unyana kaShedeure waba ngumkhuluwa womkhosi.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sikaSimeoni kwakunguShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishaddai.
Ngaphesheya komkhosi wesizwe sikaGadi kwakunguEliyashaphi unyana kaDehuyeli.
Basuka ke abaKahati, bethwala izinto ezingcwele; kwamiswa itente elingcwele phambi kokuba bafike.
Kusukela lapho kwasuka umkhosi, ngohlobo lwawo, ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka somkhosi ka-Ephrayim; noElishama unyana ka-Amihude waba ngumkhuluwa womkhosi.
Ngaphesheya komkhosi wesizwe sikaManase kwakunguGamayeli unyana kaPedasuri.
UAbidan, unyana kaGideoni, waba phezu komkhosi wesizwe sikaBhenjamini.
Kwathi, ngemuva kwazo zonke lezi zikhulu, wahamba umvikeli wesitezi sikaDani; futhi uAhiezer, unyana ka-Ammisadai, waba ngumkhuluwa wabo.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sika-Ashere kwakunguPagiyeli unyana kaOkran.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sikaNaphtali kwakungu-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.
Lokho kwakuyisinqumo sabantu baka-Israyeli lapho bephuma khona.

Wathi uMoses kuHobabu, unyana kaRehuyeli, umkakhe uMoses, waseMidiyani, thina siyohamba ezweni iNkosi akazange akusho ukuthi azosinika lona; phuma nathi, futhi sizokwenza kahle kuwe; ngoba iNkosi usekhuluma izinto ezinhle ngeSirayeli.
Wathi ke uHobaba, Ngangizohamba; ngizobuyela ezweni lami, nakwabantu bam.
Wathi uMoses: "Ungasishiya, ngoba uyazi ukuthi sizohlala kuphi ezweni lethu, futhi uzoba ngumqondisi wethu.
Uma ufika nathi, sizokwabelana nawe ngazo zonke izinto ezinhle azenzayo iNkosi.
Basuka khona emfuleni kaYehova, behamba uhambo lwezinsuku ezintathu; ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova lahamba phambi kwabo uhambo lwezinsuku ezintathu, lifuna indawo yokuphumula kubo.
Imvula kaYehova yaba phezu kwabo nsuku zonke, lapho besuka khona esitezi.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ibhokisi lesivumelwano lihamba khona, uMoses wathi, Yize, Nkosi, bahlukaniswe izitha zakho, bahambe phambi kwakho labo abakuxosha.
Kwathi lapho ihlala khona, wathi, Buyela, Nkosi, kumakhulu amawaka kaSirayeli.
Kwathi abantu bekhala ngenxa yezinkinga zabo, futhi iNkosi wabalalela; wakubona ke, wehla umsindo wakhe, khona-ke kwaphuma umlilo osuka kukaNkulunkulu phakathi kwabo, wawudlidliza izingcezu zesiteji.
Bathi abantu kuye uMoses, wathandaza uMoses kuYehova; khona-ke umlilo wehla.
Ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iTabera, ngenxa yokuthi umlilo osuka kuYehova wawuncibilika phakathi kwabo.
Wathi uMosis kulabo abahlala phakathi kwabo, "Kungaba yini uma sithola inyama ukuyodla?" Bathi, "Ngabe sizoba nenyama!"
Sikhumbula izinhlanzi esizidla ngazo mahhala e-Egypt, nama-currants, ama-melon, ama-leeks, ama-onion, ne-garlic.
Kodwa manje silahlekile isifiso sethu sokudla. Asikuboni lutho ngaphandle kwe-manna!"
I-manna yayifana nezithelo ezincane ze-coriander futhi yabukeka njenge-resin emnyama.
Abantu bahamba beyiqoqa. Beyifaka emigodini yezandla noma beyicindezela ngemigodi, bese beyibhaka emabhodweni noma beyenza ibe ngama-flat bread. Iphunga layo lifana nokudla okuthosiwe nge-olive oil.
Ngobusuku, lapho imvula iphuma esiteji, i-manna yaphuma nayo.
Wathi uMoses, ezwa izizwe zonke zikhala, ngaso sonke isikhathi, wonke umuntu emgwaqeni wetente lakhe. UYehova wagwema kakhulu, futhi uMosis wakhathazeka.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Kungani na ungenza lokhu okubi kumkhonzi wakho? Ngikwenzeni kuphi, ukuze kube nzima phambi kwakho, ukuthi ubeke phezu kwami isisindo sabantu bonke?

Ngibazalile yini labo bonke abantu? Ngaba ngibangenise ezweni, ukuthi ungangitshela ukuba ngiwathathe enhliziyweni yami, njengokuthi umama okhulelwe athwale ingane yakhe, kuze kube yilapho ngiya khona ezweni olibekele izikhulu zabo?
Ngizothola kuphi inyama yalabo bonke abantu? Bathi kimi, Ninikele inyama ukuthi siyidle.
Angikwazi ukuthwala labo bonke abantu ngami. Lo mthwalo unzima kakhulu kimi.
Uma lokhu kuyinto oyifunayo ukungiphatha ngayo, khona-ke ngiyakucela usindise manje, uma unesithakazelo kimi ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Thola ngizo abantu abamashumi asixhenxe abakhulu phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, owaziyo ukuthi bangabaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli, nabaphathi bomphakathi; ubaveze ekhempini yokuhlangana, bahlale khona nawe.
Ngizokhuphuka, ngikhuluma nawe khona lapho; futhi ngizothatha umphefumulo okhona phezu kwakho, ngiwubeke phezu kwabo; futhi bazoyithwala impahla yalabo abantu nawe, ukuze ungayithwali wena kuphela.

Uzothi kulabo abantu, Nciphiseni izandla zenu, nizilungiselele kusasa, lapho ningadla khona inyama; ngoba iNkosi wakubona ukuthi nikhala, nithi, Uma kungenjalo sizothola inyama yokuyidla! Kungcono kwabe sekuyilapho eYiputa. Ngokuba iNkosi uzokunika inyama, niyidle.
ngeke niyidle ngosuku olunye, noma usuku olulodwa, noma usuku oluhlanu, noma usuku olulishumi, noma usuku olumashumi amabili;
unyaka onke, kuze kuphume emlonyeni wenu, niyiphoxe; ngenxa yokuthi ningamtholanga iNkosi ophakathi kwenu, naphezu kwalokho niyezela kuye, nithi, Ngabe saphuma kanjani eYiputa?
Wathi uMoses, Namuhla ngiphakathi kwamakhulu amathandathu amaphesenti abantu abahamba ngezinyawo; futhi uthi, Ngizobanikeza inyama inyanga yonke, baphile.
Ingabe kuzokwanela, noma ngabe zonke izingulube nezimbuzi zibulawa ngenxa yabo? Ingabe kuzokwanela, noma ngabe zonke izinhlanzi elwandle zithathwa ngenxa yabo?"
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ingabe amandla ami ancane kakhulu? Manje uzobona ukuthi uma ngikhuluma, kuzokwenzekani noma ngeke.
Waphuma ke uMoses, wabatshela abantu amazwi kaYehova; wahlanganisa abaholi babo abamashumi asixhenxe, wababeka ngaso sonke isikhathi esitezi.

UYehova wehla emlilweni, wakhuluma noMoses; wathatha umphefumulo owawuseMoses, wababeka phezu kwabakhulu abamashumi asixhenxe. Kwathi lapho umphefumlo ufike kubo, baqala ukuprofetisa, kodwa akazange aqhubeke nokuprofeta.

Kwakhona kwaba khona abantu ababi abasele emgodini, okuthiwa ngu-Eldadi no-Medadi, ababesencwadini yamadoda amakhulu, kodwa abengaphumanga ekhempini; futhi uMoya waba phezu kwabo, baqala ukuprofetisa emgodini.
Waphuma umfana, watshela uMoses, wathi, U-Eldade no-Medade baprofetisa esiteji.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune, umkhonzi kaMoses kusukela encane, waphendula wathi, "Unkosi wami uMoses, vimbela labo!
Wathi uMosis, Ingabe unesithakazelo ngami? Ngingathanda ukuthi bonke abantu bakaYehova babe ngabaprofeti, futhi iNkosi abeke umphefumulo wakhe kubo bonke!
Wabuyela ke uMoses, namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli, ekamelweni.

Wathumela iNkosi umoya, waletha ama-quails elwandle, wabeka phezu kwazo zonke izingxenye zesibhedlela, ngaso sonke isikhathi sokuhamba kosuku olulodwa, ngaso sonke isikhathi; zathi zihlala zinemilenze emihlanu ezingeni lezulu.

Baphuma bonke abantu, baqoqa amakhowe onke ekuseni nakusihlwa, kanye nosuku lonke olulandelayo; akukho muntu okwaziyo ukuqoqa ngaphezu kwamalitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, futhi babeka ngaso sonke isiqhingi.
Uma inyama ikhona emlonyeni wabo, ngaphambi kokuba bayiphuze, uMoya oNgcwele wagwema abantu, wababulala ngobuhlungu obukhulu kakhulu.
Kwathi kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo ngokuthi iKibrothi-hataava, ngokuba khona lapho babulawe khona abantu abafunayo ukudla.
Basuka eKibrothi-hataava, bahamba befika eHaserothi, bahlala khona.
UMiriam no-Aron bakhuluma ngoMoses, ngenxa yowesifazane waseKushi ayemthandana naye; ngoba wayemthandanisa indodakazi yaseKushi.
Bathi, Ingabe iNkosi wakhuluma ngoMoses kuphela? Akazange akhulume nathi na? UNkulunkulu walalela amagama abo.
UMusa ube ngumntu osheshayo kakhulu, osheshayo kunanoma ubani emhlabeni.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, no-Aron, noMiriam, Niphumani nithathu, nifike esihlalweni sokuhlangana. Baphuma ke bona abathathu.
UYehova wehla emgodini wezulu, wahlala emgwaqeni wesitezi, wabiza uAron noMiriam; bafike bonke ababi.
Wathi, Yiqiniso, ngikhuluma: Uma kukhona umprofeti phakathi kwenu, ngizovela kuye ngamehlo ephupho, ngizokhuluma naye ngephupho;
Akunjalo umkhonzi wami uMosis; yena uthembekile endlwini yami yonke.
Ngikhuluma naye ngobuso nobuso, ngamazwi acacile, hhayi ngezinhlamvu ezifihlakele; futhi ubona isithombe soNkulunkulu. Kungani na ke ukuthi ningeke nikhohlwe ukukhuluma ngomkhonzi wami uMoses?
UYehova waba necala elikhulu kubo, waphuma.
Kwathi lapho izulu likhuphuka phezulu esitezi, yabona uMiriamu isikhumba sakhe simhlophe njengethebhulethi. Wabhekana naye uAron, wabona ukuthi isikhumba sakhe simnyama.
Wathi kuMosesi, Ngicela, nkosi yami, ungasifaki phezu kwethu isono esinjalo, njengoba sakwenza ngokungaqondi.
Akufanele abe njengomuntu ozalwa efile, nengxenye yenyama yakhe itholwe.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, ethi, OThixo, ngicela, umphilise.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uma ubaba wakhe ephuza emlonyeni wakhe, angabi ngempela engahloniphi izinsuku ezisixhenxe? Uzobeka ngaphandle kwesiqhingi izinsuku ezisixhenxe; ngemuva kwalokho uzovunyelwa ukuba afike.
UMiriamu ke wagcinwa ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi izinsuku ezisixhenxe; abantu abahambanga, kuze kube kufike uMiriamu.
Basuka eHazerothi, bamisa isikhashana esiqhingini sasePharan.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses, "Thumela abantu ukuba babhekane nezwe laseKanana, elingeke ngilinike izingane zakwaSirayeli; thumela umuntu oyedwa ophethe isizwe ngasinye.
Wabathumela ke uMoses emfuleni iFaran, njengokuthi iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; bonke babe ngabaphathi phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Lawona amagama abo: ezweni lakwaRubheni, uShamua unyana kaZakhuri.
ezweni likaSimeoni, uShafati unyana kaHori.
Ezweni likaYuda, uKalebe unyana kaJefune.
ezweni lika-Issakha, uIgali unyana kaYosefu.
ezweni lika-Ephrayim, uHoshea unyana kaNuni.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin, uPalti unyana kaRaphu.
ezweni likaZabuloni, uGadiyeli unyana kaSodi.
Ezweni likaManase, ezweni likaYosefu, nguGadi unyana kaSusi.
ezweni likaDan, u-Amiyeli unyana kaGemali.
Ezweni lika-Ashere, uSethure unyana kaMikayeli.
Ezweni likaNaphtali, nguNahbi unyana kaVofsi.
ezweni likaGadi, uGeweli unyana kaMakhi.
Lawona amagama amadoda awathunyelwe nguMoses ukubheka izwe; uMosis wabiza igama likaHoshea, unyana kaNuni, ngokuthi nguYoshuwa.
UMoses wabathumela ukuba babhekane nomhlaba waseKanana, wathi kubo: "Niya ezweni laseNtshonalanga, nifike emadolobheni aphakeme.
Bona ukuthi izwe libukeka kanjani. Thola ukuthi ngabe abantu abahlala khona banamandla noma bangaphili, ambalwa noma abaningi.
Ingabe indawo abahlala kuyo iyindawo engcono noma ebi? Ingabe imiphakathi yabo yizindawo ezivulekile zokuhlala noma zikhuselwe ngamagquma?
Ingabe le mhlaba ugcwele noma awunawo? Ingabe kunezihlahla kulo noma cha? Yiba nobuhlakani, futhi ubuyisele emuva ezinye zezithelo zezwe." Kulokhu kwakuyisikhathi sokuqala sokuvuna izimbali.
Baye benyuka, bahlola izwe, kusukela emfuleni uZin, kuze kube nguRehobhi, lapho kufike khona eHamati.
Baya ezweni laseNtshonalanga, bafika eHebroni, lapho kwahlala khona uAhimana, noSheshai, noTalmai, izingane zikaAnaki. (IHebroni yakhiwa eminyakeni eyisixhenxe ngaphambili kukaZoan waseYiputa.)
Bafika emfuleni i-Eshkoli, baqotha khona inkomishi egcwele izimbali zewayini; ababini beyithwala phakathi kwabo emgodini; futhi bathatha ama-pomelo nama-tines.
Kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi yiGoli lika-Eshkole, ngenxa yeqoqo labo labaSirayeli abalile khona.
Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-40 zokuhlola izwe, babuyela.
Bafika kuMoses no-Aron, nabo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, eKadeshi, esiqhingini saseFaran; baphendula kubo, nakubo bonke ibandla, futhi babonisa izithelo zezwe.
Bathi kuMoses, "Sifike ezweni lapho usithumelele khona; yizwe elishayela ubisi nengulube; bheka lezi zithelo zaso.
Kodwa abantu abahlala khona banamandla, namadolobhana abo anezindlu zangasese, amakhulu kakhulu; sabona khona nabantwana baka-Anaki.
Ama-Amaleki ahlala enyakatho; ama-Hethi, nama-Yebhusi, nama-Amoreyi ahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme; nama-Kanana ahlala eduze kolwandle, kanye neJordani.
UKalebe wamisa abantu phambi kukaMoses, wathi, Siyahamba namuhla, siyithathe izwe; ngoba siyakwazi ukulihlasela.
Bathi abantu ababeya naye, Asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi sizokwazi ukuhlasela labo bantu; ngoba banamandla kunathi.

Bathi, "Izwe esiluvakashele lidla labo abahlala kulo; futhi bonke abantu esibabona khona yilabo abade kakhulu. Kulokhu sikhuluma ngezwe elingenalutho phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, ngoba izwe esiluvakashele lidla labo abahlala kulo.
Sibone khona namadoda amakhulu, amakhosikazi ka-Anaki, aphuma emndenini wamaNafilimi; sazizwa ngathi sifana nezingqungquthela, futhi sabona ngathi sifana nabo.
Ngaleyo busuku ibandla lonke lashaya ngamandla, futhi abantu balele.
Bathi bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuMoses noHaroni, bathi kubo ibandla lonke, Kube sengathi safa ezweni laseYiputa, noma ngalesi siqhingi esinjalo!
Kungani na ukuthi iNkosi asiholele kule lizwe, ukuze sibulawe emidlalweni? Namadodakazi ethu nabantwana bethu bathathelwe iziboshwa. Akulungile yini ukuba sibuye eYiputa?"
Bathi phakathi kwabo, Sikhetheni umholi, sizobuya eMizi-Yiputa.
UMoses no-Aron babhukha ngobuso babo ezweni, phambi kwebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli elihlangana khona.
UYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, noKhalebe unyana ka-Yefune, abantu abasuke bebhekele izwe, baxosha izigqoko zabo.
Bathi kubo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, besithi, Izwe elihlanganiswe ngaso sonke isikhathi, liyilizwe elihle kakhulu.
Uma iNkosi ethandana nathi, uzosingenisa kulolu mhlaba, futhi usinikeze lona, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nenyama.
Kodwa-ke, ningeke nigweme iNkosi, ningeke nikhathazeke ngenxa yabantu balo lizwe; ngoba sizowadla njengamakhowe. Ukuvikelwa kwabo kuphelile, kodwa iNkosi unethu; ningabakhathazeki ngenxa yabo.
Kodwa ibandla lonke lathi lizolibabula ngetshe; khona-ke ubuhle bukaYehova buvela esitezi sokuhlangana kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Ingabe kuze kube isikhathi esingakanani isizwe sizongikhohlisa? Ingabe kuze kube isikhathi esingakanani singakholwa kimi, ngenxa yezibonakaliso zonke engizenza phakathi kwabo?
Ngizowabulala ngegciwane, ngibakhulule; kodwa wena ngizokwenza ube wuhlanga olukhulu kunawo wonke, lunamandla kakhulu kunawo.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Bazokwazi ama-Egyptians; ngoba ngamandla akho wakhipha labo abantu phakathi kwabo.

futhi bazothi kulabo abahlali kule lizwe; ngoba bayazi ukuthi wena, iNkosi, uphakathi kwalaba bantu, ukuthi ubonakala ngamehlo akho, ukuthi icloud yakho ihlala phezu kwabo, nokuthi uhamba phambireigna ngesonto emgodini wezulu, nobusuku emgodini womlilo.
Uma ubulala labo bonke abantu ngasikhathi sinye, khona-ke izizwe ezikhuluma ngezwi lakho zizothi,
Ngokuba iNkosi akakwazi ukuwangenisa la maqembu ezweni, awabhekile kubo; ngakho wabulala labo esiqhingini.
Ngakho manje, Nkosi, ngikucela ubone ukuthi amandla akho akhulu kangakanani, njengoba uthe:
UNkulunkulu ushesha ukucasuka, ugcwele inhlonipho; uxosha ububi nobubi, kodwa angeke agcine owinile ephephile; ubheka isono samababa kumantombazane kuze kube yiminyaka emithathu namashumi amane.
Ngikucela, usindise abantu bami; ngoba ubulungisa bakho bukhulu kakhulu, njengokuba ubabambisene nabo kusukela bephuma eYiputa kuze kube manje.
Wathi iNkosi, Ngibaxoshe ngokusho kwezwi lakho.
Kodwa-ke, njengoba ngiphila, futhi njengoba izwe lonke lizogcwele ubuhle bukaYehova,

Wonke umuntu phakathi kwalabo abantu ngeke abone izwe. Babona ubuhle bam, nezibonakaliso zami engizenzayo eYiputa nasezindaweni ezishisayo; futhi bangisibuza izikhathi eziyisishiyagalombili, bangangilalelanga.
Akekho phakathi kwabo ozobona izwe engikhuluma ngalo kubaba babo; angeke akubona bonke labo abangikhohlisayo.
Kodwa umkhonzi wami uKalebe unengqondo ehlukile, futhi walandela ngami ngomphefumulo wakhe wonke; ngakho ngizowufaka ezweni ebelubhekene nalo, nembewu yakhe izoyithola ibe yindawo yabo.
Ngokuba ama-Amaleki namadodakazi aseKanana ahlala emigodini, buyelani ngoMsombuluko, nihambe esiqhingini, ngendlela yolwandle olumnyama.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Ngabe ngizohlala isikhathi esingakanani ngalesi sizwe esibi, esinamahloni ngami? Ngiye ngalalela amahloni amakhosikazi aseSirayeli ngami.
Uzothi kubo: Ngiphila, kusho iNkosi, uma ngingakwenzani nalokho engikubonayo ngamazwi enu.
Kulesi siqhingi izicubu zenu zizofa. Wonke umuntu phakathi kwenu oneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu, owahlukaniswa ngenani lakhe, lowo owayenquma ukukhuluma ngami,
ngeke nifike ezweni engithembise ukuthi ngizokushiyela kulo, ngaphandle kukaKalebe unyana kaJefune noYoshuwa unyana kaNune.
Uthe: "Izingane zenu zizothathwa njengeziboshwa," kodwa ngizozifaka, futhi bazoyidla izwe lenu olukukhohlisayo.
Kodwa-ke, mayelana nawe, izicubu zakho ezifile zizowela kulo mfula.
Bazohamba izingane zenu ezweni elimnyama iminyaka engama-40, futhi bazobhekana nokuhlukunyezwa kwenu, kuze kube yilapho zonke izicubu zenu zilele kulolu mhlaba.
Kusukela ngosuku olulodwa kuya kusuku olulodwa, kuze kube yiminyaka emashumi mane, nizothwala isono senu; ukuze nikwazi ukuthi inkani lami linjani.
Ngikhuluma, ngiyathi, ngizozenza lezi zinto kulesi sizwe esibi sonke, esizungezile ngami; lapha emfuleni bazophela, bazofa lapha.
Baphinde babuyela, abantu ababethunyelwe nguMosis ukubheka izwe, wabangela ukuthi bonke abantu baseSirayeli babe nomsindo ngaye, ngenxa yolwazi olubi mayelana nezwe.
Lawa madoda, akhuluma ngokubi ngalolu lizwe, lahlaselwa yisifo, wafa phambi koYehova.
UYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, noKhalebe unyana ka-Yefune, abazange baphile phakathi kwamadoda onke adlulele ukubheka izwe.
Wathi uMosis kuwo wonke amadodana aseSirayeli amazwi kaYehova, futhi bahlupheka kakhulu.
Bavuka ekuseni kakhulu, baphuma befika esiphethweni somfula, bethi, Sithole isono; namuhla sizohamba ezweni iNkosi akusho ngalo.
Wathi uMoses, Kungani na ukuthi niphula umthetho kaYehova? Lo msebenzi awuzophumelela.
Musani ukunyuka, ngoba iNkosi akakho phakathi kwenu, ukuze nigwetshwe phambi kwalabo abaphikisayo.
Bakhona khona ama-Amaleki nabaseKanana phambi kwenu, futhi nizoqhutshwa emdlalweni; ngenxa yokuthi niyibeke phansi izandla zenu enhliziyweni yeNkosi, yena ngeke abe nani.
Kodwa-ke, bakwazi ukunyuka bafike esiphethweni somfula; uMoses nodoti womthetho kaYehova abasukanga emgwaqweni.
Bakhuphuka ama-Amaleki namadodakazi aseKanana, ahlala kulo mfula, babhekana nabo, bababulala kuze kube yiHorma.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
"Uzokhuluma ngabantwana bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni engikunika lona ukuba yikhaya lenu,

uma ninesiphuzo somlilo esilungiselelwe iNkosi, kusuka ezilwaneni zenu, noma kusukela emihlambini yenu; kungabe yisondlo esiqhutshwayo, noma isondlo esisodwa, ukufeza isibopho sakho, noma njengesibopho sesipho, noma ezimkhosini zenu, njengephunga elimnandi kukaNkulunkulu.
Uma umuntu enikela ngesibopho sakhe, kufanele aveze umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu: ilitha elilodwa lomhluzi ohlanzekile, elihlanganiswe nelitha elilodwa le-oyile.
Ngengane ngayinye yomnikelo wokushiswa, noma iyiphi enye inhlanhla, kufanele ulungiselele ilitha elilodwa lomnqumo wewayini.
Nomuntu wesifazane, ulungiselele isiphuzo somnqumo esifana nekhilogremu ezintathu zoshizi oluhlanzekile oluhlanganisiwe nolitha elilodwa nesithathu lephethroli;
kanye nelitha elilodwa nesithathu lewayini njengomnikelo wokudla; kuzoba yiphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uma ulungiselela inkomo encane, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, noma ibe yisonka, ukufeza isibopho esikhethekile, noma ibe ngumnikelo wokuthula kuYehova;
bese uletha nengulube isonka sokudla esingu-kilogremu ezinhlanu nesishiyagalombili sekhofi elihlanzekile, lixutshwe namalitha amabili ephethiloli.
futhi uthele ilitha elilodwa lewayini njengesonka, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, umhluzi othandekayo kukaNkulunkulu.
Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngengulube ngayinye, nomuntu ngayinye, nengane yamahhashi noma inkomo.
Yenza lokhu ngesilwane ngasinye, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi siningi kangakanani.
Wonke umuntu ozalwa kulolu lizwe kufanele akwenze njalo, uma enikela ngenhlanhla ngomlilo, ngephunga elimnandi kuYehova.

Uma kukhona ongaphandle ehlala phakathi kwenu, noma omunye umuntu ohlala phakathi kwenu eminyakeni ezayo, futhi enikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa wephunga elimnandi iNkosi, njengoba nikwenzayo nikwenze naye.
Umthetho owodwa uzobe ukhona engqungqutheleni yenu, nani nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu; umthetho ohlala njalo kuzo zonke izizwe zenu. Lo mhlali nowezinye izizwe nifana phambi koYehova.
Umthetho owodwa nomthetho ofanayo uzobe ukhona phakathi kwenu, nani nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
"Ukhuluma kubantwana bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni lapho ngizokulethela khona,
futhi uma nidla ukudla kwezwe, kufanele niyibeke endaweni ekhethekile, ibe yisipho esikhethekile kuYehova.
Ngokuqala kwe-dough yakho, unike i-loaf njengesipho esikhethekile. Nceda uyinike njengoba unikela ngesipho esikhethekile kusuka embewuni endaweni yokudla.
Ngazo zonke izinsuku ezizayo, kufanele ninikeze umnikelo okhethekile kukaNkulunkulu, osuka engxenyeni yokuqala yomhluzi wenu.
Uma kungenxa yephutha lenu, ningagcinanga noma yimuphi lo myalo iNkosi abewisela kuMosesi;
nganoma iyiphi imiyalelo iNkosi awawisela kuwe ngesandla sikaMoses, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho wabeka khona imiyalelo yakhe, kuze kube yilapho.

Uma ibandla lonke lisenza lokhu ngephutha, ngaphandle kokukwaziyo, khona-ke ibandla lonke lizonikela inkomo encane eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, ube ngumhluzi othandekayo kukaNkulunkulu, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesipho saso sotshwala, ngokusho komthetho; nomkhwenyana wesifazane owodwa abe yisondlo sesono.

Wathi umbingeleli alungise ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli phambi koNkulunkulu, futhi bakhululwe; ngoba kwakuyiphutha labo. Banikeza umnikelo wabo wokushiswa kuYehova kanye nesonka sabo sokuhlukunyezwa ngenxa yephutha labo.
Wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli uzoxoshwa, nalabo abangaphandle bemi phakathi kwabo; ngoba abantu bonke babe yingxenye yephutha labo.
Uma umuntu ephelelwe yithemba, kufanele athathe inkomo yonyaka owodwa, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Umbingeleli kufanele alungise lowo muntu phambi koNkulunkulu, ngenxa yesono sakhe esingenakulindela; futhi uma elungiswe phambi koThixo, uzoxoshwa.
Lolu mthetho luyasebenza kuwo wonke umuntu onephutha, noma akhuleke ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma abe ngumuntu ovela kwelinye izwe ohlala phakathi kwabo.
Kodwa uma umuntu ephelelwa yithemba, ekhohlisa ngokucacile, noma ngabe ungumnikazi wezwe, noma ngabe unomhlalaphansi, yena uphula umthetho kaYehova; lowo muntu kufanele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Uthe wakhohlisa ilizwi likaYehova, waphula umthetho wakhe; lowo muntu kufanele akhululwe; ubugebengu bakhe bukhona kuye.
Kwathi lapho abantu bakaSirayeli behlala ezweni laseNdiya, kwatholakala umuntu eqoqa imithi ngeSonto.
Bathi labo ababemuthola eqoqa imithi, bamletha kuMoses no-Aron, nebandla lonke.
Bagcina ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ngoba kwakungeke kube kucacile ukuthi yini okufanele kwenziwe kuye.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Umuntu lowo kufanele abulawe; ibandla lonke kumele ligweme ngamathumba ngaphandle kwesiqhingi.
Wathi ke wonke umphakathi wamkhipha ngaphandle kwesiqhingi, wamgqugquzela ngamatshe, waza wafa; njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMosis.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Bheka, ngikhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, ngithi kubo: Kuzohlala isikhathi eside ukuthi nikwenze izibopho ezinqolobaneni zezigqoko zenu, ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.

Uzozikhumbula ngazo zonke izimiso zikaYehova, uma uzibona, ukuze uzenze; futhi ngeke ulandele imibono yenhliziyo yakho, noma imicabango yamehlo akho, eyenza ukuthi ningikhohlwe. Uzozikhumbula ngazo zonke izimiso zikaYehova, uma uzibona, ukuze uzigcine.
ukuze niyikhumbula yonke imiyalo yami, niyenze, nibe ngcwele kuThixo wenu.
Ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu, owazikhipha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngibe uNkulunkulu wenu; ngiye iNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu.
UKora, unyana ka-Izhar, unyana ka-Kohati, unyana ka-Levi, waba mkhulu; naye wahlangana naye uDathani noAbironi, oonyana baka-Elibha, noOn, unyana ka-Pelethe, waseRubeni.
Basuka babhekana noMoses, namadoda amakhulu amabili namahlanu aseSirayeli, abezikhulu ezidume kakhulu, abakhethiwe ngumphakathi.
Bahlangana noMoses no-Aron, bethi kubo: "Niya phambili kakhulu; ibandla lonke lingcwele, wonke umuntu, futhi iNkosi unguye kubo; kungani nizibeka phezu kwabantu bakaYehova? "
UMoses, lapho ekubona khona lokhu, wehla ngobuso bakhe phansi.

Wathi kuKora, nakwabo bonke ababili bakhe, Ngosuku oluzayo iNkosi uzobonisa ukuthi ngubani owakhe, nokuthi ngubani ongcwele, ukuze amsize afike kuye; nomuntu owazikhethela yena, ukuze amsize afike kuye.
Ngakho lokhu kufanele ukwenze, wena nomndeni wakho wonke, wena noKora; nithathe iziqhingi zomlilo.
Uzobeka phezu kwazo umlilo nofuzo phambi koYehova kusasa; futhi umuntu okhethayo iNkosi, yena ozobe ngungcwele. Niye, abakwaLevi, nidlulele kakhulu!
Wathi uMoses kuKora, Ngisho manje, nilabaLevi!

Ingabe akuncane kuwe, ukuthi uNkulunkulu kaSirayeli awazihlukanisile nisuka engqungqutheleni, ukuze anidlulise kuye, ukuba nisebenzele itente elingcwele likaYehova, nihlale phambi kwengqungquthela, nibambisene nabo?
Wakudlulisa wena nabangani bakho bonke, abaLevi, kuye; futhi nifuna ukuba ngabapristi?
Kulungile, wena nomndeni wakho wonke nihlangane noYehova; yini uAron, ukuthi nimbukele kuye?
Wathumela uMoses, wabiza uDathani noAbironi, oonyana bakaElibha; bathi ke, Asizofika.
Kuncane yini lokhu, ukuthi usikhuphule ezweni eligcwele ubisi nenyamakazi, ukuze ushukumise esiqhingini? Ufuna futhi ukuba ngummengameli wethu?
Akekho umuntu owaziyo ukuthi sizofika ezweni elishayela ubisi nengulube, noma sizothola izitshalo nezihlahla zezinkomo. Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi uzozikhohlisa lezi ndodana? Asizofika!'
UMoses wehluleke kakhulu, wathi kuYehova, Ungavumeli umnikelo wabo; angikaze ngiwuthathe lutho kubo, noma inkomo eyodwa kuphela, futhi angikaze ngikwenze kabi omunye wabo.
Wathi uMoses kuKora, Thola wena nomndeni wakho wonke phambi koYehova ngoLwesihlanu; wena nabanye, noAron.
Niyithathe inkomishi ngayinye, nifake kuyo uvumba; nizibeke phambi kukaYehova: iinkomishi ezimakhulu amabili namashumi mahlanu; wena no-Aron nizithele izinkomishi zenu.
Bathatha ke wonke umuntu inkomishi yakhe, babeka kuyo umlilo, namafutha omnqumo, behlala emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, noMoses noAron.
UKora wahlangana nabo bonke abantu bakhe emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana; khona-ke ubuhle bukaYehova babuvela emphakathini wonke.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
"Hamba kude nalabo abantu, ukuze ngibasindise ngasikhathi sinye!
Wathi uMoses noAron, babhujiswa ngobuso babo ezweni, bathi: ONkulunkulu, uNkulunkulu onikeza umoya kuwo wonke umuntu ophilayo, ngabe umuntu owodwa enze isono, futhi wena ugweme isizwe sonke?
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi kulowo mhlangano: "Nquma ukuba uhambe kude nezindawo zokuhlala kukaKora, noDathani, noAbironi."
Wavuka uMoses, waya kuDathani no-Abironi; nabo bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli balandela.
Wathi kubo bonke ibandla, Nisuka ezindaweni zokuhlala zalabo bantu ababi, nize ningagculisi lutho olulodwa oluye lwaba lwayo, ukuze ningabi nokufa ngenxa yazo zonke izigebengu zabo.

Basuka khona ezindaweni zokuhlala kukaKora, noDathani, noAbironi, ngazo zonke izingcezu; uDathani noAbironi baphuma behlala emgwaqeni wezindawo zabo zokuhlala, namadodakazi abo, nabantwana babo, nezingane zabo.
Wathi uMoses, Ngalokhu nizokwazi ukuthi nguYehova obemithumela ukuba ngikwenze lezi zinto zonke, ukuthi angizange ngikwenze ngami.
Uma labo bantu befa, njengokufa kwanoma yimuphi umuntu, iNkosi angithumelele.
Kodwa uma iNkosi esenza into entsha, futhi izwe livuleka, liwaphuza labo nanoma yini enabo, bafike bephila emgodini wokufa; khona-ke nizozi ukuthi laba bantu baphula umthetho kaNkulunkulu.
Kwathi, lapho uMoses eqedile ukukhuluma ngalolu daba lonke, izwe elingaphansi kwabo lahlukaniswa.
Umhlaba wawuvuleka, wawela kubo, namakhaya abo, nalabo bonke abantu bakaKora, nezinto zabo zonke.
Baphuma bephila, nabo bonke ababenabo, bawela emgodini wokufa; izwe liwavala phezu kwabo, banyamalala phakathi kwebandla.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli onke asendaweni yabo, lapho ezwa khona izingcingo zabo, wabaleka, wathi: "Izwe lizosidla nathi."
Ke kaloku kwaphuma umlilo esuka kuYehova, wabulala labo bantu abangamakhulu amabili namashumi mahlanu abanikela ngefutha.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi ku-Elihazare, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, ukuthi athathe amabhodwe omlilo emlilweni, futhi ahlukanise amakhowe akhanyayo; ngoba amabhodwe awangcwele.

Lezi yizinkomishi zabantu ababhidlile ngempilo yabo; uzokwenza ngazo izinkomishi ezincane, ukuze zigqoke isibingelelo; ngoba bathunyelwe phambi koYehova, futhi bangcwele; zibe yizibonakaliso kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi u-Elazar, umpristi, waqoqa amabhodlela egolide, abo bonke abantu abathunyelwe, wabeka ngazo isigqoko sendawo yokubhekwa.

Waba ngumbukiso kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuthi akukho muntu ngaphandle kuka-Aron ozofika asindise inkungu phambi koYehova, ukuze angabi njengoKora nomndeni wakhe, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uEleazar ngoMoses.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli likhala ngoMosesi noAron, besithi, Nibulale abantu bakaYehova.
Kwathi lapho ibandla lihlangane noMoses na-Aron, babhekana nethenda lokuhlangana; kwabonakala ukuthi izulu liyifihla, futhi ubuhle bukaYehova buvela.
UMoses no-Aron bafika phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Bathi: "Thumelani phakathi kwalabo bantu, ukuze ngibasindise ngaso sonke isikhathi!" Bawubulale ubuso babo phansi.

Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Thola inkomishi yakho yomlilo, ubeke kuyo umlilo osuka emgodini womlilo, ukhiphe phezu kwayo inkomishi yomlilo; uye engqungqutheleni, uxhumane nabo; ngoba inhliziyo kaYehova ihlukumezeke kakhulu, isifo esibulalayo siqala.
U-Aron wenza njengoba uMoses esho, wahamba phakathi kwabaningi, lapho isifo saqala khona phakathi kwabantu. Wabeka phezu kwawo umnqumo, walungisa abantu phambi kukaThixo.
Wahlala phakathi kwabafileyo nalabo abaphilayo, khona-ke isifo sayeka.
Abantu abamashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka namakhulu asixhenxe bafa ngalolu bhubhane, ngaphandle kwalabo ababefa ngenxa kaKora.
Wabuyela uAron kuMoses, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana; ngoba isifo saso siphelile.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuSirayeli: "Ukhulume nabantwana baka-Israyeli, uze ubathathele izinkomishi ezingu-12; inkomishi ngayinye ibe yindodana yomndeni kayise.
Kuwo umkhonyovu kaLevi, ubhale igama lika-Aron. Kuzomele kube nomkhonyovu owodwa wesizwe ngasinye somzali.
Uzibeke esitezi sokuhlangana, phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, lapho ngizohlangana khona nawe.
Uma umuntu ngiwukhetha, khona-ke itshe lakhe lizokhula libe yizimbali; futhi ngale ndlela ngizomisa ukubhukha kwabantu bakaSirayeli phezu kwakho.

Wakhuluma ke uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; futhi abaphathi babo bamnika izinkomishi ezilishumi elinambini, umholi ngamnye wamadodakazi abo, inkomishi ngayinye; inkomishi ka-Aron yayiphakathi kwabo.
Wabeka uMoses izintambo phambi koYehova, esitezi somthetho wobufakazi.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, uMoses efika esihlalweni sethunywa somthetho, wabona ukuthi intambo ka-Aron, eyakwaLevi, yakhula, yavula amaqabunga ayo, yavula izimbali zayo, yavuna amaqanda ayo.
Wazikhipha uMoses zonke izinkomishi phambi kweNkosi, wazisa kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; babhekana nabo, futhi umholi ngamnye wathola inkomishi yakhe.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yenza isandla sika-Aron sibuyiselwe emuva phambi kwebhokisi lesinqumo; ligcinwe khona, libe ngubufakazi kubo bonke labo abakhohlisayo, ukuze kungabikho ukucasuka kwabo ngami, ukuze bangafa.
Wakwenza ke uMoses, njengoba iNkosi abemwisile.
Bathi amadodana aseSirayeli kuMoses, Sizofa; silahlekile, silahlekile bonke.
Wonke umuntu ofinyelela efulethini elingcwele leNkosi, uzofa; ngabe sizofa bonke?
Wathi iNkosi ku-Aron, Uzothwala wena, nabantwana bakho, nendlu yakho yomndeni, isono sendawo engcwele; uzothwala wena, nabantwana bakho, isono semisebenzi yenu yamabhishobhi.
Udadewabo, isizwe samaLevi, isizwe sobaba wakho, ubeke phambi kwakho, ukuze basebenze nawe; wena nobana bakho nisebenza phambi kwendlu yomthetho.
Bazosebenza ngaphansi kwakho, futhi bazogcina umsebenzi wesitezi sonke; kodwa ngeke bafinyelele ezintoni ezingcwele, noma emgodini womlilo, ukuze bangafa bonke, bona nowe.
Bazoqhathaniswa nawe, futhi bazogcina umsebenzi wesitezi sokuhlangana, ukuze basebenze kuyo yonke imisebenzi yayo; ngeke kube khona umuntu othile ongakufinyelela.
Uzogcina isikhundla sendawo engcwele, kanye nesihlalo somlilo, ukuze kungabikho ubuhlungu phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Ngabona ukuthi ngithathe abazalwane benu, abaLevi, phakathi kwabenyunyana bakaSirayeli; nibanikeze umnikelo wokudla, banikezelwe kuYehova, ukuze benze umsebenzi wesitezi sokubonisa.

Kodwa wena nobana bakho nizosebenza njengombhishobhi, ngezinto zonke eziphathelene nesihlalo somlilo, nalapho kungena khona ifasitela; ngoba ngikulethela umsebenzi wombhishobhi njengomnikelo. Wonke umuntu ofika endaweni engcwele kumele abulawe.

Wathi iNkosi ku-Aron, Khangela, ngikubeke wena phezu kwezipho zami ezikhethekile, ngazo zonke izinto ezingcwele zabantwana bakaSirayeli, abazinikela kimi; ngiyazinika kuwe, nawe izingane zakho, zibe yingxenye yenu kuze kube sekupheleni; ngoba ukhonjwe.

Le ngxenye izobe iyiyakho, kuzo zonke izinto ezingcwele kakhulu, ezenziwe ngomlilo: yonke iminikelo yabo yokudla, nomnikelo wosono, nomnikelo wesono, nanoma iyiphi insizakalo yabo yokusola; yizinto ezingcwele kakhulu, zizoba zakhona wena nabana bakho.
Uzozidla njengokudla okungcwele kakhulu; wonke umuntu owesifazane uzozidla, uzoba ngumuntu ongcwele.

Lezo zinto ziye zibe zakho: iminikelo yokwahlulela, ethathwe kuwo wonke ama-offering aqhutshwayo omndeni wakwaSirayeli; ngizinika wena, nabantwana bakho, namantombazane akho, njengomthetho wakho ohlala njalo. Wonke umuntu ohlanzekile endlwini yakho angazidla.
Futhi ngikulethela konke okungcono kwe-olive oil, newayini elisha, nembewu, izingcezu zokuqala zokuvuna kwabo, abazozinikela kuYehova.
Zonke izithelo zokuqala zezwe labo, abazoziletha kuYehova, zizobe zakhona; wonke umuntu ohlanzekile emndenini wakho angazidla.
Wonke umuntu ezweni lakwaSirayeli, onikezelwe ngokuphelele kuYehova, uzobe wakho.

Wonke umuntu ozalwa kuqala, noma inkomo ezalwa kuqala, izobe iyiyakho; kodwa wonke umfazi ozalwa kuqala, nomuntu ozalwa kuqala, noma inkomo ephilayo engahlanzekile, kumele uyithengele imali yokubuyisa.
Uma beneminyaka emibili ubudala, kufanele bathengiswe ngemali elinganiselwe yegolide elinhlanu, ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele, okungu-shekeli eziyishumi nambili.

Kodwa uma uvula ibele lengulube, noma ibele lengulube, noma ibele lemvu, awukwazi ukulithenga; ngoba lingcwele. Uzolibazisa igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo, futhi uzowusindisa umkhuhlane wabo, ibe yisonka esiqhutshwa ngamlilo, njengephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Inyama yabo izobe yakho, njengokuba ibele elibiwe nemilenze yesobunxele ziyobe zakho.

Wonke umthwalo ophakanyisiwe, wezinto ezingcwele abazinikela ngazo izingane zakwaSirayeli kuYehova, ngiwunike wena, nabangane bakho, nabantwana bakho, njengomthetho wakho wokugcina;reign of salt ephilayo phambi kweNkosi, isivumelwano esihlala isikhathi eside, kuwe nomndeni wakho ngemuva kwakho.
Wathi iNkosi ku-Aron, Awunazo izimpahla ezweni lakwaSirayeli, futhi awunayo inkontileka phakathi kwabantu; mina ngiyinkontileka yakho nempahla yakho emnothweni phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ngabona ukuthi ngibanike amaLevi ishumi lazo zonke izinto ezweni laseSirayeli, ibe yimikhaya yabo, ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo owenza emkhunjini wokuhlangana.
Ngaleso sikhathi abantu bakaSirayeli ngeke bafinyelele entabeni yokuhlangana, ukuze bangaba nesono, futhi baphile.

AbaLevi kuphela abazosebenza esitezi sokuhlangana, futhi bazoyithwala iphutha layo. Kuye kube ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside emiphakathini yenu yonke; futhi abakwaLevi ngeke babe nempahla phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Kodwa ishumi eliphelele, labo abaSirayeli abanikela ngalo umnikelo wokudla kuYehova, ngilinikeza amaLevi libe yimihlaba yabo; ngakho ngithi, Akufanele babe nempahla phakathi kwabaSirayeli.'
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uzokhuluma kwabaLevi, usithi kubo: Uma nithola emindenini yabantwana bakaSirayeli ingxenye yeshumi engikulethelayo njengempahla yenu, kufanele ninikeze ingxenye yeshumi laleyo ingxenye yeshumi, ibe yisibopho esiphakeme kukaNkulunkulu.
Isipho sakho sizobhekwa kuwe njengokuba kuyisithelo esivela ezindaweni zokudlidliza noma isiphuzo esivela emgodini.
Ngale ndlela nizonikela ngomnikelo oshiswayo kuYehova, ngazo zonke izingxenye zeshumi eziphikisayo ezithathwe kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli; nizonikeza uAron ukumkani inkontileka kaYehova.
Kuzo zonke izimpahla zakho ongazitholayo, uzozinikela ngalokho okungcwele kakhulu, njengomnikelo wokudla kaYehova.
Uzokhuluma kuLevi, usithi: Uma ninikela ngento engcono kakhulu, itholwe kuwe njengento ephuma emgodini wokudla, nento ephuma emgodini wewayini.
Ungayidla kuphi naphi, ninemindeni yenu; yimali yenu ngenxa yomsebenzi wenu esitezi sokuhlangana.
Uma unikela ngento engcono kakhulu yayo, ngeke ube nesono ngaleyo nto; kodwa akufanele unciphise izinto ezingcwele zakwaSirayeli, ukuze ungafa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Lokho wumthetho owawuthi iNkosi, uthi kubantwana bakaSirayeli, ukuthi bakulethe kuwe inkomo encane ebomvu, engabi necala nanoma yikuphi okubi kuyo; ingulube engasebenzisi umkhonyovu.
Uzoyinikela ku-Elazarhi umbingeleli, ithathwe ibe ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi, ibe yinyama phambi kwakhe.
U-Elazar, umbingeleli, uzothatha igazi layo emlonyeni wakhe, aphuze igazi lakhe izikhathi ezisixhenxe ebusweni besitezi sokuhlangana.
Uma kunjalo, ingulube kumele igcwaliswe lapho ebheka khona: isikhumba sayo, inyama yayo, ushukela wayo, nenyama yaso kufanele igcwaliswe.
Umbingeleli uzothatha umnqumo wezinkuni, ne-hysop, nentambo emnyama, azozibeka phakathi komlilo lapho inkomo iqhuma khona.
Uzohlamba izigqoko zakhe, futhi uzohlanza umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, bese ubuyela esiteshini; kodwa ngeke abe nenyama kuze kube sebusuku.
Owesifazane owenza umlilo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, abe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Umuntu ohlanzekile kumele aqoqe inkungu yengulube, ayibeke endaweni ehlanzekile ngaphandle komkhosi, ukuze igcinwe yibandla lakwaSirayeli, ibe ngamanzi okuwahlanza; kuyinto yomnikelo wokudla.

Uma umuntu eqoqa inkungu yakhe, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, futhi abe nakanjani kuze kube sebusuku. Kube ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, nakwalowo ohlala phakathi kwabo.
Wonke umuntu onqoba umuntu ofile, uzobe unqunywe izinsuku ezisithupha.
Uzohlanzwa ngamanzi ngosuku oluthathu, nosuku lwesixhenxe, futhi uzohlanjululwa; kodwa uma engazihlanza usuku lwesithathu, nosuku lwesixhenxe, ngeke ahlanzwe..

Wonke umuntu ocindezela umuntu ofile, engeke ahlanze isikhumba sakhe, ungenza isivivinyo esingcwele sikaYehova sibe mnyama; lowo muntu kufanele ahlonyiswe emazweni aseSirayeli. Ngokuba amanzi okuhlanza awaphuziswe phezu kwakhe, ube mnyama; ububi bakhe buhlala kuye.
Lokho wumthetho, uma umuntu efa enhliziyweni; wonke umuntu ophuma enhliziyweni yakhe, nanoma ubani ohlala enhliziyweni yakhe, bazobe bengenawo amanzi izinsuku ezisithupha.
Yonke inkomishi evulekile, engenasici esiboshwe phezu kwayo, izobi.
Wonke umuntu, uma ebhekene nomuntu obulawe ngeqhwa, noma ophilayo, noma ithambo lomuntu, noma isibhedlela, ezweni elivulekile, uzobe unqunywe ubusuku obuyisithupha.
Ukwenza ukuthi umuntu ongcolileyo ahlanzeke, kufanele ubeke inkungu yesonka esilahliwe emgodini, uthele phezu kwayo amanzi ahlanzekile.

Umuntu ohlanzekile kufanele athathe imbewu ye-hyssop, ayitshebe emanzini, afafaze inkosikazi, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuyo, nalabo bonke abakhona; futhi kumele afafaze lowo yizicubu zomuntu, noma umuntu obulawe, noma umuntu owafa, noma isibhedlela.

Umuntu ohlanzekile kufanele ahlanze umuntu ongcolileyo ngosuku lwesithathu, futhi ngosuku lwesithupha. Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili kumele ahlanze umuntu ohlanzekile; futhi umuntu ohlanzekile kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, bese emini uzohlanzwa.

Uma umuntu engenawo uthuli, futhi engahlanzeki, lowo muntu onjalo uzosuswa emiphakathini yenu; ngoba wahlambalaza indawo engcwele kaYehova; amanzi okuhlanzeka awaqhutshwa phezu kwakhe; yena ungcolile.
Lo mthetho uzoba ngumthetho wabo ohlala njalo; umuntu onqoba amanzi okuhlanza kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, nalowo onquma amanzi okuhlanza kumele abe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Nanoma yini ayishiye umuntu ongcolileyo, izobi namanzi; futhi wonke umuntu oyishiye, uzobi namanzi kuze kube semini.
Kwafika ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli esiqhingini sikaZin, ngonyaka wokuqala, bahlala eKadeshi; khona-ke wafa uMiriam, wabanjwa khona.
Akukho amanzi emphakathini, khona-ke ibandla lahlangana kuMoses noHaarnau.
Baze baxoxa noMoses, bethi, Ngabe sifile lapho abazalwane bethu befa phambi kukaYehova!
Kungani na ukuthi ningenise abantu bakaYehova kulolu lwandle, ukuze sife lapha, nathi nezilwane zethu?
Kungani na ke ukuthi nithule sisuka eYiputa, nisiveze kulo mhlaba obuhlungu? Akunawo ubisi, noma ama-tines, noma izimbali zewayini, noma ama-pomegranate; futhi akukho amanzi okuwadla.
UMoses no-Aron basuka engqungqutheleni, befika emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, bahlaliswa ngobuso babo phansi; futhi ubuhle bukaYehova babuvela kubo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Thola isandla sakho, wena noAron umkhuluwa wakho, niyihlanganise inkundla; bese nikhuluma kulo mbhoshongo phambi kwamehlo abo, khona-ke uzokhipha amanzi alo; futhi nizo ukukhishwa kwamanzi emibhoshongoni, ukuze inkundla ibe nenyama yabo.
Wathatha uMoses isandla esingaphambilini kweNkosi, njengokuba iNkosi abemwisile.
UMoses no-Aron baqoqa abantu phambi kodonga. Wathi kubo uMoses, "Hlelani, nibuxoki! Ingabe sizokulethela amanzi kusuka kulodonga?"
Waphakamisa uMoses isandla sakhe, washaya isibhakabhaka ngentambo yakhe izikhathi ezimbili, kwaphuma amanzi ngokunethezeka; yadla inkundla nenyama yawo.
UYehova wathi kuMosesi noHaronu, Ngokuba ningakholwa kimi, ukuthi ningingcwele phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ngakho-ke ngeke ningenise leli bandla ezweni engiyabanika lona.
Laziwa ngokuthi amanzi eMeriba, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakaSirayeli baxoxa khona noYehova; wabonisa ukuthi ungcwele kubo.
UMoses wathumela abathunywa eKadeshi kuye ukumkani waseEdom, bethi kuye, Usho lokhu inkosikazi yakho uSirayeli, ethi: Uyazi zonke izimo ezibuhlungu esidlule kuzo;
lapho ababa bethu behla eYiputa, sahlala khona iminyaka eminingi; futhi abaMisitaniya bakwenza kabi nathi nababa bethu.
Sacela iNkosi, waphendula, wathumela isithunywa, wasikhipha eYiputa; futhi manje sikhona eKadeshe, emzini ophakathi kwezwe lakho.

Siyakucela, usivumele sidlule ezweni lakho; ngeke sidlule ezindlini zakho, noma emivinini yakho, futhi singadla amanzi emfuleni onke. Sizohlala esiphelweni sendlela yobukhosi; ngeke sishintshe ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele, kuze sidlule ezweni lakho.
Wathi uEdom kuye, Awuzodlula lapha; ngoba uma udlula khona-ke, sizophuma futhi sizokuhlasela ngekhebula lethu.
Bathi kubo: "Sizohlala kulolu hambo; uma sidla amanzi akho, thina noma izilwane zethu, sizokhokha inhlawulo yamanzi ethu, futhi siyahamba ngezinyawo kuphela."
Wathi ke uEdom kubo, Uzodlula kuphi? Waphuma khona uEdom ebhekana nabo, eneqembu elikhulu, elinamandla kakhulu.
Kwathi, ngenxa yokuthi uEdom akazange avumele amaSirayeli ukuba adlule ezweni lakhe, amaSirayeli awashiya.
Basuka eKadeshi, bafika emfuleni uHori, bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses noAron, emfuleni iHori, enhliziyweni kaEdomu, wathi,
U-Aron uzofa, ahlangane nabantu bakhe; ngeke afike ezweni enginika lona izingane zakwaSirayeli, ngenxa yokuthi ninqobile umyalo wami ngamanzi aseMeriba.
Thola uAron noEleazaru, unyana wakhe, bafike emfuleni iHori.
Uzowususa u-Aron izigqoko zakhe zokuba ngumpristi, uzozigqokisa u-Elazar, unyana wakhe; u-Aron uzofa khona lapho, ahlangane nabantu bakhe.
Wakwenza uMoses njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; benyuka phezulu emfuleni iHori, phambi kwamehlo komphakathi wonke.
UMoses wasusa izicathulo zika-Aron, wamgqoka uEleazaru unyana wakhe. Wafa khona khona u-Aron phezulu emfuleni; uMosis no-Eleazaru baphuma emfuleni.
Kwathi lapho ibandla lonke libona ukuthi uAron ufile, bonke amadodana aseSirayeli abulale uAron izinyanga ezimashumi amathathu.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwaKanana wase-Aradi, ohlala eNtshonalanga, ekwazi ukuthi abantu bakaSirayeli befika ngendlela yase-Atarim, wahlasela amaSirayeli, wathatha abanye kubo.
Wathi uSirayeli, ekhuluma kukaNkulunkulu, ukuthi: "Uma unikela ngalolu hlanga emlenzeni wethu, siyazibulala zonke izizwe zabo."
UYehova waphendula amaSirayeli, wabanikela ngabaseKanana phambi kwabo; babenquma ukuwabulala bonke namadolobha abo; ngakho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe ngokuthi iHora.
Basuka eMfuleni uHori, behamba ngendlela yolwandle olumnyama, ukuze bajikeleze izwe lika-Edom; kodwa abantu baphoqeleka ukuba bahambe ngesandla esinzima.
Bakhuluma ngoNkulunkulu noMoses, bethi, Kungani na ukuthi nisikhuphele ezweni laseMizi-Yiputa, ukuze sife esiqhingini? Akukho ukudla, akukho amanzi; futhi siyamthanda lokudla okubi.
Wathumela iNkosi phakathi kwabantu izinkomo ezibi kakhulu, zazibulala abantu; kwaba khona abantu abaningi baseSirayeli abafile.
Bafika ke abantu kuMoses, bethi, Sifile thina, ngoba sakhuluma ngoYehova nowe; thandaza kuYehova ukuthi asuse kuzona lezi ntaka. UMosis wathandaza ngenxa yabantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yenza inkomo encane, uyibeke emgodini, ukuze wonke umuntu onqunywe ngayo abheke kuyo, aphile.
Wakwenza uMoses inkomo yesiliva, wayibeka emgodini; ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho umuntu ethenjwa yinkomo, ebheka inkomo yegolide, waphila.
Basuka abantu bakaSirayeli, bamisa isiqhingi eObhothi.
Basuka e-Obhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Iye-Abarim, esiqhingini esibhekene neMowabi, eningizimu.
Basuka khona khona, bamisa isibhedlela eGoli laseZeredi.
Basuka khona khona, bamisa isikhashana ngaphesheya komfula i-Arnoni, esiqhingini esifinyelela ezweni lama-Amori; u-Arnoni ungumkhawulo phakathi kukaMowabhi nezwe lama-Amori.
Lokhu wukuthi kungani Incwadi yamaMfazwe kaYehova ikhuluma ngo "Waheb eSuphah, nama-valleys eArnon,
kanye nezingqimba zezintaba ezifinyelela edolobhaneni le-Ar futhi zihlala eduze komgwaqo weMoab.
Basuka khona bafika eBeeri, lapho iNkosi wathi kuMosese, Zihlanganisa abantu, ngizobanikeza amanzi.
Wathi uSirayeli wadlala lo mculo, wathi: "Nqoka, ifulegi, dlala ngalo!
Uthi, "Uzokhuluma nge ifulegi, okuyinto abaphathi waxhuma, ukuthi amadoda abalulekile abantu waxhuma nge izintambo zabo royal kanye izintambo zokuhamba. "
kusukela Mattana Nahaliel, futhi kusuka Nahaliel Bamoth.
Basuka eBamothi, bafika emfuleni waseMowabi, lapho phezulu komfula iPisga ubona khona indawo enqaba.
Kwathi amaSirayeli athumela abathunywa kuShehoni, ukumkani wama-Amori, besithi,
Sizodlula ezweni lakho; asiyi kungena ezindaweni zokulima, noma ezivinini, siyodla amanzi emfuleni onke. Sizohlala emgwaqweni omkhulu wokumkani kuze sidlule ezweni lakho.
Kodwa uShehoni akazange avumele amaSirayeli ukuba adlule ezweni lakhe; wahlanganisa wonke umkhosi wakhe, waphuma waya esiqhingini, wahlasela amaSirayeli. Wafika eYahazi, wahlasela amaSirayeli.
AbaSirayeli bamhlasela emdlalweni, bathatha izwe lakhe kusukela emfuleni uArnoni kuya emfuleni uYabhoki, kuze kube yizweni lakwa-Amoni; ngoba umkhawulo wamadodana ka-Amoni wawuqinile.
Bathatha amaSirayeli yonke imiphakathi yama-Amori, bahlala kuyo, kanye neHeshboni nezindawo zayo zonke.
(Ngenxa yokuthi iHeshboni ibiyidolobha likaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori; yena owabhekana nobukhosi bokuqala bamaMowabi, wathatha lonke izwe lakhe kuya emfuleni uArnoni.)
Ngenxa yalokho abalobi bathi, Yeni eHeshboni; uSihone kufanele aphinde akhiwa futhi aqiniswe.
Ngenxa yalokho, kwaphuma umlilo eHeshboni, umsindo emzini kaShehoni; wasindisa i-Ar yaseMowabhi, namadodana asezintabeni ngase-Arnoni.
Uzolahlekelwa, wena uMowabhi! Uzolahleka, wena umuntu okhonza uKemoshi. Washiya oonyana bakhe bahambe, washiya izingane zakhe zithathelwe nguSihoni ukumkani wama-Amori.
Siwuthule uHeshboni kuze kube yiDiboni; siwuthule kuze kube yiNofa, efinyelela eMedebha.
Wahlala ke uSirayeli ezweni lama-Amori.
UMoses wathumela abantu ukuba babhekane noJazeri; futhi abaSirayeli bathatha izindlu zayo, bakhipha ama-Amori ahlala kuzo.
Baphinde babuyela, benyuka ngendlela ehamba eBhashani. Waphuma uOg ukumkani waseBhashani, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, wabahlasela e-Edrei.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ungamkholeli; ngoba ngiwubeke phambi kwakho, yena nabantu bakhe bonke, nezwe lakhe. Uzokwenza kuye njengokuba wenza kuSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni.
Babulala uOgi, nabantwana bakhe, nomndeni wakhe wonke; akazange ashiye umuntu ophilayo; bathatha izwe lakhe.
Basuka ke amakhosi aseSirayeli, bamisa isikhashana ezindaweni ezingenamanzi zaseMowabi, ngaseJordan, enkabeni yeJericho.
UBalaka unyana kaSipore wabona konke okwenze amaSirayeli kwabaAmori.
Abantu baseMowabhi bakhathazeka kakhulu, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakaSirayeli babeningi kakhulu. Amakhosi aseMowabhi ahlupheke kakhulu ngenxa yabantu bakaSirayeli.

Bathi amaMowabi kwabaphathi baseMidiyani, Lizodla leli qembu zonke izinto eziseduze kwethu, njengokuthi inkomo idle izithelo ezindaweni zomhlaba. UBalaka unyana kaSiphore waba ngukumkani wamaMowabi ngalolu sikhathi.

Wathumela, wabiza uBhileham, unyana kaBeore, ohlala ePethori, enhliziyweni yomfula i-Efrayi, ezweni lakhe lokuzalwa. UBalaka wathi, "Kuyavela isizwe esigcwele siphuma eYiputa; bona, bagubuzela indawo yomhlaba wonke, behlala eduze kwami.

Ngiyakucela, thola manje, ubulale lo mhlanga ngami; ngoba banamandla kunami. Kungenzeka ukuthi ngikwazi ukuwahlasela, futhi ngiwakhuphule ezweni; ngoba ngiyazi ukuthi lowo owubhaptizelayo ubhaptizwa, nolowo owubulalayo ubhaptizwa.
Basuka ke abakhulu baseMowabhi nabaseMidiyani, bethathe ngezandla zabo izimali zomuntu okhuluma ngezinkanyezi; bafika kuBhalamu, baveza kuye amazwi kaBalaka.
Wathi kubo uBhileham, "Bukelani lapha kusasa; noma yini ongangiphendula yona iNkosi, ngizobuya ngikutshele." Bahlala khona abakhulu baseMowabi.
Wafika uNkulunkulu kuBhileham, wathi, Babani labo abantu abakho kuwe?
Wathi uBhileham kuThixo, UBalaka unyana kaSipho, ukumkani wakwaMowabi, wathumela kuye, esithi,
Ngiyabona isizwe siphuma eYiputa, futhi siyagqugquzela isikhumba sezwe; manje ke uxhumane nami, ubeke phezu kwabo inkulumo, ukuze ngikwazi ukubhekana nabo, ngibakhuphe.
Wathi uNkulunkulu kuBhileham, "Ungayihamba nabo; ungababulali labo bantu, ngoba basindisiwe."
Wavuka ke uBhileham ekuseni, wathi kubo abakhulu bakaBalaka, Yiya ezweni lenu; ngoba iNkosi akafuni ukuthi ngihambe nani.
Babuyela kubo uBalaka abakhulu bakaMowabi, bethi, UBhalamu akafuni ukuba nathi.
Wathi uBalaka wathumela abanye abaphathi, abaningi kubo futhi abakhulu kunabokuqala.
Bafika kuBhileham, bathi kuye, Uthi uBalaka unyana kaSipho: Ngikucela, ungenzi lutho oluzokuvimbela ukuthi ungangifiki.
Ngizokulethela umnikelo omkhulu kakhulu, futhi ngizokwenza konke okushoyo; ngiyakucela, zulazula kulabo bantu ngami.

Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kubo abakhonzi bakaBalaka, Nakuba uBalaka anganginika indlu yakhe egcwele isiliva negolide, angikwazi ukuphula umthetho kaYehova uNkulunkulu wami, ngikwenze lutho olukhulu noma oluncane.
Uma kunjalo, hlalani lapha namuhla, njengokuba nabo bahlala khona; ngizobona ukuthi iNkosi uzongitshela yini.
Kwafika uNkulunkulu kuBhileham ngemini leyo, wathi kuye, Uma abantu befikile ukukubiza wena, uhamba nabo; kodwa kwenze lokho engikushoyo kuwe.
Wavuka ke uBhileham ekuseni, wamisa isikelemu sakhe, waya nabaholi baseMowabi.
UThixo wagwema ngenxa yokuthi wayehamba, wabeka isithunywa sikaYehova endlelani, ukuze agweme indlela yakhe; yena uBhileham wayehamba phezu kwebhuza lakhe, nabangane bakhe ababi.
Ithole libona uMoya oNgcwele ehlala emgwaqeni, nekhebula esikhaleni sakhe, lisuka emgwaqweni liye ensimini; uBhileham wabulala ithole, ukuze libuyele emgwaqweni.
Wathi uMoya oNgcwele, wahlala enhliziyweni encane phakathi kwezindawo ezimbili zokutshala izimbali zewayini; kwakukhona umgwaqo ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla.
Yabona inkomo isithunywa soNkulunkulu, yacindezela ikhanda layo edongweni, yacindezela nenyawo likaBhileham; yena waphinde wamshaya.
Umbingeleli kaYehova waya phambili, wahlala endaweni encane, lapho kwakungekho khona indawo yokujika ngakwesokudla noma ngasekhohlo.
Yabona inkomo uMoya oNgcwele, yalala ngezansi kukaBhileham; yena waphoqa inhliziyo yakhe, wayishaya ngentambo.
Wakwenza iNkosi ukuthi ibele likhulume, lathi kuBhileham, Yini engiyikwenzele wena, wukuthi ubumishe ngami izikhathi ezintathu?
Wathi uBhileham kulowo mkhwenyana, Ungikhohlisa; uma nginekhephu esandla sami, ngingakubulala manje.
Wathi ubhishobhi kuBhalamu, Ingabe angiyiyo ibhishobhi yakho, oyihamba ngayo kuze kube ngalolu busuku? Ngangikwenze yini lokhu kwangaphambilini? Wathi, Akunjalo.
Wavula iNkosi amehlo kaBhileham, wabona isithunywa soMoya oNgcwele sisendlela, nesikhephe esisemandleni akhe; wathi uBhileham, uxhumane ngobuso bakhe phansi.
Wathi yena umbingeleli kaYehova kuye, Kungani na ukuthi ugweme isikelemu sakho lezi zinsuku ezintathu? Ngiye ngafika ngikuvimbele indlela yakho; ngoba indlela ohamba ngayo ayilungile phambi kwami.
Yabona ibhutshuzwayo ukuthi ngikhona, yabuya yami ngalezo zikhathi ezintathu; uma ingekabuya, ngibe sengikubulala wena manje, kodwa ngiyishiye iphila.
Wathi uBhileham kusingxobo sikaYehova, Ngihlulekile; ngoba angizange ngizi ukuthi usukhona endlelani ukungivimbela; ngakho-ke, uma kungakuhle kuwe, ngizobuyela ekhaya lami.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuBhalamu, Yiya nalabo bantu; kodwa lokho ngikutshelayo wena, lokho kuphela ozokusho. Wahamba ke uBhalamu nabaholi bakaBalaka.
UBalaka, lapho ekwazi ukuthi uBhileham usefika khona, waphuma wahlangana naye emzini wamaMowabi, ogwini lwe-Arnoni, enhliziyweni yezwe lakhe.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Angikuthumeli yini wena ngamandla ukuthi ufike? Kungani na ukuthi ungafika nami? Ingabe ngingeke ngikwazi ukukunika inzalo enhle?
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, Yabona, ngifike kuwe manje; kodwa ngizokwazi yini ukuthi ngikhulume lutho? Okuthini uNkulunkulu abeke emlonyeni wami, lokho ngizokhuluma.
Wahamba ke uBhileham noBalaka waya eKiriyati-huzothi.
UBalaka wanikela ngezinkomo nezimvu, wabanika inyama uBhileham nabaholi ababe naye.
Wathi uBalaka ekuseni, wathatha uBhileham waya eBamoti-bhaali, lapho kuphakame khona uBhileham; wababona khona abantu baseSirayeli.
Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Ungikhiphe lapha izibingelelo ezisixhenxe, ngilungiselele khona izinkomo ezisixhenxe nezimvu ezisithupha.
Wakwenza uBalaka njengokuthi uBhileham, wanikela ngengulube kanye nomuntu omncane emgodini ngamnye.

Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Nqamula lapha eduze komnikelo wakho wokushiswa, ngize ngihambe; kungase kube khona ukuthi iNkosi angihlangane nami; noma yini engibonisa yona, ngizokutshela. Wahamba ke ehlathini elisha.
Wahlangana uNkulunkulu noBhileham, wathi kuye: Izibingelelo ezisixhenxe ngizilungiselele, futhi nganikela ngenkomo kanye nomkhwenyana phezu kwezibingelelo zonke.
Wabeka iNkosi incwadi emlonyeni kaBhileham, wathi, Yibuye kuBalaka, ukhulume ngale ndlela.
Wabuya ke uBhileham, wabona uBalaka ehlala eduze komnikelo wakhe wokudla, naye wonke abaholi baseMowabi.
UBhalamu waqala ukukhuluma, wathi: "UBalaka ungiveze e-Aram; ukumkani wakwaMowabi ungiveze emadolobheni asenyakatho. Wathi, 'Thina, zulazula kuYakobi; thina, zulazula eSirayeli.'
Ingabe ngizowubulala lowo uNkulunkulu angawubulali? Ngabe ngizokhuluma ngalowo iNkosi akazange akhulume ngawo?
Kusuka eziphezulu zezintaba ngibabona; kusuka emadolobheni ngiwabheka. Babantu abaphila ngokuzimela, bangazizwa sebeyizwe elilodwa phakathi kwamazwe.
Ubani okwazi ukubala abantu bakaYakobi? Baningi njengamatshe; ubani okwazi ukubala isigamu sabantu bakaSirayeli? Ngizofa ngifana nalabo abasebenza ngokulungile, futhi isiphelo sami sifane nabo.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Ungikwenzelani kuphi lokhu? Ngikutholile lapha ukuthi unqume izidumbu zami; kodwa wena ubabalise!
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi, Ingabe angeke ngilinde ukuthi ngikhulume lokho uNkulunkulu obeka emlonyeni wami?
Wathi ke uBalaka kuye, Ngicela ngikutshele, landelana nami uye kwenye indawo lapho ungababona khona; kodwa uzowabona kuphela amacala abo, awuzowabona wonke; futhi ngaleso sikhathi ungibulale.
Wathi uBalaka wamthatha waya ezindaweni zaseZophim, eziphezulu koMfula iFisga; wakhiwa khona izibingelelo eziyisixhenxe, wanikela ngengulube kanye nomuntu omncane phezu kwezibingelelo ngazo.
Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Nqaba lapha eduze komnikelo wakho wokushiswa, nami ngizobhekana noYehova lapho.
Wahlangana iNkosi noBhileham, wabeka incwadi emlonyeni wakhe, wathi, Yiya kuBalaka, ukhulume ngalokho.
Wabuya ke uBhileham, wabona uBalaka ehlala eduze komnikelo wakhe wokushiswa, namadoda amakhulu aseMowabi; wathi kuye uBalaka, Uthe yini iNkosi?
Waqala uBhileham ukushumayela, wathi, Yisuse, Balaka, ulalele; lalela, wena unyana kaSipore.
UNkulunkulu angeke abe ngumntu, ukuze akhohlwe. Angeke abe umuntu, ukuze ashintshe ingqondo yakhe. Ingabe uthembisa futhi akakwenzanga? Ingabe ukhuluma futhi akakwenzanga?
Ngiyabona ukuthi ngithunyelwe ukubonga. UNkulunkulu ubekezela, futhi angikwazi ukuwushintsha.
Akatholanga lutho olubi kuYakobi, akabona lutho olubi eSirayeli. UYehova uNkulunkulu wabo ukhona phakathi kwabo; baphuma becela ukuba abe ngukumkani wabo.
UThixo wabasusa eYiputa, Wabanikeza amandla afana nengulube yomhlaba.
Akukho lutho oluzosebenza ezweni likaYakobi, futhi akukho lutho oluzobangela ubuhlungu ezweni likaSirayeli. Bazothi kaYakobi nakwaSirayeli, Thola lokho uNkulunkulu akwenze!
