Beka, abantu bavuka njengama-lions, baphuma njenge-lion; ngeke baphumule kuze kube sekuphele ukudla kwabo, bese bephuza igazi labo ababulawa ngalo.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Uma ungawaphazamisi, akusho ukuthi awubambisene nabo.
Waphendula ke uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, Angikushonga yini kuwe, ukuthi konke okushoyo iNkosi kufanele ngikwenze?
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Yeza, ngizokuthathela enye indawo; kungase kube sengathi kulungile ebusweni bukaThixo, ukuthi ungenzi izulu labo ngami khona khona.
Wathatha ke uBalaka uBhileham, waya esiphethweni somfula iPeori, obhekene ne-Eresi.
Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Ungikhiphe lapha izibingelelo ezisixhenxe, ngilungiselele khona izinkomo ezisixhenxe nezimvu ezisithupha.
Wakwenza uBalaka njengokuthi uBhileham, wanikela ngengulube nomuntu omncane emgodini ngamunye.
Wabona uBhileham ukuthi kulungile emehlo kaYehova ukuba asindise amaSirayeli; akayeki ukubuza izibonakaliso, njengokuthi wayekwenze ngaphambilini; wabuyela, wabheka phambili, waya esiqhingi.
Waphakamisa uBhileham amehlo akhe, wabona isizwe sakwaSirayeli sisesitezi ngasesitezi; wafika phezu kwakhe umoya kaThixo.
Wathi uBhileham, yena unyana ka-Beori, umuntu obona ngokucacile ngamehlo akhe, uthi:
izindaba zomuntu okhuluma amazwi kaThixo, obona umbono ovela kulowo Onamandla onke, ohlala phantsi ngamehlo akhe avulekile:
Ngabe zihle kanjani izindlu zakho, abantu bakaYakobi, nezindlu zakho, abantu bakaSirayeli!
Bahlukaniswa njengamabhayisikili, njengezihlahla eziphakathi komfula, njengezinhlamvu ze-aloe azenzayo iNkosi, njengezihlahla zezikedrubhi ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwamanzi.
Umanzi azophuma emabhodweni abo, futhi imbewu yabo izothola amanzi amaningi; ukumkani wabo uzoba mkhulu kuna-Agagi, nobukhosi babo buzophakama.
UNkulunkulu owabasusa eYiputa, uzoba nomthelela wabo ofanayo nenyama yenkomo. Bazodla izizwe ezingezinhlekazi zabo; bazobacindezela amathambo abo, futhi bazowabulala ngemicibisholo yabo.
Bahlala bephumula njengama-lion, njengendodana ye-lion; ngubani ozowavusa? Wonke umuntu okubambisana nawe, abe ngubabalo, futhi wonke umuntu okuphazamisa wena, abe nguphazamiso.
UBalaka wehla emlonyeni kaBhileham, washaya izandla zakhe, wathi kuBhalamu, Ngikubiza ukuthi unqume izidumbu zami; kodwa namuhla ubabalise izikhathi ezintathu.
Ngokuba, phuma lapha, uye ekhaya lakho; ngithi, Ngizokulethela umholo omkhulu; kodwa iNkosi unciphise umholo wakho kuwe.
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, "Angazitshela kanjani abathunywa owawumithumela?
Nakuba uBalaka anganginika indlu yakhe egcwele isiliva negolide, angikwazi ukuphula umyalo kaYehova, ukuba ngikwenze kahle noma ngikwenze kabi ngezandla zami; ngizokhuluma lokho okushoyo iNkosi.
Ngabona ukuthi ngizobuya abantu bami; thola, ngikutshele lokho abakwenzayo labo bantu kubantu bakho, ezikhathini ezizayo.
Wathi uBhileham, yena unyana ka-Beori, umuntu obona ngokucacile ngamehlo akhe, uthi:
Izwi lomuntu okhuluma amazwi kaThixo, onolwazi oluvela kulowo ophezulu, obona umbono ovela kulowo onamandla onke, ohlala ekhonzeni, amehlo akhe evulekile:

Ngizokubona, kodwa akusekho manje; ngizobhekana naye, kodwa angeke abe eduze. Kuzophuma inkanyezi esuka kuYakobi, futhi isandla sobukhosi sizokhuphuka eSirayeli; uzophula izindlebe zakwaMowabi, nezingulube zabahlali bonke baseShethi.
I-Edom izonqotshwa, futhi iSeiri, inkosi yakhe, izonqotshwa; kodwa isiSirayeli sizoba namandla.
Uzophuma umholi ezweni likaYakobi, futhi uzobulala labo abasele kulo mzi."
Wabona uBhileham ama-Amaleki, wakhuluma wathi, Amaleki ubekuqala phakathi kwezizwe, kodwa ekupheleni kwakhe uzobiwa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wabona amaKenithi, wakhuluma wathi kubo, Ikhaya lakho liphephile, njengenjabulo ebekwe emadolobheni aphezulu.
Kodwa-ke, wena, uKeni, uzodlwengulwa, lapho iAshuri izokuthwala ejele."
Wathi, "Ubani ongaphila uma uNkulunkulu ekwenza lokhu?
Kuzofika izinqanawa ezisuka ezindaweni zase-Israyeli, ziyophula i-Ashuri ne-Ebheri; futhi labo nabo bazolahleka kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wavuka ke uBhileham, wabuyela ezweni lakhe; noBalaka wahamba indlela yakhe.
Kwathi lapho amaSirayeli ehlala khona eShitimi, kwaqala amadodana abo ukuba namaMowabhi.
Bathi, "Sicelani umnikelo wokudla," futhi bakhonza amadini abo angcwele; abantu babedla iminikelo yabo yesonka, bewuhlonipha lo mthetho.
Kwathi amaSirayeli ahlanganisana noBhaali wePehore; iNkosi wagwema kakhulu amaSirayeli.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Thola bonke abaphathi bezizwe, ubabulale, ubakhonze phambi koYehova emini; ukuze indlala yobubi beNkosi ihambe ezweni laseSirayeli.
Wathi uMosis kwabaphathi bakaSirayeli, Ubulalani wonke umuntu othile phakathi kwenu amadoda akhe ahlobene noBaali-peori.
Kwathi lapho uMoses nomphakathi wonke waseSirayeli belele emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, kwafika umuntu wesiSirayeli, waveza indodakazi yaseMidiyani ekhempini yakhe, ebhekene nabo.
Wakubona lokhu uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazarhi, oyise ka-Aron umpristi; wavuka phakathi komphakathi, wathatha isibhamu esandla sakhe.
Walandela lowo muntu waseSirayeli, waya esitezi, wabeka isibhamu phakathi kwabo bobabili, phakathi komuntu nowesifazane; khona-ke lo mkhuhlane obulalayo waba mnyama phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Kodwa abantu abangu-24,000 babesele befa ngenxa yesifo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

UPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazarhi, umngane ka-Aron ukumkani, washintsha inkohliso yami kulabo baseSirayeli; ngenxa yothando lwami lokugcina inhliziyo yami phakathi kwabo, ngaze ngazisusa izizwe zakwaSirayeli enhliziyweni yam.
Ngiyaxolisa kakhulu ngalokhu, futhi ngizoqhubeka nokwenza lokhu.

Lokhu kuzobe yisivumelwano sakhe, kanye nembewu yakhe ngemuva kwakhe, ukuthi babe ngabapristi kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku; ngenxa yokuthi wabhekana ngothando noNkulunkulu wakhe, walungisa abantu bakaSirayeli phambi kukaThixo.
Owesifazane waseSirayeli, owafa nowesifazane waseMidiyani, wayenguZimri unyana kaSalu, owayengumholi weqembu lemindeni eyisizwe sikaSimeoni.
Uwesifazane waseMidiyani owabulawa wuCozbi, intombi kaZur, owayengumholi weqembu lemindeni eMidiyani.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
"Ukwelapha Midianites njengezitha futhi ukuhlasela kwabo.
Ngokuba bakwenzani nibe ngabaphikisi, lapho bekuzazisa ukuthi nikhonza uBhaali we-Peori, noKozbi, intombi yomphathi waseMidiyani, umngane wabo, owafa ngosuku lwesifo ngenxa ye-Peori.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses no-Eleazaru, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, ngemuva kokugula okubulalayo, wathi,
Uthi uMosis ku-Israyeli, Bhala ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli ngokwemindeni yabo; babalo bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, angaphuma emkhosini eSirayeli.
UMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli bakhuluma abantu ezindaweni ezingenamanzi zaseMowabi, eduze komfula iYorodani enkabeni yeJericho, bethi,
Babala bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, njengokuthi iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses. Lokho kwakungubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli ababephuma eYiputa:
URubhen ube ngumzali kaSirayeli. Ezweni likaRubhen kwakunguHanoki, umndeni wamaHanoki; ezweni likaPalu, umndeni wamaPaluiti;
ku-Heshroni, imindeni yama-Heshroni; ku-Karmi, imindeni yama-Karmiti.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaRubhen; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-43 namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Unyana kaPalu nguElibha,
Oonyana bakaElibha: uNemuyeli, noDathani, noAbironi. Lowo nguDathani noAbironi, abaqondisi bomphakathi, abaye babhekana noMoses noAron; babekhona phakathi kweqembu likaKora, lapho bebhekana noYehova.
Umhlaba wawuvuleka, wawela kubo kanye no-Korah; futhi abakhonzi bakhe bafa, lapho umlilo wehlisa khona abantu abangumakhulu amabili namashumi amahlanu.
Kodwa oonyana bakaKora abafile.
KuSimeoni kwaba yimindeni elandelayo: NgoNemuyeli, imindeni ye-Nemuyeli; ngoYamini, imindeni ye-Yamini; ngoYakini, imindeni ye-Jahini;
kuZeraha, imindeni yamaZerahhi; kuShawuli, imindeni yamaShauli.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaSimeoni; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-22 namakhulu amabili.
KuGadi kwaba yimindeni yabo: Ngo-Zephon, indodana ka-Zefoni; ngo-Hagi, indodana ka-Hagi; ngo-Shuni, indodana ka-Shuni;
ku-Ozni, umndeni ka-Oznite; ku-Eri, umndeni ka-Erite;
ku-Arode, imindeni yama-Arodi; ku-Areli, imindeni yama-Areli.
Lezi ziyizizwe zikaGadi; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-40.
Bafa amadodana amabili kaYuda, uEr noOnan, ezweni laseKanan.
Basuka ezweni laseYuda: kusukela kuShela, imindeni yamaShelani; kusuka kuPerezi, imindeni yamaPerezi; kusuka kuZeraha, imindeni yamaZerahhi.
Ku-Perezi kwakukhona izizwe ezilandelayo: ku-Heshroni, isizwe sama-Heshroni; ku-Hamuli, isizwe sama-Hamuli.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaYuda; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili namawaka amabili namakhulu amahlanu.
Imindeni ka-Issakha: ku-Tola, imindeni yamaTholayi; ku-Puwa, imindeni yamaPhunayi;
kuYashubu, imindeni yamaYashubi; kuShimroni, imindeni yamaShimroni.
Kulezi izizwe zakwa-Issakhar; labo ababalolwe kubo beyizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili namashumi amane anane, amakhulu amathathu.
KuZabuloni kwakukhona izizwe ezilandelayo: kuSeredi, isizwe sama-Zerethi; ku-Elon, isizwe sama-Eloni; ku-Yahleeli, isizwe sama-Yahleeli.
Kulezi izizwe zikaZebulun; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti amashumi ayisishiyagalombili amawaka namakhulu amane.
Izizwe ezisuka kuYosefu zafika ngabantwana bakhe, uManase noEfrayim.
NgaManase kwavela izizwe: kuMakhire, isizwe samaMakhiri; uMakhire ube ngubaba kaGiliyadi; eGiliyadi kwavela isizwe samaGiliyadi.
Lawa amabandla asuka eGiliyadi: ku-Yezere, imindeni yamaJezeri; ku-Heleki, imindeni yamaHeleki;
ku-Asriyeli, imindeni yama-Asriyeli; eShekem, imindeni yama-Shekemi;
ku-Shemida, imindeni yama-Shemidayi; ku-Hepher, imindeni yama-Heferi.
UZelofehadi unyana ka-Heferi, akazange abe namadodana, kodwa kwaba nezingane; futhi lamagama izingane zakhe: uMahala, noNowa, noHogla, noMilka, noTirsa.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaManase; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-52 namakhulu ayisithupha.
Ezweni lika-Ephrayi kwakukhona izizwe ezilandelayo: ku-Shutela, isizwe sama-Suthelahi; ku-Bekhere, isizwe sama-Bekheri; ku-Tahani, isizwe sama-Tahani.
Kusuka ku-Eran, unyana ka-Shuthelah, kwafika iqembu le-Eranite.
Bazo zonke lezi izizwe zakwa-Ephrayi; labo ababalolwe kubo, kwaba ngumakhulu mathathu, amabili anamakhulu amahlanu. Zonke lezi zizwe zasuka kuYosefu.
Kwabe sekukhona izizwe zakwaBhenjamini: ku-Bela, isizwe sama-Belayithi; ku-Ashbeli, isizwe sama-Ashbelithi; ku-Ahiramu, isizwe sama-Ahiramithi;
ku-Shephupham, inkosi yama-Shufami; ku-Hupham, inkosi yama-Huphami.
Izizwe ezisuka ku-Ardi noNaamani, oonyana bakaBela: kusuka ku-Ardi, isizwe sama-Arditi; kusukela ku-Naamani, isizwe sama-Naamini.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaBhenjamin; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-45.
Umndeni kaDani: uSuhami, umndeni wamaSuhami; lezi ziyimindeni yakwaDani.
Wonke umndeni wakwa-Shuhami waba ngumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, anamashumi amane nane amawaka, namakhulu amane.
Ku-Ashere kwakukhona amaqembu: ku-Imna, iqembu lama-Imnite; ku-Ishivi, iqembu lama-Ishivite; ku-Beriya, iqembu lama-Berite.
Ngaye kwavela imindeni kaBeriya: Ngo-Ebheri, imindeni yamaHeberi; ngo-Malkhiyeli, imindeni yamaMalkhiyeli.
U-Ashere ube nenkosikazi, igama layo nguSera.
Bazo zonke izizwe zakwa-Ashere, labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti ayishumi nambili namawaka amathathu anamakhulu amane.
KuNaphtali kwaba yimindeni yabo: kusuka ku-Yasheeli kwakuyimindeni ye-Yasheeli; kusuka eGuni kwakuyimindeni ye-Guni;
ku-Yezere, imindeni yamaJezerithi; ku-Shileme, imindeni yamaShilemi.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaNaphtali; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-45 namakhulu amane.
Wonke umkhawulo wabo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, ababalolwe, waba ngamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namawaka amabili namakhulu amathathu nesithupha.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Bahlukanise izwe phakathi kwalezi zakwaSirayeli, ngokwenani lamagama abo, ukuze kube yibo.
Vumela isizwe esikhulu sithole inkontileka enkulu yendawo futhi isizwe esincane sithole inkontileka encane. Isizwe ngasinye sizothola indawo ngokuya ngenani labantu ababalolwe.
Kodwa-ke, izwe kumele lihlukaniswe ngokushaya inkontileka. Isizwe ngasinye somndeni wakwaSirayeli sizothola inkontileka yayo ngokwegama lesizwe saso.
Ingxenye ngayinye izohlukaniswa ngodlame phakathi kwezizwe ezinkulu nezincane.
Lawa amaqembu emindeni yamaLevi, labo ababhekwayo: kusuka kuGershoni, imindeni yamaGershoni; kusuka kuKohati, imindeni yamaKohati; kusuka kuMerariya, imindeni yamaMerariya.
Lezi ziyimindeni yamaLevi: imindeni yamaLibni, nemindeni yamaHebroni, nemindeni yamaMaheli, nemindeni yamaMushi, nemindeni yamaKorahi. UKohati ube ngubaba kaAmram.
UJokhebedi, indodana kaLawi, owazalwa kumndeni kaLawi eYiputa, wayeyinkosikazi kaAmram; wazala uAron noMoses, noonyana ababi, noMiriam, inkosikazi yabo.
U-Aron waba ubaba kaNadabhi, no-Abihu, no-Eleazar, no-Ithamari.
Kodwa uNadabhi no-Abhihu bafa, lapho benikela ngomlilo kuYehova, ongeke kwenziwe.
AbaLevi ababalolwe, amadoda aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-23; bebengabalwa phakathi kwamadodakazi kaSirayeli, ngoba kwakungaba nezwe phakathi kwabo.
Lokho yibo ababalowe nguMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli, lapho bebala khona oonyana bakaSirayeli ezindaweni ezisempumalanga zakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan, eJericho.
Akukho omunye wabo phakathi kwalabo ababalolwe nguMoses no-Aron umpristi esiqhingini iSinai.
Ngokuba iNkosi wathi ngalabo abantu, Bazofa ezweni lezulu elimnyama; kwakungekho muntu osele kubo, ngaphandle kukaKalebe unyana kaJefune noYoshuwa unyana kaNun.

Kwafika khona izingane zikaZelofehadi; uZelofehadi ube nguyise kaHeferi, owesifazane kaGileyadi, owesifazane kaMakhire, owesifazane kaManase, emndenini kaManase, owesifazane kaYosefu. Amagama izingane zakhe zaba nguMahla, noNowa, noHogla, noMilka, noTirsa.
Bahlala phambi kukaMoses, no-Elazare umbingeleli, nabaphathi, nebandla lonke, emgwaqeni wetente lengqungquthela, besithi,
Ubaba wethu wafa esiqhingini, naye akabe yilungu leqembu likaKora, labo abaphikisayo noYehova; kodwa wafa ngenxa yobubi bakhe, akazange abe nezingane.
Kungani ke ukuthi igama lobaba wethu liphele emndenini wakhe, ngenxa yokuthi akazange abe nendodana? Sinike izwe phakathi kwemindeni yobaba wethu.
Wathi uMosis, waveza isinqumo sabo phambi koYehova.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Zilungile izingane zikaZelofehadi; uzobanikeze imbewu phakathi kwabangane bakababa babo, njengento yabo; ubanikeze inkontileka yobaba wabo.
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, usithi: Uma umuntu efa, engeke abe nendodakazi, niyinike inkosikazi yakhe imbewu yakhe.
Uma engeke abe nendodakazi, unike izwe lakhe abazalwane bakhe.
Uma engeke abe nabangane, unike izwe lakhe abangane bakababa wakhe.

Uma ubaba wakhe engeke abe nabangane, khona-ke niyinike imbewu yakhe umngane wakhe osonhlalakahle kakhulu emndenini wakhe, ibe yindawo yakhe. Kuye kube ngumthetho nomthetho kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, njengoba iNkosi awisenzile uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi, Yiya phezulu kulo mnxweme we-Abarim, ubone izwe engilifumene lamadodana kaSirayeli.
Uma usuyibona, uzofa nawe, uhlangane nabantu bakho abafileyo; njengoba kwakufa uAron umzalwana wakho.
Ngokuba niyiphula imithetho yami, ukuthi ngibe ngungcwele phakathi kwabo ngamanzi, lapho ibandla likhuluma nami esiqhingini sikaZin. Laziwa ngokuthi yimanzi kaMeriba eKadeshi, esiqhingini sikaZin.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova,
"UNkulunkulu, wena uNkulunkulu onikeza umoya kuwo wonke umuntu. Nceda ukhethe umuntu phezu kwalolu hlanga
Uzobasusa emdlalweni, futhi uzowabuyisela ezweni labo; ukuze abantu bakaYehova bangabi njengamakhoboka angeke abe nomlimi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Thola uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, indodana yomoya, uyibeke isandla sakho phezu kwakhe.
Uzobeka phambi kuka-Elazare, umbingeleli, nomphakathi wonke, ube nguMengameli phakathi kwabo bonke.
Uzobeka phezu kwakhe igunya lakho, ukuze bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bamthobele.
Uzohlala phambi kuka-Elazare, umbingeleli; yena uzobuza isinqumo seNkosi ngale-Urim. Ngomyalo wakhe uJoshua nomndeni wonke wakwaSirayeli, ibandla lonke, bazophuma nabo bafike.
Wakwenza uMoses njengoba iNkosi abemwisele umthetho ngawo; wathatha uYoshuwa, wambeka phambi kuka-Elazare umpristi, nomphakathi wonke.
Wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe, wamisa ukuba abe nguMengameli, njengoba iNkosi esho ngoMosese.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMoses, 20Ubatshele izingane zakwaSirayeli ukuthi: "Njengoba nifuna ukunginikela ngomnikelo wami wesono ezikhathini zabo ezifanele; ukudla kwami okwenziwa ngomnqumo womlilo, njengephunga elimnandi.
Uzothi kubo, Le yiminikelo yenu eyenziwe ngomlilo, ongayinikela kuYehova: izinkomo ezimbili ezineminyaka eyodwa ubudala, ezingabi necala, ngosuku ngalunye, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo.
Uzonikela ngengane eyodwa ekuseni, nenye uma ilanga liphuma.
Nokho, ngaye ngamunye nizoletha isiphuzo sokudla esifana nekhilogremu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili yobisi oluhlanzekile oluhlanganisiwe nolitha elilodwa le-oyile ye-olive.
Lo ngumnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, owanikela ngawo emfuleni iSinayi; umnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo, wephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uzonikela ngesipho sokudla, isilitha ngasinye sewayini elisha; uzolibazisa iNkosi endaweni engcwele..
Uzonikela isibeleko esisodwa emini, kanye nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesipho sayo sotshwala, njengokuthi ukwenze ekuseni; yisondlo esishiswa ngomlilo, iphunga elimnandi kuYehova.

NgoMsombuluko, ninikeze izimbuzi ezimbili ezineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, ezingabi nephutha, kanye nomnikelo wokudla we-efa yesiliva, ehlotshiswe ngephethiloli, kanye nomnikelo wayo wokudla.
Lo ngumnikelo oshiswayo wesonto ngalinye, ngaphezu komnikelo oshiswayo ohlala njalo nomnikelo wayo wokudla.
Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga, nizonikela umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, nomuntu omdala owodwa, namaqanda amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi nenkinga.

Nomnikelo wokudla, umnikelo wesonka esifana nekhilogramu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili yobisi oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, ngengulube ngayinye; nomnikelo wokudla ofana nekhilogramu ezintathu zobisi oluhlanganiswe nophethiloli, ngemvu.

Uzonikela ngomnikelo oshiswayo, umnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo, wephunga elimnandi kuYehova, ilitha elilodwa neshumi nesigamu sekhilogremu yobisi oluhlanzekile oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, kanye nomntwana owodwa.

Namanzi abo okudlela azobe elingana nelitha elilodwa lewayini ngengulube ngayinye, nelitha elilodwa nesithathu ngemvu, nelitha elilodwa nesithathu ngengane ngayinye. Lo ngumnikelo wokushiswa ngonyaka wonke, ngenyanga nganye.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane owodwa njengomnikelo wesono kuYehova, ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nesonka saso.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yokuqala, izinsuku ezingu-14 zoMsombuluko kaYehova.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga kuzoba khona isikhumbuzo; usuku oluyisixhenxe nizodla inyama engenasici.
Ngosuku lokuqala, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze lutho olujwayelekile.
Ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, isonka somlilo: izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, nomkhwenyana owodwa, namaqanda amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi nenkinga.
Nakho-ke nizonikela ngomnikelo wokudla, ubisi olufino oluhlanganisiwe neoli, amakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili ngengulube ngayinye, namakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili ngemvu.
Kuzo zonke izingulube ezisixhenxe, thola ikhilogramu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili.
Ninikeze nenyama yenkomo eyodwa, ibe yisonka sesono, ukuze nilungise.
Uzonikela ngale nto ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa ojwayelekile.
Uzokwenza njalo ngosuku, izinsuku ezisixhenxe; yinyama yomnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo, uphunga elimnandi kuYehova; ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nomnikelo wayo wokudla.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nikwenze umsebenzi ojwayelekile.
Ngosuku lokuqala lokuvuna, lapho ninikela khona umnikelo wokudla okusha kukaNkulunkulu emcimbini wamaviki, kumele kube nengqungquthela engcwele; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi ojwayelekile.
Uzonikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, nomuntu omdala owodwa, namabele aneminyaka eyisithupha ubudala, njengephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
kanye nesibopho sazo sesonka, isikhunta esifinyeliwe, esimisiwe ngephethiloli, ilitha elilodwa legolide ngayinye inkomo, nelitha elilodwa legolide ngalinye ingulube;
futhi mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.

Uzonikela ngale nto kanye neziphuzo zayo, ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo nomnikelo wayo wokudla; uzoba nenyama engabi nephutha.
Ngonyaka wesixhenxe, ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga, kumele kube khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze umsebenzi othile; kufanele kube yimini yokuphuza izipho.
Ninikeze isonka esishiswayo, njengephunga elimnandi iNkosi: inkomo eyodwa encane, nomuntu oyedwa, namabele amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi necala.
kanye nesibopho sazo sokudla, imbewu ehlanzekile encibilikisiwe ngephethiloli: amasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili ngengulube eyodwa, namasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili ngemvu;
futhi mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.
Ninikeze nenyama yenkomo eyodwa, ibe yisonka sesono, ukuze nilungise.

Lokhu kungenxa yomnikelo wokushiswa wonyaka omusha, nomnikelo wayo wesonka, kanye nomnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nomnikelo wayo wesonka, neziphuzo zazo, ngokusho komthetho; yi yizipho ezifakiwe ngomlilo, iphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga yesixhenxe, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nidle ukudla, futhi ngeke nisebenze lutho.
Ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa, oyisiphuzo esithandekayo kukaNkulunkulu: inkomo eyodwa encane, nomuntu oyedwa, namabele amane aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala, angabi necala.

futhi mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.
kanye nobhontshisi omncane owodwa njengomnikelo wesono, ngaphezu komnikelo wesono wokwenza isiqiniseko, nomnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nesonka saso sokudla, neziphuzo zaso.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesixhenxe, kuzobe kukhona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi omusha onke. Usuku lokuphumula loNkulunkulu luzohlala izinsuku ezisithupha.

Ninikeze isonka esishiswayo, isiphuzo somlilo sephunga elimnandi iNkosi: izinkomo ezincane eziyishumi nambili nesikhombisa; izimvu ezimbili; amaqanda aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi namaphutha.

kanye nomnikelo wazo wokudla, ubisi olufino oluhlanganisiwe nephethiloli, okungu-sethi elilodwa lama-shekeli kunoma iyiphi ingulube eyisishiyagalombili, no-sethi elilodwa lama-shekeli kunoma iyiphi inkomo emibili;
futhi mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.

Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, yenza isibingelelo esikhethekile futhi ungasebenzisi umsebenzi ojwayelekile.
futhi ninikeze isonka esishiswayo, isiphuzo esincibilikayo ngomlilo sephunga elimnandi kuYehova: inkomo eyodwa, umnqumo owodwa, namabele amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi necala.
Nomuntu wesifazane, nomuntu omncane, namadodakazi abo, ninikeze isonka sabo, neziphuzo zabo, ngokuya ngenani labo, ngokwemithetho ebhaliwe.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.

Nizilungiselele lezi zinto kuYehova ezinyangeni zemikhosi yenu, ngaphandle kwezibopho zenu, nangaphandle komnikelo wenu wokudla, noma iminikelo yenu yokuthosa, noma iminikelo yenu yesonka, noma iminikelo yenu yotshwala, noma iminikelo yenu yezihlandlo zokuthula.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, konke okumwise iNkosi.
Wathi uMoses kubaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, ethi, Lokho wukuthi umthethosivivinywa kaYehova:
Uma umuntu enikela isipho esikhethekile kuYehova, noma ephuza umlomo wakhe ngezwi eliqinile, angeke aphula igama lakhe; wonke amazwi akhe azowenza.
Uma uwesifazane ehlala ekhaya lobaba wakhe, esenza isibopho kuYehova, noma emisa inhliziyo yakhe ngomsebenzi,
uma ubaba wakhe ekhuluma ngaye, kodwa engasho lutho kuye, khona-ke zonke izibopho zakhe nezibopho zakhe kufanele zigcinelwe.
Uma ke ubaba wakhe ephoqelela, ngosuku akubona ngalo, khona-ke zonke izinyembezi zakhe, nanoma yiziphi izibopho zakhe, ngeke zisebenze; futhi iNkosi uzomuxolela, ngoba ubaba wakhe uphoqelele.
Uma ibhishobhi ikhulelwe, futhi iyaqhubeka ihlobene ngesivumelwano, noma ngesinqumo esingenangqondo,
futhi umyeni wakhe ezwa ngalolu daba, kodwa akusho lutho kuye ngemini lapho ezwa ngayo, khona-ke izibopho zakhe nezibopho zakhe kumele zigcinwe.
Kodwa uma indodana yakhe, ngesikhathi esezizwa ngayo, ichaza ukuthi akuvumelekile, khona-ke iphupho lakhe elibi, noma isibopho sakhe esingokwengqondo, ngeke lisebenze; futhi iNkosi uzoyilungisa.
Noma yiziphi izibopho noma izinqumo ezithathwe nguwesifazane wesifazane noma obulawe kufanele zigcinwe.
Uma indodakazi yowesifazane isenza isibopho, noma iveza isandla sayo ngesinqumo, ehlala ekhaya lomyeni wakhe,
futhi indodana yakhe ikhuluma ngayo, kodwa ayibonisi lutho kuye, futhi ayivimbeli, khona-ke zonke izibopho zayo kanye nanoma yiziphi izibopho zakhe kumele zigcinwe.
Uma indodana yakhe iyisabalalisa ngalolu busuku, lapho ikhuluma khona, ngeke kube khona noma yini emthethweni wayo, noma esinqumweni sakhe; indodana yakhe iisabalalisa, futhi iNkosi uzomuxolela.
Owesifazane wakhe angavuma noma asuse noma yiziphi izibopho zakhe, nanoma yiziphi izibopho zokuyeka izinto.

Uma indodana yakhe ikhala ngayo kuze kube ngusuku olulandelayo, khona-ke umyeni wakhe uqinisile zonke izinyembezi zayo, nanoma yiziphi izibopho zakhe; ngoba wavuma ngazo ngosuku lapho ezwa ngalo, ngokukhala kwayo.
Uma elahlekile isikhathi esithile ngemuva kokulalela ngazo, uzothwala isinqumo sayo sokuphula isibopho.
Lawa amalungiselelo, asho iNkosi kuMoses, phakathi kowesifazane nowesifazane wakhe, phakathi koyise nonkosikazi yakhe, ehlala ekhaya lakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uzophinde ukhokhele abantu baseMidiyani lokho abakwenzayo kubantu bakaSirayeli; bese uza kufa, uzohlangatshelwa nabantu bakho.
Wathi uMosis kubo bonke abantu, Nciphisani phakathi kwenu amadoda empilweni, ahambe ahlasele ama-Midiyani, abe yingozi kulowo muntu.
Sebenzisa abantu abangu-1 ezweni ngalinye lamadodakazi kaSirayeli, ukulwa.
Bakhetha abantu abangu-1 eqenjini ngalinye, phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli amakhulu amabili namashumi amahlanu.
Wabathumela uMoses emkhosini, isizukulwane ngasinye esingu-1; naye noPhinehasi indodana kaElazarhi umpristi. UPhinehasi wathatha ngesandla sakhe izinto zendawo engcwele, namaphoyinti okukhumbuza.
Bahlasela iMidiyani, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses; babulala wonke umuntu owesifazane.
Babulala futhi uBalamu, unyana kaBeore, ngeqhwa, phakathi kwabo bonke abafileyo: uEvhi, no-Rekem, no-Zure, no-Hure, no-Reba, abaphathi beMidiyani.
Amadodana kaSirayeli athathe amadoda namantombazane aseMidiyani, nezingane zabo, nazo zonke izilwane zabo, nezimvu zabo, nempahla yabo.
Babulala wonke amadolobhana aseMidiyani, lapho behlala khona, kanye nezindawo zabo zokudlela.
Bathatha yonke into abayitholayo, nanoma yini ababeyiqoqe, abantu nenyama.

Bathi, "Sizokhipha izinyamazane zethu, nezilwane zethu, kanye nento ethengiswayo, siyiveze kuMoses, no-Elazare umbingeleli, kanye nebandla lakwaSirayeli, esiteji esisemaphandleni sakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan eJericho.
Waphuma ke uMoses, no-Elazare umpristi, nabaholi bonke bebandla, bahlangana nabo ngaphandle kwesiqhingi.
UMoses wehla emlonyeni wabaphathi bomkhosi, abaphathi bezinkulungwane, nabaphathi bezikhulu, ababuyayo emdlalweni.
Wababuza wathi, "Ngabe ushiye amadoda wonke ephila?
Baye labo abahamba ngemibono kaBhileham, baholela abantu bakaSirayeli ukuba bagweme ukuthula noYehova, ngomsebenzi wePeori; ngakho kwaba khona isifo phakathi kwabantu bakaYehova.
Manje bulala wonke owesifazane, futhi bulala yonke indodana ehlala nomuntu.
Ngakho-ke, gcinani engqondweni yenu ukuthi wonke uwesifazane ongazange ahlale nomuntu.

Wonke umuntu phakathi kwenu obulala umuntu, noma onquma umfileyo, kufanele ahlale ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi izinsuku eziyisithupha; ngosuku oluthathu nosuku olusixhenxe kumele nihlanzeke, nina nalabo ababoshwe.
Uzohlanza nanoma iyiphi impahla, noma iyiphi into eyenziwe ngesikhumba, noma izinwele zengulube, noma imithi.
Wathi u-Elazare, umpristi, kwabazobe bephuma emkhosini, ethi, Lokho wumthetho womthetho owawusho iNkosi kuMosese:
Igolide, isilivere, isibhakabhaka, insimbi, i-tin, ukuhola,

futhi noma yini engakwazi ukumelana nokushisa, kufanele idlule emgodini, bese ihlanzekile. Kodwa-ke, kumele ibe mhlophe ngemanzi okuhlanza. Nanoma yini engakwazi ukumelana nokushisa, kufanele idlule ngamanzi.
Nizihlanze izigqoko zenu ngosuku olusixhenxe, nihlale nihlanzekile; futhi ngemuva kwalokho ningaya eqenjini.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
U-Elazare umbingeleli, nawe, kanye nabaholi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli, kufanele nibalo bonke abantu nabanyama abathathwe.
Yabelana ngezingxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo: eyodwa yabadlali abaphuma emdlalweni kanye nenye yabanye abantu.
Engxenyeni yalabo abahamba phambili, unikezwe umnikelo wokudla iNkosi: umuntu owodwa ngamakhulu amahlanu, nokuba ngumuntu, noma inkomo, noma idla, noma ingulube, noma inkomo.
Uzothatha lokhu engxenyeni yabo, uyinike u-Elazare umpristi, ibe yisipho esikhethekile kuYehova.

Engxenyeni yabantwana bakaSirayeli, uzothatha umuntu owodwa kumakhulu amahlanu, nokuba ngumuntu, noma ingulube, noma inkomo, noma inkomo encane, noma inkomo enkulu, noma iyiphi enye into yokudla; uzowanikela kumaLevi, abaphatha umsebenzi wendawo engcwele kaYehova.
Wakwenza ke uMoses no-Elazare umpristi, njengokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Izinto eziboshwe, ezingenayo imindeni yabo, zaziyizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili nesiyisishiyagalombili namashumi amane namahlanu amaphesenti;
izingulube ezingu-72,000,
izinkomo ezingu-61,000;
kanye ezingu-32,000 abesifazane abazange baphumule nomuntu.
Ingxenye yalabo abazobe besebenza emkhosini yaba ngumakhulu amathathu, amawaka amashumi amathathu nesishiyagalombili, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili embuzi;
Ingxenye kaYehova yaba ngamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anesihlanu.
Izingulube zaziyizinkulungwane ezingu-36,000; inkontileka kaYehova yayiyizinkulungwane eziyisixhenxe nambili.
Izikelemu zaziyizigidi ezimashumi mathathu namakhulu amahlanu; inkontileka kaYehova ibiyizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili.
Kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-16, futhi inkontileka kaYehova yaba ngamashumi amathathu anesibini.
UMoses wanikela ngomnikelo kaYehova ku-Elazare umpristi, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMosis.
Ingxenye yesithathu yaba yiyo yabantu bakaSirayeli, leyo ngxenye uMosis wayisabalalisa ezweni labo.
Ingxenye yomphakathi yaba ngumakhulu amathathu, amawaka amashumi amathathu anesithupha, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, izinkomo nezimvu,
izingulube ezingu-36,000,
ezingu-30 nezinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili,
namakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye abantu.

Engxenyeni yamadodana kaSirayeli, uMoses wathatha umuntu owodwa kuwo wonke amashumi amahlanu abantu nokudla kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMosis; wabanikela kwabaLevi, abaphatha umsebenzi wendawo engcwele kaYehova.
Bafika ke kuMoses abaphathi bemikhosi, abaholi bezikhulu nabenzi-nkulungwane.
Bathi kuye, "Sinezinkontileka nabasebenzi bakho abangaphansi kwesandla sethu, futhi asikho isifazane esisengozini.
Siyazisa, ngakho, isipho kuYehova, ngazo zonke izinto zegolide esizitholayo, amabhande, namabhande, nezibopho, nezingcezu, namahlombe, ukuze sizinikele kukaNkulunkulu.
UMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli bathathe igolide kubo, lakhiwa zonke izinto zokuzigqoka.
Igolide lonke, labo abaphathi bezinkulungwane nezikhulu zamakhulu, ababelinikela njengomnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, kwakungushekeli elilodwa nesishiyagalombili lezigidi ezingu-16.
Wonke wesibhakabhaka wathatha iphoyinti lakhe.
UMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli bathatha igolide lamadodana ezigidini, namadodana emakhulu, babelimaza lisetentweni yokuhlangana, ukuze kube yinkundla yokukhumbula abantu bakaSirayeli.
Babona ukuthi iJazeri neGiliyadi yindawo engcono kakhulu yokudla izinkomo, futhi uRubhen noGadi babe nezilwane ezifuywayo eziningi.
Amadodana kaGadi namadodana kaRubhen afike kuMoses, no-Elazare umbingeleli, nabakhulu bomphakathi, bethi,
no-Ataroth, no-Dibon, no-Yazer, no-Nimrah, no-Heshbon, no-Elealeh, no-Shebam, no-Nebo, no-Beon,
Le lizwe, iNkosi alike walimaza phambi kwebandla lakwaSirayeli, izwe elilungile izilwane; futhi thina abakhonzi bakho sinezinja eziningi.
Bathi ke, Uma ubona ukuthi silungile emehlo akho, lithunyelwe izwe labo abakhonzi bakho, libe yilungelo lethu; ungasidlulisanga iJordani.
Wathi uMoses kubonyana bakaGadi nakwaRubheni, Ingabe abazalwane benu, amadodana aseSirayeli, azoya emkhosini, nihlala lapha?
Kungani na ukuthi nikhohlise izingane zakwaSirayeli, ukuze zingayidlula izwe iNkosi awabanikela ngalo?
Ngalokho abababa bakho bakwenze, lapho ngibathumela eKadeshe-barnea ukuba babone izwe.
Baye benyuka, bafika emfuleni i-Eshkole, babheka izwe; futhi bavimbela amakhosi aseSirayeli ukuthi angangeni ezweni iNkosi abewanikela ngalo.
UYehova wagwetshwa ngalolu busuku, wathi:

Wonke umuntu ophuma eYiputa, oneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala nangaphezulu, ngeke abone izwe engikhuluma ngalo ku-Abrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, ngenxa yokuthi abangitholanga ngenhliziyo yabo yonke.
UKalebe unyana kaJefune, umKenisi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune kuphela abazokubona; ngoba balandela iNkosi intliziyo yabo yonke.
Wagwema iNkosi isizwe samaSirayeli, wabashiya behamba esiqhingini iminyaka engama-40, kuze kube sekuphele isigaba sonke esikwenzele okubi phambi kwakhe.
Futhi manje, bhekani, niyinjabulo entsha yobubi, nithatha indawo yababa benu, ukuze niphuze inhliziyo kaYehova ngabaseSirayeli!
Uma nje nibuyela emuva, ningamlandelanga yena, uzophinde ashiye labo bonke abantu ezweni lesiqhingi; futhi nizoba yingozi yabo.
Bafike kuMoses bathi: "Sifuna ukwakha izindlu zezilwane zethu kanye nezindawo zokuhlala zabantwana bethu.
Sizozivikela, sizobhekana namadodakazi kaSirayeli, kuze kube sekufikeni kwabo ezweni labo; futhi izingane zethu zizohlala emizini enezindlu eziqinile, ziphephile kulabo bantu basezweni.
Sizobuyela ekhaya lethu kuze kube yilapho wonke umSirayeli ethola izwe lakhe.
Sizohlala nathi, futhi sizohlala ndawonye nabo ezweni elingaphandle kweYorodani; ngoba sithole izwe lethu lapha, ngasenyakatho yeYorodani.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Uma nikwenza lo msebenzi, uma nizibophezela emdlalweni phambi koYehova,
futhi bonke abantu bakho abaqeqeshiwe badlula iJordani phambi kweNkosi, kuze asuse izitha zakhe phambi kwakhe;
futhi izwe linqobelwe phambi koYehova, khona-ke nizobuya; nizowenza umsebenzi wenu kuYehova, nakwaSirayeli; futhi leli lizwe lizoba yinkontileka yenu phambi koYehova.
Uma ke ningakwenza lokhu, khona-ke nizosindisa isono senu phambi koYehova, futhi niziqiniseke ukuthi isono senu sizokufinyelela.
Yakha izindlu zabantwana bakho namahhashi akho, futhi yenza lokho okushoyo."
Bathi oonyana bakaGadi noRubheni kuMoses, bethi, Ngokungafani nalokho owawusho ngawo unkosi wethu, sizokwenza thina abakhonzi bakho.
Abantwana bethu, namadodana ethu, nezilwane zethu, nazo zonke izinyamazane zethu, zizohlala lapha emizini kaGiliyadi.
Sizodlula thina bonke abakhonzi bakho, wonke umuntu ogqoke isibhamu sokulwa, ukubhekana nomlilo phambi koYehova, njengokuthi unkosi wethu uthi.
Wathi uMoses ku-Elazare umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, wathi kubo:

Wathi kubo, Uma izingane zikaGadi nezingane zikaRubhen zidlula ndawonye nani iJordani, wonke umuntu ogqoke isibhamu sokulwa, phambi koYehova, futhi izwe linqobelwe phambi kwenu, khona-ke nizobanika izwe laseGiliyadi libe yindawo yabo.
Kodwa uma bengeke badlule nawe, begqoke izibhamu zabo, khona-ke bazothatha inkontileka yakho ezweni laseKanana.
Baphendula amadodana kaGadi namadodana kaRubhen, bethi, Njengokuthi iNkosi esho, sizokwenza thina abakhonzi bakho.
Sizodlula sigqoke isibhamu phambi kweNkosi, sifike ezweni laseKanana; kodwa izwe lethu lomhlaba lizoba ngasenyakatho yeYorodani.

Wabanikeza uMoses amaGadi, namaRubheni, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, unyana kaYosefu, isizwe sikaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, nesizwe sikaOg, ukumkani waseBhashani, izwe lonke, namadolobha ayo, nelizwe labo elijikelezayo.
Amadodana kaGadi akhiwa iDiboni, ne-Ataroti, ne-Aroere,
u-Atrothi-shofani, no-Yazeri, no-Yogbeha,
NaseBeth-nimra, nasebe-Beth-harani, ezindaweni ezinezindlu eziqinile; futhi bakwakha amabhodwe ezilwanyana zabo.
Amadodana kaRubhen akhiwa iHeshboni, neElealeh, neKiriyatayim,
kanye neNebo, noBaale-mehon (abaguqule amagama abo), noSibma; babeka amagama amasha ezifundeni labo ababezikwakha.
Baye eGileyadi, bayisabalalisa, bakhipha ama-Amori ahlala khona.
UMoses wabanika iGiliyadi izingane zikaMakhire, unyana kaManase; bahlala khona.
UYahiri, owesifazane waseManase, wahlasela namanye amadolobhana, wababiza ngokuthi amadolobhana kaYahiri.
Wathatha noNobha iKenati nezindawo zayo, wayibiza ngokuthi iNobha, ngegama lakhe.
Lezi ziyizindawo zokuhamba kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, lapho bephuma ezweni laseYiputa, ngoMosesi noAron, ngokwemikhosi yabo.
Wabhala ke uMoses, ngokusho komthetho kaYehova, imizila yabo yokuhamba; lezo ziyimizila yabo, kusukela emgwaqweni wokuqala kuze kube emgwaqweni wokugcina.
Basuka eRameshe, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku olulandelayo kosuku lwepasha; baphuma ngesandla esiqinile, phambi kwamehlo wonke amaMishi.
njengoba ama-Egipta enyamalala khona wonke umzali wesifazane wabo, owabulalayo iNkosi; futhi iNkosi wagwema izitha zabo.
Basuka abantu bakaSirayeli eRameshe, bamisa isikhashana eSukoti.
Basuka eSukhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Ethame, enkabeni yesiqhingi.
Basuka eEtham, babuyela ePi-Hahirothi, enyakatho yeBaale-zephoni, bamisa isicampani eMigdoli.
Basuka ePi-Hahirothi, bahamba phakathi kolwandle, befika esiqhingini; bahamba izinsuku ezintathu esiqhingini sama-Ethamu, bamisa inkosi eMara.
Basuka eMara, bafika ku-Elim; khona lapho kwakukhona izimpophoma zezintaba ezingu-12, nezihlahla zendabuko eziyisixhenxe.
Basuka e-Elim, bamisa isikhashana emfuleni omnyama.
Basuka eMfuleni Omnyama, bamisa isikhashana esiqhingini saseSin.
Basuka esiqhingini sase-Sin, bafudukela eDofka.
Basuka eDophkah bamisa ikhempu eAlush.
Basuka e-Alushe, bamisa isibhedlela e-Refidim; kwakungekho khona amanzi abantu abawadla.
Basuka eRefidim, bamisa isikhashana emfuleni iSina.
Basuka eSinayini, bamisa isikhashana eKibrothi-hataava.
Basuka eKibrothi-hataava, bafudukela eHaserothi.
Basuka eHazerothi, bamisa isikhashana eRithma.
Basuka eRithmah bamisa ikhempu eRimmon Perez.
Basuka eRimon-perezi, bamisa isikhashana eLibna.
Basuka eLibna, bamisa isiqhingi eRisa.
Basuka eRisa, bamisa inkosi eKehelatha.
Basuka eKehelatha, bafudukela emfuleni iShepher.
Basuka eMount Shepher bamisa ikhempu eHarada.
Basuka eHarada, bafudukela eMakhelothi.
Basuka eMakhelothi, bamisa isikhashana eTahati.
Basuka eTahati, bamisa isicampani eTera.
Basuka eThera, bamisa isikhashana eMithkah.
Basuka eMithkah, bafudukela eHashmonah.
Basuka eHashmonah, bamisa isikhashana eMoseroth.
Basuka eMoserothi, bafudukela eBene Jaakan.
Bashiya i-Bene Jaakan basuka eHor Haggidgad.
Basuka eHore-hagidigadi, bamisa isikhashana eYotbata.
Basuka eYotbata, bamisa isikhashana e-Abrona.
Basuka e-Abronah, bamisa isibhedlela e-Ezion-geberi.
Basuka e-Ezion-geberi, bamisa isikhashana eKadeshi, emfuleni iZin.
Basuka eKadeshi, bamisa isikhashana emfuleni iHori, enhliziyweni yezwe laseEdomu.

U-Aron umbingeleli wehla emfuleni iHore, ngokusho komyalo kaYehova; wafa khona lapho ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesihlanu, ngonyaka omashumi amane ngemuva kokuphuma kwabantu bakaSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa.
UAron ubeneminyaka engu-123 ubudala, lapho efa khona emfuleni iHor.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaKanana wase-Aradi, owahlala ezweni laseNtshonalanga, ezweni laseKanana, ukuthi abantu bakaSirayeli befika.
Basuka emfuleni iHori, bamisa isicampani eSalmona.
Basuka eZalmona, bamisa icamp ePunon.
Basuka ePunon, bamisa isikhashana eObhothi.
Basuka e-Obhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Iye-abarim, emfuleni waseMowabi.
Basuka e-Iyim, bamisa isikhashana eDiboni-Gad.
Basuka eDiboni-Gadi, bafudukela eAlmon-diblathaim.
Basuka eAlmon-diblathaim, bamisa isikhashana emadolobheni aseAbarim, eNebo.
Basuka emadolobheni ase-Abarim, bamisa isiqalo ezindaweni ezihlaba umxhwele zaseMowabhi, eduze komfula iJordani, ngaphesheya kweYericho.
Bamisa khona ezindaweni eziphakeme zaseMowabi, eduze kweYordan, kusukela eBhethi-yeshimothi kuya eAbeli-shithini.
Wakhuluma iNkosi kuMoses, ezindaweni ezihlabani zakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan enkabeni kaJericho, wathi,
"Ubatshele izingane zakwaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nidlula iJordani ezweni lakwaKanana,
Uzokhipha zonke izizwe ezihlala kulolu mhlaba phambi kwenu; uzobulala yonke imihlobiso yabo, nezithombe zabo zegolide, futhi uzobaphula zonke izakhiwo zawo eziphakeme.
Niyithathe izwe, nihlale kulo; ngoba ngikulethela leli lizwe libe yilungelo lakho.

Yabelana izwe phakathi kwamaqembu akho ngokushaya inkontileka. Nceda unike inkontileka enkulu kumaqembu amakhulu futhi inkontileka encane kumaqembu amancane. Noma yisiphi isifunda lapho inkontileka iphuma khona kunoma iyiphi inkontileka izobe yaba yabo. Yabelana phakathi kwamaqembu obaba bakho
Uma ningawakhuphula amadolobha ayo, labo abashiyeyo bazobe yizicubu ezinhliziyweni zenu, namahlombe enkundleni yenu; futhi bazoba yingozi yenu ezweni elihlala kulona.
Ngakho ngizokwenza kuwe lokho engicabanga ukuthi ngizokwenza kubo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 25"Ubatshele abantu bakaSirayeli ukuthi: Uma nifika ezweni laseKanana, leli yizwe elizobe linikezwa wena njengomhlaba wakho womndeni.
Icala lakho lasenyakatho lizohlanganisa nengxenye yesiqhingi sase-Zin, ngaphesheya komgwaqo wase-Edom. Enyakatho, umgwaqo wakho osenyakatho uzoqala engxenyeni esenyakatho yolwandle olufile.
ibuye ibe ngasempumalanga yeSkorpion Pass, iqhubekele eZin, ihambe ngasempumalanga yeKadeshe-barnea, iphele eHazar Addar, ifike eAzmon.
Kusuka e-Azmon izoshintsha ibheke emfuleni ogwini lwe-Egypt futhi iphele eMfula iMedithera.
Umkhawulo wakho wasenyakatho uzobe ulwandle lwaseMedithera. Lokhu kuzoba umkhawulo wakho enyakatho.
Isifunda sakho sasentshonalanga, cindezela umgwaqo osuka eMedithera kuya eMount Hor
futhi kusukela emfuleni uHori, kuze kube yilapho kungena khona eHamati; futhi umkhawulo uzodlula eSedadi,
bese udlula eSiphroni, uphele eHazari-enani. Lokhu kuzobe yimikhawulo yenu yasenyakatho.
Isifunda sakho sasenyakatho, zobambisa umgwaqo osuka eHazar Enan ufike eShepham.
Kuze kube yilapho umkhawulo usuka eShepham udlula eRibla, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeAyin. Kuze kube yilapho umkhawulo usuka khona ezindaweni ezisempumalanga zolwandle lwaseGaliliya.
Uzodlula emfuleni iYorodani, ufike esiphethweni saso eMfula iYorodani. Lokhu kuzobe yizwe lenu, kanye nezindawo eziphakathi kwayo zonke.
UMoses wamisa oonyana bakaSirayeli, wathi, Le yilizwe lokuthi niyihlukanise phakathi kwenu ngesinqumo, njengoba iNkosi ewiselayo ukuba linikezelwe izizwe eziyisishiyagalombili nengxenye.
Ngokuba isizwe sakwaRubheni, nesizwe sakwaGadi, ngezindlu zazo, kanye nengxenye yesizwe samaManase, bathole impahla yabo.
Lezi zinhlanga ezimbili nengxenye zazo zithole inhlalakahle yazo ngasenyakatho yeJordani, eduze kweJericho, enyakatho-mpumalanga.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
Lawona amagama amadoda azowahlukanisela izwe phakathi kwenu: u-Eleazar umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNuni.
Khetha futhi umholi owodwa wesizwe ngasinye ukuze usize ukuhlukanisa izwe.
Lawona amagama abo: ezweni likaYuda, uKhalebe unyana kaJefune.
ezweni likaSimeoni, uShemuyeli unyana ka-Amihudi.
Ezweni likaBhenjamini, nguEliyada unyana kaKislon.
Kusuka ezweni likaDan, umholi Bukki unyana kaJogli.
Kwabesilisa oonyana bakaYosefu: kwesifundazwe sikaManase, uHaniyeli unyana ka-Efodi;
futhi ezweni lika-Ephrayim, umholi uKemuyeli unyana kaShiftana.
Ezweni likaZebulun, uMengameli uElizaphane unyana kaFarna.
Ezweni lika-Issakha, umholi uPalthiyeli unyana ka-Azzan.
Ezweni lika-Ashere, umholi u-Ahhude unyana kaShelomi.
Kwesifundazwe sakwaNaphtali: umholi uPedaheli, unyana ka-Amihudi.
Lokho wukuthi, abantu abashiwo nguYehova ukuba bahlukanise izwe likaKanana phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wakhuluma iNkosi kuMoses, ezindaweni ezihlabani zakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan enkabeni kaJericho, wathi,
Wathi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 24"Ubambisene nabantu bakaSirayeli ukuthi banike amaLevi amadolobha azohlala kuwo ezweni labo lempahla yabo; futhi babe nezindawo eziphakathi kwalawo madolobha.
Lawa madolobha azobe ehlala kuwo, futhi izindlu zangasese zizobe zikhona ezilwaneni zabo, nezingulube zabo, nazo zonke izinja zabo.
Izindawo zokudlela zedolobhana ngalinye, ongazinika labo abaLevi, kufanele zifinyelele emgwaqweni womgwaqo wedolobha, kuze kube ngamasentimitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili.

Ngaphesheya komgwaqo, ulinganisele imitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni esenyakatho, nemitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni esenyakatho, nemitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni esenyakatho, nemitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni yasenyakatho, nomgwaqo ubephakathi. Lokhu kuzobe yindawo yabo yokudla.

Ezindaweni eziyisishiyagalombili nizozinikela kulabo abaLevi, zibe yizindawo zokuphepha, ukuze umuntu obulalayo akwazi ukungena kuzo; naphezu kwalezi zidolobhana zinikelwe izizwe ezimashumi amane anembini.
Zonke lezi zidolobhana nizozinikela kumaLevi, zibe yizindawo ezingu-48 kanye nezifunda zawo.

Nasezindaweni zedolobhana ongazinikela ngazo kumaLevi, ezweni lamadodana kaSirayeli, kulowo owake waba mkhulu, uthathe amadolobha amaningi, futhi kulowo owake waba ncane, uthathe amadolobhana ambalwa; isizwe ngasinye sizonikela ngamaLevi emadolobheni ayo, ngokuya ngomhlaba wayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMosesi,
"Ubatshele izingane zakwaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nidlula iJordani ezweni lakwaKanana,
Khetha amanye amadolobhana abe ngamadolobhana akho okuphepha. Umntu obulala umuntu ngengozi angahamba khona ukuvikela.
Lezi zifundazwe zizobe ziyindawo ephephile yomndeni ofuna ukukhokhela emuva ukubulala, ukuze umuntu ophenywa ngokubulala angafa ngaphambi kokuba abhekene necala phambi kweqembu.
Izindawo eziyisishiyagalombili ozozinika zizobe ziyizindawo zakho eziphephile.
Amadolobha amathathu azobe enyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, amadolobha amathathu azobe ezweni laseKanana; amadolobhana okuthula azoba khona.

Lawa madolobhana ayisishiyagalombili azobe ephephile kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, nalabo abavela kwamanye amazwe, nalowo ohlala phakathi kwabo, ukuze wonke umuntu onquma ukubulala umuntu ngephutha, ahambe khona.
Kodwa uma umuntu eshaya omunye umuntu ngento yensimbi, futhi lowo muntu efile, yena ngumuntu obulalayo. Umbulalayo kumele abulawa.
Uma umuntu enetshe esandla sakhe, elingakwazi ukubulala, lishaya omunye umuntu, futhi lowo muntu aphile, yena ngumuntu obulalayo. Lo muntu obulalayo kumele abulawa.
Uma umuntu enesitho somthi esandleni sakhe esingabulala, futhi eshaya omunye umuntu futhi lowo muntu efile, yena uyisisulu. Isisulu kufanele sibulawa.
Umngane okhokhela ukubulala kufanele asuse umbulalayo ngokwakhe. Uma etholakele, kufanele asuse umbulalayo.
Uma umuntu ecindezela omunye umuntu ngenxa yokuthi uyamthanda, noma ethutha enye into kuye ngenhloso kusukela endaweni yokufihla, ukuze aphile,

noma, uma ebulala umuntu ngesandla sakhe ngenxa yobugebengu, ukuze aphile, lowo obulalayo kumele abulawe; yena ngumuntu obulalayo. Uma umndeni womuntu obulalayo ethola lo muntu obulalayo, kufanele amfeze.
Kodwa-ke, umuntu angase acindezele omunye umuntu ngasikhathi sinye ngaphandle kokukhohlisa yena, noma athole into kuye ngaphandle kokwenza isinqumo,
noma, ngaphandle kokubona yena, throw phezu kwakhe itshe elincane ngokwanele ukubulala, ukuze aphele, futhi akayena umfowabo wakhe, futhi akazange afuna ukubuhlungu.
Ngakho-ke iqembu kumele ligweme phakathi komuntu obulalayo nomndeni ofuna ukukhokhela ukubulala, ngokuya ngalezi mithetho.

Umphakathi kufanele ugweme umsolwa wokubulala emndenini ofuna ukuxosha, futhi wambuyisele edolobhaneni lakhe eliphephile lapho waphuma khona; kumele ahlale khona kuze kube yilapho umpristi omkhulu ohlotshiswe ngowoyela ongcwele efa.
Kodwa uma umuntu ophenywe ngokubulala efika ngaphandle komkhawulo wedolobha eliphephile lapho ehamba khona,
futhi umngane wakhe atholakale ngaphandle kwedolobha, wabulala yena, umngane wakhe ngeke abe necala lokufa.
Uzohlala edolobhaneni lakhe eliphephile, kuze kube sekufa umbingeleli omkhulu; kodwa ngemuva kokufa kombingeleli omkhulu, uzobuya ezweni lakhe.
Lezo zinto ziyimithetho nemibandela yenu, nemindeni yenu yonke, lapho nihlala khona.
Uma umuntu ebulala umuntu, kufanele abulawe njengomuntu obulalayo ngokusho kwamasosha. Akukho mntu ozodlalwa ngokusho kwasosha olunye kuphela.
Musani ukuthatha inhlawulo yokubulala umuntu ofanele ukufa; kufanele abulawa.
Uma umuntu ephuma emzini wakhe wokuvikela, ngeke nithathe inkontileka yokumvumela ukuthi abuye ahlale ezweni lakhe, ngaphambi kokuba umpristi omkhulu aphele.
Ngakho-ke, ukubulala kuyinhlekelele yezwe. Nokho, akukho lutho oluzolungisa izwe phambi kuka-Allah uma umuntu ebulawa, ngaphandle kokufa komuntu obulalayo.
Mhlawumbe niyihlanze izwe lapho nihlala khona, izwe lapho ngihlala khona; ngoba mina iNkosi ngihlala phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Bafike abaphathi bezindlu zakwaGileyadi, uGileyadi indodana kaMakhire, indodana kaManase, ezindaweni zomndeni wakwaYosefu; bakhuluma kuMoses, nabaphathi, abaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli.

Bathi, Nkosi yami, iNkosi akuwisela umthetho wokuthi uhlukanise izwe phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ngokufaka isikhunta; futhi iNkosi akuwisela umthetho wokuthi ubenike izwe likaZelofehadi, umngane wethu, izingane zakhe.
Uma behlala ezindaweni ezahlukene zakwaSirayeli, khona-ke izwe labo lizothathwa ezweni lemindeni yethu, futhi lizofakwa ezweni lesifundazwe lapho bazohlala khona; ngakho sizoba nengxenye encane.
Uma unyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili wamadodana kaSirayeli ufika, khona-ke izwe labo lizofakwa ezweni lesifundazwe esibophezela kulo; futhi lizothathwa ezweni lesifundazwe sababa bethu.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli, ngokusho komthetho kaYehova, wathi, Isizwe sabantwana bakaYosefu sikhuluma kahle.
Lokhu wumthetho kaYehova mayelana nezingane zikaZelofehadi, ethi: Bazokwazi ukushada nalowo abawuthandayo; uma nje befuna ukushada nomuntu osuka emndenini wesizwe soyise wabo.
Akufanele izwe ezweni lakwaSirayeli lidlule kusuka kuhlanga elilodwa kuya kolunye; wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli kufanele agcine izwe leqembu lakhe.
Intombazane ngayinye, uma ithola isizwe ezweni lamadodana kaSirayeli, kufanele ibe nguwesifazane wesizwe sikayise, ukuze wonke amadodana kaSirayeli athole isizwe sabafazi bakhe.
Akukho lizwe elizodluliswa kusuka emndenini owodwa kuya komunye, ngoba wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli kufanele agcine izwe lakhe.
Wakwenza ke uZelofehadi, njengoba iNkosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Namadodakazi kaZelofehadi, uMahala, noThirsa, noHogela, noMilka, noNowa, bashada nabangani babo bomndeni wabo.
Bathe bazalwa uManase, indodana kaYosefu; futhi izwe labo lahlala emndenini nosukundelweni bukababa babo.
Lawa amalungiselelo, nalawo mthetho, akhuluma ngawo iNkosi kuboSirayeli ngesandla sikaMoses, ezindaweni ezingenamanzi zaseMowabi, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeYorodani, eJericho.
